package com.example.aas.art;

/**
 * Pure geometry shared by the server (validation / clamping) and the client (selection preview).
 * Everything is in world blocks on the XZ plane. No Minecraft classes, so it is safe on both sides.
 */
public final class ArtGeometry {
    private ArtGeometry() {}

    /** Moves (x, z) into the circle (cx, cz, r) if it lies outside, returns {x, z}. */
    public static double[] clampToCircle(double x, double z, double cx, double cz, double r) {
        double dx = x - cx, dz = z - cz;
        double d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d <= r || d < 1e-9) return new double[]{x, z};
        double k = r / d;
        return new double[]{cx + dx * k, cz + dz * k};
    }

    /** True if the whole circle (x, z, r) lies inside the circle (cx, cz, R). */
    public static boolean circleInside(double x, double z, double r, double cx, double cz, double R) {
        return Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz) + r <= R + 1e-6;
    }

    /** Largest width such that the whole rectangle A->B (given width) stays inside the circle (cx, cz, R). */
    public static double maxWidthInside(double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double cx, double cz, double R) {
        double dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
        double len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (len < 1e-9) return 0;
        double nx = -dz / len, nz = dx / len;
        double lo = 0, hi = 2 * R;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            double mid = (lo + hi) / 2, s = mid / 2;
            if (cornersInside(ax, az, bx, bz, nx, nz, s, cx, cz, R)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    public static boolean rectInside(double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double width, double cx, double cz, double R) {
        double dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
        double len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (len < 1e-9) return false;
        double nx = -dz / len, nz = dx / len;
        return cornersInside(ax, az, bx, bz, nx, nz, width / 2, cx, cz, R + 1e-6);
    }

    private static boolean cornersInside(double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double nx, double nz, double s,
                                         double cx, double cz, double R) {
        return Math.hypot(ax + nx * s - cx, az + nz * s - cz) <= R
                && Math.hypot(ax - nx * s - cx, az - nz * s - cz) <= R
                && Math.hypot(bx + nx * s - cx, bz + nz * s - cz) <= R
                && Math.hypot(bx - nx * s - cx, bz - nz * s - cz) <= R;
    }

    /** The four corners of rectangle A->B with the given width: {x0,z0, x1,z1, x2,z2, x3,z3}. */
    public static double[] rectCorners(double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double width) {
        double dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
        double len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (len < 1e-9) return new double[]{ax, az, ax, az, ax, az, ax, az};
        double nx = -dz / len * width / 2, nz = dx / len * width / 2;
        return new double[]{ax + nx, az + nz, bx + nx, bz + nz, bx - nx, bz - nz, ax - nx, az - nz};
    }
}

package com.example.aas.art;


import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketArtNotice;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketPlaceRadialMarker;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncArtillery;
import com.example.aas.uav.UavRules;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.mojang.logging.LogUtils;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.TicketType;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.ChunkPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.ForgeRegistries;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Server-side artillery: requests (SL), strike launch (CMD), the strike state machine and the per-player sync.
 * All rules live here; the client only sends intents and draws what PacketSyncArtillery gives it.
 * Friendly fire is ON by design: shells hurt everybody, nothing protects the own team.
 */
public final class ArtManager {
    private ArtManager() {}

    private static final Logger LOGGER = LogUtils.getLogger();
    private static final ResourceLocation SHELL_ID = new ResourceLocation("superbwarfare", "mortar_shell");
    public static final TicketType<ChunkPos> ART_TICKET =
            TicketType.create("aas_art", Comparator.comparingLong(ChunkPos::toLong), 100);

    /** Pause between two spotting shells (ticks). Not configurable on purpose: it only shapes the spotting phase. */
    public static final int SPOT_INTERVAL_TICKS = 40;
    private static final double GOLDEN_ANGLE = Math.PI * (3.0 - Math.sqrt(5.0));
    private static final int RESYNC_TICKS = 40;

    private static EntityType<?> shellType;
    private static boolean warned;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ availability
    private static EntityType<?> shellType() {
        if (shellType != null) return shellType;
        // getValue() on a defaulted registry returns a fallback entity for unknown ids, so check the key first
        if (ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.containsKey(SHELL_ID)) {
            shellType = ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.getValue(SHELL_ID);
            return shellType;
        }
        if (!warned) {
            warned = true;
            LOGGER.warn("[AAS] Entity superbwarfare:mortar_shell was not found (Superb Warfare not loaded?). Artillery is disabled.");
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean isAvailable() { return shellType() != null; }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ config helpers
    public static double requestRadius() { return AASConfig.ART_REQUEST_RADIUS.get(); }
    private static int circleMin() { return AASConfig.ART_CIRCLE_MIN_RADIUS.get(); }
    private static int circleMax() { return Math.max(circleMin(), AASConfig.ART_CIRCLE_MAX_RADIUS.get()); }
    private static int rectMinLen() { return AASConfig.ART_RECT_MIN_LENGTH.get(); }
    private static int rectMaxLen() { return Math.max(rectMinLen(), AASConfig.ART_RECT_MAX_LENGTH.get()); }
    private static int rectMinWidth() { return AASConfig.ART_RECT_MIN_WIDTH.get(); }
    private static int rectMaxWidth() { return Math.max(rectMinWidth(), AASConfig.ART_RECT_MAX_WIDTH.get()); }

    private static String fmt(long ticks) {
        long sec = (ticks + 19) / 20;
        return String.format("%d:%02d", sec / 60, sec % 60);
    }

    private static boolean fail(ServerPlayer p, String key) {
        p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg." + key), true);
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ stage 1: request (SL)
    /**
     * Called from PacketPlaceRadialMarker (TYPE_ART_REQUEST). Raycast is server-side only, from the player's
     * eye along his look vector, up to artRequestMaxDistance blocks over loaded chunks.
     */
    public static boolean tryCreateRequest(ServerPlayer p, Vec3 eye, Vec3 look) {
        return tryCreateRequest(p, eye, look, AASConfig.ART_REQUEST_MAX_DISTANCE.get());
    }

    /** Same, but with an explicit ray length: the UAV camera passes PacketPlaceRadialMarker.UAV_REACH. */
    public static boolean tryCreateRequest(ServerPlayer p, Vec3 eye, Vec3 look, double reach) {
        ServerLevel level = p.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);

        if (!ArtRules.isSquadLeader(p)) return fail(p, "not_sl");
        if (!isAvailable()) return fail(p, "disabled");
        if (!d.isGameStarted) return fail(p, "not_started");

        long now = level.getGameTime();
        long cdEnd = ArtRules.requestCooldownEnd(d, p.getUUID());
        if (now < cdEnd) {
            p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg.cooldown", fmt(cdEnd - now)), true);
            return false;
        }
        if (ArtRules.requestOf(d, p.getUUID()) != null) return fail(p, "has_request");

        double len = PacketPlaceRadialMarker.loadedReach(level, eye, look, reach);
        Vec3 end = eye.add(look.scale(len));
        BlockHitResult hit = level.clip(new ClipContext(eye, end, ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER, ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, p));
        if (hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) return fail(p, "no_target");

        BlockPos pos = hit.getBlockPos();
        double x = pos.getX() + 0.5, z = pos.getZ() + 0.5;
        if (!level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(x, z)) return fail(p, "bad_position");
        if (d.mapSizeBlocks > 0) {
            double half = d.mapSizeBlocks / 2.0;
            if (Math.abs(x - d.mapCenterX) > half || Math.abs(z - d.mapCenterZ) > half) return fail(p, "bad_position");
        }

        long expire = now + AASConfig.ART_REQUEST_CONFIRM_SECONDS.get() * 20L;
        d.artRequests.add(new ArtRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), p.getUUID(), p.getScoreboardName(), team, pos.immutable(),
                ArtRequest.PENDING, expire));
        d.setDirty();
        syncAll(level);
        p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg.requested"), true);
        return true;
    }

    /** Confirm or cancel of the owner's own PENDING request. Works while dead or downed. */
    public static void handleAction(ServerPlayer p, UUID id, boolean confirm) {
        ServerLevel level = p.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);
        ArtRequest r = ArtRules.findRequest(d, id);
        if (r == null || !UavRules.isTeam(team)) return;
        if (!r.ownerUuid.equals(p.getUUID()) || !r.team.equals(team)) return;
        if (r.status != ArtRequest.PENDING) return;

        long now = level.getGameTime();
        if (!confirm || now >= r.expireTick) {          // cancel, or too late: no cooldown either way
            d.artRequests.remove(r);
            d.setDirty();
            syncAll(level);
            return;
        }
        if (!d.isGameStarted || !isAvailable()) return;

        r.status = ArtRequest.CONFIRMED;
        r.expireTick = now + AASConfig.ART_REQUEST_LIFETIME_SECONDS.get() * 20L;
        // this SL's own REQUEST cooldown starts at the moment of confirmation
        d.artCooldownEnd.put(p.getUUID(), now + AASConfig.ART_REQUEST_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.get() * 20L);
        d.setDirty();
        notifyCommanders(level, d, r);
        syncAll(level);
    }

    private static void notifyCommanders(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d, ArtRequest r) {
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (!UavRules.teamOf(p).equals(r.team) || !ArtRules.isCommander(p, d)) continue;
            if (p.getUUID().equals(r.ownerUuid)) continue;     // the CMD does not need a notice about his own request
            p.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg.confirmed", r.ownerName).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD));
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), new PacketArtNotice(r.ownerName));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ stage 2-4: launch (CMD)
    /** typeOrdinal: 0 = circle, 1 = rectangle. Every number is clamped / re-checked here, never trusted. */
    public static boolean tryLaunch(ServerPlayer p, UUID requestId, int typeOrdinal,
                                    double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double size) {
        ServerLevel level = p.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);

        if (!UavRules.isTeam(team) || !ArtRules.isCommander(p, d)) return fail(p, "not_commander");
        if (!isAvailable()) return fail(p, "disabled");
        if (!d.isGameStarted) return fail(p, "not_started");

        long now = level.getGameTime();
        long strikeCdEnd = ArtRules.strikeCooldownEnd(d, team);
        if (now < strikeCdEnd) {                       // the strike cooldown is shared by the whole team
            p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg.strike_cooldown", fmt(strikeCdEnd - now)), true);
            return false;
        }
        ArtRequest r = ArtRules.findRequest(d, requestId);
        if (r == null || r.status != ArtRequest.CONFIRMED || !r.team.equals(team) || now >= r.expireTick) return fail(p, "no_request");
        if (typeOrdinal < 0 || typeOrdinal > 1) return fail(p, "bad_geometry");
        if (!Double.isFinite(ax) || !Double.isFinite(az) || !Double.isFinite(bx) || !Double.isFinite(bz) || !Double.isFinite(size)) {
            return fail(p, "bad_geometry");
        }

        double cx = r.centerX(), cz = r.centerZ(), R = requestRadius();
        long seed = level.random.nextLong();
        ArtStrike strike;

        // The request circle limits ONLY the anchor point (circle centre / rectangle start).
        // The strike itself (radius, length, width) may reach outside of it.
        double[] a = ArtGeometry.clampToCircle(ax, az, cx, cz, R);

        if (typeOrdinal == 0) {
            double rad = Mth.clamp(size, circleMin(), circleMax());
            strike = new ArtStrike(UUID.randomUUID(), ArtStrike.Type.CIRCLE, team, p.getUUID(), a[0], a[1], 0, 0, rad, seed);
        } else {
            double dx = bx - a[0], dz = bz - a[1];
            double len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
            if (len < 1e-3) return fail(p, "bad_geometry");
            double nl = Mth.clamp(len, rectMinLen(), rectMaxLen());
            double ex = a[0] + dx / len * nl, ez = a[1] + dz / len * nl;
            double w = Mth.clamp(size, rectMinWidth(), rectMaxWidth());
            strike = new ArtStrike(UUID.randomUUID(), ArtStrike.Type.RECT, team, p.getUUID(), a[0], a[1], ex, ez, w, seed);
        }

        d.artRequests.remove(r);            // one request = one strike; the circle disappears at once
        if (team.equals("BLUE")) d.blueArtStrikeCdEnd = now + AASConfig.ART_STRIKE_COOLDOWN_MINUTES.get() * 1200L;
        else d.redArtStrikeCdEnd = now + AASConfig.ART_STRIKE_COOLDOWN_MINUTES.get() * 1200L;
        d.activeStrikes.add(strike);
        d.setDirty();
        for (ServerPlayer t : level.players()) {
            if (UavRules.teamOf(t).equals(team)) {
                t.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg.launched").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
            }
        }
        syncAll(level);
        return true;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ tick
    public static void tickLevel(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        long now = level.getGameTime();
        boolean changed = false;

        Iterator<ArtRequest> rit = d.artRequests.iterator();
        while (rit.hasNext()) {
            ArtRequest r = rit.next();
            if (now < r.expireTick) continue;
            rit.remove();                    // timed out: PENDING without cooldown, CONFIRMED simply unused
            changed = true;
            ServerPlayer owner = level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(r.ownerUuid);
            if (owner != null) owner.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.art.msg.expired"), true);
        }

        Iterator<ArtStrike> sit = d.activeStrikes.iterator();
        while (sit.hasNext()) {
            ArtStrike s = sit.next();
            if (tickStrike(level, s)) changed = true;
            if (s.stage >= ArtStrike.STAGE_DONE) { sit.remove(); changed = true; }
        }
        if (!d.activeStrikes.isEmpty()) d.setDirty();   // phaseTick / shellsFired are saved state

        if (changed) {
            d.setDirty();
            syncAll(level);
        } else if (now % RESYNC_TICKS == 0) {            // safety resync: role changes, late joins
            syncAll(level);
        }
    }

    /** @return true when the strike moved to the next stage. */
    private static boolean tickStrike(ServerLevel level, ArtStrike s) {
        int len = stageLen(s);
        boolean shooting = s.stage == ArtStrike.STAGE_SPOT || s.isSalvoStage();
        int n = shooting ? shellCount(s) : 0;

        if (shooting) {
            while (s.shellsFired < n && s.phaseTick >= dueTick(s, s.shellsFired, n, len)) {
                fireShell(level, s, s.shellsFired, n);
                s.shellsFired++;
            }
        }
        s.phaseTick++;
        if (s.phaseTick < len) return false;

        if (shooting) {
            while (s.shellsFired < n) { fireShell(level, s, s.shellsFired, n); s.shellsFired++; }
        }
        s.stage++;
        s.phaseTick = 0;
        s.shellsFired = 0;
        return true;
    }

    private static int shellCount(ArtStrike s) {
        boolean circle = s.type == ArtStrike.Type.CIRCLE;
        if (s.stage == ArtStrike.STAGE_SPOT) {
            return circle ? AASConfig.ART_CIRCLE_SPOT_SHELLS.get() : AASConfig.ART_RECT_SPOT_SHELLS.get();
        }
        return circle ? AASConfig.ART_CIRCLE_SALVO_SHELLS.get() : AASConfig.ART_RECT_SALVO_SHELLS.get();
    }

    private static int stageLen(ArtStrike s) {
        return switch (s.stage) {
            case ArtStrike.STAGE_SPOT -> Math.max(1, shellCount(s) * SPOT_INTERVAL_TICKS);
            case ArtStrike.STAGE_SILENCE -> AASConfig.ART_SILENCE_SECONDS.get() * 20;
            case 2, 4, 6 -> Math.max(1, AASConfig.ART_SALVO_SECONDS.get() * 20);
            default -> AASConfig.ART_REST_SECONDS.get() * 20;
        };
    }

    /** Tick (inside the stage) at which shell k is due: spotting is paced, a salvo is spread evenly over its length. */
    private static int dueTick(ArtStrike s, int k, int n, int len) {
        if (s.stage == ArtStrike.STAGE_SPOT) return k * SPOT_INTERVAL_TICKS;
        return (int) ((long) k * len / n);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ shells
    private static void fireShell(ServerLevel level, ArtStrike s, int k, int n) {
        double[] p = s.stage == ArtStrike.STAGE_SPOT ? spotPos(level, s) : salvoPos(level, s, k, n);
        spawnShell(level, p[0], p[1]);
    }

    /** Spotting shells land near the centre of a circle / near the start of a rectangle. */
    private static double[] spotPos(ServerLevel level, ArtStrike s) {
        if (s.type == ArtStrike.Type.CIRCLE) {
            double r = s.size * 0.25 * Math.sqrt(level.random.nextDouble());
            double a = level.random.nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2;
            return new double[]{s.ax + Math.cos(a) * r, s.az + Math.sin(a) * r};
        }
        double dx = s.bx - s.ax, dz = s.bz - s.az, len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        double ux = dx / len, uz = dz / len;
        double along = level.random.nextDouble() * len * 0.15;
        double across = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * s.size * 0.5;
        return new double[]{s.ax + ux * along - uz * across, s.az + uz * along + ux * across};
    }

    private static double[] salvoPos(ServerLevel level, ArtStrike s, int k, int n) {
        long sd = s.seed + 31L * s.salvoIndex();
        if (s.type == ArtStrike.Type.CIRCLE) {
            // Vogel spiral = even density over the area; the index is scrambled so that consecutive shells are far apart
            int idx = scramble(k, n, sd);
            double rr = s.size * Math.sqrt((idx + 0.5) / n);
            double th = idx * GOLDEN_ANGLE + hash01(sd) * Math.PI * 2;
            double j = s.size / Math.sqrt(n) * 0.35;
            double x = s.ax + Math.cos(th) * rr + (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * j;
            double z = s.az + Math.sin(th) * rr + (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * j;
            return ArtGeometry.clampToCircle(x, z, s.ax, s.az, s.size);
        }
        // rectangle: impacts walk from the start to the end, spread across the width
        double dx = s.bx - s.ax, dz = s.bz - s.az, len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        double ux = dx / len, uz = dz / len;
        double along = Mth.clamp((k + 0.5) / n * len + (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * len / n * 0.6, 0, len);
        double frac = ((k + 0.5) * 0.7548776662466927 + hash01(sd)) % 1.0;
        double half = s.size / 2;
        double across = Mth.clamp((frac - 0.5) * s.size + (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * s.size * 0.1, -half, half);
        return new double[]{s.ax + ux * along - uz * across, s.az + uz * along + ux * across};
    }

    private static int scramble(int k, int n, long seed) {
        if (n <= 1) return 0;
        int stride = Math.max(1, (int) (n * 0.6180339887)) | 1;
        while (gcd(stride, n) != 1) stride++;
        int offset = (int) Math.floorMod(seed >>> 8, (long) n);
        return (int) (((long) k * stride + offset) % n);
    }

    private static int gcd(int a, int b) { return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b); }

    /** Deterministic 0..1 value from a seed. */
    private static double hash01(long seed) {
        long h = seed * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;
        h ^= h >>> 29;
        h *= 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9L;
        return (h >>> 11) * (1.0 / (1L << 53));
    }

    private static void spawnShell(ServerLevel level, double x, double z) {
        EntityType<?> type = shellType();
        if (type == null) return;
        ChunkPos cp = new ChunkPos(Mth.floor(x) >> 4, Mth.floor(z) >> 4);
        // keep the target chunk ticking while the shell falls (same idea as the UAV flight tickets)
        level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(ART_TICKET, cp, 3, cp);
        level.getChunk(cp.x, cp.z);              // make sure the chunk exists before the entity is added (as UavManager does)

        Entity shell = type.create(level);
        if (shell == null) return;
        double y = Math.min(AASConfig.ART_SHELL_SPAWN_HEIGHT.get(), level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1);
        shell.setPos(x, y, z);
        shell.setDeltaMovement(Vec3.ZERO);      // from here the SBW physics takes over
        level.addFreshEntity(shell);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ match hooks
    public static void onMatchStart(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d) {
        d.artRequests.clear();
        d.activeStrikes.clear();
        d.artCooldownEnd.clear();
        // requests are available at once (personal cooldowns were cleared above); the STRIKE of both teams starts on cooldown
        // (artInitialCooldownMinutes). Before the match nothing can be thrown or launched: both calls check isGameStarted.
        long end = level.getGameTime() + AASConfig.ART_INITIAL_COOLDOWN_MINUTES.get() * 1200L;
        d.blueArtStrikeCdEnd = end;
        d.redArtStrikeCdEnd = end;
        d.setDirty();
        syncAll(level);
    }

    /** Test command: every cooldown (all SL request cooldowns + both team strike cooldowns) back to zero. */
    public static void resetCooldowns(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        d.artCooldownEnd.clear();
        d.blueArtStrikeCdEnd = 0;
        d.redArtStrikeCdEnd = 0;
        d.setDirty();
        syncAll(level);
    }

    public static void onMatchEnd(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d) {
        d.artRequests.clear();
        d.activeStrikes.clear();
        d.artCooldownEnd.clear();
        d.blueArtStrikeCdEnd = 0;
        d.redArtStrikeCdEnd = 0;
        d.setDirty();
        syncAll(level);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sync (filtered on the SERVER)
    public static void syncAll(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) send(p, d);
    }

    public static void syncPlayer(ServerPlayer p) {
        send(p, AASWorldData.get(p.serverLevel()));
    }

    /**
     * What a player may know:
     *  - PENDING request: its owner only.
     *  - CONFIRMED requests: the CMD and the SLs of the same team (observers / creative see all confirmed ones).
     *  - active strikes: the whole own team (observers / creative see all). The enemy gets nothing.
     */
    private static void send(ServerPlayer p, AASWorldData d) {
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);
        boolean teamed = UavRules.isTeam(team);
        boolean observer = p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator();
        boolean sl = teamed && ArtRules.isSquadLeader(p);
        boolean cmd = teamed && ArtRules.isCommander(p, d);

        List<ArtRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ArtRequest r : d.artRequests) {
            if (r.status == ArtRequest.PENDING) {
                if (r.ownerUuid.equals(p.getUUID())) requests.add(r);
            } else if (observer || (teamed && r.team.equals(team) && (cmd || sl))) {
                requests.add(r);
            }
        }
        List<ArtStrike> strikes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ArtStrike s : d.activeStrikes) {
            if (observer || (teamed && s.team.equals(team))) strikes.add(s);
        }
        long cooldownEnd = sl ? ArtRules.requestCooldownEnd(d, p.getUUID()) : 0L;
        long strikeCooldownEnd = teamed ? ArtRules.strikeCooldownEnd(d, team) : 0L;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p),
                new PacketSyncArtillery(isAvailable(), cooldownEnd, strikeCooldownEnd, requests, strikes));
    }
}

package com.example.aas.art;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;

import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * One artillery request of one squad leader. One request = one strike: it is deleted as soon as the strike starts.
 * PENDING: waits for the owner's confirmation (config: artRequestConfirmSeconds), visible to the owner only.
 * CONFIRMED: visible to the CMD and the squad leaders of the team until it is used or expireTick passes.
 */
public class ArtRequest {
    public static final int PENDING = 0;
    public static final int CONFIRMED = 1;

    public final UUID id;
    public final UUID ownerUuid;
    public final String ownerName;
    public final String team;
    public final BlockPos pos;
    public int status;
    /** Game time (ticks) at which the request disappears in its current status. */
    public long expireTick;

    public ArtRequest(UUID id, UUID ownerUuid, String ownerName, String team, BlockPos pos, int status, long expireTick) {
        this.id = id;
        this.ownerUuid = ownerUuid;
        this.ownerName = ownerName;
        this.team = team;
        this.pos = pos;
        this.status = status;
        this.expireTick = expireTick;
    }

    public double centerX() { return pos.getX() + 0.5; }
    public double centerZ() { return pos.getZ() + 0.5; }

    public CompoundTag save() {
        CompoundTag t = new CompoundTag();
        t.putUUID("Id", id);
        t.putUUID("Owner", ownerUuid);
        t.putString("OwnerName", ownerName);
        t.putString("Team", team);
        t.putLong("Pos", pos.asLong());
        t.putInt("Status", status);
        t.putLong("Expire", expireTick);
        return t;
    }

    public static ArtRequest load(CompoundTag t) {
        return new ArtRequest(t.getUUID("Id"), t.getUUID("Owner"), t.getString("OwnerName"), t.getString("Team"),
                BlockPos.of(t.getLong("Pos")), t.getInt("Status"), t.getLong("Expire"));
    }

    public void write(FriendlyByteBuf b) {
        b.writeUUID(id);
        b.writeUUID(ownerUuid);
        b.writeUtf(ownerName);
        b.writeUtf(team);
        b.writeBlockPos(pos);
        b.writeVarInt(status);
        b.writeLong(expireTick);
    }

    public static ArtRequest read(FriendlyByteBuf b) {
        return new ArtRequest(b.readUUID(), b.readUUID(), b.readUtf(), b.readUtf(), b.readBlockPos(), b.readVarInt(), b.readLong());
    }
}

package com.example.aas.art;

import com.example.aas.uav.UavRules;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;

import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Server-side permission and cooldown rules (two separate cooldowns: request = per SL, strike = per team) of the artillery. Mirrors UavRules, with ONE difference:
 * nothing here looks at isAlive / downed, so the CMD can call a strike and an SL can confirm or cancel
 * a request from the death screen.
 */
public final class ArtRules {
    private ArtRules() {}

    /** Squad leader (SL), not a fireteam leader. */
    public static boolean isSquadLeader(ServerPlayer p) {
        return UavRules.isTeam(UavRules.teamOf(p)) && p.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsSquadLeader");
    }

    /** CMD = leader of the team's CMD squad. */
    public static boolean isCommander(ServerPlayer p, AASWorldData d) {
        return UavRules.isCommander(p, d);
    }

    /** Personal cooldown of one SL for throwing a REQUEST (starts at the confirmation). */
    public static long requestCooldownEnd(AASWorldData d, UUID sl) {
        return d.artCooldownEnd.getOrDefault(sl, 0L);
    }

    /** Team-wide cooldown of the STRIKE itself (starts when the CMD launches a strike). */
    public static long strikeCooldownEnd(AASWorldData d, String team) {
        return team.equals("BLUE") ? d.blueArtStrikeCdEnd : d.redArtStrikeCdEnd;
    }

    public static ArtRequest findRequest(AASWorldData d, UUID id) {
        for (ArtRequest r : d.artRequests) if (r.id.equals(id)) return r;
        return null;
    }

    public static ArtRequest requestOf(AASWorldData d, UUID owner) {
        for (ArtRequest r : d.artRequests) if (r.ownerUuid.equals(owner)) return r;
        return null;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.art;

import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraftforge.event.TickEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

/** Forge hooks of the artillery: level tick and per-player sync (login, respawn, dimension change). */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas")
public class ArtServerEvents {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLevelTick(TickEvent.LevelTickEvent e) {
        if (e.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END || !(e.level instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        ArtManager.tickLevel(level);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogin(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) ArtManager.syncPlayer(p);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRespawn(PlayerEvent.PlayerRespawnEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) ArtManager.syncPlayer(p);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onDimension(PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) ArtManager.syncPlayer(p);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.art;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;

import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * An active artillery strike. Ticked on the server (ArtManager) and saved in AASWorldData.
 *
 * Geometry (all in world blocks):
 *  CIRCLE: (ax, az) = centre, size = radius, (bx, bz) unused.
 *  RECT:   (ax, az) = start, (bx, bz) = end, size = width. Shells fall from the start towards the end.
 *
 * Stages: 0 spotting, 1 silence, 2 salvo 1, 3 rest, 4 salvo 2, 5 rest, 6 salvo 3, 7 finished.
 */
public class ArtStrike {
    public enum Type { CIRCLE, RECT }

    public static final int STAGE_SPOT = 0;
    public static final int STAGE_SILENCE = 1;
    public static final int STAGE_DONE = 7;

    public final UUID id;
    public final Type type;
    public final String team;
    public final UUID ownerUuid;
    public final double ax, az, bx, bz, size;
    /** Seeds the shell scattering, saved so a restart continues the same pattern. */
    public final long seed;

    public int stage = STAGE_SPOT;
    /** Ticks spent in the current stage. */
    public int phaseTick = 0;
    /** Shells already fired in the current stage (spotting or salvo). */
    public int shellsFired = 0;

    public ArtStrike(UUID id, Type type, String team, UUID ownerUuid,
                     double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double size, long seed) {
        this.id = id;
        this.type = type;
        this.team = team;
        this.ownerUuid = ownerUuid;
        this.ax = ax; this.az = az; this.bx = bx; this.bz = bz;
        this.size = size;
        this.seed = seed;
    }

    public boolean isSalvoStage() { return stage == 2 || stage == 4 || stage == 6; }
    public int salvoIndex() { return (stage - 2) / 2; }

    public CompoundTag save() {
        CompoundTag t = new CompoundTag();
        t.putUUID("Id", id);
        t.putString("Type", type.name());
        t.putString("Team", team);
        t.putUUID("Owner", ownerUuid);
        t.putDouble("Ax", ax); t.putDouble("Az", az);
        t.putDouble("Bx", bx); t.putDouble("Bz", bz);
        t.putDouble("Size", size);
        t.putLong("Seed", seed);
        t.putInt("Stage", stage);
        t.putInt("PhaseTick", phaseTick);
        t.putInt("Fired", shellsFired);
        return t;
    }

    /** @return null for entries written by the old strike system (no "Type" key). */
    public static ArtStrike load(CompoundTag t) {
        if (!t.contains("Type") || !t.hasUUID("Id")) return null;
        Type type;
        try { type = Type.valueOf(t.getString("Type")); } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) { return null; }
        ArtStrike s = new ArtStrike(t.getUUID("Id"), type, t.getString("Team"), t.getUUID("Owner"),
                t.getDouble("Ax"), t.getDouble("Az"), t.getDouble("Bx"), t.getDouble("Bz"), t.getDouble("Size"), t.getLong("Seed"));
        s.stage = t.getInt("Stage");
        s.phaseTick = t.getInt("PhaseTick");
        s.shellsFired = t.getInt("Fired");
        return s;
    }

    /** Network form: only what the client draws. */
    public void write(FriendlyByteBuf b) {
        b.writeUUID(id);
        b.writeVarInt(type.ordinal());
        b.writeUtf(team);
        b.writeDouble(ax); b.writeDouble(az);
        b.writeDouble(bx); b.writeDouble(bz);
        b.writeDouble(size);
        b.writeVarInt(stage);
    }

    public static ArtStrike read(FriendlyByteBuf b) {
        UUID id = b.readUUID();
        Type type = Type.values()[Math.floorMod(b.readVarInt(), Type.values().length)];
        String team = b.readUtf();
        ArtStrike s = new ArtStrike(id, type, team, new UUID(0, 0),
                b.readDouble(), b.readDouble(), b.readDouble(), b.readDouble(), b.readDouble(), 0L);
        s.stage = b.readVarInt();
        return s;
    }
}

            }
        }
        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving);
    }

    private void detonate(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (be instanceof AmmoStackBlockEntity ammoBe) {
                ammoBe.clear();
            }
            int count = state.getValue(MAGS);
            float power = count * 1.5F;
            level.removeBlock(pos, false);

            // РљРћРќР¤РР“
            boolean canDestroy = AASConfig.AMMO_STACK_DESTRUCTION.get();
            Level.ExplosionInteraction interaction = canDestroy ? Level.ExplosionInteraction.TNT : Level.ExplosionInteraction.NONE;

            level.explode(null, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, power, interaction);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onProjectileHit(Level level, BlockState state, BlockHitResult hit, Projectile projectile) {
        if (!level.isClientSide && (projectile.isOnFire() || projectile.getDeltaMovement().length() > 0.5)) {
            detonate(level, hit.getBlockPos(), state);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onBlockExploded(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Explosion explosion) {
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            detonate(level, pos, state);
        }
        super.onBlockExploded(state, level, pos, explosion);
    }

    @Override public VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) { return SHAPE; }
    @Override public VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) { return Shapes.empty(); }
    @Override public boolean canSurvive(BlockState state, LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) { return Block.canSupportCenter(level, pos.below(), Direction.UP); }

    @Override
    public BlockState updateShape(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighborState, LevelAccessor level, BlockPos currentPos, BlockPos neighborPos) {
        if (!state.canSurvive(level, currentPos)) return Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
        return super.updateShape(state, direction, neighborState, level, currentPos, neighborPos);
    }

    @Nullable @Override public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
        return this.defaultBlockState().setValue(FACING, context.getHorizontalDirection().getOpposite());
    }

    // === Р—РђРџРРЎР¬ РџР Р РЈРЎРўРђРќРћР’РљР• ===
    @Override
    public void setPlacedBy(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack stack) {
        super.setPlacedBy(level, pos, state, placer, stack);
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (be instanceof AmmoStackBlockEntity ammoBe) {
                // Р•СЃР»Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРѕРІС‹Р№ (РЅРµС‚ С‚РµРіР°) -> getAmmo РІРµСЂРЅРµС‚ 30.
                // Р•СЃР»Рё СЃС‚Р°СЂС‹Р№ (РµСЃС‚СЊ С‚РµРі) -> РІРµСЂРЅРµС‚ СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ.
                int ammo = AGSAmmoItem.getAmmo(stack);
                ammoBe.addAmmoBox(ammo);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) { builder.add(MAGS, FACING); }

    @Override
    public InteractionResult use(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, InteractionHand hand, BlockHitResult hit) {
        ItemStack heldItem = player.getItemInHand(hand);
        int count = state.getValue(MAGS);

        BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
        if (!(be instanceof AmmoStackBlockEntity ammoBe)) return InteractionResult.FAIL;

        // === 1. Р—РђР‘Р РђРўР¬ РљРћР РћР‘РљРЈ (Shift+РџРљРњ) ===
        if (player.isShiftKeyDown()) {
            if (!level.isClientSide) {
                int ammoInside = ammoBe.removeTopAmmoBox();

                ItemStack returnStack = new ItemStack(ModItems.AGS_AMMO.get());
                AGSAmmoItem.setAmmo(returnStack, ammoInside);

                if (!player.getInventory().add(returnStack)) player.drop(returnStack, false);
                level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.ITEM_PICKUP, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);

                if (count > 1) {
                    level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(MAGS, count - 1), 3);
                } else {
                    level.removeBlock(pos, false);
                }
            }
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        // === 2. Р”РћР‘РђР’РРўР¬ РљРћР РћР‘РљРЈ (РџРљРњ) ===
        if (heldItem.getItem() == ModItems.AGS_AMMO.get()) {
            if (count < 4) {
                if (!level.isClientSide) {
                    // Р§РµСЃС‚РЅРѕ С‡РёС‚Р°РµРј, СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ РІ СЂСѓРєРµ
                    int ammoInHand = AGSAmmoItem.getAmmo(heldItem);
                    // Р§РµСЃС‚РЅРѕ РєР»Р°РґРµРј РІ Р±Р»РѕРє
                    ammoBe.addAmmoBox(ammoInHand);

                    if (!player.isCreative()) heldItem.shrink(1);
                    level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(MAGS, count + 1), 3);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.METAL_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                }
                return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
            } else return InteractionResult.FAIL;
        }
        return InteractionResult.PASS;
    }
}

public class AGSConstructionBlock extends BaseEntityBlock {
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = DirectionProperty.create("facing", Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL);
    public static final BooleanProperty VALID = BooleanProperty.create("valid");
    private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = Block.box(0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16);

    public AGSConstructionBlock() {
        super(Properties.of().strength(1.0f).noOcclusion());
        this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH).setValue(VALID, true));
    }

    @Override

        return Shapes.empty();
    }

    @Override
    public VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
        return SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, VALID);
    }

    @Override
    public RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState state) { return RenderShape.MODEL; }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return new AGSConstructionBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(Level level, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        return createTickerHelper(type, ModBlocks.AGS_CONSTRUCTION_BE.get(), AGSConstructionBlockEntity::tick);
    }

    // === Р›РћР“РРљРђ РЎРџРђР’РќРђ Р“РћРўРћР’РћР“Рћ РђР“РЎ ===
    public void finishConstruction(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        AGS30Entity gun = new AGS30Entity(level, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY(), pos.getZ() + 0.5);

        // РџРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµРј РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёРµ, РєСѓРґР° СЃРјРѕС‚СЂРµР» С‡РµСЂС‚РµР¶ (РїСЂРёР·СЂР°Рє)
        Direction facing = state.getValue(FACING);

        // РџРµСЂРµРІРѕРґРёРј Direction РІ СѓРіРѕР» РїРѕРІРѕСЂРѕС‚Р° (yaw) СЃ РїРѕРІРѕСЂРѕС‚РѕРј РЅР° 90 РіСЂР°РґСѓСЃРѕРІ Р’РџР РђР’Рћ
        float yaw = 0;
        switch (facing) {
            case NORTH: yaw = -90f; break; // РЎРµРІРµСЂ (180) -> РџСЂР°РІРѕ -> Р’РѕСЃС‚РѕРє (-90)
            case SOUTH: yaw = 90f;  break; // Р®Рі (0) -> РџСЂР°РІРѕ -> Р—Р°РїР°Рґ (90)
            case WEST:  yaw = 180f; break; // Р—Р°РїР°Рґ (90) -> РџСЂР°РІРѕ -> РЎРµРІРµСЂ (180)
            case EAST:  yaw = 0f;   break; // Р’РѕСЃС‚РѕРє (-90) -> РџСЂР°РІРѕ -> Р®Рі (0)
        }

        // 1. РџРѕРІРѕСЂР°С‡РёРІР°РµРј С‚СЂРµРЅРѕРіСѓ (Р±Р°Р·Сѓ)
        gun.setYRot(yaw);

        // 2. РЎР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµРј РїРѕРІРѕСЂРѕС‚ Р±Р°С€РЅРё РІ 0 (РѕС‚РЅРѕСЃРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ Р±Р°Р·С‹)
        gun.setTurretYaw(0f);

        gun.setHasMagazine(true);
        gun.setAmmoCount(AGSAmmoItem.MAX_AMMO); // 30 РіСЂР°РЅР°С‚

        level.addFreshEntity(gun);
        level.removeBlock(pos, false);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.block;
import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig; // <--
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientGamePacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
public class AGSConstructionBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    public static final int MAX_PROGRESS = 2400; // 2 РјРёРЅСѓС‚С‹
    private int currentProgress = 0;
    private int activeDiggers = 0;
    private boolean sapperBoost = false;
    private String teamOwner = "NEUTRAL";

    public AGSConstructionBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.AGS_CONSTRUCTION_BE.get(), pos, state);
    }

    public void setTeam(String team) { this.teamOwner = team; setChanged(); }
    public String getTeam() { return teamOwner; }
    public float getPercentage() { return (float) currentProgress / MAX_PROGRESS; }

    public void addProgress() { addProgress(false); }

    public void addProgress(boolean isSapper) {
        if (currentProgress < MAX_PROGRESS) {
            this.activeDiggers++;
            if (isSapper) this.sapperBoost = true;
            setChanged();
        }
    }

    public void addCreativeProgress(int amount) {
        this.currentProgress += amount;
        if (this.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) this.currentProgress = MAX_PROGRESS;
        setChanged();
    }

    public static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, AGSConstructionBlockEntity entity) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return;

        if (entity.activeDiggers > 0 || entity.currentProgress > 0) {
            if (entity.activeDiggers > 0) {
                float speed = (entity.activeDiggers >= 2) ? 2.0f : 1.0f;
                if (entity.sapperBoost) speed *= 2.0f;
                float multiplier = AASConfig.DIGGING_SPEED_MULTIPLIER.get().floatValue();
                speed *= multiplier;
                entity.currentProgress += (int) Math.ceil(speed);
            }

            if (entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) {
                if (state.getBlock() instanceof AGSConstructionBlock block) {
                    // === РџР«Р›Р¬ Р”Р›РЇ AGS ===
                    ((ServerLevel) level).sendParticles(net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE,
                            pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                            25, 0.6, 0.4, 0.6, 0.05);
                    // РћР§РљР Р—Рђ РЎРўР РћРРўР•Р›Р¬РЎРўР’Рћ: РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»СЏСЋС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРёРё РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєРё
                    com.example.aas.events.ConstructionScoring.complete((ServerLevel) level, pos.asLong(), com.example.aas.events.ScoreType.BUILD_WEAPON);
                    block.finishConstruction((ServerLevel) level, pos, state);
                }
            }

            if (level.getGameTime() % 10 == 0) {
                level.sendBlockUpdated(pos, state, state, 3);
            }
        }
        entity.activeDiggers = 0;
        entity.sapperBoost = false;
    }
    // ... (save/load) ...
    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putInt("BuildProgress", currentProgress);
        tag.putString("TeamOwner", teamOwner);
    }
    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        currentProgress = tag.getInt("BuildProgress");
        if (tag.contains("TeamOwner")) teamOwner = tag.getString("TeamOwner");
    }
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }
    @Override
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag() {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        saveAdditional(tag);
        return tag;
    }
}

        // Shift + Р СџР С™Р Сљ = Р вЂ”Р С’Р вЂР В Р С’Р СћР В¬ Р РЋР Р€Р СљР С™Р Р€

            if (!level.isClientSide) {
                BlockEntity baseBE = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
                if (baseBE instanceof AmmoBagBlockEntity be) {
                    // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В° Р Р†Р В»Р В°Р Т‘Р ВµР В»РЎРЉРЎвЂ Р В°
                    if (be.getOwnerUUID() != null && !be.getOwnerUUID().equals(player.getUUID()) && !player.isCreative()) {
                        player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.own_bag_only").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                        return InteractionResult.FAIL;
                    }
                    // РќРћР’РћР•: С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Rifleman РјРѕР¶РµС‚ Р·Р°Р±СЂР°С‚СЊ СЃСѓРјРєСѓ
                    if (!canPickupByKit(player)) {
                        player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.rifleman_only_bag").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                        return InteractionResult.FAIL;
                    }
                    // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В° Р В»Р С‘Р СР С‘РЎвЂљР В° (1 РЎРѓРЎС“Р СР С”Р В° Р Р† Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚Р Вµ)
                    if (AASConfig.ONE_AMMO_BAG_PER_PLAYER.get() && !player.isCreative()) {
                        boolean hasBag = false;
                        for (int i = 0; i < player.getInventory().getContainerSize(); i++) {
                            if (player.getInventory().getItem(i).getItem() == ModItems.AMMO_BAG.get()) {
                                hasBag = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (hasBag) {
                            player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.one_bag_limit").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                            return InteractionResult.FAIL;
                        }
                    }

                    int uses = state.getValue(USES);
                    ItemStack returnStack = new ItemStack(ModItems.AMMO_BAG.get());
                    returnStack.setDamageValue(4 - uses);

                    if (!player.getInventory().add(returnStack)) player.drop(returnStack, false);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.ITEM_PICKUP, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                    level.removeBlock(pos, false);
                }
            }
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        // Р С›Р В±РЎвЂ№РЎвЂЎР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р СџР С™Р Сљ = Р СџР С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР В°
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            String kitName = player.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");
            if (kitName.isEmpty() || kitName.equals("Unassigned")) {
                player.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.no_kit").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
                return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get((net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel) level);
            String t = player.getTeam() != null ? player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
            boolean isAltVariant = player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_CurrentKitAlt");
            AASWorldData.KitInfo kit = data.getKitVariant(t, kitName, isAltVariant);

            if (kit != null) {
                if (ResupplyHandler.resupplyPlayer((ServerPlayer) player, kit, true)) {
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_resupplied_bag").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN));
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.ITEM_PICKUP, SoundSource.PLAYERS, 1f, 1f);

                    // Р С™Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ "Drone Operator" Р С‘ "Sapper" РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЏРЎвЂљ РЎРѓРЎС“Р СР С”РЎС“ РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎС“, Р В·Р В° Р С•Р Т‘Р Р…Р С• Р С—Р С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ,
                    // Р Р…Р ВµР В·Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎРѓР С‘Р СР С• Р С•РЎвЂљ РЎвЂљР С•Р С–Р С•, РЎРѓР С”Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• Р В·Р В°РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р С•Р Р† (USES) Р Р† Р Р…Р ВµР в„– Р ВµРЎвЂ°РЎвЂ Р В±РЎвЂ№Р В»Р С•.
                    boolean instantConsume = isInstantConsumeKit(kitName);
                    int usesLeft = state.getValue(USES);

                    if (instantConsume || usesLeft <= 1) {
                        // Р В­РЎвЂљР С• Р В±РЎвЂ№Р В» Р С—Р С•РЎРѓР В»Р ВµР Т‘Р Р…Р С‘Р в„– Р В·Р В°РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘ (Р С‘Р В»Р С‘ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљ РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р ВµР В±РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р СР С–Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р В°) РІР‚вЂќ РЎРѓРЎС“Р СР С”Р В° Р С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂЎР ВµР В·Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ
                        level.removeBlock(pos, false);
                    } else {
                        // Р СћРЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р С Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р Р… Р В·Р В°РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘, РЎРѓРЎС“Р СР С”Р В° Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р В»Р ВµР В¶Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓ Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†РЎв‚¬Р С‘Р СР С‘РЎРѓРЎРЏ Р В·Р В°РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р В°Р СР С‘
                        level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(USES, usesLeft - 1), 3);
                    }
                } else {
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_full").withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW));
                }
            }
        }
        return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide);
    }
}

// PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\block\AmmoStackBlockEntity.java
package com.example.aas.block;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientGamePacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class AmmoStackBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    private final List<Integer> ammoCounts = new ArrayList<>();

    public AmmoStackBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.AMMO_STACK_BE.get(), pos, state);
    }

    public void addAmmoBox(int amount) {
        if (ammoCounts.size() < 4) {
            ammoCounts.add(amount);
            setChanged();
            if (level != null) level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), 3);
        }
    }

    public int removeTopAmmoBox() {
        if (!ammoCounts.isEmpty()) {
            int amount = ammoCounts.remove(ammoCounts.size() - 1);
            setChanged();
            if (level != null) level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), 3);
            return amount;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public List<Integer> getAmmoCounts() {
        return new ArrayList<>(ammoCounts);
    }

    public void clear() {
        ammoCounts.clear();
        setChanged();
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putIntArray("AmmoCounts", ammoCounts.stream().mapToInt(i -> i).toArray());
    }

    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        ammoCounts.clear();
        if (tag.contains("AmmoCounts")) {
            int[] loadedArray = tag.getIntArray("AmmoCounts");
            for (int i : loadedArray) {
                ammoCounts.add(i);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag() {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        saveAdditional(tag);
        return tag;
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.block;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Explosion;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.BaseEntityBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.HorizontalDirectionalBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.RenderShape;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityTicker;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType;

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.DirectionProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.IntegerProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.Shapes;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.FluidState;

public class BarbedWireBlock extends BaseEntityBlock {

    public static final BooleanProperty CONSTRUCTED = BooleanProperty.create("constructed");
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = HorizontalDirectionalBlock.FACING;
    public static final BooleanProperty VALID = BooleanProperty.create("valid");
    public static final IntegerProperty BUILD_STAGE = IntegerProperty.create("build_stage", 0, 2);

    private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = Block.box(1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, 15.0D, 15.0D, 15.0D);

    public BarbedWireBlock() {
        super(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of()
                .mapColor(MapColor.METAL)
                .strength(3.0f, 9.0f)
                .noOcclusion());
        this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any()
                .setValue(CONSTRUCTED, false)
                .setValue(BUILD_STAGE, 0)
                .setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .setValue(VALID, true));
    }

    @Override
    public void entityInside(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Entity entity) {
        if (state.getValue(CONSTRUCTED)) {
            entity.makeStuckInBlock(state, new Vec3(0.25D, 0.05D, 0.25D));
            if (!level.isClientSide && entity instanceof LivingEntity) {
                if (level.getGameTime() % 20 == 0) {
                    entity.hurt(level.damageSources().cactus(), 3F);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    @Override
    public boolean onDestroyedByPlayer(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, boolean willHarvest, FluidState fluid) {
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (be instanceof BarbedWireBlockEntity wire) {
                boolean constructed = state.getValue(CONSTRUCTED);
                int stage = wire.getDamageStage();

                // РћС‚РєР°С‚ РІ 3 СѓРґР°СЂР°: РґРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРЅРѕРµ -> 70% -> 30% -> СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРёРµ.
                // РќРё СЂР°Р·Сѓ РЅРµ РґРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРЅС‹Р№ С‡РµСЂС‚С‘Р¶ (stage == 0) РѕС‚РєР°С‚РѕРІ РЅРµ РёРјРµРµС‚: СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ.
                if (constructed || stage == 1) {
                    int newStage = constructed ? 1 : 2;
                    int targetPercent = (newStage == 1) ? 70 : 30;
                    int targetProgress = Math.round(BarbedWireBlockEntity.MAX_PROGRESS * (targetPercent / 100f));

                    wire.setProgress(targetProgress);
                    wire.setDamageStage(newStage);

                    int newBuildStage = (targetPercent >= 50) ? 2 : 1;
                    BlockState newState = state.setValue(CONSTRUCTED, false).setValue(BUILD_STAGE, newBuildStage);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);

                    level.levelEvent(null, 2001, pos, Block.getId(state));

                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onDestroyedByPlayer(state, level, pos, player, willHarvest, fluid);
    }
    @Override
    public VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
        return Shapes.empty();
    }

    @Override
    public VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
        return SHAPE;
    }

    public float getDestroySpeed(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos) {
        return state.getValue(CONSTRUCTED) ? 3.0f : 0.3f;
    }

    public float getExplosionResistance(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, Explosion explosion) {
        return 9.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean propagatesSkylightDown(BlockState state, BlockGetter reader, BlockPos pos) {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public float getShadeBrightness(BlockState state, BlockGetter worldIn, BlockPos pos) {
        return 1.0F;
    }

    @Override
    public RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState state) {
        return RenderShape.MODEL;
    }

    @Override
    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(CONSTRUCTED, BUILD_STAGE, FACING, VALID);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
        return this.defaultBlockState().setValue(FACING, context.getHorizontalDirection().getOpposite());
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return new BarbedWireBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(Level level, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return null;
        return createTickerHelper(type, ModBlocks.WIRE_BE.get(), BarbedWireBlockEntity::tick);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.block;

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class BarbedWireBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    public static final int MAX_PROGRESS = 1200;
    private int currentProgress = 0;
    private int activeDiggers = 0;
    private boolean sapperBoost = false;
    private String teamOwner = "NEUTRAL";
    private List<BlockPos> linkedWires = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean isMultiWire = false;
    private boolean isUpdatingLinked = false;
    private int damageStage = 0;

    public BarbedWireBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.WIRE_BE.get(), pos, state);
    }

    // РћР±С‰РёР№ РєР»СЋС‡ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєРё РґР»СЏ РѕС‡РєРѕРІ: РјРёРЅРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ РїРѕР·РёС†РёСЏ СЃСЂРµРґРё СЃРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅС‹С… Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ (РёР»Рё СЃРІРѕСЏ, РµСЃР»Рё Р±Р»РѕРє РѕРґРёРЅРѕС‡РЅС‹Р№)
    public long getStructureKey() {
        long key = this.worldPosition.asLong();
        for (BlockPos p : linkedWires) key = Math.min(key, p.asLong());
        return key;
    }

    public void setTeam(String team) { this.teamOwner = team; setChanged(); }
    public void setLinkedWires(List<BlockPos> links) { this.linkedWires = new ArrayList<>(links); this.isMultiWire = true; setChanged(); }
    public String getTeam() { return teamOwner; }
    public float getPercentage() { return (float) currentProgress / MAX_PROGRESS; }

    public void addProgress() { addProgress(false); }

    public void addProgress(boolean isSapper) {
        if (isUpdatingLinked) return;
        performAddProgress(isSapper);
        propagateToLinks(false, 0, isSapper);
    }

    public void addCreativeProgress(int amount) {
        if (isUpdatingLinked) return;
        performCreativeAdd(amount);
        propagateToLinks(true, amount, false);
    }

    private void propagateToLinks(boolean isCreative, int amount, boolean isSapper) {
        if (isMultiWire && !linkedWires.isEmpty() && level != null) {
            isUpdatingLinked = true;
            for (BlockPos linkPos : linkedWires) {
                if (linkPos.equals(this.worldPosition)) continue;
                if (level.isLoaded(linkPos)) {
                    BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(linkPos);
                    if (be instanceof BarbedWireBlockEntity linkedWire) {
                        if (isCreative) linkedWire.performCreativeAdd(amount);
                        else linkedWire.performAddProgress(isSapper);
                    } else if (be instanceof WallBlockEntity linkedWall) {
                        if (isCreative) linkedWall.performCreativeAdd(amount);
                        else linkedWall.performAddProgress(isSapper);
                    }
                }
            }
            isUpdatingLinked = false;
        }
    }

    public void performAddProgress() { performAddProgress(false); }

    public void performAddProgress(boolean isSapper) {
        if (currentProgress < MAX_PROGRESS) {
            this.activeDiggers++;
            if (isSapper) this.sapperBoost = true;
            setChanged();
        }
    }

    public void performCreativeAdd(int amount) {
        this.currentProgress += amount;
        if (this.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) this.currentProgress = MAX_PROGRESS;
        setChanged();
    }

    public static void tick(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BarbedWireBlockEntity entity) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return;
        if (state.getValue(BarbedWireBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) return;

        if (state.getValue(BarbedWireBlock.BUILD_STAGE) == 0) {
            state = state.setValue(BarbedWireBlock.BUILD_STAGE, 1);
            level.setBlock(pos, state, 3);
        }

        if (entity.activeDiggers > 0 || entity.currentProgress > 0) {
            if (entity.activeDiggers > 0) {
                float speed = (entity.activeDiggers >= 3) ? 2.0f : 1.0f;
                if (entity.sapperBoost) speed *= 2.0f;
                float multiplier = AASConfig.DIGGING_SPEED_MULTIPLIER.get().floatValue();
                speed *= multiplier;
                entity.currentProgress += (int) Math.ceil(speed);
            }

            if (entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) {
                entity.currentProgress = MAX_PROGRESS;

                // РћР§РљР Р—Рђ РЎРўР РћРРўР•Р›Р¬РЎРўР’Рћ: РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»СЏСЋС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРёРё (РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р· РЅР° РІСЃСЋ СЃРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅСѓСЋ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєСѓ)
                com.example.aas.events.ConstructionScoring.complete((net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel) level, entity.getStructureKey(), com.example.aas.events.ScoreType.BUILD_LIGHT);
                level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(BarbedWireBlock.CONSTRUCTED, true).setValue(BarbedWireBlock.BUILD_STAGE, 2), 3);

                if (!level.isClientSide) {
                    ((net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel) level).sendParticles(net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE,
                            pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                            15, 0.5, 0.3, 0.5, 0.03);
                }
            } else {
                int newStage = (entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS / 2) ? 2 : 1;
                if (state.getValue(BarbedWireBlock.BUILD_STAGE) != newStage) {
                    state = state.setValue(BarbedWireBlock.BUILD_STAGE, newStage);
                    level.setBlock(pos, state, 3);
                }
            }

            if (level.getGameTime() % 5 == 0 || entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) {
                level.sendBlockUpdated(pos, state, state, 3);
            }
        }
        entity.activeDiggers = 0;
        entity.sapperBoost = false;
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putInt("BuildProgress", currentProgress);
        tag.putString("TeamOwner", teamOwner);
        tag.putBoolean("IsMultiWire", isMultiWire);
        tag.putInt("DamageStage", damageStage);
        ListTag list = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos p : linkedWires) list.add(LongTag.valueOf(p.asLong()));
        tag.put("LinkedWires", list);
    }

    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        currentProgress = tag.getInt("BuildProgress");
        if (tag.contains("TeamOwner")) teamOwner = tag.getString("TeamOwner");
        if (tag.contains("IsMultiWire")) isMultiWire = tag.getBoolean("IsMultiWire");
        if (tag.contains("DamageStage")) damageStage = tag.getInt("DamageStage");
        linkedWires.clear();
        if (tag.contains("LinkedWires")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("LinkedWires", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) linkedWires.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag() {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        saveAdditional(tag);
        return tag;
    }
    public int getProgress() { return currentProgress; }

    public void setProgress(int progress) {
        this.currentProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_PROGRESS, progress));
        setChanged();
        if (level != null && !level.isClientSide) level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), 3);
    }

    public int getDamageStage() { return damageStage; }

    public void setDamageStage(int stage) {
        this.damageStage = stage;
        setChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.block;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.HorizontalDirectionalBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes;

public class BunkerBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {
    public static final int MAX_PROGRESS = 2400;
    private int currentProgress = 0;
    private int activeDiggers = 0;
    private String teamOwner = "NEUTRAL";

    public BunkerBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.BUNKER_BE.get(), pos, state);
    }

    public void addProgress() { this.activeDiggers++; setChanged(); }
    public void addCreativeProgress(int amount) { this.currentProgress = Math.min(MAX_PROGRESS, this.currentProgress + amount); setChanged(); }
    public float getPercentage() { return (float) currentProgress / MAX_PROGRESS; }
    public String getTeam() { return teamOwner; }
    public void setTeam(String team) { this.teamOwner = team; setChanged(); }

    public static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BunkerBlockEntity entity) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return;

        if (entity.activeDiggers > 0) {
            float multiplier = com.example.aas.config.AASConfig.DIGGING_SPEED_MULTIPLIER.get().floatValue();
            entity.currentProgress += (int) Math.ceil(entity.activeDiggers * multiplier);

            if (entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) {
                com.example.aas.events.ConstructionScoring.complete((ServerLevel) level, pos.asLong(), com.example.aas.events.ScoreType.BUILD_BUNKER);
                entity.finishConstruction((ServerLevel) level, pos, state);
            }
            setChanged(level, pos, state);
        }
        entity.activeDiggers = 0;
    }

    // РќР°Р№С‚Рё РјРµС‚РѕРґ finishConstruction Рё Р·Р°РјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ Р±Р»РѕРє СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё СЃРµС‚РєРё (NET)
    private void finishConstruction(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Direction bunkerFacing = state.getValue(BunkerBlock.FACING);
        level.removeBlock(pos, false);

        BlockState wall = ModBlocks.WALL_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState().setValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED, true);
        BlockState slab = ModBlocks.WALL_SLAB_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState().setValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED, true);
        BlockState netBase = ModBlocks.CAMO_NET_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState();

        for (int y = 0; y <= 2; y++) {
            for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                for (int z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                    BlockPos target = pos.offset(x, y, z);

                    if (y == 2) {
                        level.setBlock(target, slab, 3);
                    } else {
                        if (x == 0 && z == 0) {
                            level.removeBlock(target, false);
                            continue;
                        }

                        boolean isEntrance = false;
                        if (bunkerFacing == Direction.NORTH && x == 0 && z == -1) isEntrance = true;
                        else if (bunkerFacing == Direction.SOUTH && x == 0 && z == 1) isEntrance = true;
                        else if (bunkerFacing == Direction.WEST && x == -1 && z == 0) isEntrance = true;
                        else if (bunkerFacing == Direction.EAST && x == 1 && z == 0) isEntrance = true;

                        if (isEntrance) {
                            // netFacing РІСЃРµРіРґР° = bunkerFacing, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃРµРІРµСЂРЅР°СЏ (Р»РёС†РµРІР°СЏ) СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅР°
                            // РјРѕРґРµР»Рё СЃРµС‚РєРё РІСЃРµРіРґР° СЃРјРѕС‚СЂРµР»Р° РЅР°СЂСѓР¶Сѓ Р±СѓРЅРєРµСЂР°, РЅРµР·Р°РІРёСЃРёРјРѕ РѕС‚ РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёСЏ РІС…РѕРґР°
                            level.setBlock(target, netBase.setValue(HorizontalDirectionalBlock.FACING, bunkerFacing), 3);
                        } else {
                            level.setBlock(target, wall, 3);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE,
                pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 40, 0.7, 0.5, 0.7, 0.05);
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putInt("BuildProgress", currentProgress);
        tag.putString("TeamOwner", teamOwner);
    }

    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        currentProgress = tag.getInt("BuildProgress");
        teamOwner = tag.getString("TeamOwner");
    }
}
