    // (РЅР° СЃР°РјРѕРј РїРµСЂРІРѕРј С‚РёРєРµ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РїРѕСЏРІР»РµРЅРёСЏ Р±Р»РѕРєР° РІ РјРёСЂРµ) вЂ” С‚Р°Рє СЌС‚Рѕ СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚
    // РЅРµР·Р°РІРёСЃРёРјРѕ РѕС‚ С‚РѕРіРѕ, РєР°РєРёРј СЃРїРѕСЃРѕР±РѕРј Р±Р»РѕРє РѕРєР°Р·Р°Р»СЃСЏ РІ РјРёСЂРµ (РѕР±С‹С‡РЅР°СЏ СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєР°,
    // СЃС‚СЂСѓРєС‚СѓСЂР°, РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР° /setblock Рё С‚.Рґ.), РІ РѕС‚Р»РёС‡РёРµ РѕС‚ setPlacedBy.
    public static final EnumProperty<CamoType> CAMO = EnumProperty.create("camo", CamoType.class);

    public enum CamoType implements StringRepresentable {
        NONE, SAND, DIRT, GRASS, SNOW, STONE;

        @Override
        public String getSerializedName() {
            return name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        }
    }

    public VehicleSpawnerBlock() {
        super(Properties.copy(Blocks.DROPPER).strength(-1.0F, 3600000.0F)); // Р‘РµРґСЂРѕРє РїСЂРѕС‡РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ
        this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any().setValue(CAMO, CamoType.NONE));
    }

    @Override
    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(CAMO);
    }

    @Override
    public RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState state) { return RenderShape.MODEL; }
    @Override
    public void onRemove(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState newState, boolean isMoving) {
        // Block really removed/replaced (a CAMO state change keeps the same block, so it is ignored)
        if (!level.isClientSide && !state.is(newState.getBlock()) && level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
            VehicleSpawnerRegistry.get(serverLevel).unregister(pos);
        }
        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving);
    }
    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return new VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Override
    public InteractionResult use(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, InteractionHand hand, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            if (player.isCreative()) {
                BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
                if (be instanceof VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity spawner) {
                    NetworkHooks.openScreen((ServerPlayer) player, spawner, pos);
                }
            } else {
                player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.creative_only"), true);
            }
        }
        return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(Level level, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return null;
        return createTickerHelper(type, ModBlocks.VEHICLE_SPAWNER_BE.get(), VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity::tick);
    }

    /**
     * РЎРєР°РЅРёСЂСѓРµС‚ Р±Р»РѕРєРё РІРѕРєСЂСѓРі СЃРїР°РІРЅРµСЂР° Рё РѕРїСЂРµРґРµР»СЏРµС‚, РєР°РєРѕР№ РєР°РјСѓС„Р»СЏР¶ РїРѕРґС…РѕРґРёС‚
     * Р»СѓС‡С€Рµ РІСЃРµРіРѕ РёСЃС…РѕРґСЏ РёР· С‚РѕРіРѕ, РєР°РєРёС… Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ РІРѕРєСЂСѓРі Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ РІСЃРµРіРѕ.
     * Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ NONE, РµСЃР»Рё РІРѕРєСЂСѓРі РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РѕС‡РЅРѕ РѕРґРЅРѕСЂРѕРґРЅРѕРіРѕ Р»Р°РЅРґС€Р°С„С‚Р°.
     */
    public static CamoType computeCamoType(LevelAccessor level, BlockPos pos) {
        final int radiusHorizontal = 3;
        final int radiusVertical = 1;
        final int minMatchesRequired = 6; // РїРѕСЂРѕРі, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РѕРґРёРЅ СЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅС‹Р№ Р±Р»РѕРє РЅРµ РґС‘СЂРіР°Р» С‚РµРєСЃС‚СѓСЂСѓ

        Map<CamoType, Integer> counts = new EnumMap<>(CamoType.class);

        for (int dx = -radiusHorizontal; dx <= radiusHorizontal; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radiusHorizontal; dz <= radiusHorizontal; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -radiusVertical; dy <= radiusVertical; dy++) {
                    if (dx == 0 && dy == 0 && dz == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos checkPos = pos.offset(dx, dy, dz);
                    CamoType type = classify(level.getBlockState(checkPos).getBlock());
                    if (type != CamoType.NONE) counts.merge(type, 1, Integer::sum);
                }
            }
        }

        CamoType best = CamoType.NONE;
        int bestCount = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<CamoType, Integer> entry : counts.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getValue() > bestCount) {
                bestCount = entry.getValue();
                best = entry.getKey();
            }
        }
        return bestCount < minMatchesRequired ? CamoType.NONE : best;
    }

    private static CamoType classify(Block block) {
        if (block == Blocks.SAND || block == Blocks.RED_SAND || block == Blocks.SANDSTONE
                || block == Blocks.RED_SANDSTONE || block == Blocks.SMOOTH_SANDSTONE
                || block == Blocks.CUT_SANDSTONE || block == Blocks.CHISELED_SANDSTONE) return CamoType.SAND;

        if (block == Blocks.DIRT || block == Blocks.COARSE_DIRT || block == Blocks.PODZOL
                || block == Blocks.ROOTED_DIRT || block == Blocks.MUD || block == Blocks.DIRT_PATH
                || block == Blocks.FARMLAND) return CamoType.DIRT;

        if (block == Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK || block == Blocks.MOSS_BLOCK || block == Blocks.GRASS
                || block == Blocks.FERN || block == Blocks.TALL_GRASS || block == Blocks.LARGE_FERN) return CamoType.GRASS;

        if (block == Blocks.SNOW || block == Blocks.SNOW_BLOCK || block == Blocks.POWDER_SNOW
                || block == Blocks.ICE || block == Blocks.PACKED_ICE || block == Blocks.BLUE_ICE) return CamoType.SNOW;

        if (block == Blocks.STONE || block == Blocks.COBBLESTONE || block == Blocks.GRAVEL
                || block == Blocks.ANDESITE || block == Blocks.DIORITE || block == Blocks.GRANITE
                || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE || block == Blocks.TUFF || block == Blocks.CALCITE) return CamoType.STONE;

        return CamoType.NONE;
    }
}

    @Override
    public void onLoad() {
        super.onLoad();
        this.loadTimer = 60;
        if (migratedLegacyConfig) setChanged();

        // Register this spawner in the persistent registry used by the vehicle list panel
        if (level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
            VehicleSpawnerRegistry.get(serverLevel).put(worldPosition, VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot.of(this));
        }
    }

    public static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity be) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return;

        if (!be.camoScanned) {
            be.camoScanned = true;
            VehicleSpawnerBlock.CamoType camo = VehicleSpawnerBlock.computeCamoType(level, pos);
            if (state.getValue(VehicleSpawnerBlock.CAMO) != camo) {
                level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(VehicleSpawnerBlock.CAMO, camo), 3);
            }
            be.setChanged();
        }

        if (be.loadTimer > 0) {
            be.loadTimer--;
            return;
        }

        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get((ServerLevel) level);

        if (!data.isGameStarted) {
            be.removeStartRedstone(level);
            if (be.hasSpawnedOnce || be.targetSpawnTick != 0 || be.lastVehicleUUID != null) {
                be.hasSpawnedOnce = false;
                be.targetSpawnTick = 0;
                be.lastVehicleUUID = null;
                data.pendingSpawnerRespawns.remove(pos);
                be.setChanged();
                be.syncToClient();
            }
            return;
        }

        long currentTick = level.getGameTime();
        String spawnerTeam = be.spawnerTeam();

        DeckSpawnConfig activeCfg = be.activeConfig(data, spawnerTeam);


        if (data.gameMode.equalsIgnoreCase("INVASION") && data.invasionPrepTicks > 0) {
            if (!spawnerTeam.equals(data.invasionDefender) && !spawnerTeam.equals("NEUTRAL")) {
                return;
            }
        }

        // 1. Р вЂ“Р С‘Р Р†Р В° Р В»Р С‘ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В° РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР С—Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р ВµРЎР‚Р В°
        // no config / empty vehicle id / disabled for the deck of this team = nothing spawns
        if (!be.isSpawnActive(activeCfg)) {
            if (be.targetSpawnTick != 0) {   // timer was running (deck disabled / redstone gone): stop it
                be.targetSpawnTick = 0;
                be.setChanged();
                be.syncToClient();
            }
            return;
        }

        boolean vehicleExistsGlobally = data.markedVehicles.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.spawnerPos != null && v.spawnerPos.equals(pos));

        if (vehicleExistsGlobally) {
            if (be.targetSpawnTick != 0) {
                be.targetSpawnTick = 0;
                be.setChanged();
                be.syncToClient();
            }
            return;
        }

        // 2. Р СћР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘ Р Р…Р ВµРЎвЂљ РІР‚вЂќ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎвЂљРЎРЏР С–Р С‘Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С Р вЂњР вЂєР С›Р вЂР С’Р вЂєР В¬Р СњР В«Р в„ў Р Т‘Р ВµР Т‘Р В»Р В°Р в„–Р Р…, Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎРѓРЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р…Р ВµР В·Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎРѓР С‘Р СР С• Р С•РЎвЂљ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р С–РЎР‚РЎС“Р В·Р С”Р С‘ РЎвЂЎР В°Р Р…Р С”Р В°.
        //    Р С›Р Р… Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р СР С–Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С• Р Р† Р СР С•Р СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂљ РЎРѓР СР ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘, Р Р† GameLogicEvents#processEntityLoss.
        Long globalDeadline = data.pendingSpawnerRespawns.get(pos);
        if (globalDeadline != null) {
            if (be.targetSpawnTick != globalDeadline) {
                be.targetSpawnTick = globalDeadline;
                be.setChanged();
                be.syncToClient();
            }
        } else if (be.targetSpawnTick == 0 && !be.hasSpawnedOnce) {
            // 3. Р ВР Р…Р С‘РЎвЂ Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С‘Р В·Р В°РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎРЏ РЎРѓР В°Р СР С•Р С–Р С• Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР С—Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р В° (РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р ВµРЎвЂ°РЎвЂ Р Р…Р С‘ РЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎС“ Р Р…Р Вµ РЎРѓР С—Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р С‘Р В»Р В°РЎРѓРЎРЉ)
            int delay = activeCfg.initialTime * 20;
            be.targetSpawnTick = currentTick + delay;
            be.setChanged();
            be.syncToClient();
        }

        // 4. Р РЋР С’Р Сљ Р РЋР СџР С’Р вЂ™Р Сњ Р СћР вЂўР ТђР СњР ВР С™Р В
        if (be.targetSpawnTick != 0 && currentTick >= be.targetSpawnTick) {
            be.spawnVehicle(activeCfg);
            data.pendingSpawnerRespawns.remove(pos);
            be.targetSpawnTick = 0;
            be.setChanged();
            be.syncToClient();
        }
    }

    // PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\block\VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity.java

    private void spawnVehicle(DeckSpawnConfig cfg) {
        if (level == null || level.isClientSide) return;
        if (cfg == null || !cfg.hasVehicle()) return;

        ResourceLocation resLoc = ResourceLocation.tryParse(cfg.vehicleIdTrimmed());
        if (resLoc == null) return;

        EntityType<?> type = ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.getValue(resLoc);
        if (type == null) return;

        Entity entity = type.create(level);
        if (entity != null) {
            entity.setPos(worldPosition.getX() + 0.5, worldPosition.getY() + 2.5, worldPosition.getZ() + 0.5);
            entity.getPersistentData().putLong("AAS_SpawnerPos", worldPosition.asLong());
            entity.setYRot(cfg.yaw);
            entity.setYHeadRot(cfg.yaw);

            String vTeam = spawnerTeam();
            String vType = "DEFAULT";
            int penalty = 0;
            int maxMats = 0;

            ItemStack modifierStack = cfg.items[0];   // modifier of the deck that is being spawned
            if (!modifierStack.isEmpty()) {
                if (modifierStack.getItem() instanceof VehicleMarkerItem marker) {
                    vTeam = marker.getTeam();
                    vType = marker.getType();
                    penalty = marker.getPenalty();
                    maxMats = marker.getMaxMats();
                }
                else if (modifierStack.getItem() instanceof SupplyTruckMarkerItem supply) {
                    vTeam = supply.getTeam();
                    vType = supply.getVehicleType();
                    penalty = supply.getPenalty();
                    maxMats = supply.getMaxMats();

                    // Р вЂњР С’Р В Р С’Р СњР СћР ВР В Р Р€Р вЂўР Сљ, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С• РЎвЂљР ВµР С– РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎС“ Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘ РЎРѓР С—Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р Вµ
                    entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("AAS_IsSupplyTruck", true);
                    // Р вЂР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР С Р СР В°Р С”РЎРѓР С‘Р СР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р Вµ РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎРѓР В»Р С• Р С‘Р В· Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂћР С‘Р С–Р В°
                    int maxCrates = com.example.aas.config.AASConfig.SUPPLY_TRUCK_CRATES.get();
                    entity.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_SupplyAmmo", maxCrates);
                }
            }

            // === Р вЂ™Р С’Р вЂ“Р СњР С›: Р вЂ™Р РЋР вЂўР вЂњР вЂќР С’ Р вЂ™Р вЂўР РЃР С’Р вЂўР Сљ Р СћР вЂўР вЂњ Р С™Р С›Р СљР С’Р СњР вЂќР В« (Р вЂќР В°Р В¶Р Вµ Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С• NEUTRAL) ===
            entity.getPersistentData().putString("AAS_VehicleTeam", vTeam);
            entity.getPersistentData().putString("AAS_VehicleType", vType);
            entity.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_TicketPenalty", penalty);

            if (maxMats > 0) {
                entity.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_VehicleMaxMats", maxMats);
                entity.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_VehicleMats", maxMats);
            }

            net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag loadoutTag = new net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag();
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                ItemStack contentStack = cfg.items[i + 1];
                if (!contentStack.isEmpty()) {
                    net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag itemTag = new net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag();
                    itemTag.putByte("Slot", (byte) i);
                    contentStack.save(itemTag);
                    loadoutTag.add(itemTag);
                }
            }
            entity.getPersistentData().put("AAS_InitialLoadout", loadoutTag);

            AASWorldData worldData = AASWorldData.get((ServerLevel) level);
            worldData.markedVehicles.removeIf(v -> v.spawnerPos != null && v.spawnerPos.equals(this.worldPosition));

            // === Р СџР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р В°РЎвЂР С Р Р…Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘ Р В°Р Р†РЎвЂљР С•-Р Р†Р С•Р В·Р Р†РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљР В° Р Р† Р В·Р В°Р С—Р С‘РЎРѓРЎРЉ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘ ===
            worldData.markedVehicles.add(new AASWorldData.VehicleRecord(
                    entity.getUUID(), vTeam, vType,
                    entity.getX(), entity.getY(), entity.getZ(), entity.getYRot(),
                    this.worldPosition,
                    cfg.autoReturnEnabled, cfg.autoReturnTime, cfg.autoReturnDestroy,
                    cfg.respawnTime // <-- Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў
            ));
            worldData.setDirty();
            PacketHandler.sendToAllClients((ServerLevel)level, worldData);

            entity.getCapability(ForgeCapabilities.ITEM_HANDLER).ifPresent(handler -> {
                for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                    ItemStack contentStack = cfg.items[i + 1];
                    if (!contentStack.isEmpty()) {
                        if (handler instanceof net.minecraftforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable modifiable) {
                            modifiable.setStackInSlot(i, contentStack.copy());
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
            }

            // === 5 Р РЋР вЂўР С™Р Р€Р СњР вЂќ Р ВР СљР СљР Р€Р СњР ВР СћР вЂўР СћР С’ Р С™ Р СљР вЂўР в„ўР Сњ-Р вЂ”Р С›Р СњР вЂў ===
            entity.getPersistentData().putLong("AAS_SpawnGraceTick", level.getGameTime());

            level.addFreshEntity(entity);
            this.lastVehicleUUID = entity.getUUID();
            this.hasSpawnedOnce = true;
            this.setChanged();
        }
    }
    private void insertItemIntoSlot(IItemHandler handler, int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot < handler.getSlots()) {
            if (handler instanceof net.minecraftforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable modifiable) {
                modifiable.setStackInSlot(slot, stack);
            } else {
                handler.insertItem(slot, stack, false);
            }
        }
    }

    // ===================================================================== decks

    private static String teamOfMarker(ItemStack s) {
        if (s.getItem() instanceof VehicleMarkerItem vm) return vm.getTeam();
        if (s.getItem() instanceof SupplyTruckMarkerItem stm) return stm.getTeam();
        return null;
    }

    /** Team of this spawner = team of the first modifier found (COMBINED deck first, then the other decks); NEUTRAL if none. */
    public String spawnerTeam() {
        DeckSpawnConfig c = deckConfigs.get(DeckType.COMBINED);
        if (c != null) {
            String t = teamOfMarker(c.items[0]);
            if (t != null) return t;
        }
        for (DeckType d : DeckType.VALUES) {
            c = deckConfigs.get(d);
            if (c == null) continue;
            String t = teamOfMarker(c.items[0]);
            if (t != null) return t;
        }
        return "NEUTRAL";
    }

    /** Vehicle inventory item (0..31) of the deck this spawner's team plays with. Used when a vehicle is re-armed. */
    public ItemStack activeLoadoutStack(int i) {
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel sl)) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        DeckSpawnConfig c = activeConfig(AASWorldData.get(sl), spawnerTeam());
        if (c == null || i < 0 || i + 1 >= DeckSpawnConfig.SLOTS) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        return c.items[i + 1];
    }

    /** Switch the deck whose modifier / inventory the GUI buffer shows. */
    public void setEditDeck(DeckType deck) {
        if (deck == null || deck == editDeck) return;
        editDeck = deck;
        loadBuffer();
        setChanged();
    }

    private void loadBuffer() {
        bufferLoading = true;
        try {
            DeckSpawnConfig c = cfg(editDeck);
            for (int i = 0; i < DeckSpawnConfig.SLOTS; i++) inventory.setStackInSlot(i, c.items[i].copy());
        } finally {
            bufferLoading = false;
        }
    }

    /** Config for editing (created on demand). */
    public DeckSpawnConfig cfg(DeckType deck) {
        return deckConfigs.computeIfAbsent(deck, k -> new DeckSpawnConfig());
    }

    /** Config of the deck the spawner's team plays with (COMBINED if the team has no deck); null = nothing configured. */
    public DeckSpawnConfig activeConfig(AASWorldData data, String team) {
        return deckConfigs.get(data.effectiveDeck(team));
    }

    private static final Direction[] REDSTONE_ORDER = {
            Direction.NORTH, Direction.EAST, Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST, Direction.DOWN, Direction.UP };
    /**
     * Spawner works now: the deck config is enabled and has a vehicle, and (if "redstone on start" is on)
     * a redstone signal reaches the block. Used by the server tick and by the client renderer.
     */
    public boolean isSpawnActive(DeckSpawnConfig cfg) {
        if (cfg == null || !cfg.hasVehicle()) return false;
        if (cfg.redstoneOnStart && (level == null || !level.hasNeighborSignal(worldPosition))) return false;
        return true;
    }
    /** Match is running: once per match put a redstone block next to the spawner (only into AIR, never over other blocks). */
    private void tickStartRedstone(Level level, BlockPos pos, DeckSpawnConfig cfg) {
        if (redstoneTried) return;
        redstoneTried = true;
        if (redstonePos != null) return;   // already placed (server restarted during the match)
        if (cfg == null || !cfg.redstoneOnStart || !cfg.hasVehicle()) return;
        for (Direction dir : REDSTONE_ORDER) {
            BlockPos p = pos.relative(dir);
            if (level.getBlockState(p).isAir()) {
                level.setBlock(p, Blocks.REDSTONE_BLOCK.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                redstonePos = p;
                setChanged();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    /** Match stopped: take our redstone block away again (only if it is still a redstone block). */
    private void removeStartRedstone(Level level) {
        redstoneTried = false;
        if (redstonePos == null) return;
        if (level.isLoaded(redstonePos) && level.getBlockState(redstonePos).is(Blocks.REDSTONE_BLOCK)) {
            level.removeBlock(redstonePos, false);
        }
        redstonePos = null;
        setChanged();
    }

    private void loadDeckConfigs(CompoundTag tag) {
        deckConfigs.clear();
        if (tag.contains("DeckConfigs", 10)) {
            CompoundTag dc = tag.getCompound("DeckConfigs");
            for (DeckType deck : DeckType.VALUES) {
                if (dc.contains(deck.id, 10)) deckConfigs.put(deck, DeckSpawnConfig.load(dc.getCompound(deck.id)));
            }
        } else if (tag.contains("VehicleID") || tag.contains("RespawnTime") || tag.contains("InitialTime")) {
            // old block: the single config becomes the COMBINED deck's config
            DeckSpawnConfig c = new DeckSpawnConfig();
            c.respawnTime = tag.getInt("RespawnTime");
            c.initialTime = tag.getInt("InitialTime");
            c.vehicleId = tag.getString("VehicleID");
            c.yaw = tag.getFloat("VehicleYaw");
            c.autoReturnEnabled = tag.getBoolean("AutoReturnEnabled");
            c.autoReturnTime = tag.contains("AutoReturnTime") ? tag.getInt("AutoReturnTime") : 60;
            c.autoReturnDestroy = tag.getBoolean("AutoReturnDestroy");
            deckConfigs.put(DeckType.COMBINED, c);
            migratedLegacyConfig = true;
        }
        redstonePos = tag.contains("RedstonePos") ? BlockPos.of(tag.getLong("RedstonePos")) : null;
    }

    private void saveDeckConfigs(CompoundTag tag) {
        CompoundTag dc = new CompoundTag();
        for (Map.Entry<DeckType, DeckSpawnConfig> e : deckConfigs.entrySet()) dc.put(e.getKey().id, e.getValue().save());
        tag.put("DeckConfigs", dc);
        if (redstonePos != null) tag.putLong("RedstonePos", redstonePos.asLong());
    }

    public void syncToClient() {
        if (level != null && !level.isClientSide) {
            level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), 3);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        loadDeckConfigs(tag);
        if (tag.contains("Inventory")) {
            // old block: the single shared inventory (modifier + vehicle items) becomes the COMBINED deck's
            CompoundTag comb = tag.getCompound("DeckConfigs").getCompound(DeckType.COMBINED.id);
            if (!comb.contains("Items")) {
                ItemStackHandler old = new ItemStackHandler(DeckSpawnConfig.SLOTS);
                old.deserializeNBT(tag.getCompound("Inventory"));
                DeckSpawnConfig c = cfg(DeckType.COMBINED);
                for (int i = 0; i < DeckSpawnConfig.SLOTS; i++) c.items[i] = old.getStackInSlot(i).copy();
                migratedLegacyConfig = true;
            }
        }
        DeckType ed = DeckType.fromId(tag.getString("EditDeck"));
        editDeck = ed != null ? ed : DeckType.COMBINED;
        loadBuffer();
        targetSpawnTick = tag.getLong("TargetSpawnTick");
        hasSpawnedOnce = tag.getBoolean("HasSpawnedOnce");
        camoScanned = tag.getBoolean("CamoScanned");
        if (tag.hasUUID("LastVehicle")) lastVehicleUUID = tag.getUUID("LastVehicle");

        // === Р С’Р вЂ™Р СћР С›-Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂ”Р вЂ™Р В Р С’Р Сћ ===
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putString("EditDeck", editDeck.id);
        saveDeckConfigs(tag);
        tag.putLong("TargetSpawnTick", targetSpawnTick);
        tag.putBoolean("HasSpawnedOnce", hasSpawnedOnce);
        tag.putBoolean("CamoScanned", camoScanned);
        if (lastVehicleUUID != null) tag.putUUID("LastVehicle", lastVehicleUUID);

        // === Р С’Р вЂ™Р СћР С›-Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂ”Р вЂ™Р В Р С’Р Сћ ===
    }

    @Override
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag() {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        saveAdditional(tag);
        return tag;
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public Component getDisplayName() {
        return Component.literal("Vehicle Spawner Config");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public AbstractContainerMenu createMenu(int id, Inventory playerInv, Player player) {
        return new VehicleSpawnerMenu(id, playerInv, this);
    }
}

    public VehicleStationBlock() {
        super(Properties.of().strength(3.0f, 20.0f).noOcclusion());
        this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any()
                .setValue(CONSTRUCTED, false)
                .setValue(BUILD_STAGE, 0)
                .setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .setValue(VALID, true));
    }

    @Override

        builder.add(CONSTRUCTED, BUILD_STAGE, FACING, VALID);
    }

    @Override
    public RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState s) {
        return RenderShape.MODEL;
    }

    @Override
    public VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
        return Shapes.block(); // РџРѕР»РЅС‹Р№ Р±Р»РѕРє РґР»СЏ РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєРё
    }

    @Override
    public VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
        // Р•СЃР»Рё РЅРµ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРѕ вЂ” РєРѕР»Р»РёР·РёРё РЅРµС‚ (РјРѕР¶РЅРѕ РїСЂРѕС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ СЃРєРІРѕР·СЊ С‡РµСЂС‚РµР¶)
        return state.getValue(CONSTRUCTED) ? Shapes.block() : Shapes.empty();
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(BlockPos p, BlockState s) {
        return new VehicleStationBlockEntity(p, s);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(Level l, BlockState s, BlockEntityType<T> t) {
        return createTickerHelper(t, ModBlocks.VEHICLE_STATION_BE.get(), VehicleStationBlockEntity::tick);
    }
    @Override
    public void onRemove(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState newState, boolean isMoving) {
        if (!state.is(newState.getBlock()) && !level.isClientSide) {
            AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get((ServerLevel) level);
            data.vehicleStations.removeIf(s -> s.pos.equals(pos));
            data.setDirty();
            PacketHandler.sendToAllClients((ServerLevel)level, data);
        }
        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving);
    }

    public static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, VehicleStationBlockEntity entity) {
        // --- РљР›РР•РќРўРЎРљРђРЇ Р§РђРЎРўР¬ (Р—Р’РЈРљ) ---
        if (level.isClientSide) {
            if (state.getValue(VehicleStationBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) {
                entity.handleSoundClient();
            }
            return;
        }

        // --- Р›РћР“РРљРђ РЎРўР РћР™РљР (РІС‹РєР°РїС‹РІР°РЅРёСЏ) ---
        if (!state.getValue(VehicleStationBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) {
            if (state.getValue(VehicleStationBlock.BUILD_STAGE) == 0) {
                level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(VehicleStationBlock.BUILD_STAGE, 1), 3);
            }

            if (entity.activeDiggers > 0 || entity.currentProgress > 0) {
                if (entity.activeDiggers > 0) {
                    float speed = (entity.activeDiggers == 1) ? 1.0f : (entity.activeDiggers == 2) ? 1.34f : (entity.activeDiggers == 3) ? 2.0f : 4.0f;
                    if (entity.sapperBoost) speed *= 2.0f;
                    float multiplier = com.example.aas.config.AASConfig.DIGGING_SPEED_MULTIPLIER.get().floatValue();
                    speed *= multiplier;
                    entity.currentProgress += (int) Math.ceil(speed);
                }

                if (entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS) {
                    entity.currentProgress = MAX_PROGRESS;
                    level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(VehicleStationBlock.CONSTRUCTED, true).setValue(VehicleStationBlock.BUILD_STAGE, 2), 3);

                    // РћС‡РєРё Р·Р° РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєСѓ СЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёРё

                            (net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel) level,
                            pos.asLong(),
                            com.example.aas.events.ScoreType.BUILD_STATION);
                } else {
                    int stage = (entity.currentProgress >= MAX_PROGRESS / 2) ? 2 : 1;
                    if (state.getValue(VehicleStationBlock.BUILD_STAGE) != stage) {
                        level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(VehicleStationBlock.BUILD_STAGE, stage), 3);
                    }
                }
                level.sendBlockUpdated(pos, state, state, 3);

            entity.activeDiggers = 0;
            entity.sapperBoost = false;

        if (level.getGameTime() % 20 != 0) return;
        if (!state.getValue(VehicleStationBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) return; // Р·Р°С‰РёС‚РЅРѕРµ РґСѓР±Р»РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ

        boolean stationHasTeam = entity.teamOwner != null && !entity.teamOwner.isBlank() && !entity.teamOwner.equals("NEUTRAL");

        List<Player> nearbyPlayers = level.getEntitiesOfClass(Player.class, area);

            }

            // РµСЃС‚СЊ СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРє "AAS_SupplyAmmo"), РјС‹ Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ РќР• РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°РµРј С†РµР»РёРєРѕРј вЂ” СЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёСЏ РѕР±СЏР·Р°РЅР°
            // РїРѕРїРѕР»РЅСЏС‚СЊ РµС‘ СЃРѕР±СЃС‚РІРµРЅРЅС‹Р№ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЊ/Р‘Рљ (РјР°РіР°Р·РёРЅС‹, AAS_InitialLoadout) РєР°Рє Сѓ Р»СЋР±РѕР№
            // РґСЂСѓРіРѕР№ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё. Р•РґРёРЅСЃС‚РІРµРЅРЅРѕРµ, С‡С‚Рѕ Р·Р°РїСЂРµС‰РµРЅРѕ С‚СЂРѕРіР°С‚СЊ вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ СЃР°Рј С‚РµРі "AAS_SupplyAmmo"

            String vTeam;

                vTeam = vehicle.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_VehicleTeam");

                if (!vTeam.isBlank()) {
                    vehicle.getPersistentData().putString("AAS_VehicleTeam", vTeam);
                }
            }

            if (vTeam == null || vTeam.isBlank()) {
                sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_no_vehicle_team").getString(), ChatFormatting.RED);
                continue;
            }
            vTeam = vTeam.trim();

            // 3. РЈСЃР»РѕРІРёРµ "РёР· РѕРґРЅРѕР№ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹"
            if (!stationHasTeam) {
                sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_no_team").getString(), ChatFormatting.RED);
                continue;
            }
            if (!vTeam.equalsIgnoreCase(entity.teamOwner)) {
                sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_wrong_team", entity.teamOwner).getString(), ChatFormatting.RED);
                continue;
            }

            // --- РџРѕРїРѕР»РЅСЏРµРј Р‘Рљ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё ---

            if (vehicle instanceof com.example.aas.entity.M2BrowningEntity m2) {
                int cur = m2.getAmmoCount();
                shownMax = 200;
                if (cur < shownMax) {
                    m2.setAmmoCount(Math.min(shownMax, cur + 5));
                    didAmmoUpdate = true;
                }
                shownCurrent = m2.getAmmoCount();
            } else if (vehicle instanceof com.example.aas.entity.AGS30Entity ags) {
                int cur = ags.getAmmoCount();
                shownMax = 30;
                if (cur < shownMax) {
                    ags.setAmmoCount(Math.min(shownMax, cur + 1));
                    didAmmoUpdate = true;
                }
                shownCurrent = ags.getAmmoCount();

            //     СЃР°РјРёРј VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity РїСЂРё СЃРїР°РІРЅРµ. РРјРµРЅРЅРѕ РћРќ Р·РЅР°РµС‚, СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ
            //     РєРѕРЅРєСЂРµС‚РЅРѕ СЌС‚РѕР№ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРµ РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕ РїРѕР»РѕР¶РёС‚СЊ (РјР°РіР°Р·РёРЅС‹, Р»РµРЅС‚С‹, СЃРЅР°СЂСЏРґС‹ Рё С‚.Рґ.).
            LoadoutResult loadoutResult = resupplyFromLoadout(vehicle);
            if (loadoutResult != null && loadoutResult.targetTotal > 0) {
                didAmmoUpdate = didAmmoUpdate || loadoutResult.changed;
                // Р•СЃР»Рё Сѓ С‚СѓСЂРµР»Рё (4a) РЅРµ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ СЃРІРѕРµРіРѕ СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРєР°, РїРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµРј РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ РїРѕ Р»РѕР°РґР°СѓС‚Сѓ
                if (shownMax == -1) {
                    shownCurrent = loadoutResult.currentTotal;
                    shownMax = loadoutResult.targetTotal;
                }
            }

            // 4c. Р¤РѕР»Р±СЌРє РґР»СЏ РІСЃРµРіРѕ РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ: РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ С‡РёРЅРёРј РїРѕРІСЂРµР¶РґС‘РЅРЅС‹Рµ СЃС‚Р°РєРё РІ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂРµ

            final boolean[] repairedMags = {false};
            if (loadoutResult == null) {
                vehicle.getCapability(ForgeCapabilities.ITEM_HANDLER).ifPresent(h -> {
                    for (int i = 0; i < h.getSlots(); i++) {
                        ItemStack s = h.getStackInSlot(i);
                        if (!s.isEmpty() && s.isDamaged()) {
                            s.setDamageValue(0);
                            repairedMags[0] = true;
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            // --- РћР±СЂР°С‚РЅР°СЏ СЃРІСЏР·СЊ РёРіСЂРѕРєСѓ РІ Action Bar ---
            if (shownMax != -1) {
                if (shownCurrent < shownMax) {
                    sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_resupplying", shownCurrent, shownMax).getString(), ChatFormatting.YELLOW);
                } else {
                    sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_ammo_full").getString(), ChatFormatting.GREEN);
                }
            } else if (didAmmoUpdate || repairedMags[0]) {
                sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_resupplying_generic").getString(), ChatFormatting.YELLOW);
            } else {
                sendActionBar(p, Component.translatable("aas.msg.station_ammo_full").getString(), ChatFormatting.GREEN);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * РќРµР±РѕР»СЊС€РѕР№ СЂРµР·СѓР»СЊС‚Р°С‚ СЃСЂР°РІРЅРµРЅРёСЏ С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµРіРѕ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё СЃ СЌС‚Р°Р»РѕРЅРЅС‹Рј Р»РѕР°РґР°СѓС‚РѕРј.
     */
    private static class LoadoutResult {
        boolean changed;
        int currentTotal;
        int targetTotal;
    }

    /**
     * РЎСЂР°РІРЅРёРІР°РµС‚ С‚РµРєСѓС‰РёР№ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЊ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё (РєР°РїР°Р±РёР»РёС‚Рё ITEM_HANDLER) СЃ СЌС‚Р°Р»РѕРЅРЅС‹Рј
     * Р»РѕР°РґР°СѓС‚РѕРј РёР· NBT "AAS_InitialLoadout" (Р·Р°РїРёСЃР°РЅ VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity РїСЂРё СЃРїР°РІРЅРµ)
     * Рё РїРѕСЃС‚РµРїРµРЅРЅРѕ (РїРѕ ~15% РѕС‚ РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ РєРѕР»РёС‡РµСЃС‚РІР° Р·Р° С‚РёРє СЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёРё) РІРѕСЃРїРѕР»РЅСЏРµС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‡Сѓ
     * РїРѕ РєР°Р¶РґРѕРјСѓ СЃР»РѕС‚Сѓ вЂ” РєР°Рє РїРѕРґ-СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РјР°РіР°Р·РёРЅС‹/РїР°С‚СЂРѕРЅС‹, С‚Р°Рє Рё РїРѕР»РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊСЋ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ СЃР»РѕС‚С‹.
     * Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ null, РµСЃР»Рё Сѓ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё РІРѕРѕР±С‰Рµ РЅРµС‚ С‚Р°РєРѕРіРѕ Р»РѕР°РґР°СѓС‚Р° (РЅРµ СЃРѕ СЃРїР°РІРЅРµСЂР° AAS).
     */
    private static LoadoutResult resupplyFromLoadout(Entity vehicle) {
        if (!vehicle.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_InitialLoadout")) return null;

        ListTag loadoutTag = vehicle.getPersistentData().getList("AAS_InitialLoadout", 10);
        if (loadoutTag.isEmpty()) return null;

        IItemHandler rawHandler = vehicle.getCapability(ForgeCapabilities.ITEM_HANDLER).orElse(null);
        if (!(rawHandler instanceof IItemHandlerModifiable handler)) return null;

        LoadoutResult result = new LoadoutResult();

        for (int i = 0; i < loadoutTag.size(); i++) {
            CompoundTag itemTag = loadoutTag.getCompound(i);
            int slot = itemTag.getByte("Slot") & 255;
            if (slot >= handler.getSlots()) continue;

            ItemStack targetStack = ItemStack.of(itemTag);
            if (targetStack.isEmpty()) continue;

            int targetCount = targetStack.getCount();
            result.targetTotal += targetCount;

            ItemStack currentStack = handler.getStackInSlot(slot);

            // Р•СЃР»Рё СЃР»РѕС‚ Р·Р°РЅСЏС‚ С‡РµРј-С‚Рѕ Р”Р РЈР“РРњ (РЅРµ С‚РµРј Р¶Рµ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚РѕРј/С‚РµРіР°РјРё) вЂ” РЅРµ С‚СЂРѕРіР°РµРј,
            // С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ РІС‹РєРёРґС‹РІР°С‚СЊ С‚Рѕ, С‡С‚Рѕ РёРіСЂРѕРє СЃР°Рј С‚СѓРґР° РїРѕР»РѕР¶РёР».
            if (!currentStack.isEmpty() && !ItemStack.isSameItemSameTags(currentStack, targetStack)) {
                result.currentTotal += currentStack.getCount();
                continue;
            }

            int currentCount = currentStack.isEmpty() ? 0 : currentStack.getCount();
            if (currentCount >= targetCount) {
                result.currentTotal += currentCount;
                continue;
            }

            int deficit = targetCount - currentCount;
            int step = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(targetCount * 0.01)); // ~15% РѕС‚ РЅРѕСЂРјС‹ Р·Р° С‚РёРє СЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёРё
            int toAdd = Math.min(deficit, step);

            ItemStack newStack = targetStack.copy();
            newStack.setCount(currentCount + toAdd);
            handler.setStackInSlot(slot, newStack);

            result.changed = true;
            result.currentTotal += (currentCount + toAdd);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static void sendActionBar(Player player, String msg, ChatFormatting color) {
        player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal(msg).withStyle(color), true);
    }

    private void handleSoundClient() {
        net.minecraftforge.fml.DistExecutor.unsafeRunWhenOn(net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist.CLIENT, () -> () -> {
            System.out.println("[AAS DEBUG] handleSoundClient called, ref=" + this.clientSoundRef);
            this.clientSoundRef = com.example.aas.client.ClientHooks.playStationSound(this, this.clientSoundRef);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void setRemoved() {
        if (this.level != null && this.level.isClientSide) {
            net.minecraftforge.fml.DistExecutor.unsafeRunWhenOn(net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist.CLIENT, () -> () -> {
                com.example.aas.client.ClientHooks.stopStationSound(this.clientSoundRef);
            });
        }
        super.setRemoved();
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putInt("BuildProgress", currentProgress);
        tag.putString("TeamOwner", teamOwner);
    }

    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        currentProgress = tag.getInt("BuildProgress");
        if (tag.contains("TeamOwner")) {
            String loaded = tag.getString("TeamOwner");
            teamOwner = (loaded == null || loaded.isBlank()) ? "NEUTRAL" : loaded.trim().toUpperCase();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag() {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        saveAdditional(tag);
        return tag;
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }
}

    }

    @Override
    public boolean onDestroyedByPlayer(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, boolean willHarvest, FluidState fluid) {
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (be instanceof WallBlockEntity wall) {
                boolean constructed = state.getValue(CONSTRUCTED);
                int stage = wall.getDamageStage();

                // РћС‚РєР°С‚ РІ 3 СѓРґР°СЂР°: РґРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРЅРѕРµ -> 70% -> 30% -> СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРёРµ.
                // РќРё СЂР°Р·Сѓ РЅРµ РґРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРЅС‹Р№ С‡РµСЂС‚С‘Р¶ (stage == 0) РѕС‚РєР°С‚РѕРІ РЅРµ РёРјРµРµС‚: СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ.
                if (constructed || stage == 1) {
                    int newStage = constructed ? 1 : 2;
                    int targetPercent = (newStage == 1) ? 70 : 30;
                    int max = wall.getMaxProgress();
                    int targetProgress = Math.round(max * (targetPercent / 100f));

                    wall.setProgress(targetProgress);
                    wall.setDamageStage(newStage);

                    int newBuildStage = (targetPercent >= 50) ? 2 : 1;
                    BlockState newState = state.setValue(CONSTRUCTED, false).setValue(BUILD_STAGE, newBuildStage);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);

                    // Р—РІСѓРє/С‡Р°СЃС‚РёС†С‹ РїРѕР»РѕРјРєРё Р±РµР· СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРёСЏ Р±Р»РѕРєР°
                    level.levelEvent(null, 2001, pos, Block.getId(state));

                    return false; // Р±Р»РѕРє РЅРµ СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ, С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РѕС‚РєР°С‚С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РЅР° СЃС‚Р°РґРёСЋ РЅР°Р·Р°Рґ
                }

        builder.add(CONSTRUCTED, BUILD_STAGE, FACING, VALID);

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
        return this.defaultBlockState()

                .setValue(CONSTRUCTED, false)
                .setValue(BUILD_STAGE, 0);
    }

    @Override
    public VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
        return SHAPE;

    @Override

        if (!state.getValue(CONSTRUCTED)) {
            return Shapes.empty();

        return SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    public RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState state) {
        return RenderShape.MODEL;

        return new WallBlockEntity(pos, state);

    @Nullable

        if (level.isClientSide) return null;
        return createTickerHelper(type, ModBlocks.WALL_BE.get(), WallBlockEntity::tick);
    }

public class WallBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    private int currentProgress = 0;
    private int activeDiggers = 0;
    private boolean sapperBoost = false;
    private String teamOwner = "NEUTRAL";
    private List<BlockPos> linkedWalls = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean isMultiWall = false;
    private boolean isUpdatingLinked = false;
    private int damageStage = 0;

    // Р›РѕРіРёРєР° С‚СЂР°РЅСЃС„РѕСЂРјР°С†РёРё РґР»СЏ Р±СѓРЅРєРµСЂР°
    private String transformTo = "";
    private int transformDir = 2; // РџРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ РЎРµРІРµСЂ (2)

    public WallBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.WALL_BE.get(), pos, state);
    }

    public int getMaxProgress() {
        int size = linkedWalls.size();
        if (size > 15) return 2400; // РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ РґР»СЏ Р±СѓРЅРєРµСЂР°
        if (size > 5) return 1200;  // РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ РґР»СЏ СЃС‚РµРЅ 3С…3
        if (size > 0 || isMultiWall) return 600; // РЎС‚РµРЅС‹ 2С…2
        return 300; // РћРґРёРЅРѕС‡РЅР°СЏ СЃС‚РµРЅР°
    }

    // РћР±С‰РёР№ РєР»СЋС‡ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєРё РґР»СЏ РѕС‡РєРѕРІ: РјРёРЅРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ РїРѕР·РёС†РёСЏ СЃСЂРµРґРё СЃРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅС‹С… Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ (РёР»Рё СЃРІРѕСЏ, РµСЃР»Рё Р±Р»РѕРє РѕРґРёРЅРѕС‡РЅС‹Р№)
    public long getStructureKey() {
        long key = this.worldPosition.asLong();
        for (BlockPos p : linkedWalls) key = Math.min(key, p.asLong());
        return key;
    }

    // РўРёРї РѕС‡РєРѕРІ Р·Р° Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРёРµ: Р±РѕР»СЊС€Р°СЏ СЃРІСЏР·РєР° (>15 Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ) - Р±СѓРЅРєРµСЂ, РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ - СЃС‚РµРЅР°/СЃРµС‚РєР°
    public com.example.aas.events.ScoreType getScoreType() {
        return (linkedWalls.size() > 15)
                ? com.example.aas.events.ScoreType.BUILD_BUNKER
                : com.example.aas.events.ScoreType.BUILD_LIGHT;
    }

    public void setTeam(String team) { this.teamOwner = team; setChanged(); }
    public void setLinkedWalls(List<BlockPos> links) { this.linkedWalls = new ArrayList<>(links); this.isMultiWall = true; setChanged(); }
    public String getTeam() { return teamOwner; }
    public float getPercentage() { return (float) currentProgress / getMaxProgress(); }

    public void setTransformTo(String blockId, int directionIndex) {
        this.transformTo = blockId;
        this.transformDir = directionIndex;
        setChanged();
    }

    public void addProgress() { addProgress(false); }

    public void addProgress(boolean isSapper) {
        if (isUpdatingLinked) return;
        performAddProgress(isSapper);
        propagateToLinks(false, 0, isSapper);
    }

    public void addCreativeProgress(int amount) {
        if (isUpdatingLinked) return;
        performCreativeAdd(amount);
        propagateToLinks(true, amount, false);
    }

    private void propagateToLinks(boolean isCreative, int amount, boolean isSapper) {
        if (isMultiWall && !linkedWalls.isEmpty() && level != null) {
            isUpdatingLinked = true;
            for (BlockPos linkPos : linkedWalls) {
                if (linkPos.equals(this.worldPosition)) continue;
                if (level.isLoaded(linkPos)) {
                    BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(linkPos);
                    if (be instanceof WallBlockEntity linkedWall) {
                        if (isCreative) linkedWall.performCreativeAdd(amount);
                        else linkedWall.performAddProgress(isSapper);
                    } else if (be instanceof BarbedWireBlockEntity linkedWire) {
                        if (isCreative) linkedWire.performCreativeAdd(amount);
                        else linkedWire.performAddProgress(isSapper);
                    }
                }
            }
            isUpdatingLinked = false;
        }
    }

    public void performAddProgress() { performAddProgress(false); }

    public void performAddProgress(boolean isSapper) {
        if (currentProgress < getMaxProgress()) {
            this.activeDiggers++;
            if (isSapper) this.sapperBoost = true;
            setChanged();
        }
    }

    public void performCreativeAdd(int amount) {
        int max = getMaxProgress();
        if (currentProgress < max) {
            this.currentProgress = Math.min(max, this.currentProgress + amount);
            setChanged();
        }
    }

    public static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, WallBlockEntity entity) {
        if (level.isClientSide) return;
        if (state.getValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) return;

        // РџРµСЂРµС…РѕРґ РёР· СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёСЏ "РіРѕР»РѕРіСЂР°РјРјР°" РІ СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ "С‡РµСЂС‚РµР¶ РІ СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Рµ"
        if (state.getValue(WallBlock.BUILD_STAGE) == 0) {
            level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(WallBlock.BUILD_STAGE, 1), 3);
        }

        if (entity.activeDiggers > 0 || entity.currentProgress > 0) {
            if (entity.activeDiggers > 0) {
                float speed = (entity.activeDiggers == 1) ? 1.0f :
                        (entity.activeDiggers == 2) ? 1.34f :
                                (entity.activeDiggers == 3) ? 2.0f : 4.0f;
                if (entity.sapperBoost) speed *= 2.0f;

                float multiplier = AASConfig.DIGGING_SPEED_MULTIPLIER.get().floatValue();
                entity.currentProgress += (int) Math.ceil(speed * multiplier);
            }

            int max = entity.getMaxProgress();

            if (entity.currentProgress >= max) {
                entity.currentProgress = max;

                // РћР§РљР Р—Рђ РЎРўР РћРРўР•Р›Р¬РЎРўР’Рћ: РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»СЏСЋС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРёРё (РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р· РЅР° РІСЃСЋ СЃРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅСѓСЋ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєСѓ)
                com.example.aas.events.ConstructionScoring.complete((net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel) level, entity.getStructureKey(), entity.getScoreType());

                // Р›РћР“РРљРђ Р—РђР’Р•Р РЁР•РќРРЇ / РўР РђРќРЎР¤РћР РњРђР¦РР
                if (!entity.transformTo.isEmpty()) {
                    Block target = ForgeRegistries.BLOCKS.getValue(new ResourceLocation(entity.transformTo));
                    if (target != null) {
                        BlockState finalState = target.defaultBlockState();
                        // РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј HORIZONTAL_FACING Рё from2DDataValue
                        if (finalState.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING)) {
                            finalState = finalState.setValue(BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING, Direction.from2DDataValue(entity.transformDir));
                        }
                        level.setBlock(pos, finalState, 3);
                    }
                } else {
                    level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED, true).setValue(WallBlock.BUILD_STAGE, 2), 3);
                }

                // Р­С„С„РµРєС‚С‹ РґС‹РјР°
                ((net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel) level).sendParticles(
                        net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE,
                        pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                        15, 0.5, 0.3, 0.5, 0.03);
            } else {
                // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРёРµ СЌС‚Р°РїР° РІРёР·СѓР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёРё
                int newStage = (entity.currentProgress >= max / 2) ? 2 : 1;
                if (state.getValue(WallBlock.BUILD_STAGE) != newStage) {
                    level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(WallBlock.BUILD_STAGE, newStage), 3);
                }
            }

            if (level.getGameTime() % 5 == 0 || entity.currentProgress >= max) {
                level.sendBlockUpdated(pos, state, state, 3);
            }
        }
        entity.activeDiggers = 0;
        entity.sapperBoost = false;
    }

    public int getProgress() { return currentProgress; }

    public void setProgress(int progress) {
        int max = getMaxProgress();
        this.currentProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(max, progress));
        setChanged();
        if (level != null && !level.isClientSide) level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), 3);
    }

    public int getDamageStage() { return damageStage; }

    public void setDamageStage(int stage) {
        this.damageStage = stage;
        setChanged();
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag);
        tag.putInt("BuildProgress", currentProgress);
        tag.putString("TeamOwner", teamOwner);
        tag.putBoolean("IsMultiWall", isMultiWall);
        tag.putString("TransformTo", transformTo);
        tag.putInt("TransformDir", transformDir);
        tag.putInt("DamageStage", damageStage);

        ListTag list = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos p : linkedWalls) list.add(LongTag.valueOf(p.asLong()));
        tag.put("LinkedWalls", list);
    }

    @Override
    public void load(CompoundTag tag) {
        super.load(tag);
        currentProgress = tag.getInt("BuildProgress");
        teamOwner = tag.getString("TeamOwner");
        isMultiWall = tag.getBoolean("IsMultiWall");
        transformTo = tag.getString("TransformTo");
        transformDir = tag.getInt("TransformDir");
        if (tag.contains("DamageStage")) damageStage = tag.getInt("DamageStage");

        linkedWalls.clear();
        if (tag.contains("LinkedWalls")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("LinkedWalls", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) linkedWalls.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag() {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        saveAdditional(tag);
        return tag;
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.art;

import com.example.aas.art.ArtRequest;
import com.example.aas.art.ArtStrike;
import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.client.uav.UavNoticeOverlay;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncArtillery;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Client copy of the artillery state. The server already filtered it for THIS player
 * (own PENDING request, confirmed requests for CMD/SL, strikes of the own team), so nothing is filtered here.
 */
public final class ArtClientState {
    private ArtClientState() {}

    public static boolean available = true;
    /** Own REQUEST cooldown (SL) and the team-wide STRIKE cooldown, game time. */
    public static long cooldownEnd;
    public static long strikeCooldownEnd;
    public static List<ArtRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
    public static List<ArtStrike> strikes = new ArrayList<>();
    /** The confirmed request the CMD works with (clicked circle). Client-side only. */
    public static UUID selectedRequest;

    public static void apply(PacketSyncArtillery m) {
        available = m.available;
        cooldownEnd = m.cooldownEnd;
        strikeCooldownEnd = m.strikeCooldownEnd;
        requests = new ArrayList<>(m.requests);
        strikes = new ArrayList<>(m.strikes);
        if (selectedRequest != null && confirmedRequest(selectedRequest) == null) selectedRequest = null;
    }

    public static void clear() {
        available = true;
        cooldownEnd = 0;
        strikeCooldownEnd = 0;
        requests = new ArrayList<>();
        strikes = new ArrayList<>();
        selectedRequest = null;
    }

    public static ArtRequest confirmedRequest(UUID id) {
        for (ArtRequest r : requests) if (r.status == ArtRequest.CONFIRMED && r.id.equals(id)) return r;
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean hasConfirmedRequests() {
        for (ArtRequest r : requests) if (r.status == ArtRequest.CONFIRMED) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /** The own (PENDING or CONFIRMED) request of this player, if any. */
    public static ArtRequest ownRequest(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return null;
        for (ArtRequest r : requests) if (r.ownerUuid.equals(mc.player.getUUID())) return r;
        return null;
    }

    /** Squad leader (not a fireteam leader), from the synced squad list. */
    public static boolean isSquadLeader(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return false;
        String name = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) if (s.leader.equals(name)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    public static long cooldownTicksLeft(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.level == null) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, cooldownEnd - mc.level.getGameTime());
    }

    public static long strikeCooldownTicksLeft(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.level == null) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, strikeCooldownEnd - mc.level.getGameTime());
    }

    public static String formatTicks(long ticks) {
        long sec = (ticks + 19) / 20;
        return String.format("%d:%02d", sec / 60, sec % 60);
    }

    /** null = a request can be thrown, otherwise the reason (shown in the ping menu). The server checks it again. */
    public static Component requestBlockReason(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!available) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.disabled");
        if (!ClientData.isGameStarted) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.not_started");
        if (ownRequest(mc) != null) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.has_request");
        long left = cooldownTicksLeft(mc);
        if (left > 0) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.cooldown", formatTicks(left));
        return null;
    }

    /** null = the CMD can start a strike, otherwise the reason (tooltip of the disabled panel buttons). */
    public static Component strikeBlockReason() {
        if (!available) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.disabled");
        if (!ClientData.isGameStarted) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.not_started");
        long left = strikeCooldownTicksLeft(Minecraft.getInstance());
        if (left > 0) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.strike_cooldown", formatTicks(left));
        if (!hasConfirmedRequests()) return Component.translatable("aas.art.reason.no_requests");
        return null;
    }

    public static void onConfirmedNotice(String ownerName) {
        UavNoticeOverlay.push(Component.translatable("aas.art.notice.confirmed", ownerName));
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.art;


import com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.NativeImage;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Placeholder icons of the artillery (drawn by the mod author). The real texture size is read once, so the
 * pictures can be any square size (16, 32, 64 ...) and are always drawn scaled to the requested size.
 */
public final class ArtIcons {
    private ArtIcons() {}

    public static final ResourceLocation REQUEST = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/map_icons/art_request.png");
    public static final ResourceLocation STAR    = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/map_icons/art_star.png");
    public static final ResourceLocation CONFIRM = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/map_icons/art_confirm.png");
    public static final ResourceLocation CANCEL  = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/map_icons/art_cancel.png");
    /** Strike marker (draw it pointing to the RIGHT, white/grey: it is tinted gold in code). */
    public static final ResourceLocation STRIKE  = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/map_icons/art_strike.png");

    public static final int COLOR_GREEN = 0xFF3CB043;
    public static final int COLOR_RED   = 0xFFE03030;
    public static final int COLOR_GOLD  = 0xFFFFC21A;

    private static final Map<ResourceLocation, int[]> SIZES = new HashMap<>();

    private static int[] sizeOf(ResourceLocation tex) {
        return SIZES.computeIfAbsent(tex, k -> {
            try (InputStream in = Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResourceOrThrow(k).open();
                 NativeImage img = NativeImage.read(in)) {
                return new int[]{Math.max(1, img.getWidth()), Math.max(1, img.getHeight())};
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return new int[]{16, 16};   // texture not drawn yet: the missing-texture square is shown instead
            }
        });
    }

    public static void draw(GuiGraphics gui, ResourceLocation tex, int x, int y, int w, int h, float alpha) {
        int[] s = sizeOf(tex);
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, alpha);
        gui.blit(tex, x, y, w, h, 0f, 0f, s[0], s[1], s[0], s[1]);
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
    }

    /** Same as draw(), multiplied by an ARGB tint (the texture itself is drawn white/grey). */
    public static void drawTinted(GuiGraphics gui, ResourceLocation tex, int x, int y, int w, int h, int argb, float alpha) {
        int[] s = sizeOf(tex);
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(((argb >> 16) & 255) / 255f, ((argb >> 8) & 255) / 255f, (argb & 255) / 255f, alpha);
        gui.blit(tex, x, y, w, h, 0f, 0f, s[0], s[1], s[0], s[1]);
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
    }

    /** Tinted icon centred on (cx, cy), rotated by angleRad around its centre (0 = the picture as drawn, pointing right). */
    public static void drawRotatedTinted(GuiGraphics gui, ResourceLocation tex, float cx, float cy, int size,
                                         float angleRad, int argb, float alpha) {
        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(cx, cy, 0f);
        gui.pose().mulPose(com.mojang.math.Axis.ZP.rotation(angleRad));
        drawTinted(gui, tex, -size / 2, -size / 2, size, size, argb, alpha);
        gui.pose().popPose();
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.art;

import com.example.aas.art.ArtRequest;
import com.example.aas.art.ArtStrike;
import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketArtLaunch;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Font;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;

/**
 * "Place the strike" mode of the map (CMD).
 *
 * The request circle is ONLY the zone where the anchor point may be put (circle centre / rectangle start).
 * The CMD does not choose a circle beforehand: the first RMB must simply land inside a confirmed request circle,
 * that circle becomes the request of the strike. Radius / length / width are free (config limits only) and may
 * reach outside of the circle.
 *
 * Circle:    RMB inside a request circle = centre -> mouse = radius -> RMB fires.
 * Rectangle: RMB inside a request circle = start -> mouse = direction and length, RMB -> mouse = width, RMB fires.
 * Esc cancels. The client only previews and clamps; the server clamps again.
 */
public class ArtMapSelection {
    private enum Stage { IDLE, CENTER, RADIUS, START, END, WIDTH }

    private Stage stage = Stage.IDLE;
    private boolean rect;
    private double ax, az, bx, bz;     // circle: (ax, az) centre; rectangle: start (a) and end (b)

    public boolean isActive() { return stage != Stage.IDLE; }
    public void cancel() { stage = Stage.IDLE; }

    public void start(boolean rectangle) {
        rect = rectangle;
        stage = rect ? Stage.START : Stage.CENTER;
    }

    /** The request the strike is anchored to (chosen by the first RMB). */
    private ArtRequest request() {
        return ArtClientState.selectedRequest == null ? null : ArtClientState.confirmedRequest(ArtClientState.selectedRequest);
    }

    private static boolean anchorStage(Stage s) { return s == Stage.CENTER || s == Stage.START; }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ limits (synced from the server config)
    private static double reqRadius() { return ClientData.artRequestRadius(); }

    /** The confirmed request circle that contains the world point (the nearest centre wins), or null. */
    private static ArtRequest requestContaining(double wx, double wz) {
        ArtRequest best = null;
        double bestD = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (ArtRequest r : ArtClientState.requests) {
            if (r.status != ArtRequest.CONFIRMED) continue;
            double d = Math.hypot(wx - r.centerX(), wz - r.centerZ());
            if (d <= reqRadius() && d < bestD) { best = r; bestD = d; }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private double radiusAt(double mx, double my, ArtMapView v) {
        double blocks = Math.hypot(v.worldX(mx) - ax, v.worldZ(my) - az);
        int min = ClientData.artCircleMin();
        int max = Math.max(min, ClientData.artCircleMax());
        return Mth.clamp(blocks, min, max);
    }

    /** End point for the mouse: only the length is limited, to [min, max]. */
    private double[] endAt(double mx, double my, ArtMapView v) {
        double dx = v.worldX(mx) - ax, dz = v.worldZ(my) - az, len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (len < 1e-6) { dx = 1; dz = 0; len = 1; }
        double nl = Mth.clamp(len, ClientData.artRectMinLen(), Math.max(ClientData.artRectMinLen(), ClientData.artRectMaxLen()));
        return new double[]{ax + dx / len * nl, az + dz / len * nl};
    }

    private double widthAt(double mx, double my, ArtMapView v) {
        double dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az, len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        double px = v.worldX(mx) - ax, pz = v.worldZ(my) - az;
        double perp = len < 1e-9 ? 0 : Math.abs(px * (-dz / len) + pz * (dx / len)) * 2;
        int min = ClientData.artRectMinWidth();
        int max = Math.max(min, ClientData.artRectMaxWidth());
        return Mth.clamp(perp, min, max);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ input
    /** @return true if the click was consumed (the mode is active and the click was on the map) */
    public boolean onRightClick(double mx, double my, ArtMapView v) {
        if (stage == Stage.IDLE || !v.inside(mx, my)) return false;

        if (anchorStage(stage)) {
            double wx = v.worldX(mx), wz = v.worldZ(my);
            ArtRequest hit = requestContaining(wx, wz);
            if (hit == null) return true;                          // outside every request circle: ignore the click
            ArtClientState.selectedRequest = hit.id;
            ax = wx; az = wz;
            stage = stage == Stage.CENTER ? Stage.RADIUS : Stage.END;
            return true;
        }

        ArtRequest r = request();
        if (r == null) { cancel(); return true; }

        switch (stage) {
            case RADIUS -> {
                double rad = radiusAt(mx, my, v);
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketArtLaunch(r.id, 0, ax, az, 0, 0, rad));
                finish();
            }
            case END -> {
                double[] e = endAt(mx, my, v);
                bx = e[0]; bz = e[1];
                stage = Stage.WIDTH;
            }
            case WIDTH -> {
                double w = widthAt(mx, my, v);
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketArtLaunch(r.id, 1, ax, az, bx, bz, w));
                finish();
            }
            default -> { }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void finish() {
        stage = Stage.IDLE;
        ArtClientState.selectedRequest = null;      // the server deletes the request; the circle disappears
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ render
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int mx, int my, ArtMapView v) {
        if (stage == Stage.IDLE) return;
        ArtRequest r = request();
        if (!anchorStage(stage) && r == null) { stage = Stage.IDLE; return; }

        Component hint;
        gui.enableScissor(v.mapX, v.mapY, v.mapX + v.mapSize, v.mapY + v.mapSize);
        switch (stage) {
            case CENTER, START -> {
                boolean ok = requestContaining(v.worldX(mx), v.worldZ(my)) != null;
                if (ok) ArtZoneRenderer.drawCross(gui, mx, my, ArtZoneRenderer.CROSS_RED, 5);   // outside the zone: no cross at all
                hint = Component.translatable(ok
                        ? (stage == Stage.CENTER ? "aas.art.select.center" : "aas.art.select.start")
                        : "aas.art.select.outside");
            }
            case RADIUS -> {
                double rad = radiusAt(mx, my, v);
                ArtZoneRenderer.drawStrike(gui, v, ArtStrike.Type.CIRCLE, ax, az, 0, 0, rad,
                        ArtZoneRenderer.STRIKE_FILL, ArtZoneRenderer.STRIKE_OUTLINE);
                hint = Component.translatable("aas.art.select.radius", Math.round(rad));
            }
            case END -> {
                double[] e = endAt(mx, my, v);
                ArtZoneRenderer.drawStrike(gui, v, ArtStrike.Type.RECT, ax, az, e[0], e[1],
                        Math.max(2, ClientData.artRectMinWidth()),
                        ArtZoneRenderer.STRIKE_FILL, ArtZoneRenderer.STRIKE_OUTLINE);
                hint = Component.translatable("aas.art.select.end", Math.round(Math.hypot(e[0] - ax, e[1] - az)));
            }
            default -> {        // WIDTH
                double w = widthAt(mx, my, v);
                ArtZoneRenderer.drawStrike(gui, v, ArtStrike.Type.RECT, ax, az, bx, bz, w,
                        ArtZoneRenderer.STRIKE_FILL, ArtZoneRenderer.STRIKE_OUTLINE);
                hint = Component.translatable("aas.art.select.width", Math.round(w));
            }
        }
        gui.disableScissor();

        int w = font.width(hint);
        int x = v.mapX + v.mapSize / 2 - w / 2;
        int y = v.mapY + 6;
        gui.fill(x - 5, y - 3, x + w + 5, y + 11, 0xCC000000);
        gui.renderOutline(x - 5, y - 3, w + 10, 14, 0xFFD01818);
        gui.drawString(font, hint, x, y, 0xFFFF8080, false);
    }
}
