package com.example.aas.client.art;


import com.example.aas.art.ArtRequest;
import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.client.uav.UavClientState;
import com.example.aas.client.uav.UavMapButtons;
import com.example.aas.client.uav.UavMapSelection;
import com.example.aas.client.uav.UavZoneRenderer;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketArtRequestAction;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Font;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The shared artillery UI of the map. ONE component used by both SquadSelectionScreen (normal map) and
 * AASDeathScreen, so everything works the same on both:
 *  - SL: "Confirm" / "Cancel" buttons inside the own PENDING request circle;
 *  - CMD: the star button (where the UAV button used to be) -> panel with tabs "Support" (UAV, unchanged) and
 *    "Tactical" (circle / rectangle strike), choosing a confirmed request circle and placing the strike inside it.
 * It also owns the UAV zone selection and the UAV "eye" button, so the screens have a single hook point.
 */
public final class ArtMapUi {
    private static final int SIZE = 24, PANEL_W = 160, TAB_H = 16, BTN_H = 20, PAD = 4;
    private static final int GOLD = 0xFFB8860B;

    private record Hit(int x, int y, int w, int h, Runnable action, Component tip) {
        boolean contains(double mx, double my) { return mx >= x && mx <= x + w && my >= y && my <= y + h; }
    }

    private final boolean showUavEye;
    private final int leftInset;
    private final UavMapSelection uavSel = new UavMapSelection();
    private final UavMapButtons uavButtons = new UavMapButtons();
    private final ArtMapSelection artSel = new ArtMapSelection();

    private boolean panelOpen;
    private boolean tacticalTab;
    private ArtMapView view;
    private final List<Hit> hits = new ArrayList<>();
    private int[] panelRect;           // x, y, w, h of the open panel (clicks inside are swallowed)
    private Component tooltip;

    /**
     * @param showUavEye whether the "look through the UAV" button follows the UAV (normal map only; unchanged UAV behaviour)
     * @param leftInset  the buttons never start left of this x (the death screen has a sidebar over the left part of the map)
     */
    public ArtMapUi(boolean showUavEye, int leftInset) {
        this.showUavEye = showUavEye;
        this.leftInset = leftInset;
    }

    public boolean isSelecting() { return uavSel.isActive() || artSel.isActive(); }

    /** Esc: leave the selection mode or close the panel. @return true if something was closed. */
    public boolean cancelSelection() {
        if (uavSel.isActive()) { uavSel.cancel(); return true; }
        if (artSel.isActive()) { artSel.cancel(); return true; }
        if (panelOpen) { panelOpen = false; return true; }
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ render
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int mx, int my, int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize,
                       double panX, double panZ, double bpp) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        hits.clear();
        panelRect = null;
        tooltip = null;
        if (mc.player == null) return;
        view = new ArtMapView(mapX, mapY, mapSize, panX, panZ, bpp);

        renderOwnRequestButtons(gui, font, mc, mx, my);
        uavSel.render(gui, font, mx, my, mapX, mapY, mapSize, panX, panZ, bpp);
        artSel.render(gui, font, mx, my, view);
        if (showUavEye) uavButtons.render(gui, mx, my, mapX, mapY, mapSize, panX, panZ, bpp, uavSel);
        if (UavClientState.isCmdLeader(mc)) renderStarAndPanel(gui, font, mc, mx, my);

        for (Hit h : hits) {
            if (h.tip() != null && h.contains(mx, my)) { tooltip = h.tip(); break; }
        }
    }

    public void renderTooltip(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int mx, int my) {
        if (tooltip != null) gui.renderTooltip(font, tooltip, mx, my);
        else if (showUavEye) uavButtons.renderTooltip(gui, font, mx, my);
    }

    /** SL: confirm / cancel buttons inside the own PENDING circle, with the time left. */
    private void renderOwnRequestButtons(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, Minecraft mc, int mx, int my) {
        for (ArtRequest r : ArtClientState.requests) {
            if (r.status != ArtRequest.PENDING || !r.ownerUuid.equals(mc.player.getUUID())) continue;
            int sx = Math.round(view.screenX(r.centerX())), sy = Math.round(view.screenY(r.centerZ()));
            if (!view.inside(sx, sy)) continue;

            int bs = 16, gap = 4;
            int by = sy + 11;
            int cx1 = sx - bs - gap / 2, cx2 = sx + gap / 2;
            iconButton(gui, mx, my, cx1, by, bs, ArtIcons.CONFIRM, ArtIcons.COLOR_GREEN, true,
                    Component.translatable("aas.art.button.confirm"),
                    () -> PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketArtRequestAction(r.id, true)));
            iconButton(gui, mx, my, cx2, by, bs, ArtIcons.CANCEL, ArtIcons.COLOR_RED, true,
                    Component.translatable("aas.art.button.cancel"),
                    () -> PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketArtRequestAction(r.id, false)));

            long left = mc.level != null ? Math.max(0, r.expireTick - mc.level.getGameTime()) : 0;
            String t = ArtClientState.formatTicks(left);
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, t, sx, by + bs + 2, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        }
    }

    private void renderStarAndPanel(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, Minecraft mc, int mx, int my) {
        int starX = Math.max(view.mapX, leftInset) + 6, starY = view.mapY + 6;
        boolean active = panelOpen || isSelecting();
        boolean hover = hitTest(mx, my, starX, starY, SIZE, SIZE);

        // panel first, so its hits come before the star's in the click order
        if (panelOpen) renderPanel(gui, font, mc, mx, my, starX, starY + SIZE + 4);

        gui.fill(starX, starY, starX + SIZE, starY + SIZE, active ? 0xCC705800 : 0xAA000000);
        gui.renderOutline(starX, starY, SIZE, SIZE, hover || active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : GOLD);
        ArtIcons.draw(gui, ArtIcons.STAR, starX + 4, starY + 4, 16, 16, 1f);
        hits.add(new Hit(starX, starY, SIZE, SIZE, this::onStarClick, Component.translatable("aas.art.star.tooltip")));
    }

    private void onStarClick() {
        if (uavSel.isActive()) uavSel.cancel();
        else if (artSel.isActive()) artSel.cancel();
        else panelOpen = !panelOpen;
    }

    private void renderPanel(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, Minecraft mc, int mx, int my, int px, int py) {
        int rows = tacticalTab ? 2 : 1;
        int h = TAB_H + PAD + rows * (BTN_H + PAD);
        gui.fill(px, py, px + PANEL_W, py + h, 0xDD000000);
        gui.renderOutline(px, py, PANEL_W, h, GOLD);
        panelRect = new int[]{px, py, PANEL_W, h};

        // tabs
        int half = PANEL_W / 2;
        tab(gui, font, mx, my, px, py, half, Component.translatable("aas.art.tab.support"), !tacticalTab, () -> tacticalTab = false);
        tab(gui, font, mx, my, px + half, py, PANEL_W - half, Component.translatable("aas.art.tab.tactical"), tacticalTab, () -> tacticalTab = true);

        int bx = px + PAD, bw = PANEL_W - 2 * PAD, by = py + TAB_H + PAD;
        if (!tacticalTab) {
            Component reason = uavButtons.launchBlockReason(mc);
            textButton(gui, font, mx, my, bx, by, bw, UavZoneRenderer.UAV_ICON, Component.translatable("aas.art.button.uav"),
                    reason == null, reason == null ? Component.translatable("aas.uav.tooltip.ready") : reason,
                    () -> {
                        if (uavButtons.launchBlockReason(Minecraft.getInstance()) == null) { uavSel.start(); panelOpen = false; }
                    });
        } else {
            Component reason = ArtClientState.strikeBlockReason();
            boolean ok = reason == null;
            textButton(gui, font, mx, my, bx, by, bw, null, Component.translatable("aas.art.button.circle"), ok,
                    ok ? Component.translatable("aas.art.button.circle.tooltip") : reason,
                    () -> startStrike(false));
            textButton(gui, font, mx, my, bx, by + BTN_H + PAD, bw, null, Component.translatable("aas.art.button.rect"), ok,
                    ok ? Component.translatable("aas.art.button.rect.tooltip") : reason,
                    () -> startStrike(true));
        }
    }

    private void startStrike(boolean rect) {
        if (ArtClientState.strikeBlockReason() != null) return;
        artSel.start(rect);
        panelOpen = false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ widgets
    private void tab(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int mx, int my, int x, int y, int w, Component label, boolean selected, Runnable action) {
        boolean hover = hitTest(mx, my, x, y, w, TAB_H);
        gui.fill(x, y, x + w, y + TAB_H, selected ? 0xCC705800 : 0x66000000);
        gui.renderOutline(x, y, w, TAB_H, hover || selected ? 0xFFFFFFFF : GOLD);
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, label, x + w / 2, y + (TAB_H - 8) / 2, selected ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFCCCCCC);
        hits.add(new Hit(x, y, w, TAB_H, action, null));
    }

    private void textButton(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int mx, int my, int x, int y, int w,
                            net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation icon, Component label,
                            boolean enabled, Component tip, Runnable action) {
        boolean hover = hitTest(mx, my, x, y, w, BTN_H);
        gui.fill(x, y, x + w, y + BTN_H, hover && enabled ? 0xCC705800 : 0xAA000000);
        gui.renderOutline(x, y, w, BTN_H, !enabled ? 0xFF4A4A4A : (hover ? 0xFFFFFFFF : GOLD));
        int tx = x + w / 2;
        if (icon != null) {
            ArtIcons.draw(gui, icon, x + 4, y + 2, 16, 16, enabled ? 1f : 0.35f);
            tx = x + 22 + (w - 22) / 2;
        }
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, label, tx, y + (BTN_H - 8) / 2, enabled ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF777777);
        hits.add(new Hit(x, y, w, BTN_H, enabled ? action : null, tip));
    }

    private void iconButton(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, int x, int y, int size,
                            net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation icon, int accent, boolean enabled,
                            Component tip, Runnable action) {
        boolean hover = hitTest(mx, my, x, y, size, size);
        gui.fill(x, y, x + size, y + size, hover ? 0xDD202020 : 0xCC000000);
        gui.renderOutline(x, y, size, size, hover ? 0xFFFFFFFF : accent);
        ArtIcons.drawTinted(gui, icon, x + 1, y + 1, size - 2, size - 2, accent, enabled ? 1f : 0.35f);
        hits.add(new Hit(x, y, size, size, enabled ? action : null, tip));
    }

    private static boolean hitTest(double mx, double my, int x, int y, int w, int h) {
        return mx >= x && mx <= x + w && my >= y && my <= y + h;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ input
    /** LMB. @return true if the click was consumed. */
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mx, double my, int button) {
        if (button != 0 || view == null) return false;
        for (Hit h : hits) {
            if (!h.contains(mx, my)) continue;
            if (h.action() != null) h.action().run();
            return true;
        }
        if (panelOpen && panelRect != null && hitTest(mx, my, panelRect[0], panelRect[1], panelRect[2], panelRect[3])) return true;
        if (showUavEye && uavButtons.mouseClicked(mx, my, button, uavSel)) return true;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (view.inside(mx, my) && UavClientState.isCmdLeader(mc)) {
            ArtRequest hit = requestAt(mx, my);
            if (hit != null) {
                if (!artSel.isActive() && !uavSel.isActive()) {
                    // plain click on a circle: choose / unchoose it, but let the map drag still start
                    ArtClientState.selectedRequest = hit.id.equals(ArtClientState.selectedRequest) ? null : hit.id;
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** RMB, only while a selection mode is active. @return true if consumed (the marker menu must not open). */
    public boolean onRightClick(double mx, double my) {
        if (view == null) return false;
        if (uavSel.isActive()) {
            return uavSel.onRightClick(mx, my, view.mapX, view.mapY, view.mapSize, view.panX, view.panZ, view.bpp);
        }
        if (artSel.isActive()) return artSel.onRightClick(mx, my, view);
        return false;
    }

    /** Topmost CONFIRMED request circle under the mouse. */
    private ArtRequest requestAt(double mx, double my) {
        double rpx = ClientData.artRequestRadius() / view.bpp;
        ArtRequest found = null;
        for (ArtRequest r : ArtClientState.requests) {
            if (r.status != ArtRequest.CONFIRMED) continue;
            if (Math.hypot(mx - view.screenX(r.centerX()), my - view.screenY(r.centerZ())) <= rpx) found = r;
        }
        return found;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.art;

/** Snapshot of the map transform of the current frame (where the map is on the screen and what it shows). */
public final class ArtMapView {
    public final int mapX, mapY, mapSize;
    public final double panX, panZ, bpp;

    public ArtMapView(int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize, double panX, double panZ, double bpp) {
        this.mapX = mapX; this.mapY = mapY; this.mapSize = mapSize;
        this.panX = panX; this.panZ = panZ; this.bpp = bpp;
    }

    public double worldX(double sx) { return panX + (sx - (mapX + mapSize / 2.0)) * bpp; }
    public double worldZ(double sy) { return panZ + (sy - (mapY + mapSize / 2.0)) * bpp; }
    public float screenX(double wx) { return (float) (mapX + mapSize / 2.0 + (wx - panX) / bpp); }
    public float screenY(double wz) { return (float) (mapY + mapSize / 2.0 + (wz - panZ) / bpp); }

    public boolean inside(double sx, double sy) {
        return sx >= mapX && sx <= mapX + mapSize && sy >= mapY && sy <= mapY + mapSize;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.art;


import com.example.aas.art.ArtGeometry;
import com.example.aas.art.ArtRequest;
import com.example.aas.art.ArtStrike;
import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.client.uav.UavZoneRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.BufferBuilder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.Tesselator;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;

/**
 * Draws the artillery on the map: request circles (blue, in the style of UavZoneRenderer.drawZone) and active strikes
 * (red). Called from AASMapRenderer.render inside the map scissor, so it works on the normal map, the minimap and
 * the death screen alike. What is drawn is exactly what the server sent to this player.
 */
public final class ArtZoneRenderer {
    private ArtZoneRenderer() {}

    public static final int REQ_FILL = 0x404F8CFF;       // translucent blue
    public static final int REQ_OUTLINE = 0xFF2F66E8;    // blue
    public static final int SELECTED_OUTLINE = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    public static final int STRIKE_FILL = 0x40FF4040;    // translucent red
    public static final int STRIKE_OUTLINE = 0xFFD01818; // red
    public static final int CROSS_RED = 0xFFFF2020;

    public static void renderAll(GuiGraphics gui, int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize, double cx, double cz, double bpp) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;
        ArtMapView view = new ArtMapView(mapX, mapY, mapSize, cx, cz, bpp);

        float reqRadius = (float) (ClientData.artRequestRadius() / bpp);
        for (ArtRequest r : ArtClientState.requests) {
            float sx = view.screenX(r.centerX()), sy = view.screenY(r.centerZ());
            boolean selected = r.id.equals(ArtClientState.selectedRequest);
            UavZoneRenderer.drawZone(gui, sx, sy, reqRadius, REQ_FILL, selected ? SELECTED_OUTLINE : REQ_OUTLINE);
            ArtIcons.draw(gui, ArtIcons.REQUEST, Math.round(sx) - 8, Math.round(sy) - 8, 16, 16, 1f);
        }

        for (ArtStrike s : ArtClientState.strikes) {
            drawStrike(gui, view, s.type, s.ax, s.az, s.bx, s.bz, s.size, STRIKE_FILL, STRIKE_OUTLINE);
        }
    }

    /** One strike shape (also used for the CMD's selection preview). The gold icon marks the centre / the start. */
    public static void drawStrike(GuiGraphics gui, ArtMapView view, ArtStrike.Type type,
                                  double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double size, int fill, int outline) {
        if (type == ArtStrike.Type.CIRCLE) {
            float sx = view.screenX(ax), sy = view.screenY(az);
            UavZoneRenderer.drawZone(gui, sx, sy, (float) (size / view.bpp), fill, outline);
            ArtIcons.drawRotatedTinted(gui, ArtIcons.STRIKE, sx, sy, 16, 0f, ArtIcons.COLOR_GOLD, 1f);
        } else {
            double[] c = ArtGeometry.rectCorners(ax, az, bx, bz, size);
            float[] xs = new float[4], ys = new float[4];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { xs[i] = view.screenX(c[i * 2]); ys[i] = view.screenY(c[i * 2 + 1]); }
            drawPolygon(gui, xs, ys, fill, outline);
            // the icon looks where the strike ends: the texture points right, screen x = world x, screen y = world z
            float angle = (float) Math.atan2(bz - az, bx - ax);
            ArtIcons.drawRotatedTinted(gui, ArtIcons.STRIKE, view.screenX(ax), view.screenY(az), 16, angle, ArtIcons.COLOR_GOLD, 1f);
        }
    }

    public static void drawCross(GuiGraphics gui, float sx, float sy, int argb, int half) {
        int x = Math.round(sx), y = Math.round(sy);
        gui.fill(x - half, y, x + half + 1, y + 1, argb);
        gui.fill(x, y - half, x + 1, y + half + 1, argb);
    }

    /** Convex polygon: translucent fill (triangle fan) + 2 px outline. */
    public static void drawPolygon(GuiGraphics gui, float[] xs, float[] ys, int fill, int outline) {
        int n = xs.length;
        if (n < 3) return;
        Matrix4f m = gui.pose().last().pose();
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableCull();
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder bb = tess.getBuilder();

        float hx = 0, hy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { hx += xs[i]; hy += ys[i]; }
        hx /= n; hy /= n;
        float fa = (fill >>> 24 & 255) / 255f, fr = (fill >> 16 & 255) / 255f, fg = (fill >> 8 & 255) / 255f, fb = (fill & 255) / 255f;
        bb.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_FAN, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        bb.vertex(m, hx, hy, 0f).color(fr, fg, fb, fa).endVertex();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) bb.vertex(m, xs[i % n], ys[i % n], 0f).color(fr, fg, fb, fa).endVertex();
        tess.end();

        float oa = (outline >>> 24 & 255) / 255f, or = (outline >> 16 & 255) / 255f, og = (outline >> 8 & 255) / 255f, ob = (outline & 255) / 255f;
        bb.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (i + 1) % n;
            float dx = xs[j] - xs[i], dy = ys[j] - ys[i];
            float len = (float) Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            if (len < 1e-3f) continue;
            float nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;     // 1 px to each side = 2 px line
            bb.vertex(m, xs[i] + nx, ys[i] + ny, 0f).color(or, og, ob, oa).endVertex();
            bb.vertex(m, xs[j] + nx, ys[j] + ny, 0f).color(or, og, ob, oa).endVertex();
            bb.vertex(m, xs[j] - nx, ys[j] - ny, 0f).color(or, og, ob, oa).endVertex();
            bb.vertex(m, xs[i] - nx, ys[i] - ny, 0f).color(or, og, ob, oa).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();

        RenderSystem.enableCull();
        RenderSystem.disableBlend();
    }
}

// PATH: src/main/java/com/example/aas/client/gui/AASChatScreen.java
package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSquadChat;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

/**
 * РџР°РЅРµР»СЊ С‡Р°С‚Р° РІ Р»РµРІРѕРј РЅРёР¶РЅРµРј СѓРіР»Сѓ (РІ РѕРґРЅРѕРј СЃС‚РёР»Рµ СЃ SquadSelectionScreen / AASDeathScreen).
 *
 * РЎРІРµСЂС…Сѓ РІРЅРёР·: Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕРє -> РёСЃС‚РѕСЂРёСЏ СЃРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёР№ -> [РєРЅРѕРїРєР° СЂРµР¶РёРјР°] [СЃС‚СЂРѕРєР° РІРІРѕРґР°].
 * Р РµР¶РёРјС‹: TEAM (РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ) -> SQUAD -> ALL -> TEAM ... (РєРЅРѕРїРєР° РёР»Рё РєР»Р°РІРёС€Р° TAB).
 * РЎРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёСЏ СѓС…РѕРґСЏС‚ С‡РµСЂРµР· PacketSquadChat (0 = ALL, 1 = TEAM, 2 = SQUAD), РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹ (/...) - РєР°Рє РѕР±С‹С‡РЅРѕ.
 */
public class AASChatScreen extends Screen {

    // === Р РµР¶РёРјС‹ (СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°СЋС‚ СЃ PacketSquadChat) ===
    private static final int MODE_ALL   = 0;
    private static final int MODE_TEAM  = 1;
    private static final int MODE_SQUAD = 2;

    // === Р¦РІРµС‚Р° (С‚Рµ Р¶Рµ, С‡С‚Рѕ РІ РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹С… СЌРєСЂР°РЅР°С… РјРѕРґР°) ===
    private static final int COLOR_ALL   = 0xFFFF55FF;
    private static final int COLOR_TEAM  = 0xFF3399FF;
    private static final int COLOR_SQUAD = 0xFF55FF55;
    private static final int TITLE_COLOR = 0xFFFFD700;
    private static final int HINT_COLOR  = 0xFFAAAAAA;

    // === Р“РµРѕРјРµС‚СЂРёСЏ ===
    private static final int MARGIN        = 6;
    private static final int PANEL_W       = 270;
    private static final int HEADER_H      = 16;
    private static final int PAD           = 6;
    private static final int GAP           = 4;
    private static final int LINE_H        = 10;
    private static final int VISIBLE_LINES = 10;
    private static final int INPUT_H       = 18;
    private static final int MODE_BTN_W    = 56;
    private static final int STRIPE_W      = 3;
    private static final long SLIDE_MS     = 180;

    // РСЃС‚РѕСЂРёСЏ РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРЅС‹С… СЃРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёР№ (СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєРё РІРІРµСЂС…/РІРЅРёР·), Р¶РёРІС‘С‚ РјРµР¶РґСѓ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёСЏРјРё С‡Р°С‚Р°
    private static final List<String> SENT_HISTORY = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditBox input;
    private int chatMode = MODE_TEAM; // РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ TEAM
    private int scroll = 0;
    private int maxScroll = 0;
    private int historyIndex = 0;
    private String draft = "";
    private final long openedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();

    // Р Р°СЃСЃС‡РёС‚Р°РЅРЅР°СЏ СЂР°СЃРєР»Р°РґРєР°
    private int panelX, panelY, panelH;
    private int histTop, histBottom;
    private int inputX, inputY, inputW;

    public AASChatScreen() {
        super(Component.literal("Chat"));
        this.historyIndex = SENT_HISTORY.size();
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        String prev = input != null ? input.getValue() : "";

        int bottom = this.height - MARGIN;
        panelX = MARGIN;
        inputY = bottom - PAD - INPUT_H;
        histBottom = inputY - GAP;
        histTop = histBottom - (VISIBLE_LINES * LINE_H + 4);
        panelY = histTop - HEADER_H;
        panelH = bottom - panelY;

        int btnX = panelX + PAD;
        this.addRenderableWidget(new ModeButton(btnX, inputY, MODE_BTN_W, INPUT_H, this::cycleMode, () -> chatMode));

        inputX = btnX + MODE_BTN_W + GAP;
        inputW = PANEL_W - PAD - (MODE_BTN_W + GAP) - PAD;

        // Р Р°РјРєСѓ СЂРёСЃСѓРµРј СЃР°РјРё (РІ СЃС‚РёР»Рµ SquadButton), РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ Сѓ EditBox РѕРЅР° РІС‹РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅР°
        input = new EditBox(this.font, inputX + 5, inputY + (INPUT_H - 8) / 2, inputW - 10, 10, Component.literal("Chat"));
        input.setBordered(false);
        input.setMaxLength(256);
        input.setValue(prev);
        this.addRenderableWidget(input);
        this.setInitialFocus(input);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() {
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ СЂРµР¶РёРјС‹

    private static int modeColor(int mode) {
        switch (mode) {
            case MODE_ALL:   return COLOR_ALL;
            case MODE_SQUAD: return COLOR_SQUAD;
            default:         return COLOR_TEAM;
        }
    }

    private static Component modeLabel(int mode) {
        switch (mode) {
            case MODE_ALL:   return Component.translatable("aas.gui.chat.all");
            case MODE_SQUAD: return Component.translatable("aas.gui.chat.squad");
            default:         return Component.translatable("aas.gui.chat.team");
        }
    }

    private static boolean isInSquad() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return false;
        String me = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.members.contains(me)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** TEAM -> SQUAD -> ALL -> TEAM. SQUAD РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°РµС‚СЃСЏ, РµСЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє РЅРµ РІ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРµ. */
    private void cycleMode() {
        int next = chatMode;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            next = (next + 1) % 3;
            if (next == MODE_SQUAD && !isInSquad()) continue;
            break;
        }
        chatMode = next;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІРєР°

    private void send() {
        String msg = input.getValue().trim();
        if (!msg.isEmpty()) {
            if (SENT_HISTORY.isEmpty() || !SENT_HISTORY.get(SENT_HISTORY.size() - 1).equals(msg)) {
                SENT_HISTORY.add(msg);
                if (SENT_HISTORY.size() > 50) SENT_HISTORY.remove(0);
            }
            if (msg.startsWith("/")) {
                if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                    this.minecraft.player.connection.sendCommand(msg.substring(1));
                }
            } else {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSquadChat(msg, chatMode));
            }
        }
        this.onClose();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ РІРІРѕРґ

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_TAB) {
            cycleMode();
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
            send();
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UP) {
            if (historyIndex > 0) {
                if (historyIndex == SENT_HISTORY.size()) draft = input.getValue();
                historyIndex--;
                input.setValue(SENT_HISTORY.get(historyIndex));
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_DOWN) {
            if (historyIndex < SENT_HISTORY.size() - 1) {
                historyIndex++;
                input.setValue(SENT_HISTORY.get(historyIndex));
            } else if (historyIndex == SENT_HISTORY.size() - 1) {
                historyIndex = SENT_HISTORY.size();
                input.setValue(draft);
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP) {
            scroll = Math.min(maxScroll, scroll + VISIBLE_LINES - 1);
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_PAGE_DOWN) {
            scroll = Math.max(0, scroll - (VISIBLE_LINES - 1));
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mx, double my, double delta) {
        if (delta > 0) scroll = Math.min(maxScroll, scroll + 3);
        else if (delta < 0) scroll = Math.max(0, scroll - 3);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mx, double my, int button) {
        // РЎС‚СЂРѕРєР° РІРІРѕРґР° С‚РѕРЅРєР°СЏ - РґР°С‘Рј С„РѕРєСѓСЃ РїРѕ РєР»РёРєСѓ РІ Р»СЋР±РѕРµ РјРµСЃС‚Рѕ РµС‘ СЂР°РјРєРё
        int ox = -slideOffset();
        if (mx >= inputX + ox && mx < inputX + inputW + ox && my >= inputY && my < inputY + INPUT_H) {
            this.setFocused(input);
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mx, my, button);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ СЂРµРЅРґРµСЂ

    private int slideOffset() {
        float p = Mth.clamp((System.currentTimeMillis() - openedAt) / (float) SLIDE_MS, 0f, 1f);
        float e = 1f - (1f - p) * (1f - p) * (1f - p);
        return -Math.round((1f - e) * (PANEL_W + MARGIN));
    }

    private List<FormattedCharSequence> buildLines() {
        int w = PANEL_W - 2 * PAD - 8;
        List<FormattedCharSequence> out = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Component> hist = new ArrayList<>(ClientData.menuChatHistory); // [0] = СЃР°РјРѕРµ РЅРѕРІРѕРµ
        for (int i = hist.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            out.addAll(this.font.split(hist.get(i), w));
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        int modeColor = modeColor(chatMode);

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(slideOffset(), 0, 0);

        // 1. Р¤РѕРЅ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё + РїРѕРґСЃРІРµС‚РєР° Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРєР° + С†РІРµС‚РЅР°СЏ РїРѕР»РѕСЃР° СЂРµР¶РёРјР° СЃР»РµРІР°
        gui.fill(panelX, panelY, panelX + PANEL_W, panelY + panelH, 0xAA000000);
        gui.fill(panelX, panelY, panelX + PANEL_W, panelY + HEADER_H, 0x22FFFFFF);
        gui.fill(panelX, panelY, panelX + STRIPE_W, panelY + panelH, modeColor);

        // 2. Р—Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕРє + РїРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєР°
        gui.drawString(this.font, Component.translatable("aas.gui.chat.title"), panelX + STRIPE_W + PAD, panelY + (HEADER_H - 8) / 2 + 1, TITLE_COLOR, false);

        String hint = Component.translatable("aas.gui.chat.hint").getString();
        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().scale(0.7f, 0.7f, 1f);
        int hintW = this.font.width(hint);
        int hintX = Math.round((panelX + PANEL_W - PAD) / 0.7f) - hintW;
        int hintY = Math.round((panelY + 5) / 0.7f);
        gui.drawString(this.font, hint, hintX, hintY, HINT_COLOR, false);
        gui.pose().popPose();

        // 3. РСЃС‚РѕСЂРёСЏ СЃРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёР№ (РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёРµ РІРЅРёР·Сѓ)
        int hx1 = panelX + PAD;
        int hx2 = panelX + PANEL_W - PAD;
        gui.fill(hx1, histTop, hx2, histBottom, 0x70000000);

        List<FormattedCharSequence> lines = buildLines();
        int total = lines.size();
        maxScroll = Math.max(0, total - VISIBLE_LINES);
        scroll = Mth.clamp(scroll, 0, maxScroll);

        int start = Math.max(0, total - VISIBLE_LINES - scroll);
        int end = Math.min(total, start + VISIBLE_LINES);
        int count = end - start;
        int y = histBottom - 2 - count * LINE_H;
        for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
            gui.drawString(this.font, lines.get(i), hx1 + 4, y, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
            y += LINE_H;
        }

        // РџРѕР»РѕСЃР° РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‚РєРё
        if (total > VISIBLE_LINES) {
            int trackTop = histTop + 2;
            int trackH = histBottom - histTop - 4;
            int thumbH = Math.max(8, trackH * VISIBLE_LINES / total);
            float frac = maxScroll == 0 ? 0f : start / (float) maxScroll;
            int thumbY = trackTop + Math.round((trackH - thumbH) * frac);
            int sx = hx2 - 4;
            gui.fill(sx, trackTop, sx + 2, trackTop + trackH, 0x33FFFFFF);
            gui.fill(sx, thumbY, sx + 2, thumbY + thumbH, (0xCC << 24) | (modeColor & 0x00FFFFFF));
        }

        // 4. РЎС‚СЂРѕРєР° РІРІРѕРґР° (СЂР°РјРєР° РІ СЃС‚РёР»Рµ SquadButton, РїСЂРё С„РѕРєСѓСЃРµ - С†РІРµС‚Р° СЂРµР¶РёРјР°)
        gui.fill(inputX, inputY, inputX + inputW, inputY + INPUT_H, 0xCC111111);
        gui.renderOutline(inputX, inputY, inputW, INPUT_H, input.isFocused() ? modeColor : 0xFF999999);
        if (input.getValue().isEmpty()) {
            gui.drawString(this.font, Component.translatable("aas.gui.chat.placeholder"), inputX + 5, inputY + (INPUT_H - 8) / 2, 0xFF777777, false);
        }

        // 5. Р’РёРґР¶РµС‚С‹ (РєРЅРѕРїРєР° СЂРµР¶РёРјР° + EditBox)
        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);

        gui.pose().popPose();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ РєРЅРѕРїРєР° СЂРµР¶РёРјР° (СЃС‚РёР»СЊ SquadButton)

    private static class ModeButton extends Button {
        private final IntSupplier mode;

        ModeButton(int x, int y, int w, int h, Runnable onClick, IntSupplier mode) {
            super(x, y, w, h, Component.empty(), b -> onClick.run(), DEFAULT_NARRATION);
            this.mode = mode;
        }

        @Override
        protected void renderWidget(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks) {
            if (!this.visible) return;

            int borderColor = this.isHovered() ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF999999;
            gui.fill(getX(), getY(), getX() + width, getY() + height, 0xCC111111);
            gui.renderOutline(getX(), getY(), width, height, borderColor);

            int m = mode.getAsInt();
            gui.drawCenteredString(Minecraft.getInstance().font, modeLabel(m),
                    getX() + width / 2, getY() + (height - 8) / 2, modeColor(m));

            if (this.isHovered()) {
                gui.fill(getX(), getY() + height - 2, getX() + 2, getY() + height, 0xFFFFFFFF);
            }
        }
    }
}

    private Tab tab(String id) {
        Tab t = new Tab(id);
        tabs.add(t);
        return t;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ layout

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        super.init();
        int cx = this.width / 2;

        // --- tab buttons (wrap into several rows on narrow screens)
        tabButtons.clear();
        int perRow = Math.max(1, (this.width - 16) / (TAB_W + 2));
        int n = tabs.size();
        int rows = (n + perRow - 1) / perRow;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            final int idx = i;
            int row = i / perRow;
            int inRow = Math.min(perRow, n - row * perRow);
            int startX = (this.width - (inRow * (TAB_W + 2) - 2)) / 2;
            int x = startX + (i % perRow) * (TAB_W + 2);
            int y = 20 + row * (TAB_H + 2);
            Button b = Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.cfg.tab." + tabs.get(i).id), btn -> selectTab(idx))
                    .bounds(x, y, TAB_W, TAB_H).build();
            this.addRenderableWidget(b);
            tabButtons.add(b);
        }

        // --- search box
        int searchY = 20 + rows * (TAB_H + 2) + 2;
        searchBox = new EditBox(this.font, cx - 100, searchY, 200, 18, Component.translatable("aas.cfg.search"));
        searchBox.setHint(Component.translatable("aas.cfg.search"));
        searchBox.setMaxLength(64);
        searchBox.setValue(searchText);
        this.addRenderableWidget(searchBox);

        // --- list
        int top = searchY + 24;
        int bottom = this.height - 50;
        list = new SettingList(this.minecraft, this.width, this.height, top, bottom);
        this.addRenderableWidget(list);
        searchBox.setResponder(s -> {
            searchText = s;
            refreshList(false);
        });
        refreshList(false);

        // --- bottom buttons
        this.addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.cfg.save"), b -> {
            saveAll();
            this.onClose();
        }).bounds(cx - 155, this.height - 28, 100, 20).build());

        this.addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.cfg.reset_tab"), b -> {
            for (Setting s : visible) s.reset();
            refreshList(true);
        }).bounds(cx - 50, this.height - 28, 100, 20).build());

        this.addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.cfg.cancel"), b -> this.onClose())
                .bounds(cx + 55, this.height - 28, 100, 20).build());
    }

    private void selectTab(int idx) {
        currentTab = idx;
        lastTab = idx;
        searchText = "";
        if (searchBox != null) searchBox.setValue(""); // triggers refresh via responder
        refreshList(false);
    }

    private boolean searching() {
        return !searchText.isBlank();
    }

    private void refreshList(boolean keepScroll) {
        if (list == null) return;
        double scroll = list.getScrollAmount();

        visible = new ArrayList<>();
        if (searching()) {
            String q = searchText.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            String qId = q.replace(' ', '_');
            for (Tab t : tabs) {
                for (Setting s : t.settings) {
                    if (s.label().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q) || s.id.contains(qId)) {
                        visible.add(s);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            visible.addAll(tabs.get(currentTab).settings);
        }
        list.reload(visible);
        list.setScrollAmount(keepScroll ? scroll : 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < tabButtons.size(); i++) {
            tabButtons.get(i).active = searching() || i != currentTab;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ save

    private int countDirty() {
        int n = 0;
        for (Tab t : tabs) for (Setting s : t.settings) if (s.isDirty()) n++;
        return n;
    }

    private void saveAll() {
        Set<ForgeConfigSpec> touched = new HashSet<>();
        for (Tab t : tabs) {
            for (Setting s : t.settings) {
                if (!s.isDirty()) continue;
                try {
                    s.apply();
                    touched.add(s.spec);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    LOGGER.error("AAS config: failed to apply {}", s.id, e);
                }
            }
        }
        for (ForgeConfigSpec spec : touched) {
            try {
                spec.save();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.error("AAS config: failed to save spec", e);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onClose() {
        if (this.minecraft != null) this.minecraft.setScreen(parentScreen);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ render

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        hoveredSetting = null;
        this.renderBackground(gui);
        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);

        gui.drawCenteredString(this.font, this.title, this.width / 2, 6, 0xFFFF55);

        int dirty = countDirty();
        if (dirty > 0) {
            gui.drawString(this.font, Component.translatable("aas.cfg.unsaved", dirty), 8, 6, 0xFFFF55);
        }

        if (visible.isEmpty()) {
            gui.drawCenteredString(this.font, Component.translatable("aas.cfg.no_results"),
                    this.width / 2, (list.listTop() + list.listBottom()) / 2, 0xAAAAAA);
        }

        boolean remote = this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.level != null
                && this.minecraft.getSingleplayerServer() == null;
        if (remote) {
            gui.drawCenteredString(this.font, Component.translatable("aas.cfg.remote_warning"),
                    this.width / 2, this.height - 42, 0xFFAA00);
        }

        if (hoveredSetting != null) {
            List<FormattedCharSequence> lines = new ArrayList<>();
            lines.addAll(this.font.split(hoveredSetting.label().copy().withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW), 240));
            lines.addAll(this.font.split(hoveredSetting.tip().copy().withStyle(ChatFormatting.GRAY), 240));
            Component extra = hoveredSetting.extra();
            if (extra != null) lines.addAll(this.font.split(extra.copy().withStyle(ChatFormatting.AQUA), 240));
            lines.addAll(this.font.split(Component.translatable("aas.cfg.default", hoveredSetting.defaultText())
                    .withStyle(ChatFormatting.DARK_GRAY), 240));
            gui.renderTooltip(this.font, lines, mx, my);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ list

    private class SettingList extends ContainerObjectSelectionList<SettingList.Row> {
        SettingList(Minecraft mc, int w, int h, int y0, int y1) {
            super(mc, w, h, y0, y1, ROW_H);
        }

        void reload(List<Setting> settings) {
            this.clearEntries();
            for (Setting s : settings) {
                this.addEntry(new Row(s, s.createWidget(AASConfigScreen.this.font)));
            }
        }

        int listTop() {
            return this.y0;
        }

        int listBottom() {
            return this.y1;
        }

        @Override
        public int getRowWidth() {
            return Math.min(this.width - 40, 400);
        }

        @Override
        protected int getScrollbarPosition() {
            return this.width / 2 + getRowWidth() / 2 + 8;
        }

        private class Row extends ContainerObjectSelectionList.Entry<Row> {
            private final Setting setting;
            private final AbstractWidget widget;

            Row(Setting setting, AbstractWidget widget) {
                this.setting = setting;
                this.widget = widget;
            }

            @Override
            public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int index, int top, int left, int width, int height,
                               int mx, int my, boolean hovered, float pt) {
                Font font = AASConfigScreen.this.font;
                if (hovered) {
                    gui.fill(left - 2, top, left + width + 2, top + height - 2, 0x22FFFFFF);
                    hoveredSetting = setting;
                }
                int labelW = width - WIDGET_W - 10;
                String text = font.plainSubstrByWidth(setting.label().getString(), labelW);
                int color = setting.isDirty() ? 0xFFFF55 : 0xFFFFFF;
                gui.drawString(font, text, left + 2, top + (height - 2 - 8) / 2, color);

                widget.setX(left + width - WIDGET_W);
                widget.setY(top + (height - 2 - widget.getHeight()) / 2);
                widget.render(gui, mx, my, pt);
            }

            @Override
            public List<? extends GuiEventListener> children() {
                return List.of(widget);
            }

            @Override
            public List<? extends NarratableEntry> narratables() {
                return List.of(widget);
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ model

    private static final class Tab {
        final String id;
        final List<Setting> settings = new ArrayList<>();

        Tab(String id) {
            this.id = id;
        }

        void add(Setting s) {
            settings.add(s);
        }
    }

    private static String fmt(double d) {
        if (d == Math.rint(d) && Math.abs(d) < 1e15) return String.valueOf((long) d);
        return String.valueOf(d);
    }

    private abstract static class Setting {
        final String id;
        final ForgeConfigSpec spec;

        Setting(String id, ForgeConfigSpec spec) {
            this.id = id;
            this.spec = spec;
        }

        Component label() {
            return Component.translatable("aas.cfg." + id);
        }

        Component tip() {
            return Component.translatable("aas.cfg." + id + ".tip");
        }

        /** Optional extra tooltip line (e.g. range). */
        Component extra() {
            return null;
        }

        abstract String defaultText();

        abstract AbstractWidget createWidget(Font font);

        abstract boolean isDirty();

        abstract void apply();

        abstract void reset();
    }

    // ---- boolean
    private static final class BoolSetting extends Setting {
        final ForgeConfigSpec.BooleanValue v;
        boolean pending;

        BoolSetting(String id, ForgeConfigSpec.BooleanValue v, ForgeConfigSpec spec) {
            super(id, spec);
            this.v = v;
            this.pending = v.get();
        }

        @Override String defaultText() {
            return Component.translatable(v.getDefault() ? "options.on" : "options.off").getString();
        }

        @Override AbstractWidget createWidget(Font font) {
            return CycleButton.onOffBuilder(pending).displayOnlyValue()
                    .create(0, 0, WIDGET_W, 20, Component.empty(), (b, val) -> pending = val);
        }

        @Override boolean isDirty() {
            return pending != v.get();
        }

        @Override void apply() {
            v.set(pending);
        }

        @Override void reset() {
            pending = v.getDefault();
        }
    }

    // ---- integer
    private static final class IntSetting extends Setting {
        final ForgeConfigSpec.IntValue v;
        final int lo, hi;
        String text;

        IntSetting(String id, ForgeConfigSpec.IntValue v, int lo, int hi, ForgeConfigSpec spec) {
            super(id, spec);
            this.v = v;
            this.lo = lo;
            this.hi = hi;
            this.text = String.valueOf(v.get());
        }

        Long raw() {
            try {
                return Long.parseLong(text.trim());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        boolean valid() {
            Long r = raw();
            return r != null && r >= lo && r <= hi;
        }

        @Override Component extra() {
            return Component.translatable("aas.cfg.range", String.valueOf(lo), String.valueOf(hi));
        }

        @Override String defaultText() {
            return String.valueOf(v.getDefault());
        }

        @Override AbstractWidget createWidget(Font font) {
            EditBox b = new EditBox(font, 0, 0, WIDGET_W, 20, Component.empty());
            b.setMaxLength(10);
            b.setFilter(s -> s.matches("\\d*"));
            b.setValue(text);
            b.setTextColor(valid() ? 0xE0E0E0 : 0xFF5555);
            b.setResponder(s -> {
                text = s;
                b.setTextColor(valid() ? 0xE0E0E0 : 0xFF5555);
            });
            return b;
        }

        @Override boolean isDirty() {
            Long r = raw();
            return r != null && r.longValue() != (long) v.get();
        }

        @Override void apply() {
            Long r = raw();
            if (r == null) return;
            v.set((int) Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, r)));
        }

        @Override void reset() {
            text = String.valueOf(v.getDefault());
        }
    }

    // ---- double
    private static final class DoubleSetting extends Setting {
        final ForgeConfigSpec.DoubleValue v;
        final double lo, hi;
        String text;

        DoubleSetting(String id, ForgeConfigSpec.DoubleValue v, double lo, double hi, ForgeConfigSpec spec) {
            super(id, spec);
            this.v = v;
            this.lo = lo;
            this.hi = hi;
            this.text = fmt(v.get());
        }

        Double raw() {
            try {
                return Double.parseDouble(text.trim());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        boolean valid() {
            Double r = raw();
            return r != null && r >= lo && r <= hi;
        }

        @Override Component extra() {
            return Component.translatable("aas.cfg.range", fmt(lo), fmt(hi));
        }

        @Override String defaultText() {
            return fmt(v.getDefault());
        }

        @Override AbstractWidget createWidget(Font font) {
            EditBox b = new EditBox(font, 0, 0, WIDGET_W, 20, Component.empty());
            b.setMaxLength(12);
            b.setFilter(s -> s.matches("\\d*\\.?\\d*"));
            b.setValue(text);
            b.setTextColor(valid() ? 0xE0E0E0 : 0xFF5555);
            b.setResponder(s -> {
                text = s;
                b.setTextColor(valid() ? 0xE0E0E0 : 0xFF5555);
            });
            return b;
        }

        @Override boolean isDirty() {
            Double r = raw();
            return r != null && Math.abs(r - v.get()) > 1e-9;
        }

        @Override void apply() {
            Double r = raw();
            if (r == null) return;
            v.set(Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, r)));
        }

        @Override void reset() {
            text = fmt(v.getDefault());
        }
    }

    // ---- string
    private static final class StringSetting extends Setting {
        final ForgeConfigSpec.ConfigValue<String> v;
        String text;

        StringSetting(String id, ForgeConfigSpec.ConfigValue<String> v, ForgeConfigSpec spec) {
            super(id, spec);
            this.v = v;
            this.text = v.get();
        }

        @Override String defaultText() {
            return v.getDefault();
        }

        @Override AbstractWidget createWidget(Font font) {
            EditBox b = new EditBox(font, 0, 0, WIDGET_W, 20, Component.empty());
            b.setMaxLength(256);
            b.setValue(text);
            b.setResponder(s -> text = s);
            return b;
        }

        @Override boolean isDirty() {
            return !text.isBlank() && !text.equals(v.get());
        }

        @Override void apply() {
            if (!text.isBlank()) v.set(text);
        }

        @Override void reset() {
            text = v.getDefault();
        }
    }

    // ---- list of 3 numbers (UAV zoom FOV)
    private static final class ZoomSetting extends Setting {
        final ForgeConfigSpec.ConfigValue<List<? extends Number>> v;
        String text;

        ZoomSetting(String id, ForgeConfigSpec.ConfigValue<List<? extends Number>> v, ForgeConfigSpec spec) {
            super(id, spec);
            this.v = v;
            this.text = join(v.get());
        }

        static String join(List<? extends Number> l) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (Number n : l) {
                if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(", ");
                sb.append(fmt(n.doubleValue()));
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }

        List<Double> parse() {
            try {
                String[] parts = text.trim().split("[,;\\s]+");
                if (parts.length != 3) return null;
                List<Double> out = new ArrayList<>();
                for (String p : parts) {
                    double d = Double.parseDouble(p);
                    if (d <= 0 || d > 170) return null;
                    out.add(d);
                }
                return out;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        @Override String defaultText() {
            return join(v.getDefault());
        }

        @Override AbstractWidget createWidget(Font font) {
            EditBox b = new EditBox(font, 0, 0, WIDGET_W, 20, Component.empty());
            b.setMaxLength(32);
            b.setFilter(s -> s.matches("[0-9.,; ]*"));
            b.setValue(text);
            b.setTextColor(parse() != null ? 0xE0E0E0 : 0xFF5555);
            b.setResponder(s -> {
                text = s;
                b.setTextColor(parse() != null ? 0xE0E0E0 : 0xFF5555);
            });
            return b;
        }

        @Override boolean isDirty() {
            List<Double> p = parse();
            if (p == null) return false;
            List<? extends Number> cur = v.get();
            if (cur.size() != 3) return true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                if (Math.abs(p.get(i) - cur.get(i).doubleValue()) > 1e-9) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        @Override void apply() {
            List<Double> p = parse();
            if (p != null) v.set(p);
        }

        @Override void reset() {
            text = join(v.getDefault());
        }
    }
}
