/**
 * Р РёСЃСѓРµС‚ РјРёРіР°СЋС‰СѓСЋ 3D-РёРєРѕРЅРєСѓ РЅР°Рґ СЃСѓРјРєРѕР№ СЃ РїР°С‚СЂРѕРЅР°РјРё вЂ” РїРѕ С‚РѕРјСѓ Р¶Рµ РїСЂРёРЅС†РёРїСѓ, С‡С‚Рѕ Рё
 * 3D-РїРёРЅРіРё (ClientEvents#render3DMarker): Р±РёР»Р±РѕСЂРґ, РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРЅС‹Р№ РЅР° РєР°РјРµСЂСѓ, Р±РµР· СѓС‡С‘С‚Р°
 * С‚РµСЃС‚Р° РіР»СѓР±РёРЅС‹ (РІРёРґРµРЅ С‡РµСЂРµР· СЃС‚РµРЅС‹). РРєРѕРЅРєР° РІРёРґРЅР° РўРћР›Р¬РљРћ РёРіСЂРѕРєР°Рј С‚РѕР№ Р¶Рµ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹,
 * С‡С‚Рѕ Рё РІР»Р°РґРµР»РµС† СЃСѓРјРєРё, Рё РїСЂРѕРїР°РґР°РµС‚ СЃР°РјР°, РєР°Рє С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р±Р»РѕРє СЃСѓРјРєРё СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· РјРёСЂР°
 * (Р·Р°Р±СЂР°Р»Рё РёР»Рё РѕРЅР° Р·Р°РєРѕРЅС‡РёР»Р°СЃСЊ).
 */
public class AmmoBagIconRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<AmmoBagBlockEntity> {

    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_TEXTURE =
            new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/ammo_bag_marker.png");

    public AmmoBagIconRenderer(BlockEntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
    }

    @Override
    public void render(AmmoBagBlockEntity be, float partialTick, PoseStack poseStack, MultiBufferSource bufferSource, int packedLight, int packedOverlay) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return;

        String myTeam = mc.player.getTeam() != null ? mc.player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
        String bagTeam = be.getOwnerTeam();

        // РРєРѕРЅРєСѓ РІРёРґРёС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃРІРѕСЏ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР°. РќРµР№С‚СЂР°Р»Р°Рј (РЅРµС‚ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹) РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ РїРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµРј.
        if (myTeam.equals("NEUTRAL") || bagTeam == null || !bagTeam.equalsIgnoreCase(myTeam)) {
            return;
        }

        poseStack.pushPose();
        poseStack.translate(0.5D, 0.9D, 0.5D);
        poseStack.mulPose(mc.getEntityRenderDispatcher().cameraOrientation());

        long gameTime = mc.level.getGameTime();
        float alpha = 0.45f + (float) Math.sin((gameTime + partialTick) * 0.4f) * 0.25f;

        float scale = 0.02f;
        double distSq = mc.player.distanceToSqr(
                be.getBlockPos().getX() + 0.5,
                be.getBlockPos().getY() + 0.5,
                be.getBlockPos().getZ() + 0.5);
        if (distSq > 100) {
            scale *= (float) (Math.sqrt(distSq) / 10.0);
        }
        scale = Math.min(scale, 0.2f);
        poseStack.scale(-scale, -scale, scale);

        Matrix4f matrix = poseStack.last().pose();

        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();
        RenderSystem.setShaderTexture(0, ICON_TEXTURE);
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionTexColorShader);

        Tesselator tesselator = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tesselator.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_TEX_COLOR);

        int a = (int) (alpha * 255);
        buf.vertex(matrix, -8, -8, 0).uv(0, 0).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, -8, 8, 0).uv(0, 1).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, 8, 8, 0).uv(1, 1).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, 8, -8, 0).uv(1, 0).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();

        tesselator.end();

        RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1, 1, 1, 1);

        poseStack.popPose();
    }
}

            Entity entity = Minecraft.getInstance().level.getEntity(entityId);
            if (entity instanceof SupplyCrateEntity crate) {
                this.materials = crate.getMaterials();
            } else {
                // Р•СЃР»Рё СЏС‰РёРє РїСЂРѕРїР°Р», Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РјРµРЅСЋ
                this.onClose();
            }
        }
    }

    private int getCost(int i) {
        return switch (i) {
            case 0 -> AASConfig.HUB_RESUPPLY_COST.get();
            case 1 -> 20;
            case 2 -> 15;
            case 3 -> 20;
            case 4 -> 50;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    private int getCooldown(int i) {
        return switch (i) {
            case 0 -> cdAmmo;
            default -> 0; // РЈ СЏС‰РёРєР° С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїР°С‚СЂРѕРЅС‹ РёРјРµСЋС‚ РєСѓР»РґР°СѓРЅ
        };
    }

    /**
     * Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅ Р»Рё СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂ {@code i} РїСЂСЏРјРѕ СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ.
     */
    private boolean isAvailable(int i) {
        if (getCooldown(i) > 0) return false;
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player != null && Minecraft.getInstance().player.isCreative()) return true;
        return materials >= getCost(i);
    }

    private int getHoveredSector(int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        double dx = mouseX - width / 2.0;
        double dy = mouseY - height / 2.0;
        double dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dist < DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS) return -1;

        double angle = Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dx, -dy)); // 0 = РІРІРµСЂС…, РїРѕ С‡Р°СЃРѕРІРѕР№
        if (angle < 0) angle += 360;
        double shifted = (angle + SECTOR_DEG / 2.0) % 360;
        return (int) Math.floor(shifted / SECTOR_DEG) % SECTOR_COUNT;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        updateData();

        int cx = width / 2;
        int cy = height / 2;
        int hovered = getHoveredSector(mouseX, mouseY);

        // Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р· Р·Р° РєР°РґСЂ РЅР° СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂ
        boolean[] available = new boolean[SECTOR_COUNT];
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) available[i] = isAvailable(i);

        PoseStack pose = gui.pose();

        // 1. Р—Р°С‚РµРјРЅС‘РЅРЅР°СЏ РїРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєР°
        fillCircle(pose, cx, cy, BACKDROP_RADIUS, COLOR_BACKDROP, 64);

        // 2. РџРѕРґСЃРІРµС‚РєР° РЅР°РІРµРґС‘РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂР°
        if (hovered >= 0) {
            float startDeg = hovered * SECTOR_DEG - SECTOR_DEG / 2f;
            float endDeg = startDeg + SECTOR_DEG;
            drawRingArc(pose, cx, cy, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS, BACKDROP_RADIUS - 6, startDeg, endDeg, COLOR_HOVER, 16);
        }

        // 3. Р‘РµР»РѕРµ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅРѕРµ РєРѕР»СЊС†Рѕ-С‚СЂРµРє
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) {
            float startDeg = i * SECTOR_DEG - SECTOR_DEG / 2f + GAP_DEG / 2f;
            float endDeg   = i * SECTOR_DEG + SECTOR_DEG / 2f - GAP_DEG / 2f;
            int color = (i == hovered) ? COLOR_TRACK : COLOR_TRACK_DIM;
            drawRingArc(pose, cx, cy, TRACK_INNER, TRACK_OUTER, startDeg, endDeg, color, 24);
        }

        // 4. РРєРѕРЅРєРё + РїРѕРґРїРёСЃРё (СЃРµСЂС‹Рµ, РµСЃР»Рё РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕ; РєСЂР°СЃРЅС‹Рµ СЃ С‚Р°Р№РјРµСЂРѕРј вЂ” РµСЃР»Рё РЅР° РљР”)
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) {
            float deg = i * SECTOR_DEG;
            double rad = Math.toRadians(deg);
            int ix = cx + (int) Math.round(Math.sin(rad) * ICON_RADIUS);
            int iy = cy - (int) Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * ICON_RADIUS);

            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            float alpha = i == hovered ? 1f : 0.85f;
            if (available[i]) {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, alpha);
            } else {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(0.45f, 0.45f, 0.45f, alpha);
            }
            gui.blit(SECTOR_ICONS[i], ix - ICON_SIZE / 2, iy - ICON_SIZE / 2, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE, 0f, 0f, 16, 16, 16, 16);
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);

            int cd = getCooldown(i);
            String label = cd > 0
                    ? String.format(I18n.get(KEY_WAIT), cd / 20)
                    : I18n.get(SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS[i]) + " (" + getCost(i) + ")";
            int labelColor;
            if (cd > 0) labelColor = 0xFFFF5555;
            else if (!available[i]) labelColor = 0xFFAAAAAA;
            else labelColor = i == hovered ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFEEEEEE;
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, label, ix, iy + ICON_SIZE / 2 + 4, labelColor);
        }

        // 5. РўРѕРЅРєРёР№ РєРѕРЅС‚СѓСЂ Р±РѕР»СЊС€РѕРіРѕ РєСЂСѓРіР°
        drawRing(pose, cx, cy, BACKDROP_RADIUS - 1, BACKDROP_RADIUS + 1, COLOR_RIM, 48);

        // 6. РўРѕРЅРєРѕРµ РєРѕР»СЊС†Рѕ РјС‘СЂС‚РІРѕР№ Р·РѕРЅС‹
        drawRing(pose, cx, cy, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS - 1, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS + 1, COLOR_INNER_RING, 48);

        // 7. Р¦РµРЅС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‚РµРєСЃС‚
        String centerText = hovered >= 0 ? I18n.get(SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS[hovered]) : I18n.get(KEY_CANCEL);
        int centerColor = hovered >= 0 ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFCCCCCC;
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, centerText, cx, cy - 4, centerColor);

        // 9. РџРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєР° СЃРЅРёР·Сѓ
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, I18n.get(KEY_HINT), cx, cy + BACKDROP_RADIUS + 10, 0xFFCCCCCC);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (button == 0) {
            int hovered = getHoveredSector((int) mouseX, (int) mouseY);
            handleSelect(hovered);
            return true;
        }
        if (button == 1) {
            this.onClose();
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void handleSelect(int sector) {
        if (sector < 0) {
            this.onClose(); // РјС‘СЂС‚РІР°СЏ Р·РѕРЅР° вЂ” Р·Р°РєСЂС‹С‚СЊ Р±РµР· РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏ
            return;
        }

        // === Р›РћР“РРљРђ РљРЈР›Р”РђРЈРќРђ (РїР°С‚СЂРѕРЅС‹ РІС‹СЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏСЋС‚ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРёР№ РљР” СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ) ===
        if (sector == SECTOR_AMMO) {
            if (cdAmmo > 0) return; // РёРіРЅРѕСЂРёСЂСѓРµРј РєР»РёРє, РµСЃР»Рё РµС‰С‘ РЅР° РљР”

            if (materials >= AASConfig.HUB_RESUPPLY_COST.get() || Minecraft.getInstance().player.isCreative()) {
                ClientData.lastFobResupplyTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
            }
        }

        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestCrateAmmo(entityId, sector));
        this.onClose();
    }

    // ================= РЈС‚РёР»РёС‚С‹ РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєРё (РёРґРµРЅС‚РёС‡РЅРѕ HubRadialScreen) =================

    private static void beginColorDraw() {
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableCull();
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
    }

    private static void fillCircle(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float radius, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_FAN, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        buf.vertex(m, cx, cy, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            float x = cx + (float) (Math.sin(ang) * radius);
            float y = cy - (float) (Math.cos(ang) * radius);
            buf.vertex(m, x, y, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }

    private static void drawRing(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float innerR, float outerR, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            float sx = (float) Math.sin(ang), sy = (float) -Math.cos(ang);
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * outerR, cy + sy * outerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * innerR, cy + sy * innerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }

    private static void drawRingArc(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float innerR, float outerR,
                                    float startDeg, float endDeg, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = Math.toRadians(startDeg + (endDeg - startDeg) * i / segments);
            float sx = (float) Math.sin(ang), sy = (float) -Math.cos(ang);
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * outerR, cy + sy * outerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * innerR, cy + sy * innerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;

/** Small helpers for the preparation screens (vote / versus): easing curves and a "fade-in veil". */
public final class DeckAnim {
    private DeckAnim() {}

    /** Colour of the dark backdrop the veil fades from (must match the screen backdrop). */
    public static final int BACKDROP_RGB = 0x101010;

    public static float clamp01(float v) { return v < 0f ? 0f : Math.min(v, 1f); }

    public static float easeOutCubic(float t) {
        t = clamp01(t);
        float u = 1f - t;
        return 1f - u * u * u;
    }

    /** Overshoots a bit and settles at 1 (used for the "VS" pop). */
    public static float easeOutBack(float t) {
        t = clamp01(t);
        final float c1 = 1.70158f, c3 = c1 + 1f;
        float u = t - 1f;
        return 1f + c3 * u * u * u + c1 * u * u;
    }

    public static int lerpColor(int a, int b, float t) {
        t = clamp01(t);
        int out = 0;
        for (int shift = 24; shift >= 0; shift -= 8) {
            int ca = (a >> shift) & 0xFF, cb = (b >> shift) & 0xFF;
            out |= ((int) (ca + (cb - ca) * t) & 0xFF) << shift;
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Draws backdrop-coloured rect over an already drawn area: visible=0 hides it, visible=1 leaves it untouched (= cheap fade-in). */
    public static void veil(GuiGraphics g, int x, int y, int w, int h, float visible) {
        if (visible >= 0.999f) return;
        g.flush();   // text is batched and drawn late; without this it would stay above the veil and not fade
        int a = (int) ((1f - clamp01(visible)) * 255f);
        g.fill(x, y, x + w, y + h, (a << 24) | BACKDROP_RGB);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import com.example.aas.client.DeckClient;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketDeckInfo;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketRequestDeckInfo;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSetEditDeck;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketUpdateDeckParams;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.EditBox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

/** Admin screen: enabled / hubLimit / crateBonus / tickets of one deck of one team. Values come from the server (PacketDeckInfo). */
public class DeckParamsScreen extends Screen {
    private final String team;
    private final Screen parent;
    private boolean enabled = true;
    private boolean loaded = false;
    private Button enabledBtn;
    private EditBox hubBox, crateBox, ticketBox;

    public DeckParamsScreen(String team, Screen parent) {
        super(Component.translatable("aas.admin.deck_params"));
        this.team = team;
        this.parent = parent;
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        int cx = width / 2;
        int y = 40;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSetEditDeck(DeckClient.editDeck.ordinal()));

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("<"), b -> cycle(-1)).bounds(cx - 130, y, 20, 20).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(">"), b -> cycle(1)).bounds(cx + 110, y, 20, 20).build());

        enabledBtn = Button.builder(Component.empty(), b -> { enabled = !enabled; updateEnabledLabel(); })
                .bounds(cx - 100, y + 30, 200, 20).build();
        addRenderableWidget(enabledBtn);
        updateEnabledLabel();

        hubBox = box(cx + 10, y + 60);
        crateBox = box(cx + 10, y + 86);
        ticketBox = box(cx + 10, y + 112);

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.admin.save"), b -> save()).bounds(cx - 100, y + 146, 98, 20).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.admin.back"), b -> minecraft.setScreen(parent)).bounds(cx + 2, y + 146, 98, 20).build());

        request();
    }

    private EditBox box(int x, int y) {
        EditBox e = new EditBox(font, x, y, 90, 18, Component.empty());
        e.setFilter(s -> s.matches("\\d{0,6}"));
        e.setValue("0");
        addRenderableWidget(e);
        return e;
    }

    private void request() {
        loaded = false;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestDeckInfo(team, DeckClient.editDeck.ordinal()));
    }

    private void cycle(int step) {
        DeckClient.editDeck = DeckClient.editDeck.next(step);
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSetEditDeck(DeckClient.editDeck.ordinal()));
        request();
    }

    private void updateEnabledLabel() {
        enabledBtn.setMessage(Component.translatable(enabled ? "aas.admin.enabled_on" : "aas.admin.enabled_off"));
    }

    public void onInfo(PacketDeckInfo msg) {
        if (msg.deck != DeckClient.editDeck.ordinal()) return;
        enabled = msg.enabled;
        updateEnabledLabel();
        hubBox.setValue(String.valueOf(msg.hubLimit));
        crateBox.setValue(String.valueOf(msg.crateBonus));
        ticketBox.setValue(String.valueOf(msg.tickets));
        loaded = true;
    }

    private static int num(EditBox b, int def) {
        try { return Integer.parseInt(b.getValue().trim()); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { return def; }
    }

    private void save() {
        if (!loaded) return;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketUpdateDeckParams(team, DeckClient.editDeck.ordinal(), enabled,
                num(hubBox, 4), Math.min(1000, num(crateBox, 0)), num(ticketBox, 800)));
        request();   // shows what the server really stored (it clamps and keeps at least one deck enabled)
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        renderBackground(gui);
        int cx = width / 2;
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable("aas.admin.deck_params_title", team), cx, 12, 0xFFFFFF);
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable(DeckClient.editDeck.classLangKey()), cx, 46, 0xFFD700);
        gui.drawString(font, Component.translatable("aas.admin.hub_limit"), cx - 130, 105, 0xAAAAAA, false);
        gui.drawString(font, Component.translatable("aas.admin.crate_bonus"), cx - 130, 131, 0xAAAAAA, false);
        gui.drawString(font, Component.translatable("aas.admin.tickets"), cx - 130, 157, 0xAAAAAA, false);
        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import com.example.aas.client.DeckClient;
import com.example.aas.client.DeckIcons;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckRegistry;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckType;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

/** "Your deck  VS  enemy deck" shown for a few seconds before the countdown. Closed by DeckClient. */
public class DeckVersusScreen extends Screen {
    private static final int PW = 190, PH = 190, PTOP = 100;   // panel size, distance from centre to its top edge

    private final boolean blue;
    private long openMs = 0L;

    public DeckVersusScreen(boolean blue) {
        super(Component.translatable("aas.deck.versus.title"));
        this.blue = blue;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }

    @Override
    public void onClose() { }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }

    /** One side in local coordinates (0,0 = centre of the composition). slideFrom = start offset of the short slide-in. */
    private void side(GuiGraphics gui, boolean teamBlue, DeckType d, int cx, float slideFrom, float appear, boolean mine) {
        String faction = DeckClient.factionOf(teamBlue);
        int x = cx + Math.round((1f - appear) * slideFrom);
        int top = -PTOP;

        DeckIcons.drawFlag(gui, faction, teamBlue, x - 18, top + 8, 36, 20);
        DeckIcons.drawEmblem(gui, faction, teamBlue, d, x - 48, top + 34, 96);
        DeckIcons.drawClass(gui, d, x - 10, top + 134, 20);
        Component name = Component.translatable(DeckRegistry.nameKey(faction, teamBlue, d));
        int line = 0;
        for (var seq : font.split(name, PW - 16)) {
            if (line >= 3) break;
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, seq, x, top + 158 + line * 10, 0xFFFFFF);
            line++;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (openMs == 0L) openMs = now;
        float ms = now - openMs;

        renderBackground(gui);
        gui.fill(0, 0, width, height, 0xE6101010);

        DeckType mine = DeckClient.state.chosen(blue);
        DeckType enemy = DeckClient.state.chosen(!blue);
        if (mine == null || enemy == null) return;

        float s = Math.min(1f, (height - 70f) / (PH + 40f));
        if (s < 0.4f) s = 0.4f;
        int off = (int) Math.min(150f, (width / s) / 4f);
        float a = DeckAnim.easeOutCubic(ms / 300f);          // both panels, one short slide (no overshoot)

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(width / 2f, height / 2f, 0);
        gui.pose().scale(s, s, 1f);
        side(gui, blue, mine, -off, -60f, a, true);
        side(gui, !blue, enemy, off, 60f, a, false);
        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().scale(3f, 3f, 1f);
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, "VS", 0, -4, 0xFFD700);
        gui.pose().popPose();
        gui.pose().popPose();

        gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable("aas.deck.versus.start_in", DeckClient.secondsLeft()), width / 2, height - 24, 0xAAAAAA);

        DeckAnim.veil(gui, 0, 0, width, height, DeckAnim.easeOutCubic(ms / 200f));   // quick fade-in of the whole screen
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Deck vote. Cannot be closed (ESC and onClose() are ignored); DeckClient closes it when the phase ends.
 * A card = one enabled deck of the player's team. Click on the card = vote (changeable), click on "?" = info window.
 */
public class DeckVoteScreen extends Screen {
    private static final int CW = 170, CH = 92, GAP = 10, STRIP = 26;

    private final boolean blue;
    private PacketDeckInfo popup = null;
    private boolean waitingForInfo = false;
    private float scale = 1f;
    private int ox, oy, cols, total;

    private long openMs = 0L;                      // for the short fade-in

    public DeckVoteScreen(boolean blue) {
        super(Component.translatable("aas.deck.vote.title"));
        this.blue = blue;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }

    @Override
    public void onClose() { /* cannot be closed while the vote runs */ }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }

    public void onInfo(PacketDeckInfo msg) {
        if (waitingForInfo) {
            popup = msg;
            waitingForInfo = false;
        }
    }

    private List<DeckType> decks() {
        List<DeckType> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (DeckType d : DeckType.VALUES) if (DeckClient.state.isEnabled(blue, d)) out.add(d);
        return out;
    }

    private void layout(int count) {
        total = count;
        cols = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, count));
        int rows = (count + cols - 1) / cols;
        int lw = cols * CW + (cols - 1) * GAP;
        int lh = rows * CH + (rows - 1) * GAP;
        float availW = width - 20f, availH = height - 70f;
        scale = Math.min(1f, Math.min(availW / lw, availH / lh));
        if (scale <= 0.1f) scale = 0.1f;
        ox = (int) ((width - lw * scale) / 2f);
        oy = (int) (50 + (availH - lh * scale) / 2f);
    }

    /** Cards of an incomplete last row are centred under the full rows. */
    private int cardX(int i) {
        int row = i / cols;
        int inRow = Math.min(cols, total - row * cols);
        return (i % cols) * (CW + GAP) + (cols - inRow) * (CW + GAP) / 2;
    }
    private int cardY(int i) { return (i / cols) * (CH + GAP); }

    private static boolean in(double x, double y, int rx, int ry, int rw, int rh) {
        return x >= rx && x < rx + rw && y >= ry && y < ry + rh;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (openMs == 0L) openMs = now;
        float fade = DeckAnim.easeOutCubic((now - openMs) / 220f);          // short fade-in of the whole screen

        renderBackground(gui);
        gui.fill(0, 0, width, height, 0xE6101010);

        gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable("aas.deck.vote.title"), width / 2, 12, 0xFFFFFF);
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable("aas.deck.vote.timer", DeckClient.secondsLeft()), width / 2, 28, 0xFFD700);

        List<DeckType> decks = decks();
        layout(decks.size());
        String faction = DeckClient.factionOf(blue);
        int[] votes = DeckClient.state.votes(blue);
        double vx = (mouseX - ox) / (double) scale, vy = (mouseY - oy) / (double) scale;

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(ox, oy, 0);
        gui.pose().scale(scale, scale, 1f);
        for (int i = 0; i < decks.size(); i++) {
            DeckType d = decks.get(i);
            int cx = cardX(i), cy = cardY(i);
            boolean selected = DeckClient.myVote == d.ordinal();
            boolean hover = popup == null && in(vx, vy, cx, cy, CW, CH);

            gui.fill(cx, cy, cx + CW, cy + CH, hover ? 0xE6262626 : 0xE6181818);
            gui.renderOutline(cx, cy, CW, CH, selected ? 0xFFFFD700 : (hover ? 0xFF888888 : 0xFF555555));
            if (selected) gui.renderOutline(cx + 1, cy + 1, CW - 2, CH - 2, 0xFFFFD700);

            DeckIcons.drawEmblem(gui, faction, blue, d, cx + 6, cy + 6, 60);
            DeckIcons.drawFlag(gui, faction, blue, cx + CW - 42, cy + 6, 36, 20);

            int sy = cy + CH - STRIP;
            gui.fill(cx, sy, cx + CW, cy + CH, 0xFF000000);
            DeckIcons.drawClass(gui, d, cx + 4, sy + 4, 18);

            Component name = Component.translatable(DeckRegistry.nameKey(faction, blue, d));
            List<FormattedCharSequence> lines = font.split(name, CW - 4 - 18 - 6 - 22 - 4);
            for (int l = 0; l < Math.min(2, lines.size()); l++) {
                gui.drawString(font, lines.get(l), cx + 26, sy + 4 + l * 10, 0xFFFFFF, false);
            }

            int qx = cx + CW - 22, qy = sy + 4;
            boolean qHover = in(vx, vy, qx, qy, 18, 18);
            gui.fill(qx, qy, qx + 18, qy + 18, qHover ? 0xFF666666 : 0xFF3C3C3C);
            gui.renderOutline(qx, qy, 18, 18, 0xFFFFFFFF);
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, "?", qx + 9, qy + 5, 0xFFFFFF);

            int n = votes[d.ordinal()];
            if (n > 0) {                                  // nobody voted: show nothing
                String count = String.valueOf(n);
                gui.drawString(font, count, cx + CW - 6 - font.width(count), sy - 12, 0xFFFFFF, true);
            }
        }
        gui.pose().popPose();

        if (popup != null) renderPopup(gui);
        else if (waitingForInfo) gui.drawCenteredString(font, "...", width / 2, height - 20, 0xAAAAAA);

        DeckAnim.veil(gui, 0, 0, width, height, fade);     // flushes the text first, then covers everything evenly
    }

    private static String limit(int v) {
        if (v < 0) return "\u221E";
        if (v == 0) return I18n.get("aas.deck.info.none");
        return String.valueOf(v);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ "?" window
    private static final int P_W = 300, P_PAD = 8, P_ROW = 14, P_SEC_H = 13, P_HEAD_H = 36;
    private static final int COL_BG = 0xF0101010, COL_BORDER = 0xFF555555, COL_SEC_BG = 0x40FFFFFF;
    private static final int COL_STRIPE = 0x14FFFFFF, COL_DIM = 0xFF999999, COL_TEXT = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    private static final int COL_GOOD = 0xFF55FF55, COL_BAD = 0xFFFF5555, COL_TICKETS = 0xFFFF8888;
    private static final int P_ICON = 12;

    /** Section bar: dim caption on a light strip. */
    private void popupSection(GuiGraphics gui, int x, int y, int w, String caption) {
        gui.fill(x + 1, y, x + w - 1, y + P_SEC_H, COL_SEC_BG);
        gui.drawString(font, caption.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT), x + P_PAD, y + 3, COL_DIM, false);
    }

    /** One "label ........ value" row of the parameters block; iconTex != null draws that icon left of the value. */
    private void popupStat(GuiGraphics gui, int x, int y, int w, int idx, String label, String value, int color,
                           net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation iconTex) {
        if ((idx & 1) == 1) gui.fill(x + 1, y, x + w - 1, y + P_ROW, COL_STRIPE);
        int ty = y + (P_ROW - font.lineHeight) / 2 + 1;
        gui.drawString(font, label, x + P_PAD, ty, COL_TEXT, false);
        int vr = x + w - P_PAD;
        gui.drawString(font, value, vr - font.width(value), ty, color, false);
        if (iconTex != null) {
            VehicleListPanel.drawTexOrStub(gui, iconTex, vr - font.width(value) - P_ICON - 3, y + (P_ROW - P_ICON) / 2, P_ICON);
        }
    }

    private void renderPopup(GuiGraphics gui) {
        PacketDeckInfo p = popup;
        DeckType d = DeckType.byOrdinal(p.deck);
        String faction = DeckClient.factionOf(blue);

        // fit the vehicle list on small screens: extra lines collapse into "+N"
        int fixed = P_HEAD_H + P_SEC_H * 2 + P_ROW * 5 + 6 + 20;
        int maxVeh = Math.max(1, (height - 8 - fixed) / P_ROW);
        int total = p.vehicles.isEmpty() ? 1 : p.vehicles.size();
        int shown = Math.min(total, maxVeh);
        boolean more = !p.vehicles.isEmpty() && p.vehicles.size() > shown;
        if (more) shown = Math.max(1, shown - 1);          // one line is taken by "+N"
        int vehLines = p.vehicles.isEmpty() ? 1 : shown + (more ? 1 : 0);

        int w = P_W;
        int h = P_HEAD_H + P_SEC_H + vehLines * P_ROW + 6 + P_SEC_H + P_ROW * 5 + 20;
        int x = (width - w) / 2, y = Math.max(4, (height - h) / 2);

        gui.fill(x, y, x + w, y + h, COL_BG);
        gui.renderOutline(x, y, w, h, COL_BORDER);

        // ---- header: emblem, name, class, flag
        gui.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + w - 1, y + P_HEAD_H, 0x30FFFFFF);
        if (d != null) {
            DeckIcons.drawEmblem(gui, faction, blue, d, x + P_PAD, y + 6, 24);
            gui.drawString(font, Component.translatable(DeckRegistry.nameKey(faction, blue, d)), x + P_PAD + 24 + 6, y + 8, 0xFFFFD700, false);
            gui.drawString(font, Component.translatable(d.classLangKey()), x + P_PAD + 24 + 6, y + 20, COL_DIM, false);
        }
        DeckIcons.drawFlag(gui, faction, blue, x + w - P_PAD - 30, y + 10, 30, 18);
        gui.fill(x + 1, y + P_HEAD_H, x + w - 1, y + P_HEAD_H + 1, COL_BORDER);

        // ---- vehicles block
        int ry = y + P_HEAD_H + 1;
        popupSection(gui, x, ry, w, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.title_vehicles"));
        VehicleListPanel.drawTexOrStub(gui, VehicleListPanel.ICON_TICKETS, x + w - P_PAD - 10, ry + 2, 10);   // column: tickets lost
        ry += P_SEC_H;
        int colTickets = x + w - P_PAD;       // right edge of the tickets column
        int colCount = colTickets - 40;       // right edge of the "x2" column
        if (p.vehicles.isEmpty()) {
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.no_vehicles"), x + w / 2, ry + 3, COL_DIM);
            ry += P_ROW;
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < shown; i++) {
                PacketDeckInfo.VehicleLine l = p.vehicles.get(i);
                if ((i & 1) == 1) gui.fill(x + 1, ry, x + w - 1, ry + P_ROW, COL_STRIPE);
                var cat = com.example.aas.util.VehicleCatalog.resolve(null, l.markerType());
                VehicleListPanel.drawTexOrStub(gui, VehicleListPanel.mapIcon(l.markerType(), cat), x + P_PAD, ry + (P_ROW - P_ICON) / 2, P_ICON);
                int ty = ry + (P_ROW - font.lineHeight) / 2 + 1;
                String cnt = "x" + l.count();
                int nameL = x + P_PAD + P_ICON + 4;
                String name = I18n.get(l.nameKey());
                int nameMax = colCount - font.width(cnt) - nameL - 8;
                if (font.width(name) > nameMax) name = font.plainSubstrByWidth(name, Math.max(0, nameMax - font.width("..."))) + "...";
                gui.drawString(font, name, nameL, ty, COL_TEXT, false);
                gui.drawString(font, cnt, colCount - font.width(cnt), ty, COL_DIM, false);
                String pen = l.penalty() > 0 ? "-" + l.penalty() : "0";
                gui.drawString(font, pen, colTickets - font.width(pen), ty, l.penalty() > 0 ? COL_TICKETS : COL_DIM, false);
                ry += P_ROW;
            }
            if (more) {
                int rest = p.vehicles.size() - shown;
                gui.drawCenteredString(font, "+" + rest, x + w / 2, ry + 3, COL_DIM);
                ry += P_ROW;
            }
        }
        ry += 6;

        // ---- deck parameters block
        gui.fill(x + 1, ry - 1, x + w - 1, ry, COL_BORDER);
        popupSection(gui, x, ry, w, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.title_params"));
        ry += P_SEC_H;
        int i = 0;
        popupStat(gui, x, ry, w, i++, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.l_hubs"), limit(p.hubLimit), limitColor(p.hubLimit), null); ry += P_ROW;
        popupStat(gui, x, ry, w, i++, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.l_aa"), limit(p.antiAirMax), limitColor(p.antiAirMax), null); ry += P_ROW;
        popupStat(gui, x, ry, w, i++, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.l_hat"), limit(p.hatMax), limitColor(p.hatMax), null); ry += P_ROW;
        popupStat(gui, x, ry, w, i++, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.l_crate"), String.valueOf(p.crateTotal), COL_TEXT, null); ry += P_ROW;
        popupStat(gui, x, ry, w, i, I18n.get("aas.deck.info.l_tickets"), String.valueOf(p.tickets), COL_TEXT, VehicleListPanel.ICON_TICKETS);

        gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable("aas.deck.info.click_close"), x + w / 2, y + h - 13, 0xFF888888);
    }

    private static int limitColor(int v) {
        return v < 0 ? COL_GOOD : (v == 0 ? COL_BAD : COL_TEXT);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (button != 0) return true;
        if (popup != null || waitingForInfo) {   // the window closes with a click, the vote keeps running
            popup = null;
            waitingForInfo = false;
            return true;
        }
        List<DeckType> decks = decks();
        layout(decks.size());
        double vx = (mouseX - ox) / (double) scale, vy = (mouseY - oy) / (double) scale;
        for (int i = 0; i < decks.size(); i++) {
            int cx = cardX(i), cy = cardY(i);
            if (!in(vx, vy, cx, cy, CW, CH)) continue;
            DeckType d = decks.get(i);
            if (in(vx, vy, cx + CW - 22, cy + CH - STRIP + 4, 18, 18)) {
                waitingForInfo = true;
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestDeckInfo(blue ? "BLUE" : "RED", d.ordinal()));
            } else {
                DeckClient.myVote = d.ordinal();
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketDeckVote(d.ordinal()));
            }
            return true;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        return false;   // ESC and everything else is swallowed
    }
}

    private static final String KEY_WALL    = "aas.build.walls";

    private static final String KEY_HINT    = "aas.radio.hint";
    private static final String KEY_BACK    = "aas.radio.back";

    // Р СџР С•РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р С•Р С” РЎРѓР ВµР С”РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†: 0=Up(HUB), 1=Wire, 2=Bunker, 3=Vehicle Station, 4=Walls(Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹), 5=Back
    private static final ResourceLocation[] SECTOR_ICONS      = {ICON_HUB, ICON_WIRE, ICON_BUNKER, ICON_STATION, ICON_WALL, ICON_BACK};
    private static final String[]           SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS = {KEY_HUB, KEY_WIRE, KEY_BUNKER, KEY_STATION, KEY_WALL, KEY_BACK};
    // РРЅРґРµРєСЃ СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂР° "РќР°Р·Р°Рґ" вЂ” РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёР№ РІ РєРѕР»РµСЃРµ, РІСЃРµРіРґР° РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅ (Р±РµР· РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєРё РјР°С‚РµСЂРёР°Р»РѕРІ).
    private static final int SECTOR_BACK = 5;
    // ID Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р ВµР С” Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ ClientPlacementHandler (Wire=13, Bunker=17, Vehicle Station=18, 1x1 Wall=10 Р С”Р В°Р С” Р В±Р В°Р В·Р В° Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р С‘ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•Р С‘Р СР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР ВµР Р…)
    private static final int PLACEMENT_ID_WIRE    = 13;
    private static final int PLACEMENT_ID_BUNKER  = 17;
    private static final int PLACEMENT_ID_STATION = 18;
    private static final int PLACEMENT_ID_WALL    = 10;

    private final Screen parentScreen;
    private boolean isSwitching = false;

    public DefenseRadialScreen(Screen parent) {
        super(Component.literal("Defense Menu"));
        this.parentScreen = parent;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }

    @Override

        super.init();
        triggerRadioAnim("deploy");

    @Override
    public void onClose() {
        if (!isSwitching) {
            triggerRadioAnim("close");
        }
        super.onClose();
    }

    private void triggerRadioAnim(String animName) {
        if (this.minecraft.player != null) {
            ItemStack stack = this.minecraft.player.getMainHandItem();
            if (stack.getItem() instanceof RallyItem radio) {
                long instanceId = stack.getOrCreateTag().getLong("GeckoLibID");
                radio.triggerAnim(this.minecraft.player, instanceId, "RadioController", animName);
            }
        }
    }

    private int getHoveredSector(int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        double dx = mouseX - width / 2.0;
        double dy = mouseY - height / 2.0;
        double dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dist < DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS) return -1;

        double angle = Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dx, -dy)); // 0 = Р Р†Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂ¦, Р С—Р С• РЎвЂЎР В°РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С•Р в„–
        if (angle < 0) angle += 360;
        double shifted = (angle + SECTOR_DEG / 2.0) % 360;
        return (int) Math.floor(shifted / SECTOR_DEG) % SECTOR_COUNT;
    }

    /**
     * Р СљР С•Р В¶Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” РЎРѓР ВµР в„–РЎвЂЎР В°РЎРѓ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”РЎС“ Р Р† РЎРѓР ВµР С”РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р Вµ {@code i} (Р С‘РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С•
     * Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР Р†Р ВµРЎвЂљР С”Р С‘ Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р…Р С”Р С‘ Р В±Р ВµР В»РЎвЂ№Р С/РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р С РІР‚вЂќ Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂЎР В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎС“РЎР‹ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”РЎС“ Р Р†РЎРѓРЎвЂ РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р С• Р Т‘Р ВµР В»Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ
     * ClientPlacementHandler/РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚ Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘ РЎР‚Р ВµР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р в„– Р С—Р С•Р С—РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР С”Р Вµ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘).
     */
    private boolean canBuildSector(int i) {
        return switch (i) {
            case 0 -> ClientPlacementHandler.canBuildHub();               // HUB
            case 1 -> ClientPlacementHandler.canAfford(PLACEMENT_ID_WIRE);    // Barbed Wire
            case 2 -> ClientPlacementHandler.canAfford(PLACEMENT_ID_BUNKER);  // Bunker
            case 3 -> ClientPlacementHandler.canAfford(PLACEMENT_ID_STATION); // Vehicle Station
            case 4 -> ClientPlacementHandler.canAfford(PLACEMENT_ID_WALL);    // Walls (РЎРѓР В°Р СРЎвЂ№Р в„– Р Т‘Р ВµРЎв‚¬РЎвЂР Р†РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р Р†Р В°РЎР‚Р С‘Р В°Р Р…РЎвЂљ 1x1)
            case 5 -> true; // Back вЂ” РІСЃРµРіРґР° РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅ
            default -> true;
        };
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        int cx = width / 2;
        int cy = height / 2;
        int hovered = getHoveredSector(mouseX, mouseY);

        // Р вЂќР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎС“Р С—Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓРЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р Р… РЎР‚Р В°Р В· Р В·Р В° Р С”Р В°Р Т‘РЎР‚ Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР ВµР С”РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚, Р Р…Р Вµ Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С Р В»Р С‘РЎв‚¬Р Р…Р С‘Р в„– РЎР‚Р В°Р В·.
        boolean[] canBuild = new boolean[SECTOR_COUNT];
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) canBuild[i] = canBuildSector(i);

        PoseStack pose = gui.pose();

        // 1. Р вЂ”Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР СР Р…РЎвЂР Р…Р Р…Р В°РЎРЏ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р В»Р С•Р В¶Р С”Р В°
        fillCircle(pose, cx, cy, BACKDROP_RADIUS, COLOR_BACKDROP, 64);

        // 2. Р СџР С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР Р†Р ВµРЎвЂљР С”Р В° Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р ВµР Т‘РЎвЂР Р…Р Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР ВµР С”РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р В°
        if (hovered >= 0) {
            float startDeg = hovered * SECTOR_DEG - SECTOR_DEG / 2f;
            float endDeg = startDeg + SECTOR_DEG;
            drawRingArc(pose, cx, cy, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS, BACKDROP_RADIUS - 6, startDeg, endDeg, COLOR_HOVER, 16);
        }

        // 3. Р вЂР ВµР В»Р С•Р Вµ РЎРѓР ВµР С–Р СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р Р…Р С•Р Вµ Р С”Р С•Р В»РЎРЉРЎвЂ Р С•-РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р ВµР С”
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) {
            float startDeg = i * SECTOR_DEG - SECTOR_DEG / 2f + GAP_DEG / 2f;
            float endDeg   = i * SECTOR_DEG + SECTOR_DEG / 2f - GAP_DEG / 2f;
            int color = (i == hovered) ? COLOR_TRACK : COLOR_TRACK_DIM;
            drawRingArc(pose, cx, cy, TRACK_INNER, TRACK_OUTER, startDeg, endDeg, color, 24);
        }

        // 4. Р ВР С”Р С•Р Р…Р С”Р С‘ + Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С‘ (РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Вµ, Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”РЎС“ РЎРѓР ВµР в„–РЎвЂЎР В°РЎРѓ РЎР‚Р В°Р В·Р СР ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р Р…Р Вµ Р С—Р С•Р В»РЎС“РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ)
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) {
            float deg = i * SECTOR_DEG;
            double rad = Math.toRadians(deg);
            int ix = cx + (int) Math.round(Math.sin(rad) * ICON_RADIUS);
            int iy = cy - (int) Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * ICON_RADIUS);

            boolean available = canBuild[i];

            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            float alpha = i == hovered ? 1f : 0.85f;
            if (available) {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, alpha);
            } else {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(0.45f, 0.45f, 0.45f, alpha);
            }
            gui.blit(SECTOR_ICONS[i], ix - ICON_SIZE / 2, iy - ICON_SIZE / 2, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE, 0f, 0f, 16, 16, 16, 16);
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);

            String label = I18n.get(SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS[i]);
            int labelColor;
            if (!available) labelColor = 0xFFAAAAAA;
            else labelColor = i == hovered ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFEEEEEE;
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, label, ix, iy + ICON_SIZE / 2 + 4, labelColor);
        }

        // 5. Р СћР С•Р Р…Р С”Р С‘Р в„– Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂљРЎС“РЎР‚ Р В±Р С•Р В»РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р С•Р С–Р С• Р С”РЎР‚РЎС“Р С–Р В°
        drawRing(pose, cx, cy, BACKDROP_RADIUS - 1, BACKDROP_RADIUS + 1, COLOR_RIM, 48);

        // 6. Р СћР С•Р Р…Р С”Р С•Р Вµ Р С”Р С•Р В»РЎРЉРЎвЂ Р С• Р СРЎвЂРЎР‚РЎвЂљР Р†Р С•Р в„– Р В·Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂ№
        drawRing(pose, cx, cy, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS - 1, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS + 1, COLOR_INNER_RING, 48);

        // 7. Р В¦Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎРѓРЎвЂљ
        String centerText = hovered >= 0 ? I18n.get(SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS[hovered]) : I18n.get(KEY_CANCEL);
        int centerColor = hovered >= 0 ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFCCCCCC;
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, centerText, cx, cy - 4, centerColor);

        // 8. Р СџР С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР С”Р В°Р В·Р С”Р В° РЎРѓР Р…Р С‘Р В·РЎС“
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, I18n.get(KEY_HINT), cx, cy + BACKDROP_RADIUS + 10, 0xFFCCCCCC);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (button == 0) {
            int hovered = getHoveredSector((int) mouseX, (int) mouseY);
            handleSelect(hovered);
            return true;
        }
        if (button == 1) {
            Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(parentScreen);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void handleSelect(int sector) {
        if (sector < 0) {
            this.onClose(); // Р СРЎвЂРЎР‚РЎвЂљР Р†Р В°РЎРЏ Р В·Р С•Р Р…Р В° РІР‚вЂќ Р В·Р В°Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р В±Р ВµР В· Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘РЎРЏ
            return;
        }

        switch (sector) {
            case 0 -> { // HUB РІР‚вЂќ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р СР С–Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С• Р Р…Р В° Р С—Р С•Р В·Р С‘РЎвЂ Р С‘Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°, Р В±Р ВµР В· Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘РЎвЂ Р ВµР В»Р С‘Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRadioAction(14));
                this.onClose();
            }
            case 1 -> { // Barbed Wire
                ClientPlacementHandler.startPlacing(PLACEMENT_ID_WIRE);
                this.onClose();
            }
            case 2 -> { // Bunker
                ClientPlacementHandler.startPlacing(PLACEMENT_ID_BUNKER);
                this.onClose();
            }
            case 3 -> { // Vehicle Station
                ClientPlacementHandler.startPlacing(PLACEMENT_ID_STATION);
                this.onClose();
            }
            case 4 -> { // Walls РІР‚вЂќ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹
                this.isSwitching = true;
                Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new WallRadialScreen(this));
            }
            case 5 -> { // Back вЂ” РЅР°Р·Р°Рґ РЅР° РїСЂРµРґС‹РґСѓС‰РёР№ СЌРєСЂР°РЅ
                Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(parentScreen);
            }
        }
    }

    // ================= Р Р€РЎвЂљР С‘Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С‘РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С”Р С‘ (РЎвЂљР Вµ Р В¶Р Вµ, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С• Р С‘ Р Р† StaticGunRadialScreen) =================

    private static void beginColorDraw() {
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableCull();
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
    }

    private static void fillCircle(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float radius, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_FAN, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        buf.vertex(m, cx, cy, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            float x = cx + (float) (Math.sin(ang) * radius);
            float y = cy - (float) (Math.cos(ang) * radius);
            buf.vertex(m, x, y, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }

    private static void drawRing(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float innerR, float outerR, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            float sx = (float) Math.sin(ang), sy = (float) -Math.cos(ang);
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * outerR, cy + sy * outerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * innerR, cy + sy * innerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }

    private static void drawRingArc(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float innerR, float outerR,
                                    float startDeg, float endDeg, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = Math.toRadians(startDeg + (endDeg - startDeg) * i / segments);
            float sx = (float) Math.sin(ang), sy = (float) -Math.cos(ang);
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * outerR, cy + sy * outerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * innerR, cy + sy * innerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }
}

import com.example.aas.network.PacketDownedAction;

public class DownedScreen extends Screen {
    private static final ResourceLocation HEARTBEAT_ICON = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/heartbeat.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation VIGNETTE_TEXTURE = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/misc/vignette.png");

    private Button callMedicButton;
    private long lastMedicCallTime = 0;

    // РЎРўРђР›Рћ
    public DownedScreen() {
        super(Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.title"));
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        int cx = this.width / 2;
        int bottomY = this.height - 50;

        // РЎРўРђР›Рћ
        this.addRenderableWidget(new SquadButton(cx - 130, bottomY, 120, 24, Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.give_up"), b -> {
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketDownedAction(1));
            this.onClose();
        }));

        this.callMedicButton = this.addRenderableWidget(new SquadButton(cx + 10, bottomY, 120, 24, Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.call_medic"), b -> {
            long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
            if (currentTime - lastMedicCallTime >= 15000) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketDownedAction(0));
                lastMedicCallTime = currentTime;
            }
        }));
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        renderVignette(gui);

        int cx = this.width / 2;
        int baseY = this.height - 150;
        int boxW = 320;
        int boxH = 135;

        renderSquadFrame(gui, cx - boxW / 2, baseY, boxW, boxH);

        // РРєРѕРЅРєР°
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        float revProgress = com.example.aas.client.ClientData.reviveProgressSelf;
        com.example.aas.client.gui.ReviveIconRenderer.drawGui(
                gui, HEARTBEAT_ICON, cx, baseY + 28, 36f, 20.5f, 23.5f, revProgress);

        // Р Р°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ РґРѕ СЃРѕСЋР·РЅРёРєРѕРІ
        String allyStatus = getAllyDistanceStatus();
        gui.drawCenteredString(this.font, allyStatus, cx, baseY + 55, 0xFFFFFF);

        // === РРЎРџР РђР’Р›Р•РќРќР«Р™ РўРђР™РњР•Р  (РџСЂРѕР±Р»РµРјР° в„–2) ===
        // Р’РјРµСЃС‚Рѕ this.screenOpenTime РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј РіР»РѕР±Р°Р»СЊРЅСѓСЋ РјРµС‚РєСѓ РёР· ClientData
        int maxSeconds = com.example.aas.config.AASConfig.MAX_DOWNED_TIME_SECONDS.get();
        long deathTime = com.example.aas.client.ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp;

        // РЎС‡РёС‚Р°РµРј СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґ РїСЂРѕС€Р»Рѕ СЃ РјРѕРјРµРЅС‚Р° СЃРјРµСЂС‚Рё (РїР°РґРµРЅРёСЏ РІ РЅРѕРє)
        // Р•СЃР»Рё deathTime РІРґСЂСѓРі 0, СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµРј С‡С‚Рѕ РїСЂРѕС€Р»Рѕ 0 СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґ (С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ Р±Р°РіРѕРІ)
        long elapsedSeconds = (deathTime == 0) ? 0 : (System.currentTimeMillis() - deathTime) / 1000;
        long remainingBleedout = maxSeconds - elapsedSeconds;

        if (remainingBleedout < 0) remainingBleedout = 0;

        // РЎРўРђР›Рћ
        String bleedText = Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.bleeding_out", remainingBleedout).getString();
        gui.drawCenteredString(this.font, bleedText, cx, baseY + 72, 0xAAAAAA);

        // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРёРµ РљР” РЅР° РєРЅРѕРїРєРµ
        long remainingCooldown = 15000 - (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastMedicCallTime);
        if (remainingCooldown > 0) {
            callMedicButton.setMessage(Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.call_medic_cd", (remainingCooldown / 1000 + 1)));
            callMedicButton.active = false;
        } else {
            callMedicButton.setMessage(Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.call_medic"));
            callMedicButton.active = true;
        }

        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);
    }

    private String getAllyDistanceStatus() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.level == null || mc.player == null) return "NO NEARBY ALLIES";

        double minDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        Player closestAlly = null; // РџРµСЂРµРјРµРЅРЅР°СЏ РґР»СЏ С…СЂР°РЅРµРЅРёСЏ СЃР°РјРѕРіРѕ Р±Р»РёР·РєРѕРіРѕ РёРіСЂРѕРєР°
        boolean found = false;

        for (Player other : mc.level.players()) {
            // РџСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°РµРј СЃРµР±СЏ, СЃРїРµРєС‚Р°С‚РѕСЂРѕРІ Рё РјРµСЂС‚РІС‹С…
            if (other == mc.player || other.isSpectator() || !other.isAlive()) continue;

            // РџСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°РµРј РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рµ СЃР°РјРё РІ РЅРѕРєРµ вЂ” РёС… РЅРµ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµРј Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёРј СЃРѕСЋР·РЅРёРєРѕРј
            if (com.example.aas.client.ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS.contains(other.getId())) continue;

            // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµРј, РІ РѕРґРЅРѕР№ Р»Рё РјС‹ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРµ
            if (mc.player.getTeam() != null && other.getTeam() == mc.player.getTeam()) {
                double dist = mc.player.distanceTo(other);
                if (dist < minDistance) {
                    minDistance = dist;
                    closestAlly = other;
                    found = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!found || minDistance > 250) return Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.no_allies").getString();

        String allyName = closestAlly.getScoreboardName();

        return Component.translatable("aas.gui.downed.closest_ally", (int) minDistance, allyName).getString();
    }

    private void renderSquadFrame(GuiGraphics gui, int x, int y, int w, int h) {
        gui.fill(x, y, x + w, y + h, 0x99000000);
        gui.renderOutline(x, y, w, h, 0x44FFFFFF);
        gui.renderOutline(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, h - 4, 0xBBFFFFFF);
    }

    private void renderVignette(GuiGraphics gui) {
        RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();
        RenderSystem.depthMask(false);
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();

        // Р‘Р«Р›Рћ: 0.7f (РѕС‡РµРЅСЊ РїР»РѕС‚РЅРѕ). РЎРўРђР›Рћ: 0.35f (РїСЂРѕР·СЂР°С‡РЅРѕ)
        // РўР°РєР¶Рµ РЅРµРјРЅРѕРіРѕ СѓРІРµР»РёС‡РёРј СЏСЂРєРѕСЃС‚СЊ РєСЂР°СЃРЅРѕРіРѕ (0.8f)
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(0.8f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.05f);

        gui.blit(VIGNETTE_TEXTURE, 0, 0, 0, 0, this.width, this.height, this.width, this.height);
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.80f);
        RenderSystem.depthMask(true);
        RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
    }

    public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }

    // РљР›РђРЎРЎ РљРќРћРџРљР РЎ РРЎРџР РђР’Р›Р•РќРќР«Рњ Р’Р«Р”Р•Р›Р•РќРР•Рњ
    private static class SquadButton extends Button {
        public SquadButton(int x, int y, int width, int height, Component message, OnPress onPress) {
            super(x, y, width, height, message, onPress, DEFAULT_NARRATION);
        }

        @Override
        protected void renderWidget(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks) {
            if (!this.visible) return;

            // РРЎРџР РђР’Р›Р•РќРР•: РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ isHovered() РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ isHoveredOrFocused()
            // РўРµРїРµСЂСЊ РєРЅРѕРїРєР° Р±СѓРґРµС‚ СЏСЂРєРѕ-Р±РµР»РѕР№ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РєРѕРіРґР° РЅР° РЅРµРµ РЅР°РІРµРґРµРЅР° РјС‹С€СЊ
            int borderColor = this.isHovered() ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF999999;

            // Р•СЃР»Рё РєРЅРѕРїРєР° РІС‹РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅР° (РёРґРµС‚ РљР”), РґРµР»Р°РµРј СЂР°РјРєСѓ С‚РµРјРЅРѕР№
            if (!this.active) borderColor = 0xFF444444;

            gui.fill(getX(), getY(), getX() + width, getY() + height, 0xCC111111);
            gui.renderOutline(getX(), getY(), width, height, borderColor);

            int textColor = this.active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF777777;

            // РўРµРєСЃС‚ С‚РµРїРµСЂСЊ РІСЃРµРіРґР° Р±СѓРґРµС‚ Р±РµР»С‹Рј (РёР»Рё СЃРµСЂС‹Рј РїСЂРё РљР”), РЅРѕ Р±РµР· Р»РёС€РЅРµР№ С‚РµРЅРё
            gui.drawCenteredString(Minecraft.getInstance().font, this.getMessage(), getX() + width / 2, getY() + (height - 8) / 2, textColor);

            // РЈРіРѕР»РѕРє РІРёРґРµРЅ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїСЂРё РЅР°РІРµРґРµРЅРёРё РјС‹С€Рё
            if (this.active && this.isHovered()) {
                gui.fill(getX(), getY() + height - 2, getX() + 2, getY() + height, 0xFFFFFFFF);
            }
        }
    }

/**

 * Р’РёР·СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ СЃС‚РёР»СЊ РїРѕР»РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊСЋ РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЏРµС‚ WallRadialScreen / DefenseRadialScreen / StaticGunRadialScreen
 * (С‚РѕС‚ Р¶Рµ С‚СЂРµРє, С‚Р° Р¶Рµ РјС‘СЂС‚РІР°СЏ Р·РѕРЅР° СЃ "РћС‚РјРµРЅР°", С‚РѕС‚ Р¶Рµ РїСЂРёРЅС†РёРї РїРѕРґСЃРІРµС‚РєРё РЅР°РІРµРґС‘РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂР°
 * Рё СЃРµСЂС‹С… РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС‹С…/Р·Р°РєСѓР»РґР°СѓРЅРµРЅРЅС‹С… РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє).
 *
 * РРЅРґРµРєСЃС‹ СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂРѕРІ (0..4) СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°СЋС‚ СЃ С‚РёРїР°РјРё РІ PacketRequestAmmo/HubBlockEntity РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ вЂ”
 * РЅРµ РјРµРЅСЏС‚СЊ РїРѕСЂСЏРґРѕРє Р±РµР· РїСЂР°РІРєРё СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРЅРѕР№ Р»РѕРіРёРєРё.
 */
public class HubRadialScreen extends Screen {

    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_AMMO   = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/hub_ammo.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_AGS    = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/hub_ags.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_M2     = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/hub_m2.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_MORTAR = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/hub_mortar.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_TOW    = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/hub_tow.png");

    private static final int SECTOR_COUNT = 5;
    private static final float SECTOR_DEG = 360f / SECTOR_COUNT;

    // ---- Р“РµРѕРјРµС‚СЂРёСЏ (С‚РѕС‚ Р¶Рµ СЃС‚РёР»СЊ, С‡С‚Рѕ Рё РІ DefenseRadialScreen/StaticGunRadialScreen/WallRadialScreen) ----
    private static final int BACKDROP_RADIUS = 130;
    private static final int TRACK_OUTER = 56;
    private static final int TRACK_INNER = 50;
    private static final int DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS = 40;
    private static final int ICON_RADIUS = 95;
    private static final int ICON_SIZE = 20;
    private static final float GAP_DEG = 6f;

    // ---- Р¦РІРµС‚Р° ----
    private static final int COLOR_BACKDROP   = 0x7A000000;
    private static final int COLOR_HOVER      = 0x80CCCCCC;
    private static final int COLOR_TRACK      = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    private static final int COLOR_TRACK_DIM  = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    private static final int COLOR_INNER_RING = 0xFFC2A278;
    private static final int COLOR_RIM        = 0x55FFFFFF;

    // ---- РљР»СЋС‡Рё Р»РѕРєР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёРё ----
    private static final String KEY_AMMO      = "aas.hub.ammo";
    private static final String KEY_AGS       = "aas.hub.ags";
    private static final String KEY_M2        = "aas.hub.m2";
    private static final String KEY_MORTAR    = "aas.hub.mortar";
    private static final String KEY_TOW       = "aas.hub.tow";
    private static final String KEY_CANCEL    = "aas.radio.cancel";
    private static final String KEY_HINT      = "aas.radio.hint";
    private static final String KEY_MATERIALS = "aas.hud.materials";
    private static final String KEY_WAIT      = "aas.radio.wait";

    // РџРѕСЂСЏРґРѕРє СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂРѕРІ: 0=РџР°С‚СЂРѕРЅС‹, 1=РђР“РЎ-30, 2=Рњ2, 3=РњРёРЅРѕРјС‘С‚, 4=РџРўР Рљ (СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°РµС‚ СЃ ID РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ)
    private static final ResourceLocation[] SECTOR_ICONS      = {ICON_AMMO, ICON_AGS, ICON_M2, ICON_MORTAR, ICON_TOW};
    private static final String[]           SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS = {KEY_AMMO, KEY_AGS, KEY_M2, KEY_MORTAR, KEY_TOW};

    private static final int SECTOR_AMMO = 0;

    private final BlockPos hubPos;

    private int cdAmmo = 0;
    private int cdAGS = 0;
    private int cdM2 = 0;
    private int cdMortar = 0;
    private int cdTOW = 0;
    private int materials = 0;

    public HubRadialScreen(BlockPos pos) {
        super(Component.literal("Hub Supply"));
        this.hubPos = pos;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }

    private void updateData() {
        // === Р’С‹С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРёРµ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРѕРіРѕ РєСѓР»РґР°СѓРЅР° РїРѕРїРѕР»РЅРµРЅРёСЏ РїР°С‚СЂРѕРЅРѕРІ ===
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - ClientData.lastFobResupplyTime;
        if (elapsed < 60000 && !Minecraft.getInstance().player.isCreative()) {
            cdAmmo = (int) ((60000 - elapsed) / 50); // РџРµСЂРµРІРѕРґ РІ С‚РёРєРё (РґР»СЏ РІРёР·СѓР°Р»Р°)
        } else {
            cdAmmo = 0;
        }

        if (Minecraft.getInstance().level != null) {
            BlockEntity be = Minecraft.getInstance().level.getBlockEntity(hubPos);
            if (be instanceof HubBlockEntity hub) {
                this.cdAGS = hub.cooldownAGS;
                this.cdM2 = hub.cooldownM2;
                this.cdMortar = hub.cooldownMortar;
                this.cdTOW = hub.cooldownTOW;
                this.materials = hub.getMaterials();
            }
        }
    }

    private int getCost(int i) {
        return switch (i) {
            case 0 -> AASConfig.HUB_RESUPPLY_COST.get();
            case 1 -> 20;
            case 2 -> 15;
            case 3 -> 20;
            case 4 -> 50;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    private int getCooldown(int i) {
        return switch (i) {
            case 0 -> cdAmmo;
            case 1 -> cdAGS;
            case 2 -> cdM2;
            case 3 -> cdMortar;
            case 4 -> cdTOW;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    /**
     * Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅ Р»Рё СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂ {@code i} РїСЂСЏРјРѕ СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ (РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚СЃСЏ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ РїРѕРґСЃРІРµС‚РєРё РёРєРѕРЅРєРё
     * Р±РµР»С‹Рј/СЃРµСЂС‹Рј вЂ” РѕРєРѕРЅС‡Р°С‚РµР»СЊРЅСѓСЋ РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєСѓ Рё РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚РєСѓ РєР»РёРєР° РІСЃС‘ СЂР°РІРЅРѕ РґРµР»Р°РµС‚ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ).
     */
    private boolean isAvailable(int i) {
        if (getCooldown(i) > 0) return false;
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player != null && Minecraft.getInstance().player.isCreative()) return true;
        return materials >= getCost(i);
    }

    private int getHoveredSector(int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        double dx = mouseX - width / 2.0;
        double dy = mouseY - height / 2.0;
        double dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dist < DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS) return -1;

        double angle = Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dx, -dy)); // 0 = РІРІРµСЂС…, РїРѕ С‡Р°СЃРѕРІРѕР№
        if (angle < 0) angle += 360;
        double shifted = (angle + SECTOR_DEG / 2.0) % 360;
        return (int) Math.floor(shifted / SECTOR_DEG) % SECTOR_COUNT;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        updateData();

        int cx = width / 2;
        int cy = height / 2;
        int hovered = getHoveredSector(mouseX, mouseY);

        // Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р· Р·Р° РєР°РґСЂ РЅР° СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂ, РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµСЃС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµРј Р»РёС€РЅРёР№ СЂР°Р·.
        boolean[] available = new boolean[SECTOR_COUNT];
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) available[i] = isAvailable(i);

        PoseStack pose = gui.pose();

        // 1. Р—Р°С‚РµРјРЅС‘РЅРЅР°СЏ РїРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєР°
        fillCircle(pose, cx, cy, BACKDROP_RADIUS, COLOR_BACKDROP, 64);

        // 2. РџРѕРґСЃРІРµС‚РєР° РЅР°РІРµРґС‘РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃРµРєС‚РѕСЂР°
        if (hovered >= 0) {
            float startDeg = hovered * SECTOR_DEG - SECTOR_DEG / 2f;
            float endDeg = startDeg + SECTOR_DEG;
            drawRingArc(pose, cx, cy, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS, BACKDROP_RADIUS - 6, startDeg, endDeg, COLOR_HOVER, 16);
        }

        // 3. Р‘РµР»РѕРµ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅРѕРµ РєРѕР»СЊС†Рѕ-С‚СЂРµРє
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) {
            float startDeg = i * SECTOR_DEG - SECTOR_DEG / 2f + GAP_DEG / 2f;
            float endDeg   = i * SECTOR_DEG + SECTOR_DEG / 2f - GAP_DEG / 2f;
            int color = (i == hovered) ? COLOR_TRACK : COLOR_TRACK_DIM;
            drawRingArc(pose, cx, cy, TRACK_INNER, TRACK_OUTER, startDeg, endDeg, color, 24);
        }

        // 4. РРєРѕРЅРєРё + РїРѕРґРїРёСЃРё (СЃРµСЂС‹Рµ, РµСЃР»Рё РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕ; РєСЂР°СЃРЅС‹Рµ СЃ С‚Р°Р№РјРµСЂРѕРј вЂ” РµСЃР»Рё РЅР° РљР”)
        for (int i = 0; i < SECTOR_COUNT; i++) {
            float deg = i * SECTOR_DEG;
            double rad = Math.toRadians(deg);
            int ix = cx + (int) Math.round(Math.sin(rad) * ICON_RADIUS);
            int iy = cy - (int) Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * ICON_RADIUS);

            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            float alpha = i == hovered ? 1f : 0.85f;
            if (available[i]) {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, alpha);
            } else {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(0.45f, 0.45f, 0.45f, alpha);
            }
            gui.blit(SECTOR_ICONS[i], ix - ICON_SIZE / 2, iy - ICON_SIZE / 2, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE, 0f, 0f, 16, 16, 16, 16);
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);

            int cd = getCooldown(i);
            String label = cd > 0
                    ? String.format(I18n.get(KEY_WAIT), cd / 20)
                    : I18n.get(SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS[i]) + " (" + getCost(i) + ")";
            int labelColor;
            if (cd > 0) labelColor = 0xFFFF5555;
            else if (!available[i]) labelColor = 0xFFAAAAAA;
            else labelColor = i == hovered ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFEEEEEE;
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, label, ix, iy + ICON_SIZE / 2 + 4, labelColor);
        }

        // 5. РўРѕРЅРєРёР№ РєРѕРЅС‚СѓСЂ Р±РѕР»СЊС€РѕРіРѕ РєСЂСѓРіР°
        drawRing(pose, cx, cy, BACKDROP_RADIUS - 1, BACKDROP_RADIUS + 1, COLOR_RIM, 48);

        // 6. РўРѕРЅРєРѕРµ РєРѕР»СЊС†Рѕ РјС‘СЂС‚РІРѕР№ Р·РѕРЅС‹
        drawRing(pose, cx, cy, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS - 1, DEAD_ZONE_RADIUS + 1, COLOR_INNER_RING, 48);

        // 7. Р¦РµРЅС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‚РµРєСЃС‚
        String centerText = hovered >= 0 ? I18n.get(SECTOR_LABEL_KEYS[hovered]) : I18n.get(KEY_CANCEL);
        int centerColor = hovered >= 0 ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFCCCCCC;
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, centerText, cx, cy - 4, centerColor);

        // 9. РџРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєР° СЃРЅРёР·Сѓ
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, I18n.get(KEY_HINT), cx, cy + BACKDROP_RADIUS + 10, 0xFFCCCCCC);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (button == 0) {
            int hovered = getHoveredSector((int) mouseX, (int) mouseY);
            handleSelect(hovered);
            return true;
        }
        if (button == 1) {
            this.onClose();
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void handleSelect(int sector) {
        if (sector < 0) {
            this.onClose(); // РјС‘СЂС‚РІР°СЏ Р·РѕРЅР° вЂ” Р·Р°РєСЂС‹С‚СЊ Р±РµР· РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏ
            return;
        }

        // === Р›РћР“РРљРђ РљРЈР›Р”РђРЈРќРђ (РїР°С‚СЂРѕРЅС‹ РІС‹СЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏСЋС‚ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРёР№ РљР” СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ, РєР°Рє Рё СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ) ===
        if (sector == SECTOR_AMMO) {
            if (cdAmmo > 0) return; // РёРіРЅРѕСЂРёСЂСѓРµРј РєР»РёРє, РµСЃР»Рё РµС‰С‘ РЅР° РљР”

            if (materials >= AASConfig.HUB_RESUPPLY_COST.get() || Minecraft.getInstance().player.isCreative()) {
                ClientData.lastFobResupplyTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
            }
        }

        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestAmmo(hubPos, sector));
        this.onClose();
    }

    // ================= РЈС‚РёР»РёС‚С‹ РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєРё (С‚Рµ Р¶Рµ, С‡С‚Рѕ Рё РІ DefenseRadialScreen/StaticGunRadialScreen/WallRadialScreen) =================

    private static void beginColorDraw() {
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableCull();
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
    }

    private static void fillCircle(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float radius, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_FAN, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        buf.vertex(m, cx, cy, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            float x = cx + (float) (Math.sin(ang) * radius);
            float y = cy - (float) (Math.cos(ang) * radius);
            buf.vertex(m, x, y, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }

    private static void drawRing(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float innerR, float outerR, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            float sx = (float) Math.sin(ang), sy = (float) -Math.cos(ang);
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * outerR, cy + sy * outerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * innerR, cy + sy * innerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }

    private static void drawRingArc(PoseStack pose, float cx, float cy, float innerR, float outerR,
                                    float startDeg, float endDeg, int argb, int segments) {
        beginColorDraw();
        Matrix4f m = pose.last().pose();
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tess.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        float a = ((argb >>> 24) & 0xFF) / 255f, r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            double ang = Math.toRadians(startDeg + (endDeg - startDeg) * i / segments);
            float sx = (float) Math.sin(ang), sy = (float) -Math.cos(ang);
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * outerR, cy + sy * outerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
            buf.vertex(m, cx + sx * innerR, cy + sy * innerR, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();
    }
}

    private void saveKit() {
        try { menu.maxPerTeam = Integer.parseInt(maxTeamBox.getValue()); } catch(Exception ignored){}
        try { menu.maxPerSquad = Integer.parseInt(maxSquadBox.getValue()); } catch(Exception ignored){}
        try { menu.minSquadPlayers = Integer.parseInt(minPlayersBox.getValue()); } catch(Exception ignored){}
        menu.displayName = nameBox.getValue(); // <-- Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў

        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSaveKit(
                menu.team, menu.kitName, menu.isAlt, menu.hasAlt, menu.isLeaderOnly,
                menu.maxPerTeam, menu.maxPerSquad, menu.minSquadPlayers,
                menu.displayName,                              // <-- Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў
                menu.resupplyFlags, menu.saveNbtFlags
        ));

        this.minecraft.player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal(menu.isAlt ? "Alt Kit Saved!" : "Kit Saved!"), true);
    }

        for (int i = 0; i < menu.slots.size(); i++) {
            net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot slot = menu.slots.get(i);
            if (slot.container == menu.kitInventory) {
                int idx = slot.getContainerSlot();
                if (idx >= 0 && idx < 49) {
                    if (menu.saveNbtFlags[idx]) {
                        // Р В Р Р‹Р В РЎвЂР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋР РЏР РЋР РЏ Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р В РЎВР В РЎвЂќР В Р’В° Р В РўвЂР В Р’В»Р РЋР РЏ NBT
                        gui.fill(leftPos + slot.x, topPos + slot.y, leftPos + slot.x + 16, topPos + slot.y + 16, 0x600000FF);
                    }
                    else if (menu.resupplyFlags[idx]) {
                        // Р В РІР‚вЂњР В Р’ВµР В Р’В»Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’В°Р РЋР РЏ Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР В Р’В·Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р РЋРІР‚РЋР В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В°Р РЋР РЏ Р В РўвЂР В Р’В»Р РЋР РЏ Resupply
                        gui.fill(leftPos + slot.x, topPos + slot.y, leftPos + slot.x + 16, topPos + slot.y + 16, 0x60FFFF00);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mx, double my, int button) {
        if (button == 2) { // Р В Р Р‹Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’ВµР В РўвЂР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋР РЏР РЋР РЏ Р В РЎвЂќР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂ”Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В° Р В РЎВР РЋРІР‚в„–Р РЋРІвЂљВ¬Р В РЎвЂ
            net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot slot = this.hoveredSlot;
            if (slot != null && slot.container == menu.kitInventory) {
                int idx = slot.getContainerSlot();
                if (idx >= 0 && idx < 49) {
                    if (hasShiftDown()) {
                        menu.saveNbtFlags[idx] = !menu.saveNbtFlags[idx];
                    } else {
                        menu.resupplyFlags[idx] = !menu.resupplyFlags[idx];
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mx, my, button);
    }

    @Override

        gui.fill(leftPos, topPos, leftPos + imageWidth, topPos + imageHeight, 0xFF333333);

        for (net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot slot : menu.slots) {
