package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import com.example.aas.client.KitIconStyle;

import com.example.aas.client.AASClipboard;
import com.example.aas.client.KitKeyUtil;
import com.example.aas.network.*;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

public class KitListScreen extends Screen {
    private final String team;
    private static final int COLUMNS = 4;
    private static final int ROW_HEIGHT = 60;

    public KitListScreen(String team) {
        super(Component.literal(team + " Kits"));
        this.team = team;
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        int startX = (width - 440) / 2;
        int startY = 64;

        // --- Whole-team buttons (in-game clipboard) ---
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("COPY ALL"), b ->
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestKitData(team, "ALL"))).bounds(startX, 10, 80, 20).build());

        Button pasteAllBtn = Button.builder(Component.literal("PASTE ALL"), b -> {
            if (AASClipboard.teamKitsData != null)
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketPasteTeam(team, AASClipboard.teamKitsData));
        }).bounds(startX + 85, 10, 80, 20).build();
        pasteAllBtn.active = (AASClipboard.teamKitsData != null);
        addRenderableWidget(pasteAllBtn);

        // --- Key for this team: generate (copy to system clipboard) / paste ---
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("COPY KEY"), b ->
                KitKeyUtil.requestCopy("TEAM", team, "ALL", false)).bounds(startX + 180, 10, 80, 20).build());

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("PASTE KEY"), b ->
                KitKeyUtil.importForTeam(team)).bounds(startX + 265, 10, 80, 20).build());

        addDeckControls(startX);

        // --- Kit grid ---
        for (int i = 0; i < AASWorldData.KIT_NAMES.length; i++) {
            String kitName = AASWorldData.KIT_NAMES[i];
            int row = i / COLUMNS;
            int col = i % COLUMNS;
            int x = startX + col * 110;
            int y = startY + row * ROW_HEIGHT + 26;

            addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(kitName), b ->
                    PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketOpenKitEditor(team, kitName))).bounds(x, y, 70, 20).build());

            addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("C"), b ->
                    PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestKitData(team, kitName))).bounds(x + 72, y, 15, 20).build());

            Button pBtn = Button.builder(Component.literal("P"), b -> {
                if (AASClipboard.kitData != null)
                    PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketPasteKit(team, kitName, AASClipboard.kitData));
            }).bounds(x + 89, y, 15, 20).build();
            pBtn.active = (AASClipboard.kitData != null);
            addRenderableWidget(pBtn);
        }
    }

    // --- deck switch / copy kits between decks / deck settings (all kit packets work with the selected deck) ---
    private com.example.aas.deck.DeckType copyTarget = null;

    private void addDeckControls(int startX) {
        com.example.aas.deck.DeckType cur = com.example.aas.client.DeckClient.editDeck;
        if (copyTarget == null || copyTarget == cur) copyTarget = cur.next(1);
        final com.example.aas.deck.DeckType target = copyTarget;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSetEditDeck(cur.ordinal()));

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.admin.deck_btn", Component.translatable(cur.classLangKey())), b -> {
            com.example.aas.client.DeckClient.editDeck = cur.next(hasShiftDown() ? -1 : 1);
            copyTarget = null;
            rebuildWidgets();
        }).bounds(startX, 34, 135, 20).build());

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.admin.copy_to", Component.translatable(target.classLangKey())), b -> {
            com.example.aas.deck.DeckType n = target.next(hasShiftDown() ? -1 : 1);
            if (n == cur) n = n.next(hasShiftDown() ? -1 : 1);
            copyTarget = n;
            rebuildWidgets();
        }).bounds(startX + 140, 34, 135, 20).build());

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.admin.copy_btn"), b ->
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketCopyDeckKits(team, cur.ordinal(), target.ordinal()))).bounds(startX + 280, 34, 70, 20).build());

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.translatable("aas.admin.deck_settings"), b ->
                this.minecraft.setScreen(new DeckParamsScreen(team, this))).bounds(startX + 355, 34, 85, 20).build());
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        renderBackground(gui);
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, title, width / 2, 1, 0xFFFFFF);

        int startX = (width - 440) / 2;
        int startY = 64;

        for (int i = 0; i < AASWorldData.KIT_NAMES.length; i++) {
            String kitName = AASWorldData.KIT_NAMES[i];
            int row = i / COLUMNS;
            int col = i % COLUMNS;
            String iconPath = kitName.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_");
            ResourceLocation iconLoc = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/kits/" + iconPath + ".png");
            int iconX = startX + col * 110 + (70 / 2) - 12;
            int iconY = startY + row * ROW_HEIGHT;
            KitIconStyle.apply(KitIconStyle.DEFAULT_COLOR, 1.0f);
            gui.blit(iconLoc, iconX, iconY, 0, 0, 24, 24, 24, 24);
            KitIconStyle.reset();
        }
        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import com.example.aas.network.PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;

public class KitPreviewScreen extends Screen {
    private final Screen parent;
    private final PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit;
    private boolean showingAlt;
    private Button variantToggleBtn;
    // Screen.title РІ СЌС‚РѕР№ РІРµСЂСЃРёРё Minecraft РѕР±СЉСЏРІР»РµРЅ final, РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ РїРѕРґ СЃРІРѕР№
    // РґРёРЅР°РјРёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№ Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕРє (РјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё РїРµСЂРµРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРё STANDARD/ALTERNATIVE) Р·Р°РІРѕРґРёРј РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅРѕРµ РїРѕР»Рµ.
    private Component displayTitle;

    // === Р¦РІРµС‚РѕРІР°СЏ СЃС…РµРјР° РєРЅРѕРїРѕРє РІ СЃС‚РёР»Рµ "APPLY FOR CMD" (Р»Р°Р№Рј-Р·РµР»С‘РЅС‹Р№) ===
    private static final int BTN_BG = 0xCC111111;
    private static final int BTN_BORDER_IDLE = 0xFF999999;
    private static final int BTN_BORDER_HOVER = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    private static final int BTN_BORDER_DISABLED = 0xFF3A3A3A;

    public KitPreviewScreen(Screen parent, PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit) { this(parent, kit, false); }

    public KitPreviewScreen(Screen parent, PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit, boolean startOnAlt) {
        super(Component.translatable("aas.gui.kit.preview.title",
                startOnAlt ? kit.altDisplayName : kit.displayName));
        this.parent = parent;
        this.kit = kit;

        this.displayTitle = this.getTitle();

    // РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅРµРЅР° СЃС‚Р°СЂР°СЏ СЃРёРіРЅР°С‚СѓСЂР° РґР»СЏ СЃРѕРІРјРµСЃС‚РёРјРѕСЃС‚Рё, РµСЃР»Рё РіРґРµ-С‚Рѕ РµС‰С‘ РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ СЃС‚Р°СЂС‹Рј СЃРїРѕСЃРѕР±РѕРј
    public KitPreviewScreen(Screen parent, String kitName, List<ItemStack> items) {
        this(parent, new PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO(kitName, true, "", items, false, new java.util.ArrayList<>()), false);
    }

    private List<ItemStack> currentItems() {
        return showingAlt ? kit.altItems : kit.items;
    }

    // === РљРЅРѕРїРєР° РІ СЃС‚РёР»Рµ "APPLY FOR CMD" (С‚С‘РјРЅР°СЏ РїР»Р°С€РєР° + Р»Р°Р№Рј-Р·РµР»С‘РЅР°СЏ СЂР°РјРєР°) ===
    private static class AasFlatButton extends Button {
        AasFlatButton(int x, int y, int width, int height, Component message, OnPress onPress) {
            super(x, y, width, height, message, onPress, DEFAULT_NARRATION);
        }

        @Override
        protected void renderWidget(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks) {
            if (!this.visible) return;

            int borderColor = this.isHovered() ? BTN_BORDER_HOVER : BTN_BORDER_IDLE;
            if (!this.active) borderColor = BTN_BORDER_DISABLED;

            gui.fill(getX(), getY(), getX() + width, getY() + height, BTN_BG);
            gui.renderOutline(getX(), getY(), width, height, borderColor);

            int textColor = this.active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF777777;
            gui.drawCenteredString(Minecraft.getInstance().font, this.getMessage(), getX() + width / 2, getY() + (height - 8) / 2, textColor);

            if (this.active && this.isHovered()) {
                gui.fill(getX(), getY() + height - 2, getX() + 2, getY() + height, BTN_BORDER_HOVER);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        this.addRenderableWidget(new AasFlatButton(this.width / 2 - 90, this.height - 30, 80, 20,
                Component.translatable("aas.gui.kit.preview.back"), b -> this.minecraft.setScreen(parent)));

        if (kit.hasAlt) {
            variantToggleBtn = new AasFlatButton(this.width / 2 + 10, this.height - 30, 80, 20,
                    Component.translatable(showingAlt ? "aas.gui.kit.preview.button.standard" : "aas.gui.kit.preview.button.alternative"),
                    b -> {
                        showingAlt = !showingAlt;
                        this.displayTitle = Component.translatable("aas.gui.kit.preview.title",
                                showingAlt ? kit.altDisplayName : kit.displayName);
                        b.setMessage(Component.translatable(showingAlt ? "aas.gui.kit.preview.button.standard" : "aas.gui.kit.preview.button.alternative"));
                    });
            this.addRenderableWidget(variantToggleBtn);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        if (!this.minecraft.player.isAlive()) {
            gui.fill(0, 0, this.width, this.height, 0xFF000000);
        } else {
            this.renderBackground(gui);
        }
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, this.displayTitle, this.width / 2, 20, 0xFFFFFF);
        if (kit.hasAlt) {
            Component tag = showingAlt
                    ? Component.translatable("aas.gui.kit.preview.tag.alternative").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD)
                    : Component.translatable("aas.gui.kit.preview.tag.standard").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN);
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, tag, this.width / 2, 32, 0xFFFFFF);
        }

        List<ItemStack> items = currentItems();
        int startX = this.width / 2 - (9 * 18) / 2;
        int startY = 50;

        // Р РёСЃСѓРµРј РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЊ (РєР°Рє РІ KitEditor, РЅРѕ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РєР°СЂС‚РёРЅРєРё)
        // 1. РћСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРѕР№ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЊ (9-35)
        for (int i = 0; i < 27; i++) {
            int x = startX + (i % 9) * 18;
            int y = startY + (i / 9) * 18;
            drawSlot(gui, x, y, safeGet(items, i + 9));
        }

        // 2. РҐРѕС‚Р±Р°СЂ (0-8)
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            int x = startX + i * 18;
            int y = startY + 60;
            drawSlot(gui, x, y, safeGet(items, i));
        }

        // 3. Р‘СЂРѕРЅСЏ (36-39) Рё РІС‚РѕСЂР°СЏ СЂСѓРєР° (40)
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            int x = startX + i * 18;
            int y = startY + 85;
            drawSlot(gui, x, y, safeGet(items, i + 36));
        }

        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);
    }

    private ItemStack safeGet(List<ItemStack> items, int idx) {
        return (idx >= 0 && idx < items.size()) ? items.get(idx) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onClose() {
        if (this.minecraft.player != null && !this.minecraft.player.isAlive()) {
            // Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµРјСЃСЏ РІ РјРµРЅСЋ РІС‹Р±РѕСЂР° РєРёС‚РѕРІ (РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕРµ СЃР°РјРѕ РІРµСЂРЅРµС‚ РІ DeathScreen)
            this.minecraft.setScreen(parent);
        } else {
            super.onClose();
        }
    }
    private void drawSlot(GuiGraphics gui, int x, int y, ItemStack stack) {
        gui.fill(x, y, x + 17, y + 17, 0x50FFFFFF);
        gui.renderFakeItem(stack, x + 1, y + 1);
        gui.renderItemDecorations(font, stack, x + 1, y + 1);
    }
}

FILE: MapGrid.java

// PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\client\gui\MapGrid.java
package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.Font;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;

/**
 * Tactical map grid (Arma/Squad style).
 *
 * - Big squares: 300x300 blocks, semi-transparent black lines.
 * - Small squares: 100x100 blocks (3x3 inside each big one), semi-transparent white lines.
 * - Letters (A, B, C ...) along the top = columns (X, west -> east).
 * - Numbers (1, 2, 3 ...) along the left = rows (Z, north -> south).
 * - Small squares are numbered like a numpad:  7 8 9 / 4 5 6 / 1 2 3.
 * - When zoomed in, each big square shows its name (e.g. "J5") in its top-left part.
 * - Hover tooltip, e.g. "J5 9", is drawn to the top-right of the cursor.
 *
 * The grid is anchored to the map image: (0,0) of the grid = top-left corner of the map.
 * Everything is derived from the current zoom (blocks per pixel) and the map size in blocks,
 * so no texture is needed.
 */
public final class MapGrid {

    public static final int BIG = 300;
    public static final int SMALL = 100;

    // ARGB colors
    private static final int COLOR_BIG    = 0x99000000; // black, ~60%
    private static final int COLOR_SMALL  = 0x55FFFFFF; // white, ~33%
    private static final int COLOR_STRIP  = 0x66000000; // background of top/left label strips
    private static final int COLOR_LABEL  = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    private static final int COLOR_NAME   = 0xCCFFFFFF;
    private static final int COLOR_TIP_TEXT = 0xFFFFFFFF; // white text
    private static final int COLOR_TIP_OUTLINE = 0xFF000000; // black outline

    // Level of detail thresholds (screen pixels)
    private static final double MIN_SMALL_PX = 8;    // below: hide the white 100m lines
    private static final double MIN_BIG_PX   = 6;    // below: hide the black 300m lines
    private static final double MIN_NAME_PX  = 90;   // below: no "J5" inside big squares
    private static final double THICK_BIG_PX = 150;  // above: black lines become 2px thick

    private static final float NAME_SCALE = 0.75f;

    private MapGrid() {}

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- naming

    /** 0 -> A, 25 -> Z, 26 -> AA, 27 -> AB ... */
    public static String letters(int index) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int n = index + 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            int r = (n - 1) % 26;
            sb.insert(0, (char) ('A' + r));
            n = (n - 1) / 26;
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** Numpad digit for a small square: row 0 (north) = 7 8 9, row 2 (south) = 1 2 3. */
    public static int numpad(int ix, int iy) {
        return (2 - iy) * 3 + ix + 1;
    }

    /**
     * Name of the big square, e.g. "J5".
     */
    public static String bigName(int col, int row) {
        return letters(col) + (row + 1);
    }

    /**
     * Full name of the cell for a point given in blocks relative to the map's top-left corner.
     * Returns null if the point is outside of the map. Example: "J5 9".
     */
    public static String cellName(double u, double v, int sizeBlocks) {
        if (u < 0 || v < 0 || u >= sizeBlocks || v >= sizeBlocks) return null;
        int col = (int) Math.floor(u / BIG);
        int row = (int) Math.floor(v / BIG);
        int ix = clamp((int) Math.floor((u - col * (double) BIG) / SMALL), 0, 2);
        int iy = clamp((int) Math.floor((v - row * (double) BIG) / SMALL), 0, 2);
        return bigName(col, row) + " " + numpad(ix, iy);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing

    /**
     * Draws the grid. Call it in screen space, inside the map scissor, right after the map texture.
     *
     * @param mapX, mapY, mapSize map panel on screen
     * @param offX, offY          world offset (in blocks) of the map's top-left corner relative to the
     *                            map center - the same (int)drawX / (int)drawY the map texture is blitted at
     * @param sizeBlocks          map size in blocks
     * @param bpp                 blocks per screen pixel (ClientData.mapScale)
     */
    public static void render(GuiGraphics gui, Font font,
                              int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize,
                              int offX, int offY, int sizeBlocks, double bpp) {
        if (sizeBlocks <= 0 || bpp <= 0) return;

        final double ppb = 1.0 / bpp;                       // pixels per block
        final double half = mapSize / 2.0;
        final double ox = mapX + half + offX * ppb;         // screen x of the grid origin
        final double oy = mapY + half + offY * ppb;
        final double ex = ox + sizeBlocks * ppb;            // screen x of the right map edge
        final double ey = oy + sizeBlocks * ppb;
        final int mapRight = mapX + mapSize;
        final int mapBottom = mapY + mapSize;

        // part of the map image that is actually visible inside the panel
        final int vx0 = (int) Math.max(mapX, Math.floor(ox));
        final int vy0 = (int) Math.max(mapY, Math.floor(oy));
        final int vx1 = (int) Math.min(mapRight, Math.ceil(ex));
        final int vy1 = (int) Math.min(mapBottom, Math.ceil(ey));
        if (vx1 <= vx0 || vy1 <= vy0) return;

        final double smallPx = SMALL * ppb;
        final double bigPx = BIG * ppb;
        final int smallCount = sizeBlocks / SMALL;          // number of full 100m steps

        // ---- small (white) lines: every 100m that is not a 300m line
        if (smallPx >= MIN_SMALL_PX) {
            int i0 = Math.max(1, (int) Math.floor((vx0 - ox) / smallPx));
            int i1 = Math.min(smallCount, (int) Math.ceil((vx1 - ox) / smallPx));
            for (int i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
                if ((i * SMALL) % BIG == 0) continue;
                int x = (int) Math.round(ox + i * smallPx);
                if (x < vx0 || x >= vx1) continue;
                gui.fill(x, vy0, x + 1, vy1, COLOR_SMALL);
            }
            int j0 = Math.max(1, (int) Math.floor((vy0 - oy) / smallPx));
            int j1 = Math.min(smallCount, (int) Math.ceil((vy1 - oy) / smallPx));
            for (int j = j0; j <= j1; j++) {
                if ((j * SMALL) % BIG == 0) continue;
                int y = (int) Math.round(oy + j * smallPx);
                if (y < vy0 || y >= vy1) continue;
                gui.fill(vx0, y, vx1, y + 1, COLOR_SMALL);
            }
        }

        // ---- big (black) lines: every 300m + map borders
        final int cols = ceilDiv(sizeBlocks, BIG);
        if (bigPx >= MIN_BIG_PX) {
            int w = bigPx >= THICK_BIG_PX ? 2 : 1;
            for (int c = 0; c <= cols; c++) {
                double bx = (c == cols) ? ex : ox + c * bigPx;
                int x = (int) Math.round(bx) - (c == cols ? w : 0);
                if (x + w <= vx0 || x >= vx1) continue;
                gui.fill(Math.max(x, vx0), vy0, Math.min(x + w, vx1), vy1, COLOR_BIG);
            }
            for (int r = 0; r <= cols; r++) {
                double by = (r == cols) ? ey : oy + r * bigPx;
                int y = (int) Math.round(by) - (r == cols ? w : 0);
                if (y + w <= vy0 || y >= vy1) continue;
                gui.fill(vx0, Math.max(y, vy0), vx1, Math.min(y + w, vy1), COLOR_BIG);
            }
        }

        // ---- edge labels: letters on top, numbers on the left
        final int rows = cols; // map is square
        final int topH = font.lineHeight + 3;
        final int leftW = font.width(String.valueOf(rows)) + 5;

        gui.fill(mapX, mapY, mapRight, mapY + topH, COLOR_STRIP);
        gui.fill(mapX, mapY + topH, mapX + leftW, mapBottom, COLOR_STRIP);

        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            double x0 = ox + c * bigPx;
            double x1 = Math.min(ox + (c + 1) * bigPx, ex);
            String s = letters(c);
            double a = Math.max(x0, mapX + leftW);
            double b = Math.min(x1, mapRight);
            if (b - a < font.width(s) + 4) continue;
            int tx = (int) Math.round((a + b) / 2.0 - font.width(s) / 2.0);
            gui.drawString(font, s, tx, mapY + 2, COLOR_LABEL, true);
        }
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            double y0 = oy + r * bigPx;
            double y1 = Math.min(oy + (r + 1) * bigPx, ey);
            double a = Math.max(y0, mapY + topH);
            double b = Math.min(y1, mapBottom);
            if (b - a < font.lineHeight + 2) continue;
            String s = String.valueOf(r + 1);
            int ty = (int) Math.round((a + b) / 2.0 - font.lineHeight / 2.0);
            gui.drawString(font, s, mapX + 3, ty, COLOR_LABEL, true);
        }

        // ---- big square names ("J5") in the top-left part when zoomed in enough
        if (bigPx >= MIN_NAME_PX) {
            int c0 = Math.max(0, (int) Math.floor((vx0 - ox) / bigPx));
            int c1 = Math.min(cols - 1, (int) Math.floor((vx1 - 1 - ox) / bigPx));
            int r0 = Math.max(0, (int) Math.floor((vy0 - oy) / bigPx));
            int r1 = Math.min(rows - 1, (int) Math.floor((vy1 - 1 - oy) / bigPx));
            for (int r = r0; r <= r1; r++) {
                for (int c = c0; c <= c1; c++) {
                    String name = bigName(c, r);
                    double x0 = ox + c * bigPx;
                    double y0 = oy + r * bigPx;
                    double x1 = Math.min(x0 + bigPx, ex);
                    double y1 = Math.min(y0 + bigPx, ey);
                    double lx = Math.max(x0, mapX + leftW) + 3;
                    double ly = Math.max(y0, mapY + topH) + 3;
                    double tw = font.width(name) * NAME_SCALE;
                    double th = font.lineHeight * NAME_SCALE;
                    if (lx + tw > x1 - 1 || ly + th > y1 - 1) continue; // square is mostly off-screen
                    gui.pose().pushPose();
                    gui.pose().translate(lx, ly, 0);
                    gui.pose().scale(NAME_SCALE, NAME_SCALE, 1.0f);
                    gui.drawString(font, name, 0, 0, COLOR_NAME, true);
                    gui.pose().popPose();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tooltip with the cell under the cursor ("J5 9"), drawn to the top-right of the cursor.
     * Call it after the map scissor is disabled. Does nothing if the cursor is outside of the map image.
     */
    public static void renderHover(GuiGraphics gui, Font font,
                                   int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize,
                                   int offX, int offY, int sizeBlocks, double bpp,
                                   int mouseX, int mouseY, int screenW, int screenH) {
        if (sizeBlocks <= 0 || bpp <= 0) return;
        if (mouseX < mapX || mouseX > mapX + mapSize || mouseY < mapY || mouseY > mapY + mapSize) return;

        double half = mapSize / 2.0;
        double u = (mouseX - mapX - half) * bpp - offX;
        double v = (mouseY - mapY - half) * bpp - offY;
        String text = cellName(u, v, sizeBlocks);
        if (text == null) return;

        // plain text, no background: white digits with a black outline, close to the cursor
        int w = font.width(text) + 2;
        int h = font.lineHeight;
        int x = mouseX + 5;
        int y = mouseY + 8;
        if (x + w > screenW - 2) x = mouseX - w - 5;   // no room on the right -> put it on the left
        if (y < 2) y = mouseY + 8;                     // no room above -> put it below
        if (y + h > screenH - 2) y = mouseY - h - 2;
        if (x < 2) x = 2;

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(0, 0, 500);
        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue;
                gui.drawString(font, text, x + dx, y + dy, COLOR_TIP_OUTLINE, false);
            }
        }
        gui.drawString(font, text, x, y, COLOR_TIP_TEXT, false);
        gui.pose().popPose();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- view limits

    /**
     * Clamps the view center along one axis so the visible area never goes past the map edges
     * (so the background gradient is never visible).
     *
     * @param center       desired view center (world blocks)
     * @param mapCenter    center of the map image (world blocks)
     * @param mapBlocks    map size in blocks
     * @param viewBlocks   size of the visible area in blocks (panel pixels * blocks-per-pixel)
     * @return the clamped center; if the view is larger than the map, the map center
     */
    public static double clampCenter(double center, double mapCenter, double mapBlocks, double viewBlocks) {
        double half = viewBlocks / 2.0;
        double min = mapCenter - mapBlocks / 2.0 + half;
        double max = mapCenter + mapBlocks / 2.0 - half;
        if (min > max) return mapCenter;
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, center));
    }

    /**
     * Largest blocks-per-pixel value at which the whole panel is still covered by the map
     * (zooming out further would show the background). Never below minBpp.
     */
    public static double maxBpp(int sizeBlocks, int panelPx, double minBpp) {
        if (panelPx <= 0) return Double.MAX_VALUE;
        return Math.max(minBpp, sizeBlocks / (double) panelPx);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- utils

    private static int ceilDiv(int a, int b) { return (a + b - 1) / b; }

    private static int clamp(int v, int lo, int hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }
}

            // [4] РўРЇР–РЃР›РђРЇ РўР•РҐРќРРљРђ вЂ” РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ APC
            mapMarker(4, "aas.gui.map_marker.heavy_vehicle", "APC", C_VEH, "AP",
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.tank",         "Tank",         C_VEH, "TK"),
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.heavy_supply", "Heavy Supply", C_VEH, "HS"),
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.mobile_zu",    "Mobile ZU",    C_VEH, "ZU"),
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.spg",          "SPG",          C_VEH, "SP")),
            // [5] РђР’РРђР¦РРЇ вЂ” РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ Helicopter
            mapMarker(5, "aas.gui.map_marker.aircraft", "Helicopter", C_AIR, "HL",
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.cas_heli",    "CAS Heli",    C_AIR, "CH"),
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.cas_fighter", "CAS Fighter", C_AIR, "CF")),
            // [6] РЎРўР РћР•РќРРЇ вЂ” РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ Enemy HUB
            mapMarker(6, "aas.gui.map_marker.structures", "Enemy HUB", C_STR, "HB",
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.enemy_rally", "Enemy Rally", C_STR, "RL"),
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.mortar",      "Mortar",      C_STR, "MR"),
                    mapSub("aas.gui.map_marker.tow",         "TOW",         C_STR, "TW")),
            // [8] РњР•РўРљР РљРћРњРђРќР”Р« вЂ” Supply Request, Р±РµР· РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ
            mapMarker(8, "aas.gui.map_marker.supply_request", "Supply Request", C_SUP, "SR"),
            // [11] РњР•РўРљРђ РҐРђР‘Рђ вЂ” Hub Marker, Р±РµР· РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ, СЃС‚РѕРёС‚ РЅР°Рґ [8].
            // РќР° РєР°СЂС‚Рµ СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ СЃРІРѕРµР№ РёРєРѕРЅРєРѕР№ + Р·РѕР»РѕС‚РёСЃС‚С‹РјРё РїСѓРЅРєС‚РёСЂРЅС‹РјРё СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃР°РјРё С…Р°Р±Р° (СЃРј. AASMapRenderer).
            mapMarker(11, "aas.gui.map_marker.hub_marker", "Hub Marker", C_HUB, "HM"),
            // [9] РЎРўР Р•Р›РљРђ вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ SL
            squadMarker(9, "aas.gui.map_marker.arrow", ICON_ARROW_MENU, ARROW_ACTION, C_STR, "AR"),
            // [10] РЎРўР Р•Р›РљРђ РћРўР РЇР”Рђ вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ SL, СЃР»РµРІР° РѕС‚ [7]
            squadMarker(10, "aas.gui.map_marker.arrow_squad", ICON_SQUAD_ARROW_MENU,
                    SQUAD_ARROW_ACTION, 0xFF33DD33, "AS"),
            // [12] РњР•РўРљР Р”Р›РЇ BRAVO вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ SL, СЃР»РµРІР° РѕС‚ [10]. Р—Р°РјРµРЅСЏСЋС‚ РјРµС‚РєСѓ Bravo-С„Р°РµСЂС‚РёРјР°.
            groupMarker(12, "bravo", BRAVO_ICONS, PacketSquadMarker.GROUP_BRAVO, C_BRAVO, "B"),
            // [13] РњР•РўРљР Р”Р›РЇ CHARLIE вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ SL, СЃР»РµРІР° РѕС‚ [12]. Р—Р°РјРµРЅСЏСЋС‚ РјРµС‚РєСѓ Charlie-С„Р°РµСЂС‚РёРјР°.
            groupMarker(13, "charlie", CHARLIE_ICONS, PacketSquadMarker.GROUP_CHARLIE, C_CHARLIE, "C")
    };

    // =========================== РЎРћРЎРўРћРЇРќРР• ==========================
    private boolean open = false;
    private boolean isSL = false;
    private int variant = 0;
    private int targetX, targetZ;
    private int panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH;
    private int hoverSlot = -1;      // РЅР°РІРµРґС‘РЅРЅР°СЏ РіР»Р°РІРЅР°СЏ РєРЅРѕРїРєР°
    private int openSubSlot = -1;    // РєРЅРѕРїРєР°, Сѓ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕР№ СЂР°СЃРєСЂС‹С‚Рѕ РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ
    private int hoverItem = -1;      // РЅР°РІРµРґС‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ РїСѓРЅРєС‚ РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ

    private AASMapRenderer map;      // РєР°СЂС‚Р°, Р·Р° РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕР№ РµРґРµС‚ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ (РјРѕР¶РµС‚ Р±С‹С‚СЊ null)
    private int offX, offY;          // СЃРјРµС‰РµРЅРёРµ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РѕС‚ С‚РѕС‡РєРё РєР»РёРєР° РЅР° СЌРєСЂР°РЅРµ
    private boolean arrowPending = false;
    private boolean arrowSquad = false;      // NEW: true = СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєР° РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° (Р·РµР»С‘РЅР°СЏ)
    private int arrowStartX, arrowStartZ;

    public boolean isOpen() {
        return open;
    }

    public void close() {
        open = false;
        openSubSlot = -1;
        hoverSlot = -1;
        hoverItem = -1;
    }

    /**
     * Р”Р»СЏ keyPressed СЂРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЏ: РіР»РѕС‚Р°РµС‚ ESC, РїРѕРєР° РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚Р°.
     * РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°РЅРёРµ: if (markerPanel.handleEscapePressed(keyCode)) return true;
     */
    public boolean handleEscapePressed(int keyCode) {
        if (keyCode != 256) return false;      // 256 = GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE
        if (open) { close(); return true; }
        if (arrowPending) { arrowPending = false; return true; }
        return false;
    }

    // =========================== РћРўРљР Р«РўРР• ===========================

    /**
     * РћС‚РєСЂС‹С‚СЊ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ Сѓ РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂР°: С†РµРЅС‚СЂ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё [1] РѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ СЂРѕРІРЅРѕ РїРѕРґ РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂРѕРј.
     * Р•СЃР»Рё РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РІРјРµСЃС‚Рµ СЃ СЃР°РјС‹Рј РґР»РёРЅРЅС‹Рј РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ РЅРµ РІР»РµР·Р°РµС‚ вЂ” СЃРґРІРёРіР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂСЊ СЌРєСЂР°РЅР°.
     * Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ Р’РњР•РЎРўРћ setScreen(new TacticalMapRadialScreen(...)).
     */
    /** РЎС‚Р°СЂС‹Р№ РІР°СЂРёР°РЅС‚ (РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РЅРµ РµРґРµС‚ Р·Р° РєР°СЂС‚РѕР№). РћСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅ РґР»СЏ СЃРѕРІРјРµСЃС‚РёРјРѕСЃС‚Рё. */
    public void openAt(int worldX, int worldZ, double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        openAt(worldX, worldZ, mouseX, mouseY, null);
    }

    /**
     * РћС‚РєСЂС‹С‚СЊ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ Сѓ РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂР°: С†РµРЅС‚СЂ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё [1] РѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ СЂРѕРІРЅРѕ РїРѕРґ РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂРѕРј.
     * Р•СЃР»Рё РїРµСЂРµРґР°РЅ mapRenderer вЂ” РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РїСЂРёРІСЏР·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ Рє С‚РѕС‡РєРµ РЅР° РєР°СЂС‚Рµ Рё РµРґРµС‚ Р·Р° РЅРµР№.
     */
    public void openAt(int worldX, int worldZ, double mouseX, double mouseY, AASMapRenderer mapRenderer) {
        String role = getClientRole();
        if ("NONE".equals(role)) return;

        this.isSL = "SL".equals(role);
        this.variant = getClientVariant();
        this.targetX = worldX;
        this.targetZ = worldZ;
        this.map = mapRenderer;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        int screenW = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
        int screenH = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledHeight();

        panelW = PAD * 2 + 11 * CELL + 10 * GAP;
        panelH = PAD * 2 + 3 * CELL + 2 * GAP;   // 3 СЂСЏРґР°: [11] / [8] / РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРѕР№ СЂСЏРґ

        int maxSub = 0;
        for (Entry e : PANEL) {
            if (e.sub != null) maxSub = Math.max(maxSub, e.sub.length);
        }
        int longestSubH = PAD * 2 + maxSub * CELL + (maxSub - 1) * GAP;
        int totalH = panelH + GAP + longestSubH;

        int wantX = (int) mouseX - (PAD + 4 * (CELL + GAP) + CELL / 2);
        int wantY = (int) mouseY - (PAD + 2 * (CELL + GAP) + CELL / 2);

        panelX = Mth.clamp(wantX, 0, Math.max(0, screenW - panelW));
        int yMax = screenH - totalH;
        if (yMax < 0) yMax = Math.max(0, screenH - panelH);
        panelY = Mth.clamp(wantY, 0, yMax);

        // Р—Р°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РµРј, РЅР° СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ СЃРґРІРёРЅСѓС‚Р° РѕС‚ С‚РѕС‡РєРё РєР»РёРєР°, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РїРѕС‚РѕРј
        // РґРµСЂР¶Р°С‚СЊ СЌС‚Рѕ СЃРјРµС‰РµРЅРёРµ, РїРѕРєР° РєР°СЂС‚Р° РґРІРёРіР°РµС‚СЃСЏ
        offX = panelX - (int) mouseX;
        offY = panelY - (int) mouseY;

        open = true;
        openSubSlot = -1;
        hoverSlot = -1;
        hoverItem = -1;
    }

    /**
     * РџРµСЂРµСЃС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµС‚ РїРѕР·РёС†РёСЋ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РїРѕ С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµРјСѓ РїРѕР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёСЋ РєР°СЂС‚С‹.
     * Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ false, РµСЃР»Рё С‚РѕС‡РєР° РєР»РёРєР° СѓС€Р»Р° Р·Р° РїСЂРµРґРµР»С‹ РєР°СЂС‚С‹ (С‚РѕРіРґР° РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ).
     */
    private boolean followMap() {
        if (map == null) return true;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return false;

        double bpp = map.getBlocksPerPixel();
        double cx = map.getCenterX(mc.player);
        double cz = map.getCenterZ(mc.player);
        int ax = (int) (map.getMapX() + map.getMapSize() / 2.0 + (targetX - cx) / bpp);
        int ay = (int) (map.getMapY() + map.getMapSize() / 2.0 + (targetZ - cz) / bpp);

        if (ax < map.getMapX() || ax > map.getMapX() + map.getMapSize()
                || ay < map.getMapY() || ay > map.getMapY() + map.getMapSize()) {
            return false;
        }
        panelX = ax + offX;
        panelY = ay + offY;
        return true;
    }

    /** РљСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂ РЅР°Рґ РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРѕР№ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊСЋ РёР»Рё РЅР°Рґ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚С‹Рј РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ? */
    private boolean onPanelArea(int mx, int my) {
        if (mx >= panelX && mx < panelX + panelW && my >= panelY && my < panelY + panelH) return true;
        if (openSubSlot >= 0) return inSubArea(bySlot(openSubSlot), mx, my);
        return false;
    }

    // ============================ Р’Р’РћР” ==============================

    /**
     * РћС‚РґР°РІР°С‚СЊ РџР•Р Р•Р” СЃРѕР±СЃС‚РІРµРЅРЅС‹РјРё РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚С‡РёРєР°РјРё СЂРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЏ.
     * Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ true, РµСЃР»Рё РєР»РёРє РїРѕРіР»РѕС‰С‘РЅ (РІ С‚.С‡. РєР»РёРє РІРЅРµ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё вЂ” РѕРЅ РµС‘ Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚).
     */
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        // Р–РґС‘Рј РєРѕРЅРµС† СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєРё
        if (arrowPending) {
            if (button == 1 && map != null && map.isMouseOver(mouseX, mouseY)) {
                finishArrow(mouseX, mouseY);
                return true;
            }
            if (button == 1) {          // РџРљРњ РјРёРјРѕ РєР°СЂС‚С‹ вЂ” РѕС‚РјРµРЅР°
                arrowPending = false;
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (!open) return false;
        if (!followMap()) {
            close();
            return false;
        }
        int mx = (int) mouseX, my = (int) mouseY;
        boolean onPanel = onPanelArea(mx, my);

        if (button != 0) {
            // РџРљРњ/РЎРљРњ: РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ, РЅРµР·Р°РІРёСЃРёРјРѕ РѕС‚ С‚РѕРіРѕ, РіРґРµ Р±С‹Р» РєР»РёРє вЂ”
            // РїРѕ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РёР»Рё РјРёРјРѕ РЅРµС‘. Р‘РѕР»СЊС€Рµ РќР• РѕС‚РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РЅРѕРІСѓСЋ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РІ С‚РѕС‡РєРµ РєР»РёРєР°.
            close();
            return true; // <-- Р±С‹Р»Рѕ: return onPanel;
        }

        if (button != 0) {
            // РџРљРњ/РЎРљРњ: Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ. Р•СЃР»Рё РџРљРњ Р±С‹Р» РїРѕ РєР°СЂС‚Рµ (РЅРµ РїРѕ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё),
            // РІРѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµРј false, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЂРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЊ СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹Р» РЅРѕРІСѓСЋ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РЅР° РЅРѕРІРѕРј РјРµСЃС‚Рµ.
            close();
            return onPanel;
        }

        // 1) РїСѓРЅРєС‚С‹ РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ
        if (openSubSlot >= 0) {
            Entry parent = bySlot(openSubSlot);
            int idx = subItemAt(parent, mx, my);
            if (idx >= 0) {
                place(parent.sub[idx]);
                return true;
            }
            if (inSubArea(parent, mx, my)) return true;
        }

        // 2) РіР»Р°РІРЅС‹Рµ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё: РєР»РёРє СЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚ РјРµС‚РєСѓ РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ
        for (Entry e : PANEL) {
            if (slOnly(e) && !isSL) continue;
            if (inCell(e, mx, my)) {
                place(e);
                return true;
            }
        }

        // 3) Р·Р°Р·РѕСЂС‹ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ РґРµР»Р°СЋС‚
        if (onPanel) return true;

        // 4) Р›РљРњ РїРѕ РєР°СЂС‚Рµ РІРЅРµ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё: РѕС‚РґР°С‘Рј РєР»РёРє РєР°СЂС‚Рµ (РїРµСЂРµС‚Р°СЃРєРёРІР°РЅРёРµ), РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РѕСЃС‚Р°С‘С‚СЃСЏ
        if (map != null && map.isMouseOver(mouseX, mouseY)) return false;

        // 5) Р›РљРњ РІ Р»СЋР±РѕРј РґСЂСѓРіРѕРј РјРµСЃС‚Рµ (Р±РѕРєРѕРІР°СЏ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ Рё С‚.Рї.): Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј
        close();
        return true;
    }

    // =========================== РћРўР РРЎРћР’РљРђ ==========================

    /** Р РёСЃРѕРІР°С‚СЊ РІ СЃР°РјРѕРј РљРћРќР¦Р• render() СЂРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЏ, РїРѕРІРµСЂС… РІСЃРµРіРѕ. */
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        if (arrowPending) renderArrowPreview(gui, mouseX, mouseY);
        if (!open) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || !followMap()) {
            close();
            return;
        }
        Font font = mc.font;

        updateHover(mouseX, mouseY);
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(0, 0, PANEL_Z);   // РїРѕРґРЅРёРјР°РµРј РІСЃСЋ РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ РІС‹С€Рµ РјРµС‚РѕРє

        // --- РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅС‹Рµ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё (РѕР±С‰РµР№ РїРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєРё РЅРµС‚) ---
        for (Entry e : PANEL) {
            if (slOnly(e) && !isSL) continue;
            int x = cellX(e.slot), y = cellY(e.slot);
            boolean hovered = (e.slot == hoverSlot) || (e.slot == openSubSlot);
            gui.fill(x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL, hovered ? COLOR_CELL_HOVER : COLOR_CELL);
            gui.renderOutline(x, y, CELL, CELL, hovered ? COLOR_BORDER_HOVER : COLOR_BORDER);
            drawIcon(gui, font, e, x + (CELL - ICON) / 2, y + (CELL - ICON) / 2);
            if (e.sub != null) drawSubBadge(gui, x, y);
        }

        // --- РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ (РїРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєРё РЅРµС‚) ---
        if (openSubSlot >= 0) {
            Entry parent = bySlot(openSubSlot);
            int sx = subX(parent), sy = subY(parent);
            for (int i = 0; i < parent.sub.length; i++) {
                Entry it = parent.sub[i];
                int ix = sx + PAD;
                int iy = sy + PAD + i * (CELL + GAP);
                boolean hovered = (i == hoverItem);
                gui.fill(ix, iy, ix + CELL, iy + CELL, hovered ? COLOR_CELL_HOVER : COLOR_CELL);
                gui.renderOutline(ix, iy, CELL, CELL, hovered ? COLOR_BORDER_HOVER : COLOR_BORDER);
                drawIcon(gui, font, it, ix + (CELL - ICON) / 2, iy + (CELL - ICON) / 2);
            }
        }

        Component tip = tooltip();
        if (tip != null) gui.renderTooltip(font, tip, mouseX, mouseY);

        gui.pose().popPose();   // РІРѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµРј РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Сѓ РѕР±СЂР°С‚РЅРѕ
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    // ======================= РЎР›РЈР–Р•Р‘РќРђРЇ Р“Р•РћРњР•РўР РРЇ =====================

    private static int colOf(int slot) {
        switch (slot) {
            case 13: return 0;
            case 12: return 1;
            case 10: return 2;
            case 7:  return 3;
            case 1:  return 4;
            case 2:  return 5;
            case 3:  return 6;
            case 4:  return 7;
            case 5:  return 8;
            case 6:  return 9;
            case 9:  return 10;
            default: return 4;   // СЃР»РѕС‚С‹ [8] Рё [11] СЃС‚РѕСЏС‚ РЅР°Рґ [1]
        }
    }

    private int cellX(int slot) {
        return panelX + PAD + colOf(slot) * (CELL + GAP);
    }

    private int cellY(int slot) {
        if (slot == 11) return panelY + PAD;                       // РІРµСЂС…РЅРёР№ СЂСЏРґ
        if (slot == 8)  return panelY + PAD + CELL + GAP;          // СЃСЂРµРґРЅРёР№ СЂСЏРґ
        return panelY + PAD + 2 * (CELL + GAP);                    // РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРѕР№ СЂСЏРґ
    }

    private boolean inCell(Entry e, int mx, int my) {
        int x = cellX(e.slot), y = cellY(e.slot);
        return mx >= x && mx < x + CELL && my >= y && my < y + CELL;
    }

    private int subX(Entry parent) { return cellX(parent.slot) - PAD; }
    private int subY(Entry parent) { return cellY(parent.slot) + CELL + GAP; }
    private int subW()             { return CELL + PAD * 2; }
    private int subH(Entry parent) {
        int n = parent.sub.length;
        return PAD * 2 + n * CELL + (n - 1) * GAP;
    }

    /**
     * РҐРёС‚-Р·РѕРЅР° РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ Р‘Р•Р— РјС‘СЂС‚РІРѕР№ Р·РѕРЅС‹: РЅР°С‡РёРЅР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂСЏРјРѕ РѕС‚ РЅРёР¶РЅРµРіРѕ РєСЂР°СЏ
     * РіР»Р°РІРЅРѕР№ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё (Р·Р°Р·РѕСЂ GAP Рё РЅРёР¶РЅСЏСЏ РєСЂРѕРјРєР° С„РѕРЅР° РІС…РѕРґСЏС‚ РІ Р·РѕРЅСѓ).
     */
    private boolean inSubArea(Entry parent, int mx, int my) {
        int x = subX(parent);
        int top = cellY(parent.slot) + CELL;          // РЅРёР¶РЅРёР№ РєСЂР°Р№ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё
        int bottom = subY(parent) + subH(parent);
        return mx >= x && mx < x + subW() && my >= top && my < bottom;
    }

    private int subItemAt(Entry parent, int mx, int my) {
        int x = subX(parent) + PAD;
        for (int i = 0; i < parent.sub.length; i++) {
            int y = subY(parent) + PAD + i * (CELL + GAP);
            if (mx >= x && mx < x + CELL && my >= y && my < y + CELL) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    // =========================== HOVER-Р›РћР“РРљРђ ========================

    /**
     * РџРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ СЂР°СЃРєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё РЅР°РІРµРґРµРЅРёРё РЅР° СЃРІРѕСЋ РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ Рё Р·Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ,
     * РєРѕРіРґР° РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂ СѓС€С‘Р» Р СЃ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё, Р СЃ РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ.
     */
    private void updateHover(int mx, int my) {
        hoverSlot = -1;
        hoverItem = -1;

        for (Entry e : PANEL) {
            if (slOnly(e) && !isSL) continue;
            if (inCell(e, mx, my)) {
                hoverSlot = e.slot;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (openSubSlot >= 0) {
            Entry parent = bySlot(openSubSlot);
            if (hoverSlot == openSubSlot) {
                // РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂ РІСЃС‘ РµС‰С‘ РЅР° В«СЃРІРѕРµР№В» РєРЅРѕРїРєРµ вЂ” РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ РѕСЃС‚Р°С‘С‚СЃСЏ
            } else if (inSubArea(parent, mx, my)) {
                hoverItem = subItemAt(parent, mx, my);
            } else {
                openSubSlot = -1;   // СѓС€С‘Р» Рё СЃ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё, Рё СЃ РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ
            }
        }

        if (hoverSlot >= 0) {
            Entry hovered = bySlot(hoverSlot);
            if (hovered.sub != null) {
                if (openSubSlot != hoverSlot) hoverItem = -1;
                openSubSlot = hoverSlot;
            }
        }
    }

    private Component tooltip() {
        if (openSubSlot >= 0 && hoverItem >= 0) {
            return Component.translatable(bySlot(openSubSlot).sub[hoverItem].nameKey);
        }
        if (hoverSlot >= 0) {
            return Component.translatable(bySlot(hoverSlot).nameKey);
        }
        return null;
    }

    // =========================== Р”Р•Р™РЎРўР’РРЇ ============================

    private void place(Entry e) {
        if (e.squadType == ARROW_ACTION || e.squadType == SQUAD_ARROW_ACTION) {
            arrowStartX = targetX;
            arrowStartZ = targetZ;
            arrowSquad = (e.squadType == SQUAD_ARROW_ACTION);
            arrowPending = true;
            close();
            return;
        }
        if (e.mapType != null) {
            // РљРЅРѕРїРєРё 2вЂ“6 Рё 8: С‚Рµ Р¶Рµ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРѕРІС‹Рµ РєР»СЋС‡Рё, С‡С‚Рѕ СѓР¶Рµ Р»РµР¶Р°С‚ РІ activeMarkers
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketPlaceMapMarker(targetX, targetZ, e.mapType));
        } else {
            // Р РѕРјР± (6) Рё РјРµС‚РєРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° (0..3): СЃСѓС‰РµСЃС‚РІСѓСЋС‰РёРµ С‡РёСЃР»РѕРІС‹Рµ С‚РёРїС‹
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSquadMarker(targetX, targetZ, e.squadType, e.squadGroup));
        }
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player != null) {
            mc.player.playSound(ModSounds.MAP_MARKER_PLACE.get(), 1.0f, 1.0f);
        }
        close();    // РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё РёРіСЂРѕРє РѕСЃС‚Р°С‘С‚СЃСЏ РЅР° С‚РѕРј Р¶Рµ СЌРєСЂР°РЅРµ
    }

    // ============================ РРљРћРќРљР =============================

    private void drawIcon(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, Entry e, int x, int y) {
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        ResourceLocation icon = iconFor(e);
        if (textureExists(icon)) {
            int[] size = textureSize(icon);
            int tw = size[0];
            int th = size[1];
            gui.pose().pushPose();
            gui.pose().translate(x, y, 0);
            gui.pose().scale(ICON / (float) tw, ICON / (float) th, 1.0f);
            gui.blit(icon, 0, 0, 0, 0, tw, th, tw, th);
            gui.pose().popPose();
        } else {
            gui.fill(x, y, x + ICON, y + ICON, (e.stubColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x44000000);
            gui.renderOutline(x, y, ICON, ICON, (e.stubColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x99000000);
            gui.drawCenteredString(font, e.stub, x + ICON / 2, y + (ICON - font.lineHeight) / 2, e.stubColor);
        }
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    /** РњР°Р»РµРЅСЊРєРёР№ С‚СЂРµСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРє РІ СѓРіР»Сѓ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё вЂ” РїСЂРёР·РЅР°Рє РЅР°Р»РёС‡РёСЏ РїРѕРґРјРµРЅСЋ. */
    private void drawSubBadge(GuiGraphics gui, int x, int y) {
        int bx = x + CELL - 7, by = y + CELL - 7;
        gui.fill(bx, by, bx + 5, by + 1, 0xFF999999);
        gui.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + 4, by + 2, 0xFF999999);
        gui.fill(bx + 2, by + 2, bx + 3, by + 3, 0xFF999999);
    }

    /** Р•СЃС‚СЊ Р»Рё PNG РІ СЂРµСЃСѓСЂСЃР°С… РјРѕРґР° (РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµРј С„Р°Р№Р» РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјСѓСЋ, Р° РЅРµ С‡РµСЂРµР· TextureManager). */
    private static boolean textureExists(ResourceLocation tex) {
        Boolean cached = TEXTURE_EXISTS.get(tex);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        boolean exists = Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(tex).isPresent();
        TEXTURE_EXISTS.put(tex, exists);
        return exists;
    }

    /** Р РµР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂ PNG РІ РїРёРєСЃРµР»СЏС… (С‡РёС‚Р°РµРј РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р· Рё Р·Р°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РµРј). */
    private static int[] textureSize(ResourceLocation tex) {
        int[] cached = TEXTURE_SIZE.get(tex);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        int[] size = new int[]{16, 16};
        try (java.io.InputStream in = Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().open(tex);
             NativeImage img = NativeImage.read(in)) {
            size[0] = img.getWidth();
            size[1] = img.getHeight();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // РѕСЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏРµРј 16x16
        }
        TEXTURE_SIZE.put(tex, size);
        return size;
    }

    // ============================= Р РћР›Р ==============================

    /**
     * РљР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРѕРµ РѕРїСЂРµРґРµР»РµРЅРёРµ СЂРѕР»Рё вЂ” С‚РѕС‡РЅРѕРµ Р·РµСЂРєР°Р»Рѕ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРЅРѕРіРѕ getPlayerRole(...)
     * РёР· PacketPlaceMapMarker: "SL" / "FTL" / "NONE" (РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРѕРІ РІ ClientData).
     */
    private static String getClientRole() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return "NONE";
        String name = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.members.contains(name)) {
                if (s.leader.equals(name)) return "SL";
                if (s.bravoLeader.equals(name) || s.charlieLeader.equals(name)) return "FTL";
                return "NONE";
            }
        }
        return "NONE";
    }
    /** РљР°РєРѕР№ РЅР°Р±РѕСЂ РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚СЊ: 0 = SL, 1 = Bravo FTL, 2 = Charlie FTL. */
    private static int getClientVariant() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 0;
        String name = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.members.contains(name)) {
                if (s.bravoLeader.equals(name)) return 1;
                if (s.charlieLeader.equals(name)) return 2;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    /** РРєРѕРЅРєР° РєРЅРѕРїРєРё СЃ СѓС‡С‘С‚РѕРј С„Р°РµСЂС‚РёРјР° (С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ РјРµС‚РѕРє РґРІРёР¶РµРЅРёСЏ/Р°С‚Р°РєРё/РѕР±РѕСЂРѕРЅС‹/СЃС‚СЂРѕРёС‚СЊ). */
    private ResourceLocation iconFor(Entry e) {
        if (e.mapType == null && e.squadType >= 0 && e.squadType <= 3 && variant != 0) {
            return (variant == 1 ? BRAVO_ICONS : CHARLIE_ICONS)[e.squadType];
        }
        return e.icon;
    }
    // ============================ РЎРўР Р•Р›РљРђ ============================

    /** Р’С‚РѕСЂРѕР№ РџРљРњ РїРѕ РєР°СЂС‚Рµ: СЃС‚Р°РІРёРј РєРѕРЅРµС† СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєРё. */
    private void finishArrow(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        arrowPending = false;
        if (mc.player == null || map == null) return;
        int hx = (int) (map.getCenterX(mc.player)
                + (mouseX - (map.getMapX() + map.getMapSize() / 2.0)) * map.getBlocksPerPixel());
        int hz = (int) (map.getCenterZ(mc.player)
                + (mouseY - (map.getMapY() + map.getMapSize() / 2.0)) * map.getBlocksPerPixel());
        if (hx == arrowStartX && hz == arrowStartZ) return;
        if (arrowSquad) {
            // СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєР° РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°: SquadMarker type 7, РІРёРґСЏС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СѓС‡Р°СЃС‚РЅРёРєРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(
                    new PacketSquadMarker(arrowStartX, arrowStartZ, 7, hx, hz));
        } else {
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(
                    new PacketPlaceMapMarker(arrowStartX, arrowStartZ, "Arrow:" + hx + ":" + hz));
        }
        mc.player.playSound(ModSounds.MAP_MARKER_PLACE.get(), 1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    /** РџРѕРєР° Р¶РґС‘Рј РєРѕРЅРµС†: С‚РѕС‡РєР° РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Р° + СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєР° Р·Р° РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂРѕРј + РїРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєР°. */
    private void renderArrowPreview(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || map == null) { arrowPending = false; return; }
        double bpp = map.getBlocksPerPixel();
        int sx = (int) (map.getMapX() + map.getMapSize() / 2.0 + (arrowStartX - map.getCenterX(mc.player)) / bpp);
        int sy = (int) (map.getMapY() + map.getMapSize() / 2.0 + (arrowStartZ - map.getCenterZ(mc.player)) / bpp);

        // Р¦РІРµС‚ Р·Р°РІРёСЃРёС‚ РѕС‚ С‚РёРїР° СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєРё: РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ = Р·РµР»С‘РЅР°СЏ, РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРЅР°СЏ = РєСЂР°СЃРЅР°СЏ
        int dotColor = arrowSquad ? 0xFF33DD33 : 0xFFE02020;   // ARGB РґР»СЏ gui.fill
        int arrowRgb = arrowSquad ? 0x33DD33   : 0xE02020;     // RGB РґР»СЏ drawArrow

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(0, 0, 800);
        gui.enableScissor(map.getMapX(), map.getMapY(),
                map.getMapX() + map.getMapSize(), map.getMapY() + map.getMapSize());
        gui.fill(sx - 3, sy - 3, sx + 3, sy + 3, 0xFF000000);
        gui.fill(sx - 2, sy - 2, sx + 2, sy + 2, dotColor);
        if (map.isMouseOver(mouseX, mouseY)) map.drawArrow(gui, sx, sy, mouseX, mouseY, 0.7f, arrowRgb);
        gui.disableScissor();
        gui.drawString(mc.font, Component.translatable("aas.gui.map_marker.arrow_hint"),
                mouseX + 10, mouseY + 12, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        gui.pose().popPose();
    }
    private static Entry bySlot(int slot) {
        for (Entry e : PANEL) {
            if (e.slot == slot) return e;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

    );
    // РЎС‚СЂР°С…РѕРІРѕС‡РЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·РґРµР» вЂ” СЃСЋРґР° РїРѕРїР°РґСѓС‚ РєРёС‚С‹, РЅРµ РїСЂРёРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РЅРё Рє РѕРґРЅРѕР№ РёР· РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂРёР№ РІС‹С€Рµ
    // (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ РµСЃР»Рё РІ Р±СѓРґСѓС‰РµРј РґРѕР±Р°РІСЏС‚ РЅРѕРІС‹Р№ РєРёС‚ Рё Р·Р°Р±СѓРґСѓС‚ РѕР±РЅРѕРІРёС‚СЊ СЌС‚РѕС‚ СЌРєСЂР°РЅ).
    private static final CategoryDef OTHER_CATEGORY =
            new CategoryDef("aas.gui.kit.category.other", "category_other", List.of());

    // РЎРµРєС†РёСЏ, РїРѕСЃС‡РёС‚Р°РЅРЅР°СЏ РЅР° С‚РµРєСѓС‰РёР№ РЅР°Р±РѕСЂ РєРёС‚РѕРІ
    private static final class Section {
        final CategoryDef def;
        final List<PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO> kits = new ArrayList<>();
        int y;
        int height;

        Section(CategoryDef def) {
            this.def = def;
        }
    }

    private final List<Section> sections = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String, int[]> kitPos = new HashMap<>(); // kitName -> {x, y} Р‘РђР—РћР’РћР“Рћ (РЅРµ РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‡РµРЅРЅРѕРіРѕ) СѓРіР»Р° С‚Р°Р№Р»Р°
    private int startX;
    private int gridX;
    private int dividerX;

    // === РЎРєСЂРѕР»Р» РєРѕР»С‘СЃРёРєРѕРј, РµСЃР»Рё РєРѕРЅС‚РµРЅС‚ РЅРµ РІР»РµР·Р°РµС‚ РїРѕ РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Рµ ===
    private static final int VIEWPORT_TOP = 26;    // РіРґРµ РЅР°С‡РёРЅР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‡РёРІР°РµРјР°СЏ РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚СЊ (РїРѕРґ Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРєРѕРј)
    private static final int VIEWPORT_BOTTOM_PAD = 6; // РѕС‚СЃС‚СѓРї СЃРЅРёР·Сѓ СЌРєСЂР°РЅР°
    private static final int SCROLL_STEP = 22;     // px Р·Р° РѕРґРёРЅ "С‰РµР»С‡РѕРє" РєРѕР»РµСЃР°
    private int scrollOffset = 0;      // СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ px СѓР¶Рµ РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‡РµРЅРѕ РІРЅРёР·
    private int contentHeight = 0;     // РїРѕР»РЅР°СЏ РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Р° РєРѕРЅС‚РµРЅС‚Р° (РІСЃРµ СЃРµРєС†РёРё), СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РІ computeLayout()

    private int viewportBottom() { return this.height - VIEWPORT_BOTTOM_PAD; }
    private int maxScroll() { return Math.max(0, contentHeight - (viewportBottom() - VIEWPORT_TOP)); }

    // === Р’С‹Р±РѕСЂ РІР°СЂРёР°РЅС‚Р° (СЃС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚/Р°Р»СЊС‚) ===
    // РРјСЏ РєРёС‚Р°, РґР»СЏ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕРіРѕ СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ РїРѕРєР°Р·Р°РЅ РІС‹Р±РѕСЂ STANDARD/ALTERNATIVE. null РµСЃР»Рё РЅРµС‚.
    private String variantPopupKitName = null;
    private boolean variantPopupIsPreview = false; // РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚ Р»Рё РїРѕРїР°Рї РґР»СЏ РїСЂРµРІСЊСЋ (РіР»Р°Р·) РёР»Рё РІС‹Р±РѕСЂР° РєРёС‚Р°

    public PlayerKitSelectScreen(List<PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO> kits) {
        super(Component.translatable("aas.gui.kit.select.title"));
        this.kits = new java.util.ArrayList<>(kits);
    }

    // === РљРЅРѕРїРєР° РІ СЃС‚РёР»Рµ "APPLY FOR CMD" (С‚С‘РјРЅР°СЏ РїР»Р°С€РєР° + Р»Р°Р№Рј-Р·РµР»С‘РЅР°СЏ СЂР°РјРєР°), С‚РµРєСЃС‚ РЅРµ РјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ ===
    private static class AasFlatButton extends Button {
        AasFlatButton(int x, int y, int width, int height, Component message, OnPress onPress) {
            super(x, y, width, height, message, onPress, DEFAULT_NARRATION);
        }

        @Override
        protected void renderWidget(GuiGraphics gui, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks) {
            if (!this.visible) return;

            int borderColor = this.isHovered() ? BTN_BORDER_HOVER : BTN_BORDER_IDLE;
            if (!this.active) borderColor = BTN_BORDER_DISABLED;

            gui.fill(getX(), getY(), getX() + width, getY() + height, BTN_BG);
            gui.renderOutline(getX(), getY(), width, height, borderColor);

            int textColor = this.active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF777777;
            gui.drawCenteredString(Minecraft.getInstance().font, this.getMessage(), getX() + width / 2, getY() + (height - 8) / 2, textColor);

            if (this.active && this.isHovered()) {
                gui.fill(getX(), getY() + height - 2, getX() + 2, getY() + height, BTN_BORDER_HOVER);
            }
        }
    }

    // === РЎР±РѕСЂРєР° СЃРµРєС†РёР№ Рё СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚ (РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· init(), С‚.Рє. С€РёСЂРёРЅР° СЌРєСЂР°РЅР° РјРѕР¶РµС‚ РїРѕРјРµРЅСЏС‚СЊСЃСЏ) ===
    private void computeLayout() {
        sections.clear();
        kitPos.clear();

        Set<String> used = new HashSet<>();

        for (CategoryDef def : CATEGORY_DEFS) {
            Section section = new Section(def);
            if (def.kitOrder == null) {
                // Р”РёРЅР°РјРёС‡РµСЃРєР°СЏ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂРёСЏ "РћС„РёС†РµСЂС‹" вЂ” Р±РµСЂС‘Рј РІСЃРµ РєРёС‚С‹ СЃ РіР°Р»РѕС‡РєРѕР№ isOfficer.
                // РРіСЂРѕРєР°Рј, РЅРµ СЏРІР»СЏСЋС‰РёРјСЃСЏ Р»РёРґРµСЂР°РјРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°, СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ СѓР¶Рµ РЅРµ РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµС‚ С‚Р°РєРёРµ РєРёС‚С‹,
                // РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ СЂР°Р·РґРµР» СЃР°Рј СЃРєСЂРѕРµС‚СЃСЏ, РµСЃР»Рё РѕРЅ РёРј РЅРµ РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅ.
                for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : kits) {
                    if (kit.isOfficer) {
                        section.kits.add(kit);
                        used.add(kit.name);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (String name : def.kitOrder) {
                    for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : kits) {
                        if (kit.name.equals(name) && !kit.isOfficer) {
                            section.kits.add(kit);
                            used.add(kit.name);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!section.kits.isEmpty()) sections.add(section);
        }

        // РЎС‚СЂР°С…РѕРІРѕС‡РЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·РґРµР» РґР»СЏ РЅРµ СЂР°СЃРїРѕР·РЅР°РЅРЅС‹С… РєРёС‚РѕРІ
        Section other = new Section(OTHER_CATEGORY);
        for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : kits) {
            if (!used.contains(kit.name)) other.kits.add(kit);
        }
        if (!other.kits.isEmpty()) sections.add(other);

        startX = (width - TOTAL_WIDTH) / 2;
        dividerX = startX + ICON_COL_WIDTH + DIVIDER_GAP / 2;
        gridX = startX + ICON_COL_WIDTH + DIVIDER_GAP;

        int y = TOP_Y;
        for (Section section : sections) {
            int rows = (section.kits.size() + COLUMNS - 1) / COLUMNS;
            int h = rows * ROW_HEIGHT;
            section.y = y;
            section.height = h;

            for (int i = 0; i < section.kits.size(); i++) {
                int row = i / COLUMNS;
                int col = i % COLUMNS;
                int x = gridX + col * TILE_WIDTH;
                int ky = y + row * ROW_HEIGHT + 26;
                kitPos.put(section.kits.get(i).name, new int[]{x, ky});
            }

            y += h + SECTION_GAP;
        }
        contentHeight = y - SECTION_GAP - TOP_Y; // РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Р° РІСЃРµРіРѕ РєРѕРЅС‚РµРЅС‚Р° Р±РµР· РІРµСЂС…РЅРµРіРѕ РѕС‚СЃС‚СѓРїР° Рё Р»РёС€РЅРµРіРѕ С…РІРѕСЃС‚РѕРІРѕРіРѕ gap
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        computeLayout();
        // РЁРёСЂРёРЅР°/РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Р° СЌРєСЂР°РЅР° С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‡С‚Рѕ РїРѕСЃС‡РёС‚Р°РЅС‹ Р·Р°РЅРѕРІРѕ вЂ” РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‚РєР° РјРѕРіР»Р° СЃС‚Р°С‚СЊ РЅРµРІР°Р»РёРґРЅРѕР№ (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ
        // РѕРєРЅРѕ СѓРІРµР»РёС‡РёР»Рё Рё РІСЃС‘ РІР»РµР·Р»Рѕ) вЂ” РїРѕРґСЂРµР·Р°РµРј РЅР° РІСЃСЏРєРёР№ СЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№.
        scrollOffset = Math.min(scrollOffset, maxScroll());
        rebuildKitWidgets();
    }

    // РџРµСЂРµСЃРѕР±РёСЂР°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё СЃ СѓС‡С‘С‚РѕРј С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµРіРѕ scrollOffset. Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· init() Рё РёР· mouseScrolled(),
    // С‚.Рє. РїРѕР·РёС†РёРё РІРёРґР¶РµС‚РѕРІ Minecraft-РєРЅРѕРїРѕРє РЅРµР»СЊР·СЏ РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ "СЃРґРІРёРЅСѓС‚СЊ" С‡РµСЂРµР· GuiGraphics вЂ” РёС… РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕ
    // РЅР° СЃР°РјРѕРј РґРµР»Рµ РїРµСЂРµРјРµСЃС‚РёС‚СЊ.
    private void rebuildKitWidgets() {
        this.clearWidgets();

        for (Section section : sections) {
            for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : section.kits) {
                int[] pos = kitPos.get(kit.name);
                int x = pos[0];
                int y = pos[1] - scrollOffset;

                // РћСЃРЅРѕРІРЅР°СЏ РєРЅРѕРїРєР° РІС‹Р±РѕСЂР°
                AasFlatButton btn = new AasFlatButton(x, y, BUTTON_WIDTH - 20, 20, Component.literal(kit.name), b -> {
                    if (kit.hasAlt) {
                        // Р•СЃС‚СЊ Р°Р»СЊС‚РµСЂРЅР°С‚РёРІРЅР°СЏ РІРµСЂСЃРёСЏ вЂ” РїРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµРј РІС‹Р±РѕСЂ РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ РЅРµРјРµРґР»РµРЅРЅРѕРіРѕ РІС‹Р±РѕСЂР°
                        variantPopupKitName = (kit.name.equals(variantPopupKitName) && !variantPopupIsPreview) ? null : kit.name;
                        variantPopupIsPreview = false;
                        rebuildKitWidgets(); // РїРѕРєР°Р·Р°С‚СЊ/СЃРєСЂС‹С‚СЊ РїРѕРїР°Рї Р±РµР· РїРѕС‚РµСЂРё scrollOffset
                    } else {
                        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSelectKit(kit.name, false));
                        this.minecraft.getSoundManager().play(net.minecraft.client.resources.sounds.SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(com.example.aas.sound.ModSounds.KIT_SELECT.get(), 1.0F));
                        this.onClose();
                    }
                });

                btn.active = kit.available;
                this.addRenderableWidget(btn);

                // РљРќРћРџРљРђ Р“Р›РђР—РРљ (РїСЂРµРІСЊСЋ)
                this.addRenderableWidget(new AasFlatButton(x + BUTTON_WIDTH - 18, y, 20, 20, EYE_ICON, b -> {
                    if (kit.hasAlt) {
                        variantPopupKitName = (kit.name.equals(variantPopupKitName) && variantPopupIsPreview) ? null : kit.name;
                        variantPopupIsPreview = true;
                        rebuildKitWidgets();
                    } else {
                        this.minecraft.setScreen(new KitPreviewScreen(this, kit, false));
                    }
                }));
            }
        }

        rebuildVariantPopup();
    }

    private void rebuildVariantPopup() {
        if (variantPopupKitName == null) return;
        PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit = null;
        for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO k : kits) {
            if (k.name.equals(variantPopupKitName)) { kit = k; break; }
        }
        if (kit == null || !kit.hasAlt) return;
        int[] pos = kitPos.get(kit.name);
        if (pos == null) return;

        int x = pos[0];
        int y = pos[1] - scrollOffset + 22; // РїСЂСЏРјРѕ РїРѕРґ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕР№ РєРёС‚Р°
        final PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO fKit = kit;

        if (variantPopupIsPreview) {
            this.addRenderableWidget(new AasFlatButton(x, y, (BUTTON_WIDTH - 20) / 2, 16, Component.literal("Stnd"), b -> {
                variantPopupKitName = null;
                this.minecraft.setScreen(new KitPreviewScreen(this, fKit, false));
            }));

            this.addRenderableWidget(new AasFlatButton(x + (BUTTON_WIDTH - 20) / 2, y, (BUTTON_WIDTH - 20) / 2, 16, Component.literal("Alt"), b -> {
                variantPopupKitName = null;
                this.minecraft.setScreen(new KitPreviewScreen(this, fKit, true));
            }));
        } else {
            this.addRenderableWidget(new AasFlatButton(x, y, (BUTTON_WIDTH - 20) / 2, 16, Component.literal("Stnd"), b -> {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSelectKit(fKit.name, false));
                this.onClose();
            }));

            this.addRenderableWidget(new AasFlatButton(x + (BUTTON_WIDTH - 20) / 2, y, (BUTTON_WIDTH - 20) / 2, 16, Component.literal("Alt"), b -> {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSelectKit(fKit.name, true));
                this.onClose();
            }));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double delta) {
        int max = maxScroll();
        if (max <= 0) return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        int newOffset = scrollOffset - (int) Math.signum(delta) * SCROLL_STEP;
        newOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(max, newOffset));
        if (newOffset != scrollOffset) {
            scrollOffset = newOffset;
            rebuildKitWidgets();
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void onClose() {
        if (this.minecraft.player != null && !this.minecraft.player.isAlive()) {
            // Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє РјС‘СЂС‚РІ, РїСЂРё Р·Р°РєСЂС‹С‚РёРё РІС‹Р±РѕСЂР° РєРёС‚Р° РІРѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµРј РµРіРѕ РІ AASDeathScreen
            this.minecraft.setScreen(new com.example.aas.client.AASDeathScreen(null, false));
        } else {
            super.onClose();
        }
    }

    public void updateKits(List<PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO> newKits) {
        this.kits.clear();
        this.kits.addAll(newKits);

        // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ РєРЅРѕРїРѕРє Р±РµР· РїРµСЂРµСЂРёСЃРѕРІРєРё РІСЃРµРіРѕ СЌРєСЂР°РЅР°
        for (net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable widget : this.renderables) {
            if (widget instanceof Button btn) {
                String btnText = btn.getMessage().getString();
                for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : this.kits) {
                    if (kit.name.equals(btnText)) {
                        btn.active = kit.available;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        if (!this.minecraft.player.isAlive()) {
            gui.fill(0, 0, this.width, this.height, 0xFF000000);
        } else {
            this.renderBackground(gui);
        }
        gui.drawCenteredString(font, title, width / 2, 10, 0xFFFFFF);

        int viewportBottom = viewportBottom();
        // РћР±СЂРµР·Р°РµРј РІСЃС‘, С‡С‚Рѕ СЂРёСЃСѓРµРј РЅРёР¶Рµ, РїРѕ РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‡РёРІР°РµРјРѕР№ РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚Рё вЂ” РєРѕРЅС‚РµРЅС‚ РЅРµ Р±СѓРґРµС‚ РЅР°РµР·Р¶Р°С‚СЊ
        // РЅР° Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕРє СЃРІРµСЂС…Сѓ Рё РІС‹Р»РµР·Р°С‚СЊ Р·Р° РЅРёР¶РЅРёР№ РєСЂР°Р№ СЌРєСЂР°РЅР°.
        gui.enableScissor(0, VIEWPORT_TOP, this.width, viewportBottom);

        // === РћС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєР° СЂР°Р·РґРµР»РѕРІ: РїРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєР° РїРѕРґ РёРєРѕРЅРєСѓ + РёРєРѕРЅРєР° + РїРѕРґРїРёСЃСЊ + РІРµСЂС‚РёРєР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ Р»РёРЅРёСЏ ===
        for (Section section : sections) {
            int sectionY = section.y - scrollOffset;
            int iconX = startX + (ICON_COL_WIDTH - ICON_SIZE) / 2;
            int iconY = sectionY + Math.max(0, (section.height - ICON_SIZE - 12) / 2);

            // РџРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєР° РїРѕРґ РёРєРѕРЅРєСѓ СЂР°Р·РґРµР»Р° вЂ” РІ СЃС‚РёР»Рµ РѕСЂРёРіРёРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ "APPLY FOR CMD" (С‚С‘РјРЅР°СЏ РїР»Р°С€РєР° + СЃРµСЂР°СЏ СЂР°РјРєР°)
            int badgePad = 6;
            int badgeX = iconX - badgePad;
            int badgeY = iconY - badgePad;
            int badgeSize = ICON_SIZE + badgePad * 2;
            gui.fill(badgeX, badgeY, badgeX + badgeSize, badgeY + badgeSize, 0xCC111111);
            gui.renderOutline(badgeX, badgeY, badgeSize, badgeSize, 0xFF999999);

            ResourceLocation iconLoc = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/kits/" + section.def.iconFile + ".png");
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            gui.blit(iconLoc, iconX, iconY, 0, 0, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE);

            gui.drawCenteredString(font, Component.translatable(section.def.titleKey),
                    startX + ICON_COL_WIDTH / 2, badgeY + badgeSize + 6, 0xFFD9D9D9);

            // Р’РµСЂС‚РёРєР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ СЂР°Р·РґРµР»РёС‚РµР»СЊРЅР°СЏ РїРѕР»РѕСЃРєР°
            gui.fill(dividerX, sectionY, dividerX + 1, sectionY + section.height, 0x55FFFFFF);
        }

        // === РћС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєР° РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє РєРёС‚РѕРІ Рё РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂР° Р°Р»СЊС‚-РІРµСЂСЃРёРё ===
        for (Section section : sections) {
            for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : section.kits) {
                int[] pos = kitPos.get(kit.name);
                if (pos == null) continue;
                int x = pos[0];
                int y = pos[1] - scrollOffset;

                String iconName = kit.name.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_");
                ResourceLocation iconLoc = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/kits/" + iconName + ".png");

                int iconX = x + (BUTTON_WIDTH / 2) - 12 - 5; // -5, С‚.Рє. РєРЅРѕРїРєР° С‚РµРїРµСЂСЊ СѓР¶Рµ РЅР° 20px, С†РµРЅС‚СЂСѓРµРј РїРѕ С‚Р°Р№Р»Сѓ
                int iconY = y - 26;

                KitIconStyle.apply(KitIconStyle.DEFAULT_COLOR, kit.available ? 1.0f : 0.4f);
                gui.blit(iconLoc, iconX, iconY, 0, 0, 24, 24, 24, 24);
            }
        }
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);

        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);

        gui.disableScissor();

        // РџСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕР№ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ РїСЂРѕРєСЂСѓС‚РєРё СЃРїСЂР°РІР° РѕС‚ СЃРµС‚РєРё (РІРёРґРµРЅ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РµСЃР»Рё РєРѕРЅС‚РµРЅС‚ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РЅРµ РІР»РµР·Р°РµС‚)
        int max = maxScroll();
        if (max > 0) {
            int trackX = Math.min(this.width - 6, gridX + GRID_WIDTH + 6);
            int trackTop = VIEWPORT_TOP;
            int trackHeight = viewportBottom - VIEWPORT_TOP;
            gui.fill(trackX, trackTop, trackX + 3, trackTop + trackHeight, 0x33FFFFFF);

            int thumbHeight = Math.max(12, trackHeight * trackHeight / (trackHeight + max));
            int thumbY = trackTop + (int) ((trackHeight - thumbHeight) * (scrollOffset / (float) max));
            gui.fill(trackX, thumbY, trackX + 3, thumbY + thumbHeight, 0xAAFFFFFF);
        }

        // РўСѓР»С‚РёРї РїСЂРёС‡РёРЅС‹ Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІРєРё
        for (net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable widget : this.renderables) {
            if (widget instanceof Button btn && btn.isHovered() && !btn.active) {
                for (PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO kit : kits) {
                    if (btn.getMessage().getString().equals(kit.name)) {
                        gui.renderTooltip(font, Component.literal(kit.reason), mx, my);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.gui;

import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketOpenPointEditor;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSavePoint;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.EditBox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

public class PointEditorScreen extends Screen {
    private final PacketOpenPointEditor data;

    private EditBox nameBox;
    private String currentShape;
    private EditBox p1x, p1y, p1z;
    private EditBox p2x, p2y, p2z;

    private EditBox bluePrioBox, redPrioBox, capTimeBox;
    private EditBox penaltyBox, deductBox, lockBox;
    private EditBox gainNeutBox, gainCapBox; // <-- РќРћР’Р«Р• РџРћР›РЇ

    public PointEditorScreen(PacketOpenPointEditor data) {
        super(Component.literal("Edit Point: " + data.originalName));
        this.data = data;
        this.currentShape = data.shape;
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        super.init();
        int cx = this.width / 2;
        int cy = this.height / 2;
        int startY = cy - 90;

        // РРјСЏ Рё Р¤РѕСЂРјР°
        nameBox = new EditBox(this.font, cx - 80, startY, 110, 16, Component.empty());
        nameBox.setValue(data.originalName);
        this.addRenderableWidget(nameBox);

        this.addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(currentShape), b -> {
            currentShape = currentShape.equals("CUBE") ? "CYLINDER" : "CUBE";
            b.setMessage(Component.literal(currentShape));
        }).bounds(cx + 80, startY - 2, 60, 20).build());

        // РљРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ P1
        p1x = createCoordBox(cx - 50, startY + 30, data.p1x);
        p1y = createCoordBox(cx, startY + 30, data.p1y);
        p1z = createCoordBox(cx + 50, startY + 30, data.p1z);

        // РљРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ P2
        p2x = createCoordBox(cx - 50, startY + 60, data.p2x);
        p2y = createCoordBox(cx, startY + 60, data.p2y);
        p2z = createCoordBox(cx + 50, startY + 60, data.p2z);

        // РќРёР¶РЅРёРµ РЅР°СЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєРё
        int bottomY = startY + 100;
        bluePrioBox = createCoordBox(cx - 100, bottomY, data.bluePriority);
        redPrioBox  = createCoordBox(cx - 40,  bottomY, data.redPriority);
        capTimeBox  = createCoordBox(cx + 20,  bottomY, data.captureTime);
        lockBox     = createCoordBox(cx + 80,  bottomY, data.lockMin);

        penaltyBox = createCoordBox(cx - 60, bottomY + 35, data.penalty);
        deductBox  = createCoordBox(cx + 20, bottomY + 35, data.deduct);

        // --- РќРћР’Р«Р• РўР•РљРЎРўРћР’Р«Р• РџРћР›РЇ ---
        gainNeutBox = createCoordBox(cx - 60, bottomY + 60, data.gainNeut);
        gainCapBox  = createCoordBox(cx + 20, bottomY + 60, data.gainCap);

        // РљРЅРѕРїРєР° СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅРµРЅРёСЏ (РЎРґРІРёРЅСѓС‚Р° РЅРµРјРЅРѕРіРѕ РЅРёР¶Рµ, РЅР° +90)
        this.addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("SAVE"), b -> {
            saveAndClose();
        }).bounds(cx - 50, bottomY + 90, 100, 20).build());
    }

    private EditBox createCoordBox(int x, int y, int value) {
        EditBox box = new EditBox(this.font, x, y, 40, 16, Component.empty());
        box.setValue(String.valueOf(value));
        box.setFilter(s -> s.matches("-?\\d*")); // Р Р°Р·СЂРµС€Р°РµРј РјРёРЅСѓСЃ Рё С†РёС„СЂС‹
        this.addRenderableWidget(box);
        return box;
    }

    private void saveAndClose() {
        try {
            String newName = nameBox.getValue().trim();
            if (newName.isEmpty()) return;

            int x1 = Integer.parseInt(p1x.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : p1x.getValue());
            int y1 = Integer.parseInt(p1y.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : p1y.getValue());
            int z1 = Integer.parseInt(p1z.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : p1z.getValue());
            int x2 = Integer.parseInt(p2x.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : p2x.getValue());
            int y2 = Integer.parseInt(p2y.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : p2y.getValue());
            int z2 = Integer.parseInt(p2z.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : p2z.getValue());

            int bp = Integer.parseInt(bluePrioBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : bluePrioBox.getValue());
            int rp = Integer.parseInt(redPrioBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : redPrioBox.getValue());
            int time = Integer.parseInt(capTimeBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "1" : capTimeBox.getValue());
            int pen = Integer.parseInt(penaltyBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : penaltyBox.getValue());
            int ded = Integer.parseInt(deductBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : deductBox.getValue());
            int lock = Integer.parseInt(lockBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : lockBox.getValue());

            // РЎС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµРј Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёСЏ РґР»СЏ РЅРѕРІС‹С… РїРµСЂРµРјРµРЅРЅС‹С…
            int gNeut = Integer.parseInt(gainNeutBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : gainNeutBox.getValue());
            int gCap = Integer.parseInt(gainCapBox.getValue().isEmpty() ? "0" : gainCapBox.getValue());

            // РћС‚РїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµРј РІСЃРµ РїР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂС‹, РІРєР»СЋС‡Р°СЏ РЅРѕРІС‹Рµ
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketSavePoint(data.originalName, newName, currentShape, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, bp, rp, time, pen, ded, lock, gNeut, gCap));
            this.onClose();
        } catch (Exception e) {}
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, int mx, int my, float pt) {
        this.renderBackground(gui);
        int cx = this.width / 2;
        int cy = this.height / 2;
        int startY = cy - 90;

        // РќРµРјРЅРѕРіРѕ СѓРІРµР»РёС‡РёР»Рё РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Сѓ С‡РµСЂРЅРѕРіРѕ РѕРєРЅР° (+25 РїРёРєСЃРµР»РµР№)
        gui.fill(cx - 160, cy - 110, cx + 160, cy + 135, 0xEE000000);
        gui.renderOutline(cx - 160, cy - 110, 320, 245, 0xFFFFFFFF);

        gui.drawCenteredString(font, "EDIT POINT", cx, cy - 105, 0xFFFFAA00);

        gui.drawString(font, "Name:", cx - 120, startY + 4, 0xAAAAAA);
        gui.drawString(font, "Shape:", cx + 40, startY + 4, 0xAAAAAA);

        gui.drawString(font, "Pos 1 (X Y Z):", cx - 135, startY + 34, 0xAAAAAA);
        gui.drawString(font, "Pos 2 (X Y Z):", cx - 135, startY + 64, 0xAAAAAA);

        int bottomY = startY + 90;
        gui.drawString(font, "BluePrio", cx - 100, bottomY, 0x5555FF);
        gui.drawString(font, "RedPrio", cx - 40, bottomY, 0xFF5555);
        gui.drawString(font, "Time (m)", cx + 20, bottomY, 0xAAAAAA);
        gui.drawString(font, "Lock (m)", cx + 80, bottomY, 0xAAAAAA);

        gui.drawString(font, "Tix Penalty", cx - 60, bottomY + 25, 0xAAAAAA);
        gui.drawString(font, "Cap Deduct", cx + 20, bottomY + 25, 0xAAAAAA);

        // --- РќРћР’Р«Р• РўР•РљРЎРўРћР’Р«Р• РџРћР”РџРРЎР ---
        gui.drawString(font, "Gain Neut", cx - 60, bottomY + 50, 0x55FF55);
        gui.drawString(font, "Gain Cap", cx + 20, bottomY + 50, 0x55FF55);

        super.render(gui, mx, my, pt);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }
}
