package com.example.aas.client.uav;

import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketUavLaunch;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Font;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;

/**
 * "Choose the UAV zone" mode of the map screen: RMB sets the centre, mouse sets the radius (clamped to the
 * configured min/max), RMB confirms, Esc cancels. The screen routes RMB here BEFORE the marker menu.
 */
public class UavMapSelection {
    private enum Stage { IDLE, CENTER, RADIUS }

    private Stage stage = Stage.IDLE;
    private double centerX, centerZ;

    public boolean isActive() { return stage != Stage.IDLE; }
    public void start() { stage = Stage.CENTER; }
    public void cancel() { stage = Stage.IDLE; }

    /** @return true if the click was consumed (it was on the map while the mode is active) */
    public boolean onRightClick(double mx, double my, int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize,
                                double panX, double panZ, double bpp) {
        if (stage == Stage.IDLE) return false;
        if (mx < mapX || mx > mapX + mapSize || my < mapY || my > mapY + mapSize) return false;
        if (stage == Stage.CENTER) {
            centerX = panX + (mx - (mapX + mapSize / 2.0)) * bpp;
            centerZ = panZ + (my - (mapY + mapSize / 2.0)) * bpp;
            stage = Stage.RADIUS;
            return true;
        }
        int r = radiusAt(mx, my, mapX, mapY, mapSize, panX, panZ, bpp);
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketUavLaunch(centerX, centerZ, r));
        stage = Stage.IDLE;
        return true;
    }

    private int radiusAt(double mx, double my, int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize, double panX, double panZ, double bpp) {
        double sx = mapX + mapSize / 2.0 + (centerX - panX) / bpp;
        double sy = mapY + mapSize / 2.0 + (centerZ - panZ) / bpp;
        double blocks = Math.hypot(mx - sx, my - sy) * bpp;
        int min = ClientData.uavMinRadius();
        int max = Math.max(min, ClientData.uavMaxRadius());
        return Mth.clamp((int) Math.round(blocks), min, max);
    }

    public void render(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int mouseX, int mouseY, int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize,
                       double panX, double panZ, double bpp) {
        if (stage == Stage.IDLE) return;
        Component hint;
        if (stage == Stage.RADIUS) {
            int r = radiusAt(mouseX, mouseY, mapX, mapY, mapSize, panX, panZ, bpp);
            float sx = (float) (mapX + mapSize / 2.0 + (centerX - panX) / bpp);
            float sy = (float) (mapY + mapSize / 2.0 + (centerZ - panZ) / bpp);
            gui.enableScissor(mapX, mapY, mapX + mapSize, mapY + mapSize);
            UavZoneRenderer.drawZone(gui, sx, sy, (float) (r / bpp));
            UavZoneRenderer.drawIcon(gui, sx, sy, 16);
            gui.disableScissor();
            hint = Component.translatable("aas.uav.select.radius", r);
        } else {
            hint = Component.translatable("aas.uav.select.center");
            gui.fill(mouseX - 5, mouseY, mouseX + 6, mouseY + 1, 0xFFFFFF00);   // СЏСЂРєРѕ-Р¶С‘Р»С‚С‹Р№
            gui.fill(mouseX, mouseY - 5, mouseX + 1, mouseY + 6, 0xFFFFFF00);
        }
        int w = font.width(hint);
        int x = mapX + mapSize / 2 - w / 2;
        int y = mapY + 6;
        gui.fill(x - 5, y - 3, x + w + 5, y + 11, 0xCC000000);
        gui.renderOutline(x - 5, y - 3, w + 10, 14, 0xFFB8860B);
        gui.drawString(font, hint, x, y, 0xFFFFE680, false);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.uav;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderGuiEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

/** Text-only notification in the style of the downed timer plate (dark plate, red outline, red text). */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public class UavNoticeOverlay {
    private static Component text;
    private static long start;
    private static final long TOTAL_MS = 4000, FADE_MS = 600;

    public static void push(Component c) { text = c; start = System.currentTimeMillis(); }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRender(RenderGuiEvent.Post e) {
        renderPlate(e.getGuiGraphics());
    }

    /**
     * Draws the plate. Public so full-screen screens (map, death screen), which cover the HUD, can draw it themselves.
     * Several callers in one frame are harmless: the timer is time based, not frame based.
     */
    public static void renderPlate(GuiGraphics g) {
        if (text == null) return;
        long el = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
        if (el >= TOTAL_MS) { text = null; return; }
        float a = el > TOTAL_MS - FADE_MS ? (TOTAL_MS - el) / (float) FADE_MS : 1f;
        int alpha = Math.max(4, (int) (a * 255));
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        int w = mc.font.width(text);
        int cx = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth() / 2;
        int y = 40;
        g.fill(cx - w / 2 - 8, y, cx + w / 2 + 8, y + 18, ((int) (a * 0xAA)) << 24);
        g.renderOutline(cx - w / 2 - 8, y, w + 16, 18, (alpha << 24) | 0xFF5555);
        g.drawCenteredString(mc.font, text, cx, y + 5, (alpha << 24) | 0xFF5555);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.uav;

import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.SquadSelectionScreen;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.WorldMarkerRadialScreen;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketUavView;
import com.example.aas.uav.UavExitReason;
import net.minecraft.client.KeyMapping;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.player.LocalPlayer;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Marker;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.minecraftforge.client.event.*;
import net.minecraftforge.client.gui.overlay.VanillaGuiOverlay;
import net.minecraftforge.event.TickEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.EventPriority;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.LogicalSide;
/**
 * Client side of looking through the UAV.
 *  - the camera is a client-only Marker entity placed on the analytic orbit (the real UAV entity may not even be
 *    tracked by this client when it is far from the body);
 *  - the body is frozen: mouse turning is captured every frame and turned into a clamped camera tilt;
 *  - Q cycles zoom 1->2->3->off, E leaves.
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public class UavViewClient {

    private static boolean viewing = false;
    private static Marker anchor;
    private static int zoomStage = 0;       // 0 = off, 1..3
    private static float viewYaw, viewPitch;
    private static float frozenYaw, origPitch;

    public static boolean isViewing() { return viewing; }
    public static int zoomStage() { return zoomStage; }
    public static float viewYaw() { return viewYaw; }
    public static float viewPitch() { return viewPitch; }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ enter / exit
    /** Authoritative state from the server. */
    public static void onServerState(boolean active, int reason) {
        if (active) enter();
        else exit(UavExitReason.byId(reason));
    }
    private static Vec3 frozenPos;   // РіРґРµ СЃС‚РѕСЏР»Рѕ С‚РµР»Рѕ, РєРѕРіРґР° РЅР°С‡Р°Р»СЃСЏ РїСЂРѕСЃРјРѕС‚СЂ
    private static int holdTicks;    // РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РІС‹С…РѕРґР° РґРµСЂР¶РёРј С‚РµР»Рѕ, РїРѕРєР° РЅРµ РІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚СЃСЏ РµРіРѕ С‡Р°РЅРєРё

    private static void pinBody(LocalPlayer pl) {
        pl.setPos(frozenPos.x, frozenPos.y, frozenPos.z);
        pl.setDeltaMovement(Vec3.ZERO);
        pl.fallDistance = 0f;
    }

    private static boolean bodyChunksReady(Minecraft mc) {
        int cx = Mth.floor(frozenPos.x) >> 4, cz = Mth.floor(frozenPos.z) >> 4;
        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
            for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++)
                if (!mc.level.getChunkSource().hasChunk(cx + dx, cz + dz)) return false;
        return true;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onPlayerTick(TickEvent.PlayerTickEvent e) {
        if (e.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END || e.side != LogicalSide.CLIENT) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (frozenPos == null || mc.player == null || mc.level == null || e.player != mc.player) return;
        if (viewing) { pinBody(mc.player); return; }
        if (holdTicks > 0 && !bodyChunksReady(mc)) { holdTicks--; pinBody(mc.player); return; }
        frozenPos = null;
        holdTicks = 0;
    }
    private static void enter() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null || !UavClientState.active) return;
        if (viewing) return;
        anchor = new Marker(EntityType.MARKER, mc.level);
        Vec3 p = UavClientState.position(mc.level.getGameTime());
        placeAnchor(p);

        LocalPlayer pl = mc.player;
        frozenPos = pl.position();   // body is pinned here while viewing and after exit until its chunks are back
        holdTicks = 0;
        frozenYaw = pl.getYRot();
        origPitch = pl.getXRot();
        viewYaw = frozenYaw;
        viewPitch = 90f;
        zoomStage = 0;
        // pitch 0 for the whole session: no clamping at +-90 can swallow mouse deltas
        pl.setXRot(0f);
        pl.xRotO = 0f;

        viewing = true;
        mc.setCameraEntity(anchor);
        if (mc.screen != null) mc.setScreen(null);
    }

    /** Leave the camera. Shows a notification for forced exits. */
    public static void exit(UavExitReason reason) {
        if (!viewing) return;
        exitSilently();
        if (reason.notifies()) UavNoticeOverlay.push(Component.translatable(reason.langKey()));
    }

    public static void exitSilently() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (viewing && mc.player != null) {
            mc.player.setYRot(frozenYaw);
            mc.player.yRotO = frozenYaw;
            mc.player.setXRot(origPitch);
            mc.player.xRotO = origPitch;
            mc.setCameraEntity(mc.player);
            if (frozenPos != null) holdTicks = 200; // up to 10 s: keep the body still until its chunks arrive
        }
        viewing = false;
        zoomStage = 0;
        anchor = null;
    }

    private static void placeAnchor(Vec3 p) {
        anchor.setPos(p.x, p.y, p.z);
        anchor.xo = anchor.xOld = p.x;
        anchor.yo = anchor.yOld = p.y;
        anchor.zo = anchor.zOld = p.z;
    }

    private static float zoomScale(Minecraft mc) {
        if (zoomStage == 0) return 1f;
        double base = mc.options.fov().get();
        return (float) Mth.clamp(ClientData.uavZoomFov(zoomStage - 1) / base, 0.05, 1.0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ per frame
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRenderTick(TickEvent.RenderTickEvent e) {
        if (!viewing) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null || anchor == null) { exitSilently(); return; }

        if (e.phase == TickEvent.Phase.START) {
            if (!UavClientState.active) { exitSilently(); return; }
            placeAnchor(UavClientState.position(mc.level.getGameTime() + e.renderTickTime));
            if (mc.getCameraEntity() != anchor) mc.setCameraEntity(anchor);
        } else {
            // mouse look already turned the body this frame: convert to tilt and put the body back
            LocalPlayer pl = mc.player;
            float dYaw = Mth.wrapDegrees(pl.getYRot() - frozenYaw);
            float dPitch = pl.getXRot();
            float k = zoomScale(mc);
            viewYaw = Mth.wrapDegrees(viewYaw + dYaw * k);
            float maxTilt = ClientData.uavMaxTilt();
            viewPitch = Mth.clamp(viewPitch + dPitch * k, 90f - maxTilt, 90f); // 90 = straight down
            pl.setYRot(frozenYaw);
            pl.yRotO = frozenYaw;
            pl.setXRot(0f);
            pl.xRotO = 0f;
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void onCameraAngles(ViewportEvent.ComputeCameraAngles e) {
        if (!viewing) return;
        e.setYaw(viewYaw);
        e.setPitch(viewPitch);
        e.setRoll(0f);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void onFov(ViewportEvent.ComputeFov e) {
        if (viewing && zoomStage > 0) e.setFOV(ClientData.uavZoomFov(zoomStage - 1));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ input
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientTick(TickEvent.ClientTickEvent e) {
        if (!viewing || e.phase != TickEvent.Phase.START) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) { exitSilently(); return; }
        if (UavClientState.isDowned(mc)) { exit(UavExitReason.DOWNED); return; }
        drainBlockedKeys(mc);
        debugLog(mc);
    }

    private static void drainBlockedKeys(Minecraft mc) {
        KeyMapping[] list = {mc.options.keyDrop, mc.options.keyInventory, mc.options.keySwapOffhand,
                mc.options.keyAttack, mc.options.keyUse, mc.options.keyPickItem};
        for (KeyMapping k : list) while (k.consumeClick()) { }
        for (KeyMapping k : mc.options.keyHotbarSlots) while (k.consumeClick()) { }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onKey(InputEvent.Key e) {
        if (!viewing) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        drainBlockedKeys(mc); // the event fires right after KeyMapping.click(): eat Q/E/slots before handleKeybinds
        if (mc.screen != null || e.getAction() != GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) return;
        if (e.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_Q) {
            zoomStage = (zoomStage + 1) % 4; // 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> off
        } else if (e.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_E) {
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketUavView(false));
            exit(UavExitReason.USER);
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onMouseButton(InputEvent.MouseButton.Pre e) {
        // the ping button must still reach ClientEvents: markers can be thrown from the UAV camera
        if (viewing && Minecraft.getInstance().screen == null
                && !com.example.aas.client.ModKeyBindings.PLACE_PING_KEY.matchesMouse(e.getButton())) e.setCanceled(true);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onScroll(InputEvent.MouseScrollingEvent e) {
        // minimap open: the wheel zooms it (ClientEvents.onMouseScroll); otherwise it must not switch hotbar slots
        if (viewing && Minecraft.getInstance().screen == null && !ClientData.isMapOpen) e.setCanceled(true);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onInteraction(InputEvent.InteractionKeyMappingTriggered e) {
        if (viewing) { e.setCanceled(true); e.setSwingHand(false); }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onMovement(MovementInputUpdateEvent e) {
        if (!viewing) return;
        net.minecraft.client.player.Input in = e.getInput();
        in.up = in.down = in.left = in.right = false;
        in.forwardImpulse = 0f;
        in.leftImpulse = 0f;
        in.jumping = false;
        in.shiftKeyDown = false;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onScreenOpening(ScreenEvent.Opening e) {
        // the big map (SquadSelectionScreen) and the marker wheel (WorldMarkerRadialScreen) are allowed while viewing
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ HUD hiding
    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onOverlayPre(RenderGuiOverlayEvent.Pre e) {
        if (!viewing) return;
        Object o = e.getOverlay();
        if (o == VanillaGuiOverlay.HOTBAR.type() || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.CROSSHAIR.type()
                || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.PLAYER_HEALTH.type() || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.ARMOR_LEVEL.type()
                || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.FOOD_LEVEL.type() || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.AIR_LEVEL.type()
                || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.MOUNT_HEALTH.type() || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.JUMP_BAR.type()
                || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.EXPERIENCE_BAR.type() || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.ITEM_NAME.type()
                || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.POTION_ICONS.type() || o == VanillaGuiOverlay.SCOREBOARD.type()) {
            e.setCanceled(true);
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onHand(RenderHandEvent e) {
        if (viewing) e.setCanceled(true);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ lifecycle
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLoggingOut(net.minecraftforge.client.event.ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.LoggingOut e) {
        viewing = false;
        zoomStage = 0;
        anchor = null;
        frozenPos = null;
        holdTicks = 0;
        UavClientState.clear();
    }

    /** New LocalPlayer after respawn/dimension change: vanilla already re-pointed the camera, just reset our state. */
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onPlayerClone(net.minecraftforge.client.event.ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.Clone e) {
        viewing = false;
        zoomStage = 0;
        anchor = null;
        frozenPos = null;
        holdTicks = 0;
    }
    private static int dbgTick = 0;

    private static void debugLog(Minecraft mc) {
        if (++dbgTick % 100 != 0 || anchor == null || mc.level == null) return;
        int cx = Mth.floor(anchor.getX()) >> 4, cz = Mth.floor(anchor.getZ()) >> 4;
        int loaded = 0, total = 0;
        for (int dx = -8; dx <= 8; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -8; dz <= 8; dz++) {
                total++;
                if (mc.level.getChunk(cx + dx, cz + dz, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkStatus.FULL, false) != null) loaded++;
            }
        }
        com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger().info(
                "[AAS-client] cam=({},{},{}) camChunk=({},{}) loaded8={}/{} renderDist={} stats={}",
                (int) anchor.getX(), (int) anchor.getY(), (int) anchor.getZ(), cx, cz, loaded, total,
                mc.options.getEffectiveRenderDistance(), mc.levelRenderer.getChunkStatistics());
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.uav;

import com.example.aas.client.ClientData;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.MapGrid;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.math.Axis;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderGuiEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

import java.util.Random;

/** Camera-feed look (procedural, no shaders), crosshair and the hint plates while looking through the UAV. */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public class UavViewOverlay {
    private static final Random RND = new Random();
    private static long glitchUntil = 0, nextGlitch = 0;

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRender(RenderGuiEvent.Post e) {
        if (!UavViewClient.isViewing()) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        GuiGraphics g = e.getGuiGraphics();
        int w = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
        int h = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledHeight();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();

        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();

        // light flicker
        float flick = 0.035f + 0.03f * (float) Math.sin(now * 0.021) + RND.nextFloat() * 0.02f;
        g.fill(0, 0, w, h, ((int) (Math.max(0f, flick) * 255) << 24));

        // scanlines
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y += 3) g.fill(0, y, w, y + 1, 0x16000000);

        // slow horizontal band
        int band = (int) ((now / 14) % (h + 90)) - 90;
        g.fillGradient(0, band, w, band + 45, 0x00FFFFFF, 0x14FFFFFF);
        g.fillGradient(0, band + 45, w, band + 90, 0x14FFFFFF, 0x00FFFFFF);

        // weak noise
        for (int i = 0; i < 140; i++) {
            int x = RND.nextInt(w), y = RND.nextInt(h);
            g.fill(x, y, x + 1 + RND.nextInt(2), y + 1, RND.nextBoolean() ? 0x30FFFFFF : 0x30000000);
        }

        // rare short glitch
        if (now > nextGlitch) {
            glitchUntil = now + 90 + RND.nextInt(110);
            nextGlitch = now + 3500 + RND.nextInt(5000);
        }
        if (now < glitchUntil) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int y = RND.nextInt(h - 12), hh = 3 + RND.nextInt(9);
                g.fill(0, y, w, y + hh, 0x33FFFFFF);
                g.fill(RND.nextInt(w / 2), y, w, y + 1, 0x55FF2020);
                g.fill(0, y + hh - 1, RND.nextInt(w / 2), y + hh, 0x5520FFFF);
            }
        }

        // vignette (same look as before; top/bottom rings no longer lose their alpha at the very edge)
        int steps = 36;
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            int a = (int) (((steps - i) / (float) steps) * ((steps - i) / (float) steps) * 150);
            int c = a << 24;
            int sx = i * (w / 2 / steps + 1), sy = i * (h / 2 / steps + 1);
            g.fill(sx, 0, sx + (w / 2 / steps + 1), h, c);
            g.fill(w - sx - (w / 2 / steps + 1), 0, w - sx, h, c);
            g.fill(0, sy, w, sy + (h / 2 / steps + 1), c);
            g.fill(0, h - sy - (h / 2 / steps + 1), w, h - sy, c);
        }

        drawHud(g, mc, w, h, e.getPartialTick());
        // СЃРїРёСЃРєРё РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЏС‰РёС… (CMD / РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ / Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ / СЂР°С†РёСЏ) Рё РїР»Р°С€РєР° В«СЏ РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЋВ» вЂ” РїРѕРІРµСЂС… РїРѕРјРµС…
        if (!(mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.SquadSelectionScreen
                || mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.AASChatScreen
                || mc.screen instanceof net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.DeathScreen)) {
            com.example.aas.client.AASOverlay.renderUavVoiceHud(g, mc, w, h);
        }
        // key hints, top-right (same plates as before, mirrored to the right side)
        String[] keys = {"aas.uav.hint.zoom", "aas.uav.hint.exit", "aas.uav.hint.tilt"};
        int y = 12;
        for (String k : keys) {
            Component t = Component.translatable(k);
            int tw = mc.font.width(t);
            g.fill(w - tw - 20, y, w, y + 18, 0xAA000000);
            g.fill(w - 3, y, w, y + 18, 0xFFB8860B);
            g.drawString(mc.font, t, w - tw - 13, y + 5, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
            y += 22;
        }
        RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
        RenderSystem.disableBlend();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ HUD (reference: gunship / UAV feed)
    private static final int INK = 0xFFFFFFFF, INK_DIM = 0xB0FFFFFF;
    private static final String[] CARDINAL = {"N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"};

    private static void drawHud(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, int w, int h, float partial) {
        if (mc.level == null) return;
        float yaw = UavViewClient.viewYaw(), pitch = UavViewClient.viewPitch();
        double heading = Mth.wrapDegrees(yaw + 180f);             // compass: 0 = north, 90 = east
        if (heading < 0) heading += 360.0;
        double now = mc.level.getGameTime() + partial;
        Vec3 cam = UavClientState.active ? UavClientState.position(now) : mc.gameRenderer.getMainCamera().getPosition();

        drawCompass(g, mc, w, heading);
        drawPitchScale(g, mc, h, -pitch);                          // 90 deg straight down shows as -90
        drawTopLeft(g, mc, now);
        drawReticle(g, w, h, heading);
        drawTarget(g, mc, w, h, cam, yaw, pitch);
        drawAircraft(g, mc, w, h, cam);
    }

    private static void text(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, String t, int x, int y) {
        g.drawString(mc.font, t, x, y, INK, true);
    }

    private static void textRight(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, String t, int xRight, int y) {
        g.drawString(mc.font, t, xRight - mc.font.width(t), y, INK, true);
    }

    /** Compass tape at the top: shows where the camera looks (heading), +-60 degrees around it. */
    private static void drawCompass(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, int w, double heading) {
        int tapeW = (int) Mth.clamp(w * 0.45, 240, 560);
        double ppd = tapeW / 120.0;
        int cx = w / 2, base = 50;
        g.fill(cx - tapeW / 2, base, cx + tapeW / 2, base + 1, INK_DIM);
        int a0 = (int) Math.floor((heading - 60) / 5.0) * 5, a1 = (int) Math.ceil((heading + 60) / 5.0) * 5;
        for (int a = a0; a <= a1; a += 5) {
            int x = cx + (int) Math.round((a - heading) * ppd);
            if (x < cx - tapeW / 2 || x > cx + tapeW / 2) continue;
            int norm = ((a % 360) + 360) % 360;
            boolean major = norm % 15 == 0;
            g.fill(x, base + 1, x + 1, base + (major ? 8 : 4), INK_DIM);
            if (major && Math.abs(x - cx) > 18) {
                String label = norm % 45 == 0 ? CARDINAL[norm / 45] : String.format("%03d", norm);
                g.drawString(mc.font, label, x - mc.font.width(label) / 2, base - 11, INK_DIM, true);
            }
        }
        // current heading box
        String hs = String.format("%03d", Math.floorMod((int) Math.round(heading), 360));
        int bw = mc.font.width(hs) + 10;
        g.fill(cx - bw / 2, base - 36, cx + bw / 2, base - 20, 0xCC000000);
        g.renderOutline(cx - bw / 2, base - 36, bw, 16, INK);
        g.drawString(mc.font, hs, cx - mc.font.width(hs) / 2, base - 32, INK, true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) g.fill(cx - 3 + i, base - 20 + i, cx + 4 - i, base - 19 + i, INK);   // little pointer
    }

    /** Vertical camera tilt scale on the left: 0 (horizon) at the top .. -90 (straight down) at the bottom. */
    private static void drawPitchScale(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, int h, float angle) {
        int x = 74, top = (int) (h * 0.26), len = (int) (h * 0.48);
        g.fill(x, top, x + 1, top + len, INK_DIM);
        for (int a = 0; a <= 90; a += 5) {
            int y = top + (int) Math.round(a / 90.0 * len);
            boolean major = a % 15 == 0;
            g.fill(x - (major ? 9 : 4), y, x, y + 1, INK_DIM);
            if (major) {
                String l = a == 0 ? "0" : "-" + a;
                g.drawString(mc.font, l, x - 13 - mc.font.width(l), y - 4, INK_DIM, true);
            }
        }
        float a = Mth.clamp(angle, -90f, 0f);
        int y = top + (int) Math.round(-a / 90.0 * len);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) g.fill(x + 3 + i, y - 4 + i, x + 4 + i, y + 5 - i, INK);   // pointer, tip towards the scale
        g.drawString(mc.font, String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", a), x + 14, y - 4, INK, true);
    }

    /** Top-left: remaining UAV charge (flight time), then the zoom of the camera. */
    private static void drawTopLeft(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, double now) {
        int x = 20, y = 14;
        double total = Math.max(1, UavClientState.endTick - UavClientState.startTick);
        double left = Mth.clamp(UavClientState.endTick - now, 0, total);
        double frac = left / total;
        text(g, mc, "CHARGE", x, y);
        int bx = x + mc.font.width("CHARGE") + 8, bw = 90;
        g.fill(bx, y, bx + bw, y + 9, 0x66000000);
        g.renderOutline(bx - 1, y - 1, bw + 2, 11, INK_DIM);
        int color = frac > 0.5 ? 0xFFE8E8E8 : (frac > 0.2 ? 0xFFFFC840 : 0xFFFF4040);
        g.fill(bx, y, bx + (int) Math.round(bw * frac), y + 9, color);
        int secs = (int) Math.ceil(left / 20.0);
        text(g, mc, String.format("%02d:%02d", secs / 60, secs % 60), x, y + 16);

        // zoom: real magnification versus the normal field of view
        int stage = UavViewClient.zoomStage();
        double base = mc.options.fov().get();
        double mag = stage == 0 ? 1.0 : base / Math.max(1.0, ClientData.uavZoomFov(stage - 1));
        text(g, mc, String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.1fX", mag), x, y + 40);
        g.drawString(mc.font, "DAY TV", x, y + 52, INK_DIM, true);
    }

    /** Crosshair with corner brackets; the north arrow orbits around it. */
    private static void drawReticle(GuiGraphics g, int w, int h, double heading) {
        int cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2, s = 24, t = 7;
        // centre cross with a gap
        g.fill(cx - 8, cy, cx - 2, cy + 1, INK); g.fill(cx + 3, cy, cx + 9, cy + 1, INK);
        g.fill(cx, cy - 8, cx + 1, cy - 2, INK); g.fill(cx, cy + 3, cx + 1, cy + 9, INK);
        // corner brackets
        g.fill(cx - s, cy - s, cx - s + t, cy - s + 1, INK_DIM); g.fill(cx - s, cy - s, cx - s + 1, cy - s + t, INK_DIM);
        g.fill(cx + s - t, cy - s, cx + s, cy - s + 1, INK_DIM); g.fill(cx + s - 1, cy - s, cx + s, cy - s + t, INK_DIM);
        g.fill(cx - s, cy + s - 1, cx - s + t, cy + s, INK_DIM); g.fill(cx - s, cy + s - t, cx - s + 1, cy + s, INK_DIM);
        g.fill(cx + s - t, cy + s - 1, cx + s, cy + s, INK_DIM); g.fill(cx + s - 1, cy + s - t, cx + s, cy + s, INK_DIM);

        // north arrow: if the camera looks east (90), north is on the left of the screen
        double a = Math.toRadians(-heading);
        int r = 38;
        float ax = (float) (cx + Math.sin(a) * r), ay = (float) (cy - Math.cos(a) * r);
        g.pose().pushPose();
        g.pose().translate(ax, ay, 0);
        g.pose().mulPose(Axis.ZP.rotationDegrees((float) -heading));
        g.pose().scale(1.5f, 1.5f, 1f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) g.fill(-i / 2 - (i == 0 ? 0 : 0), -3 + i, i / 2 + 1, -2 + i, INK);   // triangle pointing "up" = north
        g.pose().popPose();
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        float lx = (float) (cx + Math.sin(a) * (r + 13)), ly = (float) (cy - Math.cos(a) * (r + 13));
        g.drawString(mc.font, "N", Math.round(lx) - mc.font.width("N") / 2, Math.round(ly) - 4, INK, true);
    }

    private static String grid(double x, double z) {
        int size = ClientData.mapSizeBlocks;
        if (size <= 0) return "--";
        String c = MapGrid.cellName(x - (ClientData.mapCenterX - size / 2.0), z - (ClientData.mapCenterZ - size / 2.0), size);
        return c == null ? "--" : c.replace(" ", " - ");
    }

    /** Right-middle: what the crosshair points at (grid reference + distance from the UAV). */
    private static void drawTarget(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, int w, int h, Vec3 cam, float yaw, float pitch) {
        int xr = w - 20, y = (int) (h * 0.42);
        String gridText = "--", range = "---";
        Vec3 dir = Vec3.directionFromRotation(pitch, yaw);
        BlockHitResult hit = mc.level.clip(new ClipContext(cam, cam.add(dir.scale(900.0)),
                ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER, ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, mc.player));
        if (hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            Vec3 p = hit.getLocation();
            gridText = grid(p.x, p.z);
            range = (int) Math.round(cam.distanceTo(p)) + "m";
        }
        textRight(g, mc, "TARGET", xr, y);
        textRight(g, mc, "GRID REF " + gridText, xr, y + 18);
        textRight(g, mc, "RANGE " + range, xr, y + 30);
    }

    /** Bottom-right: where the UAV itself is. */
    private static void drawAircraft(GuiGraphics g, Minecraft mc, int w, int h, Vec3 cam) {
        int xr = w - 20, y = (int) (h * 0.74);
        textRight(g, mc, "AIRCRAFT", xr, y);
        textRight(g, mc, "LOCATION " + grid(cam.x, cam.z), xr, y + 18);
        textRight(g, mc, "ELEVATION " + (int) Math.round(cam.y) + "m", xr, y + 30);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client.uav;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.BufferBuilder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.Tesselator;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;

/** Draws the UAV zone circle (light yellow fill, dark yellow outline) and the UAV icon on the map. */
public final class UavZoneRenderer {
    private UavZoneRenderer() {}

    public static final ResourceLocation UAV_ICON = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/uav_icon.png");
    private static final int FILL = 0x40FFF3A6;     // translucent light yellow
    private static final int OUTLINE = 0xFFB8860B;  // dark yellow

    /** Called from AASMapRenderer.render (inside the map scissor) for the own team's active zone. */
    public static void renderZone(GuiGraphics gui, int mapX, int mapY, int mapSize, double centerX, double centerZ, double bpp) {
        if (!UavClientState.active) return;
        float sx = (float) (mapX + mapSize / 2.0 + (UavClientState.cx - centerX) / bpp);
        float sy = (float) (mapY + mapSize / 2.0 + (UavClientState.cz - centerZ) / bpp);
        drawZone(gui, sx, sy, (float) (UavClientState.radius / bpp));
        // the icon sits on the flying UAV itself (it orbits with it), not in the zone centre
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.level != null) {
            Vec3 p = UavClientState.position(mc.level.getGameTime() + mc.getPartialTick());
            float ux = (float) (mapX + mapSize / 2.0 + (p.x - centerX) / bpp);
            float uy = (float) (mapY + mapSize / 2.0 + (p.z - centerZ) / bpp);
            drawIcon(gui, ux, uy, 16);
        }
    }

    public static void drawIcon(GuiGraphics gui, float sx, float sy, int size) {
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
        gui.blit(UAV_ICON, Math.round(sx) - size / 2, Math.round(sy) - size / 2, size, size, 0, 0, 32, 32, 32, 32);
    }

    public static void drawZone(GuiGraphics gui, float cx, float cy, float radiusPx) {
        drawZone(gui, cx, cy, radiusPx, FILL, OUTLINE);
    }

    /** Same zone style with custom colours (the artillery uses blue for requests and red for strikes). */
    public static void drawZone(GuiGraphics gui, float cx, float cy, float radiusPx, int fillArgb, int outlineArgb) {
        if (radiusPx < 1f) return;
        int segments = Mth.clamp((int) (radiusPx / 2f), 48, 256);
        Matrix4f m = gui.pose().last().pose();

        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableCull();
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
        Tesselator tess = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder bb = tess.getBuilder();

        // fill: triangle fan
        float fa = (fillArgb >>> 24 & 255) / 255f, fr = (fillArgb >> 16 & 255) / 255f, fg = (fillArgb >> 8 & 255) / 255f, fb = (fillArgb & 255) / 255f;
        bb.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_FAN, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        bb.vertex(m, cx, cy, 0f).color(fr, fg, fb, fa).endVertex();
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            float a = i * Mth.TWO_PI / segments;
            bb.vertex(m, cx + Mth.cos(a) * radiusPx, cy + Mth.sin(a) * radiusPx, 0f).color(fr, fg, fb, fa).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();

        // outline: triangle strip ring, 2 px
        float oa = (outlineArgb >>> 24 & 255) / 255f, or = (outlineArgb >> 16 & 255) / 255f, og = (outlineArgb >> 8 & 255) / 255f, ob = (outlineArgb & 255) / 255f;
        float inner = radiusPx - 1f, outer = radiusPx + 1f;
        bb.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLE_STRIP, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            float a = i * Mth.TWO_PI / segments;
            float c = Mth.cos(a), s = Mth.sin(a);
            bb.vertex(m, cx + c * outer, cy + s * outer, 0f).color(or, og, ob, oa).endVertex();
            bb.vertex(m, cx + c * inner, cy + s * inner, 0f).color(or, og, ob, oa).endVertex();
        }
        tess.end();

        RenderSystem.enableCull();
        RenderSystem.disableBlend();
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import com.example.aas.client.gui.AASChatScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.ChatScreen;
import net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.minecraftforge.client.event.InputEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.client.event.ScreenEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;

/**
 * РџРѕРґРјРµРЅСЏРµС‚ РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ ChatScreen РЅР° AASChatScreen, РєРѕРіРґР° РёРіСЂРѕРє РѕС‚РєСЂС‹Р» С‡Р°С‚ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕР№ С‡Р°С‚Р° (T).
 * РћС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РёРµ С‡Р°С‚Р° РєР»Р°РІРёС€РµР№ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґ ("/") РѕСЃС‚Р°С‘С‚СЃСЏ РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Рј - С‚Р°Рј РЅСѓР¶РµРЅ РїСЂРµРґР·Р°РїРѕР»РЅРµРЅРЅС‹Р№ "/".
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public class AASChatEvents {

    private static long chatKeyPressedAt = -1;

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onKey(InputEvent.Key event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.screen != null) return;
        if (event.getAction() != GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) return;

        // Р’Р°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚ РѕС‚РєСЂРѕРµС‚СЃСЏ РЅР° Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РµРј С‚РёРєРµ - Р·Р°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РµРј, С‡С‚Рѕ РїСЂРёС‡РёРЅР° РёРјРµРЅРЅРѕ РєРЅРѕРїРєР° С‡Р°С‚Р°
        if (mc.options.keyChat.getKey().getValue() == event.getKey()) {
            chatKeyPressedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onScreenOpening(ScreenEvent.Opening event) {
        if (chatKeyPressedAt < 0) return;
        long age = System.currentTimeMillis() - chatKeyPressedAt;

        // Р РѕРІРЅРѕ РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ ChatScreen (РЅРµ РїРѕРґРєР»Р°СЃСЃС‹ РґСЂСѓРіРёС… РјРѕРґРѕРІ) Рё СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РЅР°Р¶Р°С‚РёСЏ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё С‡Р°С‚Р°
        if (age < 250 && event.getNewScreen() != null && event.getNewScreen().getClass() == ChatScreen.class) {
            event.setNewScreen(new AASChatScreen());
            chatKeyPressedAt = -1;
        } else if (age >= 250) {
            chatKeyPressedAt = -1;
        }
    }
}
