@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class ClientPlacementHandler {

    private static boolean isPlacing = false;
    private static int structureId = -1;
    private static float rotationY = 0;

    public static boolean isPlacing() {
        return isPlacing;
    }

    public static void startPlacing(int id) {
        isPlacing = true;
        structureId = id;

        if (structureId >= 20 && structureId <= 23) {
            rotationY = 90;
        } else {
            rotationY = 0;
        }
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(null);
    }

    public static void stopPlacing() {
        isPlacing = false;
        structureId = -1;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onScreenOpen(ScreenEvent.Opening event) {
        if (isPlacing && event.getScreen() instanceof PauseScreen) {
            event.setCanceled(true);
            stopPlacing();
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRenderLevel(RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
        if (!isPlacing || event.getStage() != RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_TRANSLUCENT_BLOCKS) return;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return;

        boolean holdingRadio = mc.player.getMainHandItem().getItem() instanceof com.example.aas.item.RallyItem
                || mc.player.getOffhandItem().getItem() instanceof com.example.aas.item.RallyItem;

        if (!holdingRadio) {
            stopPlacing();
            return;
        }

        HitResult hit = mc.hitResult;
        if (hit == null || hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) return;

        BlockHitResult blockHit = (BlockHitResult) hit;
        BlockPos placePos = blockHit.getBlockPos().relative(blockHit.getDirection());

        boolean isValid = validatePlacement(mc, placePos);

        PoseStack pose = event.getPoseStack();
        pose.pushPose();

        Vec3 camPos = event.getCamera().getPosition();
        pose.translate(placePos.getX() - camPos.x, placePos.getY() - camPos.y, placePos.getZ() - camPos.z);

        pose.translate(0.5, 0, 0.5);
        pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(rotationY));
        pose.translate(-0.5, 0, -0.5);

        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        if (isValid) {
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.6f);
        } else {
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.6f);
        }

        try {
            if (structureId == 20) {
                BlockState m2State = ModBlocks.M2_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(M2ConstructionBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(M2ConstructionBlock.VALID, isValid);
                renderGhostBlock(mc, m2State, pose, 0, 0, 0);
            }
            else if (structureId == 21) {
                BlockState agsState = ModBlocks.AGS_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(AGSConstructionBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(AGSConstructionBlock.VALID, isValid);
                renderGhostBlock(mc, agsState, pose, 0, 0, 0);
            }
            else if (structureId == 22) {
                BlockState mortarState = ModBlocks.MORTAR_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(MortarConstructionBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(MortarConstructionBlock.VALID, isValid);
                renderGhostBlock(mc, mortarState, pose, 0, 0, 0);
            }
            else if (structureId == 23) {
                BlockState towState = ModBlocks.TOW_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(TOWConstructionBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(TOWConstructionBlock.VALID, isValid);
                renderGhostBlock(mc, towState, pose, 0, 0, 0);
            }
            else if (structureId == 13) {
                BlockState wireState = ModBlocks.BARBED_WIRE_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(BarbedWireBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(BarbedWireBlock.CONSTRUCTED, false)
                        .setValue(BarbedWireBlock.VALID, isValid);
                for (int x = 0; x < 3; x++) renderGhostBlock(mc, wireState, pose, x - 1, 0, 0);
            }
            else {
                BlockState wallState = ModBlocks.WALL_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(WallBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED, false)
                        .setValue(WallBlock.VALID, isValid);

                BlockState slabState = ModBlocks.WALL_SLAB_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(WallBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED, false)
                        .setValue(WallBlock.VALID, isValid);

                BlockState wireState = ModBlocks.BARBED_WIRE_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(BarbedWireBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                        .setValue(BarbedWireBlock.CONSTRUCTED, false)
                        .setValue(BarbedWireBlock.VALID, isValid);

                if (structureId == 11) { // 2x2
                    renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, 0, 0, 0);
                    renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, 1, 0, 0);
                    renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, 0, 1, 0);
                    renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, 1, 1, 0);
                } else if (structureId == 12) { // 3x3
                    for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < 3; y++) {
                            renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, x, y, 0);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (structureId == 15) { // Wire Wall (Р В Р Р‹Р РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋРЎвЂњР В РЎвЂ”Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋР Р‰Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В° Р РЋР С“ Р В РЎвЂќР В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р РЋР вЂ№Р РЋРІР‚РЋР В РЎвЂќР В РЎвЂўР В РІвЂћвЂ“) 3x2x3
                    for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                        // Р В РІР‚вЂќР В Р’В°Р В РўвЂР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂР В РІвЂћвЂ“ Р РЋР вЂљР РЋР РЏР В РўвЂ (Р РЋР С“Р РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋРЎвЂњР В РЎвЂ”Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋР Р‰Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В°, Р В РЎвЂ“Р В РўвЂР В Р’Вµ Р РЋР С“Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂР РЋРІР‚С™ Р В РЎвЂР В РЎвЂ“Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂќ)
                        renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, x, 0, 0);
                        // Р В РЎСџР В Р’ВµР РЋР вЂљР В Р’ВµР В РўвЂР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂР В РІвЂћвЂ“ Р РЋР вЂљР РЋР РЏР В РўвЂ (Р РЋР С“Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В° 2 Р В Р’В±Р В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂќР В Р’В° Р В Р вЂ  Р В Р вЂ Р РЋРІР‚в„–Р РЋР С“Р В РЎвЂўР РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋРЎвЂњ, Р В Р вЂ Р В РЎВР В Р’ВµР РЋР С“Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂў Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂќР В РЎвЂ)
                        renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, x, 0, -1);
                        renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, x, 1, -1);
                        // Р В Р Р‹Р В РЎВР В Р’ВµР РЋРІР‚В°Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В°Р РЋР РЏ Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂќР В Р’В° (Р В Р вЂ Р В РЎвЂ”Р В Р’ВµР РЋР вЂљР В Р’ВµР В РўвЂ Р В РЎвЂќ Р В Р вЂ Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р В РЎвЂ“Р РЋРЎвЂњ Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В° Р РЋРЎвЂњР РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋР Р‰ Р В Р’В·Р В Р’ВµР В РЎВР В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂ)
                        renderGhostBlock(mc, wireState, pose, x, 0, -2);
                    }
                } else if (structureId == 16) { // Loophole (Р В РЎвЂ™Р В РЎВР В Р’В±Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р В Р’В·Р РЋРЎвЂњР РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°) 3x3
                    for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < 3; y++) {
                            if (x == 0 && y == 1) {
                                renderGhostBlock(mc, slabState, pose, x, y, 0); // Р В РЎСџР В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р РЋРЎвЂњ-Р В Р’В±Р В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂќ Р В Р вЂ  Р РЋРІР‚В Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’Вµ
                            } else {
                                renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, x, y, 0);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // Р В РІР‚в„ў Р В РЎВР В Р’ВµР РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂўР В РўвЂР В Р’Вµ onRenderLevel Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В»Р В Р’В°Р РЋР С“Р РЋР С“Р В Р’В° ClientPlacementHandler
                } else if (structureId == 17) { // Bunker Ghost
                    BlockState wall = ModBlocks.WALL_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState().setValue(WallBlock.VALID, isValid);
                    BlockState slab = ModBlocks.WALL_SLAB_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState().setValue(WallBlock.VALID, isValid);
                    BlockState net = ModBlocks.CAMO_NET_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState();

                    // Р В РІР‚в„ўР РЋРІР‚в„–Р РЋРІР‚РЋР В РЎвЂР РЋР С“Р В Р’В»Р РЋР РЏР В Р’ВµР В РЎВ Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В°Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р В Р вЂ Р В Р’В»Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂР В Р’Вµ Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В° Р В РЎвЂўР РЋР С“Р В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В Р’Вµ Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’ВµР В РЎвЂќР РЋРЎвЂњР РЋРІР‚В°Р В Р’ВµР В РЎвЂ“Р В РЎвЂў Р В РЎвЂ”Р В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В РЎвЂўР РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’В° Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ Р РЋР Р‰Р РЋР вЂ№
                    // rotationY Р В РЎВР В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋР РЏР В Р’ВµР РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋР С“Р РЋР РЏ Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В° 90 Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂ Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂР В РЎвЂќР В Р’Вµ. 0 = North, -90 = East, -180 = South, -270 = West
                    int angle = (int) rotationY % 360;
                    if (angle < 0) angle += 360;

                    Direction currentFacing = Direction.NORTH;
                    if (angle == 90 || angle == 270) currentFacing = Direction.EAST; // Р В Р в‚¬Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂўР РЋРІР‚В°Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂў Р В РўвЂР В Р’В»Р РЋР РЏ Р В РЎвЂ”Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂР В Р’В·Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В°
                    if (angle == 180) currentFacing = Direction.SOUTH;

                    for (int y = 0; y <= 2; y++) {
                        for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                            for (int z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                                BlockPos ghostTarget = new BlockPos(x, y, z);

                                // Р В РЎв„ўР РЋР вЂљР РЋРІР‚в„–Р РЋРІвЂљВ¬Р В Р’В° - Р В Р вЂ Р РЋР С“Р В Р’ВµР В РЎвЂ“Р В РўвЂР В Р’В° Р В РЎвЂ”Р В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р РЋРЎвЂњР В Р’В±Р В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂўР В РЎвЂќ
                                if (y == 2) {
                                    renderGhostBlock(mc, slab, pose, x, y, z);
                                } else {
                                    if (x == 0 && z == 0) continue;

                                    // Р В РІР‚в„ўР РЋРІР‚В¦Р В РЎвЂўР В РўвЂ Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р РЋР Р‰Р В РЎвЂќР В РЎвЂў Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В° x=0, z=-1 (Р В РЎвЂўР РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂўР РЋР С“Р В РЎвЂР РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’ВµР В Р’В»Р РЋР Р‰Р В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂў Р В Р вЂ Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р РЋРІР‚В°Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂР РЋР РЏ pose)
                                    // Р В РЎС›Р В Р’В°Р В РЎвЂќ Р В РЎвЂќР В Р’В°Р В РЎвЂќ pose Р РЋРЎвЂњР В Р’В¶Р В Р’Вµ Р В Р вЂ Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р РЋРІР‚В°Р В Р’В°Р В Р’ВµР РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋР С“Р РЋР РЏ Р РЋРІР‚РЋР В Р’ВµР РЋР вЂљР В Р’ВµР В Р’В· pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(rotationY)),
                                    // Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В°Р В РЎВ Р В РўвЂР В РЎвЂўР РЋР С“Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’В°Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂўР РЋРІР‚РЋР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂў Р РЋР вЂљР В РЎвЂР РЋР С“Р В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В Р’В°Р РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋР Р‰ Р В Р вЂ Р РЋРІР‚В¦Р В РЎвЂўР В РўвЂ Р В Р вЂ Р РЋР С“Р В Р’ВµР В РЎвЂ“Р В РўвЂР В Р’В° Р В Р вЂ  Р В РЎвЂўР В РўвЂР В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂўР В РІвЂћвЂ“ Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂўР РЋРІР‚РЋР В РЎвЂќР В Р’Вµ, Р В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ¦ Р В РЎвЂ”Р В РЎвЂўР В Р вЂ Р В Р’ВµР РЋР вЂљР В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’ВµР РЋРІР‚С™Р РЋР С“Р РЋР РЏ Р РЋР С“Р В Р’В°Р В РЎВ!
                                    if (x == 0 && z == -1 && y < 2) {
                                        renderGhostBlock(mc, net, pose, x, y, z);
                                    } else {
                                        renderGhostBlock(mc, wall, pose, x, y, z);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (structureId == 18) { // Vehicle Station
                    BlockState vsState = ModBlocks.VEHICLE_STATION_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                            .setValue(VehicleStationBlock.VALID, isValid);
                    // FACING Р В РЎСљР В РІР‚Сћ Р В Р Р‹Р В РЎС›Р В РЎвЂ™Р В РІР‚в„ўР В Р’ВР В РЎС™, Р В Р’ВµР В РЎвЂ“Р В РЎвЂў Р В РЎвЂќР РЋР вЂљР РЋРЎвЂњР РЋРІР‚С™Р В РЎвЂР РЋРІР‚С™ pose.mulPose Р В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂР В Р’В¶Р В Р’Вµ
                    renderGhostBlock(mc, vsState, pose, 0, 0, 0);
                } else { // 1x1
                    renderGhostBlock(mc, wallState, pose, 0, 0, 0);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {}

        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
        pose.popPose();
    }

    private static void renderGhostBlock(Minecraft mc, BlockState state, PoseStack pose, int xOff, int yOff, int zOff) {
        pose.pushPose();
        pose.translate(xOff, yOff, zOff);
        mc.getBlockRenderer().renderSingleBlock(state, pose, mc.renderBuffers().bufferSource(),
                15728880, OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY);
        mc.renderBuffers().bufferSource().endBatch(ItemBlockRenderTypes.getChunkRenderType(state));
        pose.popPose();
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onMouseInput(InputEvent.MouseButton.Pre event) {
        if (!isPlacing) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.screen != null) return;

        if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            if (event.getButton() == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) {
                event.setCanceled(true);
                if (structureId >= 20 && structureId <= 23) {
                    return;
                }
                rotationY -= 90;
                if (rotationY <= -360) rotationY = 0;
            }
            else if (event.getButton() == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT) {
                HitResult hit = mc.hitResult;
                if (hit != null && hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
                    BlockHitResult blockHit = (BlockHitResult) hit;
                    BlockPos placePos = blockHit.getBlockPos().relative(blockHit.getDirection());

                    if (validatePlacement(mc, placePos)) {
                        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketBuildRequest(structureId, placePos, (int) rotationY));
                        stopPlacing();
                    } else {
                        mc.player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Not enough materials or out of range!").withStyle(net.minecraft.ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                    }
                }
                event.setCanceled(true);
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean validatePlacement(Minecraft mc, BlockPos pos) {
        if (mc.player == null) return false;
        String playerTeam = "NEUTRAL";
        if (mc.player.getTeam() != null) playerTeam = mc.player.getTeam().getName();

        if (structureId == 14 && AASConfig.HUB_PLACEMENT_REQUIRES_CRATE.get() && !mc.player.isCreative()) {
            double crateRad = 50.0;
            net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB area = new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(pos).inflate(crateRad);
            java.util.List<com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity> nearbyCrates = mc.level.getEntitiesOfClass(com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity.class, area);

            final String team = playerTeam;
            boolean hasValidCrate = nearbyCrates.stream().anyMatch(c ->
                    c.getTeamOwner().equals("NEUTRAL") || c.getTeamOwner().equalsIgnoreCase(team));

            if (!hasValidCrate) return false;
        }

        int cost = 5; // Р В РІР‚СњР В Р’ВµР РЋРІР‚С›Р В РЎвЂўР В Р’В»Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В°Р РЋР РЏ Р РЋРІР‚В Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’В° (Р В РўвЂР В Р’В»Р РЋР РЏ 1x1 Р РЋР С“Р РЋРІР‚С™Р В Р’ВµР В Р вЂ¦Р РЋРІР‚в„– Р В РЎвЂ Р В Р’ВµР РЋР С“Р В Р’В»Р В РЎвЂ ID Р В Р вЂ¦Р В Р’Вµ Р РЋРЎвЂњР В РЎвЂќР В Р’В°Р В Р’В·Р В Р’В°Р В Р вЂ¦ Р В Р вЂ¦Р В РЎвЂР В Р’В¶Р В Р’Вµ)
        if (structureId == 11) cost = 5; // 2x2 Wall
        if (structureId == 12) cost = 10; // 3x3 Wall
        if (structureId == 13) cost = 15; // Barbed Wire
        if (structureId == 15) cost = 25; // Wire Wall
        if (structureId == 16) cost = 20; // Loophole (Р В РЎвЂ™Р В РЎВР В Р’В±Р РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°Р В Р’В·Р РЋРЎвЂњР РЋР вЂљР В Р’В°)
        if (structureId == 17) cost = 50; // Bunker
        if (structureId == 18) cost = 100; // Vehicle Station
        if (structureId == 20) cost = 100; // M2
        if (structureId == 21) cost = 100; // AGS
        if (structureId == 22) cost = 300; // Mortar
        if (structureId == 23) cost = 200; // TOW

        if (playerTeam.equals("NEUTRAL") && !mc.player.isCreative()) return false;

        String currentDimension = mc.level.dimension().location().toString();

        int hubRadius = ClientData.hubBuildRadius();
        double maxDistSqHub = hubRadius * hubRadius;

        int crateRadius = AASConfig.CRATE_BUILD_RADIUS.get();
        double maxDistSqCrate = crateRadius * crateRadius;

        int totalMaterials = 0;
        boolean isInRange = false;

        if (ClientData.clientHubs != null) {
            for (com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.HubInfo hubInfo : ClientData.clientHubs) {
                if (hubInfo.dimension != null && !hubInfo.dimension.equals(currentDimension)) {
                    continue;
                }
                BlockPos hubPos = hubInfo.pos;
                if (hubPos.distSqr(pos) <= maxDistSqHub) {
                    if (mc.level.isLoaded(hubPos)) {
                        BlockEntity be = mc.level.getBlockEntity(hubPos);
                        BlockState hubState = mc.level.getBlockState(hubPos);
                        if (be instanceof HubBlockEntity hub) {
                            if (hub.getTeam().equalsIgnoreCase(playerTeam) || hub.getTeam().equals("NEUTRAL")) {
                                if (hubState.hasProperty(HubBlock.CONSTRUCTED) && !hubState.getValue(HubBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) continue;
                                isInRange = true;
                                totalMaterials += hub.getMaterials();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB searchArea = new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(pos).inflate(crateRadius);
        java.util.List<com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity> crates = mc.level.getEntitiesOfClass(com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity.class, searchArea);

        for (com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity crate : crates) {
            if (crate.getTeamOwner().equalsIgnoreCase(playerTeam) || crate.getTeamOwner().equals("NEUTRAL")) {
                if (crate.distanceToSqr(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5) <= maxDistSqCrate) {
                    isInRange = true;
                    totalMaterials += crate.getMaterials();
                }
            }
        }

        if (!isInRange) return false;
        if (mc.player.isCreative()) return true;

        return totalMaterials >= cost;
    }

    // ================= Р вЂќР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎС“Р С—Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹ (Р В±Р ВµР В· Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Р…Р В° Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”) =================

    /**
     * Р РЋРЎвЂљР С•Р С‘Р СР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘ Р С—Р С• structureId. Р СћР В° Р В¶Р Вµ РЎвЂљР В°Р В±Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂ Р В°, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С• Р С‘ Р Р† validatePlacement,
     * Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Р…Р ВµРЎРѓР ВµР Р…Р В° Р С•РЎвЂљР Т‘Р ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р ВµРЎвЂ Р СР С•Р В¶Р Р…Р С• Р В±РЎвЂ№Р В»Р С• Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР С‘РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·Р С•Р Р†Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С‘Р В· РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹.
     */
    public static int getCost(int structureId) {
        int cost = 5; // Р СџР С• РЎС“Р СР С•Р В»РЎвЂЎР В°Р Р…Р С‘РЎР‹ (1x1 РЎРѓРЎвЂљР ВµР Р…Р В°)
        if (structureId == 11) cost = 5;   // 2x2 Wall
        if (structureId == 12) cost = 10;  // 3x3 Wall
        if (structureId == 13) cost = 15;  // Barbed Wire
        if (structureId == 15) cost = 25;  // Wire Wall
        if (structureId == 16) cost = 20;  // Loophole
        if (structureId == 17) cost = 50;  // Bunker
        if (structureId == 18) cost = 100; // Vehicle Station
        if (structureId == 20) cost = 100; // M2
        if (structureId == 21) cost = 100; // AGS
        if (structureId == 22) cost = 300; // Mortar
        if (structureId == 23) cost = 200; // TOW
        return cost;
    }

    /**
     * Р РЋРЎС“Р СР СР В° Р СР В°РЎвЂљР ВµРЎР‚Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С•Р Р† Р С‘Р В· Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµРЎвЂ¦ HUB/РЎРЏРЎвЂ°Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р† РЎРѓР Р…Р В°Р В±Р В¶Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р ВµР в„– Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘РЎвЂ№, Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘РЎРЏРЎвЂ°Р С‘РЎвЂ¦РЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р† РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘РЎС“РЎРѓР Вµ
     * Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘ Р С›Р Сћ Р СћР вЂўР С™Р Р€Р В©Р вЂўР в„ў Р СџР С›Р вЂ”Р ВР В¦Р ВР В Р ВР вЂњР В Р С›Р С™Р С’ (Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р С•РЎвЂљ РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР С”Р С‘ Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р С”РЎС“РЎР‚РЎРѓР С•РЎР‚Р В°, Р С”Р В°Р С” Р Р† validatePlacement РІР‚вЂќ
     * РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂљ Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р Т‘ Р Р…РЎС“Р В¶Р ВµР Р… Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹, Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С•Р Вµ Р С•РЎвЂљР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р вЂќР С› РЎвЂљР С•Р С–Р С•, Р С”Р В°Р С” Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР В°Р В» РЎвЂ Р ВµР В»Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉРЎРѓРЎРЏ).
     * Р вЂ™Р С•Р В·Р Р†РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ -1, Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р Р†Р С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р Вµ Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р† РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘РЎС“РЎРѓР Вµ Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Р…Р С‘ Р С•Р Т‘Р Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• Р С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р СР В°РЎвЂљР ВµРЎР‚Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С•Р Р†.
     */
    public static int getAvailableMaterials() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return -1;

        String playerTeam = "NEUTRAL";
        if (mc.player.getTeam() != null) playerTeam = mc.player.getTeam().getName();
        if (playerTeam.equals("NEUTRAL") && !mc.player.isCreative()) return -1;

        BlockPos pos = mc.player.blockPosition();
        String currentDimension = mc.level.dimension().location().toString();

        int hubRadius = AASConfig.HUB_BUILD_RADIUS.get();
        double maxDistSqHub = (double) hubRadius * hubRadius;
        int crateRadius = ClientData.crateBuildRadius();
        double maxDistSqCrate = (double) crateRadius * crateRadius;

        int totalMaterials = 0;
        boolean isInRange = false;

        if (ClientData.clientHubs != null) {
            for (com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.HubInfo hubInfo : ClientData.clientHubs) {
                if (hubInfo.dimension != null && !hubInfo.dimension.equals(currentDimension)) {
                    continue;
                }
                BlockPos hubPos = hubInfo.pos;
                if (hubPos.distSqr(pos) <= maxDistSqHub) {
                    if (mc.level.isLoaded(hubPos)) {
                        BlockEntity be = mc.level.getBlockEntity(hubPos);
                        BlockState hubState = mc.level.getBlockState(hubPos);
                        if (be instanceof HubBlockEntity hub) {
                            if (hub.getTeam().equalsIgnoreCase(playerTeam) || hub.getTeam().equals("NEUTRAL")) {
                                if (hubState.hasProperty(HubBlock.CONSTRUCTED) && !hubState.getValue(HubBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) continue;
                                isInRange = true;
                                totalMaterials += hub.getMaterials();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB searchArea = new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(pos).inflate(crateRadius);
        java.util.List<com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity> crates =
                mc.level.getEntitiesOfClass(com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity.class, searchArea);

        for (com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity crate : crates) {
            if (crate.getTeamOwner().equalsIgnoreCase(playerTeam) || crate.getTeamOwner().equals("NEUTRAL")) {
                if (crate.distanceToSqr(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5) <= maxDistSqCrate) {
                    isInRange = true;
                    totalMaterials += crate.getMaterials();
                }
            }
        }

        return isInRange ? totalMaterials : -1;
    }

    /**
     * Р СљР С•Р В¶Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р СџР В Р Р‡Р СљР С› Р РЋР вЂўР в„ўР В§Р С’Р РЋ (Р С—Р С• РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р ВµР в„– РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР в„– Р С—Р С•Р В·Р С‘РЎвЂ Р С‘Р С‘, Р Т‘Р С• Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Р…Р В° Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”)
     * Р С—Р С•Р В·Р Р†Р С•Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓР ВµР В±Р Вµ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”РЎС“ structureId РІР‚вЂќ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•Р С‘РЎвЂљ Р В»Р С‘ Р С•Р Р… Р Р† РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘РЎС“РЎРѓР Вµ HUB/РЎРЏРЎвЂ°Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р С‘ РЎвЂ¦Р Р†Р В°РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В»Р С‘ Р СР В°РЎвЂљР ВµРЎР‚Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С•Р Р†.
     * Р ВРЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р С Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР Р†Р ВµРЎвЂљР С”Р С‘ Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р…Р С•Р С” (Р В±Р ВµР В»Р В°РЎРЏ/РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р В°РЎРЏ).
     */
    public static boolean canAfford(int structureId) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player != null && mc.player.isCreative()) return true;
        int available = getAvailableMaterials();
        return available >= 0 && available >= getCost(structureId);
    }

    /**
     * Р СљР С•Р В¶Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ HUB РЎРѓР С• РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р ВµР в„– РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР в„– Р С—Р С•Р В·Р С‘РЎвЂ Р С‘Р С‘ (HUB РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р СР С–Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С•,
     * Р В±Р ВµР В· Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Р…Р В° Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”, РЎРѓР С. PacketRadioAction actionId == 14). Р РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р…Р С•Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р С
     * РЎРЊР С”РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р С•Р С Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘ (DefenseRadialScreen), РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р В·Р В°РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р ВµР Вµ Р С—Р С•Р С”Р В°Р В·Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р…Р С”РЎС“ HUB РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–,
     * Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚ Р Р†РЎРѓРЎвЂ РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р С• Р С•РЎвЂљР С”Р В°Р В¶Р ВµРЎвЂљ. Р вЂєР С•Р С–Р С‘Р С”Р В° РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР Р…Р С• Р С—Р С•Р Р†РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р С‘ Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р Вµ:
     *   1) Р Т‘Р С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р…РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Т‘Р С• РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р ВµР С–Р С• Р В¶Р Вµ HUB'Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р СР ВµР Р…РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р Вµ AASConfig.MIN_HUB_DISTANCE (Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р Т‘Р В°Р В¶Р Вµ Р Р† Р С”РЎР‚Р С‘Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р†Р Вµ);
     *   2) Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р Р†Р С”Р В»РЎР‹РЎвЂЎРЎвЂР Р… AASConfig.HUB_PLACEMENT_REQUIRES_CRATE РІР‚вЂќ РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р С•Р С (50 Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р†) Р Т‘Р С•Р В»Р В¶Р ВµР Р…
     *      Р В±РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р в„–/Р Р…Р ВµР в„–РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎРЏРЎвЂ°Р С‘Р С” РЎРѓР Р…Р В°Р В±Р В¶Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ (Р Р…Р Вµ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р† Р С”РЎР‚Р С‘Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р†Р Вµ).
     * Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В° Р В»Р С‘Р СР С‘РЎвЂљР В° Р С”Р С•Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р В° HUB'Р С•Р Р† Р В·Р Т‘Р ВµРЎРѓРЎРЉ Р СњР вЂў Р Т‘Р ВµР В»Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РІР‚вЂќ Р С”Р В»Р С‘Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљ Р Р…Р Вµ Р В·Р Р…Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ maxBlueHubs/maxRedHubs.
     */
    public static boolean canBuildHub() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return false;

        String playerTeam = (mc.player.getTeam() != null)
                ? mc.player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase()
                : "NEUTRAL";

        BlockPos pos = mc.player.blockPosition();
        String currentDimension = mc.level.dimension().location().toString();

        // 1. Р вЂќР С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р…РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Т‘Р С• РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р ВµР С–Р С• HUB'Р В° РІР‚вЂќ Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР С–Р Т‘Р В°, Р Т‘Р В°Р В¶Р Вµ Р Р† Р С”РЎР‚Р С‘Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р†Р Вµ (Р С”Р В°Р С” Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р Вµ).
        int minDist = ClientData.minHubDistance();
        double minDistSq = (double) minDist * minDist;
        if (ClientData.clientHubs != null) {
            for (com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.HubInfo hubInfo : ClientData.clientHubs) {
                if (hubInfo.dimension != null && !hubInfo.dimension.equals(currentDimension)) continue;
                if (hubInfo.team != null && hubInfo.team.equalsIgnoreCase(playerTeam)
                        && hubInfo.pos.distSqr(pos) < minDistSq) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Р Р‡РЎвЂ°Р С‘Р С” РЎРѓР Р…Р В°Р В±Р В¶Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р С•Р С, Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р ВµР В±РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р С—Р С• Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂћР С‘Р С–РЎС“ РІР‚вЂќ Р Р† Р С”РЎР‚Р С‘Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р†Р Вµ Р Р…Р Вµ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ.
        if (AASConfig.HUB_PLACEMENT_REQUIRES_CRATE.get() && !mc.player.isCreative()) {
            double crateCheckRad = 50.0;
            net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB area = new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(pos).inflate(crateCheckRad);
            java.util.List<com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity> crates =
                    mc.level.getEntitiesOfClass(com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity.class, area);

            final String team = playerTeam;
            boolean hasValidCrate = crates.stream().anyMatch(c ->
                    c.getTeamOwner().equals("NEUTRAL") || c.getTeamOwner().equalsIgnoreCase(team));

            if (!hasValidCrate) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import com.example.aas.block.VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.DeckVersusScreen;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.DeckVoteScreen;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.DeckParamsScreen;
import com.example.aas.client.gui.TeamSelectionScreen;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckPhase;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckSpawnConfig;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckSyncPayload;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckType;
import com.example.aas.item.SupplyTruckMarkerItem;
import com.example.aas.item.VehicleMarkerItem;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketDeckInfo;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.player.LocalPlayer;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

/** Client-side state of the preparation (filled from PacketSyncGameData) and the logic that opens / closes its screens. */
public final class DeckClient {
    private DeckClient() {}

    public static DeckSyncPayload state = DeckSyncPayload.EMPTY;
    private static long phaseEndMs = 0;
    private static DeckPhase lastPhase = DeckPhase.NONE;
    /** The deck this player voted for (only remembered on the client, the server counts the real votes). */
    public static int myVote = -1;
    /** The deck the admin edits in the kit menus (the server keeps its own copy, see PacketSetEditDeck). */
    public static DeckType editDeck = DeckType.COMBINED;

    public static void onSync(DeckSyncPayload p) {
        state = p;
        phaseEndMs = System.currentTimeMillis() + p.timerTicks * 50L;
        DeckPhase phase = p.phase();
        if (phase != lastPhase) {
            if (phase == DeckPhase.DECK_VOTE) myVote = -1;
            lastPhase = phase;
        }
        refreshScreens();
    }

    /** Milliseconds left in the current phase (0 when over). */
    public static long msLeft() {
        return Math.max(0L, phaseEndMs - System.currentTimeMillis());
    }

    /** Whole seconds left in the current phase (rounded up). */
    public static int secondsLeft() {
        long ms = phaseEndMs - System.currentTimeMillis();
        return ms <= 0 ? 0 : (int) ((ms + 999) / 1000);
    }

    /** TRUE = blue, FALSE = red, null = no team. */
    public static Boolean myTeamIsBlue(LocalPlayer p) {
        if (p == null || p.getTeam() == null) return null;
        String n = p.getTeam().getName();
        if (n.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue")) return Boolean.TRUE;
        if (n.equalsIgnoreCase("Red")) return Boolean.FALSE;
        return null;
    }

    public static String factionOf(boolean blue) {
        return blue ? ClientData.BLUE_FACTION : ClientData.RED_FACTION;
    }

    private static boolean isPrepScreen(Screen s) {
        return s instanceof DeckVoteScreen || s instanceof DeckVersusScreen
                || (s instanceof TeamSelectionScreen t && t.isPrep());
    }

    private static void refreshScreens() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        LocalPlayer pl = mc.player;
        if (pl == null) return;
        boolean participant = !pl.isCreative() && !pl.isSpectator();
        Boolean blue = myTeamIsBlue(pl);
        DeckPhase ph = state.phase();
        Screen cur = mc.screen;

        boolean wantTeam = participant && ph == DeckPhase.TEAM_SELECT && blue == null;
        boolean wantVote = participant && ph == DeckPhase.DECK_VOTE && blue != null && state.enabledCount(blue) > 1;
        boolean wantVs = participant && ph == DeckPhase.VERSUS && blue != null
                && state.chosen(true) != null && state.chosen(false) != null;

        if (wantTeam) {
            if (!(cur instanceof TeamSelectionScreen t && t.isPrep())) mc.setScreen(new TeamSelectionScreen(true));
        } else if (wantVote) {
            if (!(cur instanceof DeckVoteScreen)) mc.setScreen(new DeckVoteScreen(blue));
        } else if (wantVs) {
            if (!(cur instanceof DeckVersusScreen)) mc.setScreen(new DeckVersusScreen(blue));
        } else if (isPrepScreen(cur)) {
            mc.setScreen(null);   // setScreen does not call onClose(), so the "cannot be closed" rule is not in the way
        }
    }

    public static void onInfo(PacketDeckInfo msg) {
        Screen cur = Minecraft.getInstance().screen;
        if (cur instanceof DeckVoteScreen s) s.onInfo(msg);
        else if (cur instanceof DeckParamsScreen s) s.onInfo(msg);
    }

    /** Config shown on the spawner block (floating text): the deck the spawner's team plays with, COMBINED if none is chosen. */
    public static DeckSpawnConfig spawnerConfig(VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity be) {
        String team = be.spawnerTeam();
        DeckType deck = null;
        if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("BLUE")) deck = state.chosen(true);
        else if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("RED")) deck = state.chosen(false);
        if (deck == null) deck = DeckType.COMBINED;
        DeckSpawnConfig c = be.deckConfigs.get(deck);
        return c != null ? c : new DeckSpawnConfig();
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import com.example.aas.deck.DeckRegistry;
import com.example.aas.deck.DeckType;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/** Draws deck emblems, class icons and faction flags. A missing emblem texture is replaced by a filled team-coloured circle. */
public final class DeckIcons {
    private DeckIcons() {}

    private static final Map<ResourceLocation, Boolean> EXISTS = new HashMap<>();

    /** ResourceManager lookup, cached (texture packs are only re-read on F3+T, call clearCache() from a reload listener if needed). */
    public static boolean exists(ResourceLocation rl) {
        return EXISTS.computeIfAbsent(rl, k -> Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(k).isPresent());
    }

    public static void clearCache() {
        EXISTS.clear();
    }

    private static void circle(GuiGraphics g, int x, int y, int size, float r, float gr, float b) {
        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(r, gr, b, 1.0f);
        BadgeCircle.blit(g, x, y, size);
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    /** A crisp filled square drawn by code (a scaled-up tiny texture would be blurry). */
    private static void square(GuiGraphics g, int x, int y, int size, int argb) {
        int dark = 0xFF000000 | (((argb >> 16 & 0xFF) * 6 / 10) << 16) | (((argb >> 8 & 0xFF) * 6 / 10) << 8) | ((argb & 0xFF) * 6 / 10);
        g.fill(x, y, x + size, y + size, dark);
        g.fill(x + 2, y + 2, x + size - 2, y + size - 2, argb);
    }

    public static void drawEmblem(GuiGraphics g, String faction, boolean blueTeam, DeckType deck, int x, int y, int size) {
        ResourceLocation tex = DeckRegistry.emblemTexture(faction, blueTeam, deck);
        if (!exists(tex)) {
            ResourceLocation alt = DeckRegistry.emblemTextureAlt(faction, blueTeam, deck);
            if (exists(alt)) tex = alt;
        }
        if (exists(tex)) {
            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
            g.blit(tex, x, y, 0, 0, size, size, size, size);
        } else if (blueTeam) {
            square(g, x, y, size, 0xFF2F5FD9);
        } else {
            square(g, x, y, size, 0xFFD92F2F);
        }
    }

    public static void drawClass(GuiGraphics g, DeckType deck, int x, int y, int size) {
        ResourceLocation tex = DeckRegistry.classIcon(deck);
        if (exists(tex)) {
            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
            g.blit(tex, x, y, 0, 0, size, size, size, size);
        } else {
            square(g, x, y, size, 0xFF8C8C8C);
        }
    }

    public static void drawFlag(GuiGraphics g, String faction, boolean blueTeam, int x, int y, int w, int h) {
        ResourceLocation tex = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/flags/" + DeckRegistry.resolveFaction(faction, blueTeam) + ".png");
        if (exists(tex)) {
            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
            g.blit(tex, x, y, 0, 0, w, h, w, h);
        } else {
            g.fill(x, y, x + w, y + h, blueTeam ? 0xFF0000AA : 0xFFAA0000);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;

/**
 * Р•РґРёРЅРѕРµ РјРµСЃС‚Рѕ РґР»СЏ С†РІРµС‚РѕРІ РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє РєРёС‚РѕРІ. РўРµРєСЃС‚СѓСЂС‹ РєРёС‚РѕРІ (textures/gui/kits/*.png) Р±РµР»С‹Рµ,
 * Р° С†РІРµС‚ Р·Р°РґР°С‘С‚СЃСЏ Р·РґРµСЃСЊ РїСЂРё РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєРµ (С‡РµСЂРµР· shader color).

 */
public final class KitIconStyle {
    private KitIconStyle() {}

    /** Р¦РІРµС‚ РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє РєРёС‚РѕРІ РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ (РјРµРЅСЋ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРѕРІ, РІС‹Р±РѕСЂ РєРёС‚Р° Рё С‚.Рї.): #ADE800 */
    public static final int DEFAULT_COLOR = 0xFFADE800;

    // Р¦РІРµС‚Р° РєР°РЅР°Р»РѕРІ РіРѕР»РѕСЃР° (РєР°Рє РІ СЃРїРёСЃРєРµ РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЏС‰РёС… СЃР»РµРІР°)
    public static final int COLOR_LOCAL   = 0xFF55AAFF;   // V вЂ” СЃРёРЅРёР№
    public static final int COLOR_SQUAD   = 0xFF55FF55;   // B вЂ” Р·РµР»С‘РЅС‹Р№
    public static final int COLOR_COMMAND = 0xFFFFAA00;   // * вЂ” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚РѕР№

    /** РљСЂР°СЃРёС‚ РІСЃС‘, С‡С‚Рѕ СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РґР°Р»СЊС€Рµ (blit), РІ СЌС‚РѕС‚ С†РІРµС‚ СЃ Р·Р°РґР°РЅРЅРѕР№ РїСЂРѕР·СЂР°С‡РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊСЋ. */
    public static void apply(int argb, float alpha) {
        float r = ((argb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f;
        float g = ((argb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f;
        float b = (argb & 0xFF) / 255f;
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(r, g, b, alpha);
    }

    public static void reset() {
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
    }

    /**
     * Р¦РІРµС‚ РєР°РЅР°Р»Р°, РІ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕРј РёРіСЂРѕРє РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ РџР РЇРњРћ РЎР•Р™Р§РђРЎ (РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№ > РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ > Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№),
     * РёР»Рё 0, РµСЃР»Рё РѕРЅ РЅРµ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ РЅРё РІ РѕРґРЅРѕРј РёР· СЌС‚РёС… РєР°РЅР°Р»РѕРІ.
     */
    public static int speakingColor(String name) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Long t = ClientData.COMMAND_SPEAKERS.get(name);
        if (t != null && now - t < 300) return COLOR_COMMAND;
        t = ClientData.SQUAD_SPEAKERS.get(name);
        if (t != null && now - t < 300) return COLOR_SQUAD;
        t = ClientData.LOCAL_SPEAKERS.get(name);
        if (t != null && now - t < 300) return COLOR_LOCAL;
        return 0;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketOpenKitEditor;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketPasteKit;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketRequestKitData;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtIo;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * "Kit key" = one text string that holds full kit data (items, NBT, resupply flags,
 * limits, display names, alt versions). Format: "AASKIT1:" + Base64url(gzip(NBT)).
 * Copy it from one world, paste it into another one.
 *
 * Types: KIT (one kit), TEAM (all kits of one team), ALL (both teams).
 * Entries inside are stored as "TEAM|KitName" -> kit tag.
 */
public class KitKeyUtil {
    public static final String PREFIX = "AASKIT1:";

    public static class Decoded {
        public String type;
        public boolean isAlt;
        public final LinkedHashMap<String, CompoundTag> kits = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ encode / decode

    public static String encode(String type, boolean isAlt, Map<String, CompoundTag> kits) throws Exception {
        CompoundTag root = new CompoundTag();
        root.putInt("V", 1);
        root.putString("Type", type);
        root.putBoolean("Alt", isAlt);
        CompoundTag k = new CompoundTag();
        kits.forEach(k::put);
        root.put("Kits", k);
        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        NbtIo.writeCompressed(root, bos);
        return PREFIX + Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bos.toByteArray());
    }

    public static Decoded decode(String key) throws Exception {
        if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty");
        key = key.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", "");
        if (!key.startsWith(PREFIX)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("not a kit key");
        byte[] raw = Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(key.substring(PREFIX.length()));
        CompoundTag root = NbtIo.readCompressed(new ByteArrayInputStream(raw));
        Decoded d = new Decoded();
        d.type = root.getString("Type");
        d.isAlt = root.getBoolean("Alt");
        CompoundTag k = root.getCompound("Kits");
        for (String name : k.getAllKeys()) d.kits.put(name, k.getCompound(name));
        return d;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ copy (generate key)

    /** scope: "KIT" (one kit), "TEAM" (all kits of team), "ALL" (both teams; team is ignored). */
    public static void requestCopy(String scope, String team, String kitName, boolean isAlt) {
        String t = scope.equals("ALL") ? "BOTH" : team;
        String k = scope.equals("KIT") ? kitName : "ALL";
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketRequestKitData(t, k, isAlt, scope));
    }

    /** Called on the client when the server answers a key request. */
    public static void onKeyData(String scope, boolean isAlt, Map<String, CompoundTag> kits) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        try {
            if (kits.isEmpty()) { msg("Nothing to copy"); return; }
            String key = encode(scope, isAlt, kits);
            mc.keyboardHandler.setClipboard(key);
            msg("Kit key copied: " + kits.size() + " kit(s), " + key.length() + " chars");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            msg("Failed to generate key: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ paste (apply key)

    private static Decoded readClipboard() {
        try {
            return decode(Minecraft.getInstance().keyboardHandler.getClipboard());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            msg("Clipboard does not contain a valid kit key");
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static String teamOf(String entryKey) { int i = entryKey.indexOf('|'); return i < 0 ? "" : entryKey.substring(0, i); }
    private static String nameOf(String entryKey) { int i = entryKey.indexOf('|'); return i < 0 ? entryKey : entryKey.substring(i + 1); }

    private static boolean validName(String n) {
        for (String s : AASWorldData.KIT_NAMES) if (s.equals(n)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /** Both-teams screen: a key of type ALL fills both teams, a TEAM key fills the team it came from. */
    public static void importAllTeams() {
        Decoded d = readClipboard();
        if (d == null) return;
        if (d.type.equals("KIT")) { msg("This key holds a single kit - open a team / kit to paste it"); return; }
        List<String[]> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CompoundTag> tags = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, CompoundTag> e : d.kits.entrySet()) {
            String team = teamOf(e.getKey()), name = nameOf(e.getKey());
            if ((team.equals("BLUE") || team.equals("RED")) && validName(name)) { jobs.add(new String[]{team, name}); tags.add(e.getValue()); }
        }
        send(jobs, tags);
    }

    /** Kit-list screen: paste all kits of the key into this team (a TEAM key from the other team is remapped). */
    public static void importForTeam(String team) {
        Decoded d = readClipboard();
        if (d == null) return;
        if (d.type.equals("KIT")) { msg("This key holds a single kit - open the kit and paste it there"); return; }
        List<String[]> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CompoundTag> tags = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, CompoundTag> e : d.kits.entrySet())
            if (teamOf(e.getKey()).equals(team) && validName(nameOf(e.getKey()))) { jobs.add(new String[]{team, nameOf(e.getKey())}); tags.add(e.getValue()); }
        if (jobs.isEmpty() && d.type.equals("TEAM")) { // key came from the other team
            for (Map.Entry<String, CompoundTag> e : d.kits.entrySet())
                if (validName(nameOf(e.getKey()))) { jobs.add(new String[]{team, nameOf(e.getKey())}); tags.add(e.getValue()); }
        }
        send(jobs, tags);
    }

    /** Editor screen: paste one kit (or the matching kit of a team key) into the kit that is open now. */
    public static void importForEditor(String team, String kitName, boolean isAlt) {
        Decoded d = readClipboard();
        if (d == null) return;
        CompoundTag tag = null;
        if (d.type.equals("KIT")) {
            tag = d.kits.values().stream().findFirst().orElse(null);
        } else {
            tag = d.kits.get(team + "|" + kitName);
            if (tag == null) for (Map.Entry<String, CompoundTag> e : d.kits.entrySet())
                if (nameOf(e.getKey()).equals(kitName)) { tag = e.getValue(); break; }
        }
        if (tag == null) { msg("No kit \"" + kitName + "\" in this key"); return; }
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketPasteKit(team, kitName, isAlt, tag));
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketOpenKitEditor(team, kitName, isAlt)); // reopen with new data
        msg("Kit key pasted");
    }

    private static void send(List<String[]> jobs, List<CompoundTag> tags) {
        if (jobs.isEmpty()) { msg("Key has no kits for this target"); return; }
        for (int i = 0; i < jobs.size(); i++) {
            boolean last = (i == jobs.size() - 1); // sync to clients only once, on the last kit
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketPasteKit(jobs.get(i)[0], jobs.get(i)[1], false, tags.get(i), last));
        }
        msg("Kit key pasted: " + jobs.size() + " kit(s)");
    }

    private static void msg(String s) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player != null) mc.player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal(s), true);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;

/**
 * РљР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРёР№ РїРѕРјРѕС‰РЅРёРє РґР»СЏ РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє СЂР°РЅРіРѕРІ РєРёС‚РѕРІ (1..20).
 * РўРµРєСЃС‚СѓСЂС‹: assets/aas/textures/gui/ranks/rank_1.png ... rank_20.png
 */
public final class KitRankIcons {

    public static final int MAX_LEVEL = 20;

    /** Р Р°Р·РјРµСЂ СЃР°РјРѕР№ С‚РµРєСЃС‚СѓСЂС‹ РІ РїРёРєСЃРµР»СЏС… (РєР°Рє Сѓ РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє РєРёС‚РѕРІ вЂ” 10x10). Р•СЃР»Рё РЅР°СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°РЅС‹ РґСЂСѓРіРѕРіРѕ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂР°, РїРѕРјРµРЅСЏР№ С‚СѓС‚. */
    public static final int TEX_SIZE = 10;

    /** РЎРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РјРµСЃС‚Р° Р·Р°РЅРёРјР°РµС‚ РёРєРѕРЅРєР° СЂР°РЅРіР° РІ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРµ (10 px РёРєРѕРЅРєР° + 2 px РѕС‚СЃС‚СѓРї, РєР°Рє Сѓ РёРєРѕРЅРєРё РєРёС‚Р°). */
    public static final int ROW_ADVANCE = 12;

    private static final ResourceLocation[] ICONS = new ResourceLocation[MAX_LEVEL + 1];

    static {
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_LEVEL; i++) {
            ICONS[i] = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/ranks/rank_" + i + ".png");
        }
    }

    /** РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ РґР»СЏ РїРѕРєР°Р·Р°. 0 = РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°С‚СЊ (РєРѕРЅС„РёРі РІС‹РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅ / РЅРµС‚ РґР°РЅРЅС‹С…). */
    public static int levelOf(String playerName) {
        if (!ClientData.serverShowKitRanks) return 0;
        Integer lvl = ClientData.playerKitRanks.get(playerName);
        if (lvl == null) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_LEVEL, lvl));
    }

    /** Р РёСЃСѓРµС‚ РёРєРѕРЅРєСѓ 10x10. */
    public static void draw(GuiGraphics gui, int level, int x, int y) {
        draw(gui, level, x, y, 10);
    }

    /** Р РёСЃСѓРµС‚ РёРєРѕРЅРєСѓ СЃ Р·Р°РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рј СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂРѕРј РЅР° СЌРєСЂР°РЅРµ (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ 9, РєР°Рє Сѓ РёРєРѕРЅРєРё РєРёС‚Р° РІ SquadPanelOverlay). */
    public static void draw(GuiGraphics gui, int level, int x, int y, int size) {
        if (level < 1 || level > MAX_LEVEL) return;
        gui.blit(ICONS[level], x, y, size, size, 0f, 0f, TEX_SIZE, TEX_SIZE, TEX_SIZE, TEX_SIZE);
    }
    /** РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ СЂР°РЅРіР° РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РёР»Рё null, РµСЃР»Рё РґР°РЅРЅС‹С… РЅРµС‚. */
    public static KitRankProgress progressOf(String playerName) {
        if (!ClientData.serverShowKitRanks) return null;
        return ClientData.playerKitRankProgress.get(playerName);
    }
    private KitRankIcons() {
    }
}

package com.example.aas.network;
import java.util.UUID;

public class MapPlayerInfo {
    public String name;
    public UUID uuid;
    public double x, z;
    public float rot;
    public int squadId;
    public boolean isLeader;
    public boolean isDowned;
    public boolean isDead;
    public long lastShoutTime;
    public boolean inVehicle;
    public int vehicleId;
    public int seatIndex;
    public String team;

    // РќРћР’РћР•: СЃРЅР°СЂСЏР¶РµРЅРёРµ РјРµРґРёРєР° (+ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё РєСЂСѓР¶РєР°)
    public boolean isMedic;
    // РќРћР’РћР•: СЂРѕР»СЊ РІ С„Р°РµСЂС‚РёРјРµ вЂ” "" (РЅРµС‚), "B" (РіР»Р°РІР° Bravo), "C" (РіР»Р°РІР° Charlie)
    public String fireteamRole;

    public MapPlayerInfo(String name, UUID uuid, double x, double z, float rot, int squadId, boolean isLeader,
                         boolean isDowned, boolean isDead, long lastShoutTime, boolean inVehicle, int vehicleId,
                         int seatIndex, String team, boolean isMedic, String fireteamRole) {
        this.name = name;
        this.uuid = uuid;
        this.x = x;
        this.z = z;
        this.rot = rot;
        this.squadId = squadId;
        this.isLeader = isLeader;
        this.isDowned = isDowned;
        this.isDead = isDead;
        this.lastShoutTime = lastShoutTime;
        this.inVehicle = inVehicle;
        this.vehicleId = vehicleId;
        this.seatIndex = seatIndex;
        this.team = team;
        this.isMedic = isMedic;
        this.fireteamRole = fireteamRole == null ? "" : fireteamRole;
    }
}

 */
public final class OwnVoiceIndicator {

    /** СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РјСЃ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРµРіРѕ РїР°РєРµС‚Р° СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµРј, С‡С‚Рѕ РёРіСЂРѕРє РµС‰С‘ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ (РєР°Рє РІ СЃРїРёСЃРєРµ СЃР»РµРІР°) */
    private static final long ACTIVE_MS = 350;

    // --- СЂР°СЃРїРѕР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёРµ РІ РёРіСЂРµ (SquadPanelOverlay: MARGIN = 6, PANEL_WIDTH = 150) ---

    private static final int HUD_BOTTOM_MARGIN = 6;

    /** РРєРѕРЅРєР° РєРёС‚Р°; РµСЃР»Рё РєРёС‚Р° РЅРµС‚ (null / РїСѓСЃС‚Рѕ / Unassigned) вЂ” РёРєРѕРЅРєР° none. */

    public static boolean isCommander(String name) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || name == null) return false;
        boolean isBlue = mc.player.getTeam() != null && mc.player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase().contains("BLUE");
        int cmdId = isBlue ? ClientData.blueCMDId : ClientData.redCMDId;
        if (cmdId == -1) return false;
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.id == cmdId) return name.equals(s.leader);
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Р¦РІРµС‚ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РІ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРѕРј С‡Р°С‚Рµ: Р¦РњР” вЂ” Р¶С‘Р»С‚С‹Р№, РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ Р»РёРґРµСЂС‹ вЂ” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚РѕР№. */
    public static int commandColor(String name) {

    private static final int NONE = 0, LOCAL = 1, SQUAD = 2, COMMAND = 3, RADIO = 4;

    private static int activeChannel(String self) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        int best = NONE;
        long bestTs = 0;
        long t;
        if ((t = ts(ClientData.LOCAL_SPEAKERS, self)) > bestTs && now - t < ACTIVE_MS)   { best = LOCAL;   bestTs = t; }
        if ((t = ts(ClientData.SQUAD_SPEAKERS, self)) > bestTs && now - t < ACTIVE_MS)   { best = SQUAD;   bestTs = t; }
        if ((t = ts(ClientData.COMMAND_SPEAKERS, self)) > bestTs && now - t < ACTIVE_MS) { best = COMMAND; bestTs = t; }
        if ((t = ts(ClientData.RADIO_SPEAKERS, self)) > bestTs && now - t < ACTIVE_MS)   { best = RADIO;   bestTs = t; }
        return best;
    }

    private static long ts(Map<String, Long> map, String name) {
        Long v = map.get(name);
        return v == null ? 0L : v;
    }

    /** true, РµСЃР»Рё СЏ РїСЂСЏРјРѕ СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЋ РІ РєР°РєРѕРј-Р»РёР±Рѕ РєР°РЅР°Р»Рµ */
    public static boolean isSpeaking() {
        String self = selfName();
        return self != null && activeChannel(self) != NONE;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ

    private static AASWorldData.Squad findMySquad(String myName) {
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.members.contains(myName)) return s;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** С‚РѕС‚ Р¶Рµ РЅРѕРјРµСЂ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°, С‡С‚Рѕ РІ Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРєРµ SquadPanelOverlay */
    private static int displaySquadNumber(Minecraft mc, AASWorldData.Squad mySquad) {
        String myTeam = mc.player.getTeam() != null ? mc.player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
        String myDim = mc.level.dimension().location().toString();
        boolean isBlue = myTeam.contains("BLUE");
        int teamCMDId = isBlue ? ClientData.blueCMDId : ClientData.redCMDId;

        List<AASWorldData.Squad> teamSquads = new ArrayList<>();
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.team.equalsIgnoreCase(myTeam) && s.dimension != null && s.dimension.equals(myDim)) {
                teamSquads.add(s);
            }
        }
        teamSquads.sort((s1, s2) -> {
            if (s1.id == teamCMDId && teamCMDId != -1) return -1;
            if (s2.id == teamCMDId && teamCMDId != -1) return 1;
            return Integer.compare(s1.id, s2.id);
        });
        for (int i = 0; i < teamSquads.size(); i++) {
            if (teamSquads.get(i).id == mySquad.id) return i + 1;
        }
        return mySquad.id;
    }

    /**
     * РќРѕРјРµСЂ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° РёРіСЂРѕРєР° (РєР°Рє РІ Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРєРµ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°) РёР»Рё null, РµСЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє РЅРµ РІ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРµ.
     * РќСѓР¶РµРЅ РґР»СЏ РєСЂСѓР¶РєР° РІ СЃРїРёСЃРєРµ РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЏС‰РёС… (Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ Рё РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№ РєР°РЅР°Р»С‹).
     */
    public static String squadNumberOf(String playerName) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null || playerName == null) return null;
        AASWorldData.Squad sq = findMySquad(playerName);
        return sq == null ? null : String.valueOf(displaySquadNumber(mc, sq));
    }
    /** true, РµСЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕРёС‚ РІ CMD-РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРµ (РµРіРѕ Р±РµР№РґР¶ СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ Р·РІРµР·РґРѕР№) */
    public static boolean isCmdSquadOf(String playerName) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null || playerName == null) return false;
        return com.example.aas.client.BadgeCircle.isCmdSquad(findMySquad(playerName));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєР°

    /** HUD РІ РёРіСЂРµ: РІРЅРёР·Сѓ; РїСЂР°РІРµРµ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°, Р° РµСЃР»Рё РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РЅРµС‚ вЂ” Сѓ Р»РµРІРѕРіРѕ РєСЂР°СЏ */
    public static void renderHud(GuiGraphics gui, Minecraft mc, int screenWidth, int screenHeight) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return;
        // РїРѕРґ СЌС‚РёРјРё СЌРєСЂР°РЅР°РјРё РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ СЂРёСЃСѓСЋС‚ РѕРЅРё СЃР°РјРё
        if (mc.screen instanceof net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.DeathScreen
                || mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.SquadSelectionScreen) return;

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (ClientData.squadPanelExpanded) panelCollapsedSince = -1;
        else if (panelCollapsedSince < 0) panelCollapsedSince = now;

        boolean panelVisible = findMySquad(mc.player.getScoreboardName()) != null
                && !(panelCollapsedSince > 0 && now - panelCollapsedSince > PANEL_GONE_AFTER_MS)
                && !com.example.aas.client.uav.UavViewClient.isViewing();

        // РїРѕРєР° РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚ AASChatScreen, РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ С‡Р°С‚Р° СЃС‚РѕРёС‚ РЅР° РјРµСЃС‚Рµ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° вЂ” СѓС…РѕРґРёРј РїСЂР°РІРµРµ РЅРµС‘
        boolean chatOpen = mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.AASChatScreen;
        float target = chatOpen ? HUD_X_CHAT : (panelVisible ? HUD_X_WITH_PANEL : HUD_X_NO_PANEL);
        hudX = (hudX < 0) ? target : Mth.lerp(0.25f, hudX, target);
        if (Math.abs(hudX - target) < 0.5f) hudX = target;

        render(gui, mc.font, Math.round(hudX), screenHeight - HUD_BOTTOM_MARGIN - 10);
    }

    private static final int ROW_ACTIVE_MS = 500;
    private static final int LIST_BADGE_SIZE = 10;

    /**
     * РЎРїРёСЃРѕРє Р”Р РЈР“РРҐ РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЏС‰РёС… РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ (СЂР°С†РёСЏ, РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№, РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ, Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№) вЂ” РґР»СЏ СЌРєСЂР°РЅРѕРІ-РјРµРЅСЋ.
     * РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚ (РјС‹С€Рё РЅРµ РѕР±СЂР°Р±Р°С‚С‹РІР°РµС‚), РЅР° РІС‹СЃРѕРєРѕРј СЃР»РѕРµ z=600: Р»РµР¶РёС‚ РїРѕРІРµСЂС… РјРµРЅСЋ Рё РЅРµ РјРµС€Р°РµС‚ РєР»РёРєР°Рј.
     * (x, y) вЂ” Р»РµРІС‹Р№ РІРµСЂС…РЅРёР№ СѓРіРѕР» РїРµСЂРІРѕР№ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё.
     */
    public static void renderOthers(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int x, int y) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();   // {РёРјСЏ, С†РІРµС‚, РїСЂРµС„РёРєСЃ, РєСЂСѓР¶РѕРє?, СЂР°С†РёСЏ?}
        collect(rows, ClientData.RADIO_SPEAKERS, now, COLOR_RADIO, "", false, true, false);
        collect(rows, ClientData.COMMAND_SPEAKERS, now, COLOR_COMMAND, "\u2605 ", true, false, true);
        collect(rows, ClientData.SQUAD_SPEAKERS, now, COLOR_SQUAD, "", false, false, false);
        collect(rows, ClientData.LOCAL_SPEAKERS, now, COLOR_LOCAL, "", true, false, false);
        if (rows.isEmpty()) return;

        boolean anyBadge = false;
        for (Object[] r : rows) {
            if ((Boolean) r[3] && squadNumberOf((String) r[0]) != null) { anyBadge = true; break; }
        }
        int badgeW = anyBadge ? LIST_BADGE_SIZE + 3 : 0;
        final int KIT_SIZE = 9, KIT_X = 3, VOICE_X = KIT_X + KIT_SIZE + 2, NAME_X = VOICE_X + 8 + 3;

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(0, 0, 600);
        for (Object[] r : rows) {
            String name = (String) r[0];
            int color = (Integer) r[1];
            String label = (String) r[2] + name;
            boolean radio = (Boolean) r[4];

            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            if (radio) {
                gui.fill(x, y - 2, x + font.width(label) + 19, y + 10, 0x80000000);
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(((color >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, ((color >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, (color & 0xFF) / 255f, 1f);
                gui.blit(RADIO_ICON, x + 3, y, 0, 0, 8, 8, 8, 8);
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
                gui.drawString(font, label, x + 14, y, color, false);
            } else {
                gui.fill(x, y - 2, x + badgeW + NAME_X + font.width(label) + 6, y + 10, 0x80000000);

                if (badgeW > 0 && (Boolean) r[3]) {
                    String num = squadNumberOf(name);
                    if (num != null) BadgeCircle.draw(gui, font, x + 2, y - 1, LIST_BADGE_SIZE, color, num, isCmdSquadOf(name));
                }

                // РєРёС‚: РµСЃР»Рё РєРёС‚Р° РЅРµС‚ вЂ” РјРµСЃС‚Рѕ РѕСЃС‚Р°С‘С‚СЃСЏ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рј (РЅРёРєРё СЂРѕРІРЅРѕ)
                String kitName = ClientData.playerKits.getOrDefault(name, "Unassigned");
                if (kitName != null && !kitName.isEmpty() && !kitName.equalsIgnoreCase("Unassigned")) {
                    ResourceLocation kitIcon = new ResourceLocation("aas",
                            "textures/gui/kits/" + kitName.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "_") + ".png");
                    KitIconStyle.apply(color, 1.0f);
                    gui.blit(kitIcon, x + badgeW + KIT_X, y, KIT_SIZE, KIT_SIZE, 0f, 0f, 10, 10, 10, 10);
                    KitIconStyle.reset();
                }

                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(((color >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, ((color >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, (color & 0xFF) / 255f, 1f);
                gui.blit(VoiceIcons.forPlayer(name), x + badgeW + VOICE_X, y, 0, 0, 8, 8, 8, 8);
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);

                gui.drawString(font, label, x + badgeW + NAME_X, y, color, false);
            }
            y += 14;
        }
        gui.pose().popPose();
    }

    private static void collect(List<Object[]> rows, Map<String, Long> speakers, long now, int color,
                                String prefix, boolean badge, boolean radio, boolean command) {
        for (var e : new ArrayList<>(speakers.entrySet())) {
            if (isSelf(e.getKey()) || now - e.getValue() >= ROW_ACTIVE_MS) continue;
            rows.add(new Object[]{e.getKey(), command ? commandColor(e.getKey()) : color, prefix, badge, radio});
        }
    }

    public static boolean render(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int x, int y) {
        return render(gui, font, x, y, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
    }

    /**
     * Р РёСЃСѓРµС‚ РїР»Р°С€РєСѓ. (x, y) вЂ” Р»РµРІС‹Р№ РІРµСЂС…РЅРёР№ СѓРіРѕР» С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р°/РёРєРѕРЅРєРё; РїР»Р°С€РєР° Р·Р°РЅРёРјР°РµС‚ РїРѕ РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Рµ y-2 .. y+10.
     * Р•СЃР»Рё РїР»Р°С€РєР° С€РёСЂРµ maxWidth вЂ” РѕРЅР° РїСЂРѕРїРѕСЂС†РёРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ СѓРјРµРЅСЊС€Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ.
     *
     * @return true, РµСЃР»Рё С‡С‚Рѕ-С‚Рѕ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ РЅР°СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°РЅРѕ
     */
    public static boolean render(GuiGraphics gui, Font font, int x, int y, int maxWidth) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        String self = selfName();
        if (self == null || mc.level == null) return false;
        int ch = activeChannel(self);
        if (ch == NONE) return false;

        int color;
        String key;
        ResourceLocation icon;
        switch (ch) {
            case COMMAND -> { color = commandColor(self); key = "aas.voice.channel.command"; icon = VoiceIcons.forPlayer(self); }
            case SQUAD   -> { color = COLOR_SQUAD;   key = "aas.voice.channel.squad";   icon = VoiceIcons.forPlayer(self); }
            case RADIO   -> { color = COLOR_RADIO;   key = "aas.voice.channel.radio";   icon = RADIO_ICON; }
            default      -> { color = COLOR_LOCAL;   key = "aas.voice.channel.local";   icon = VoiceIcons.forPlayer(self); }
        }

        Component label = Component.translatable(key);
        int iconX = 3;
        int textX = iconX + 8 + 3;
        int width = textX + font.width(label) + 6;

        float scale = width > maxWidth ? Math.max(0.5f, maxWidth / (float) width) : 1f;

        gui.pose().pushPose();
        gui.pose().translate(x, y, 600);          // РІС‹СЃРѕРєРёР№ СЃР»РѕР№: РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµРєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚
        if (scale != 1f) gui.pose().scale(scale, scale, 1f);

        gui.fill(0, -2, width, 10, 0x80000000);

        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(((color >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f, ((color >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f, (color & 0xFF) / 255f, 1f);
        gui.blit(icon, iconX, 0, 0, 0, 8, 8, 8, 8);
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);

        gui.drawString(font, label, textX, 0, color, false);

        gui.pose().popPose();
        return true;
    }

/**
 * Radio click sounds of the held voice keys: "start" when the key goes down, "end" when it is released.
 * Squad channel (B): factions insurgency / militia use their own set, all other factions the normal squad set.
 * Command channel (*): one set for every faction. Local chat (V) is silent.
 * Only the speaking player hears the clicks (local UI sound, no world position).
 *
 * Channels are the same numbers as VoiceKeyHandler / VoiceChannelState: 0 none, 1 local, 2 squad, 3 command.
 */
public final class RadioClickSounds {
    private static final int SQUAD = 2, COMMAND = 3;

    private RadioClickSounds() {}

    /** Called by VoiceKeyHandler when the active channel changes (from -> to). */
    public static void onChannelChange(int from, int to) {
        if (from == to) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        LocalPlayer pl = mc.player;
        if (pl == null) return;
        boolean ins = isInsurgentFaction(pl);

        if ((from == SQUAD || from == COMMAND) && allowed(pl, from)) play(mc, pick(from, false, ins));
        if ((to == SQUAD || to == COMMAND) && allowed(pl, to)) play(mc, pick(to, true, ins));
    }

    /** Click of ANOTHER player in my channel (sent by the server, who may hear it is decided there). */
    public static void playRemote(int channel, boolean start) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        LocalPlayer pl = mc.player;
        if (pl == null) return;
        if (channel != SQUAD && channel != COMMAND) return;
        play(mc, pick(channel, start, isInsurgentFaction(pl)));
    }

    private static RegistryObject<SoundEvent> pick(int channel, boolean start, boolean ins) {
        if (channel == COMMAND) return start ? ModSounds.RADIO_COMMAND_START : ModSounds.RADIO_COMMAND_END;
        if (ins) return start ? ModSounds.RADIO_INSURGENT_START : ModSounds.RADIO_INSURGENT_END;
        return start ? ModSounds.RADIO_SQUAD_START : ModSounds.RADIO_SQUAD_END;
    }

    private static void play(Minecraft mc, RegistryObject<SoundEvent> ev) {
        mc.getSoundManager().play(SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(ev.get(), 1.0F));
    }

    /** Same rule as the server: squad chat needs a squad, command chat needs a squad leader. */
    private static boolean allowed(LocalPlayer pl, int channel) {
        String me = pl.getScoreboardName();
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            boolean leader = me.equals(s.leader);
            if (channel == COMMAND ? leader : (leader || s.members.contains(me))) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isInsurgentFaction(LocalPlayer pl) {
        Boolean blue = DeckClient.myTeamIsBlue(pl);
        if (blue == null) return false;
        String f = DeckRegistry.resolveFaction(DeckClient.factionOf(blue), blue);
        return "insurgency".equals(f) || "militia".equals(f);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.client;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;

import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

/**
 * РџР»Р°С€РєРё СЃР»РµРІР° СЃРІРµСЂС…Сѓ: С‚РёРјРєРёР»Р» + Р»РёС‡РЅС‹Рµ СѓРІРµРґРѕРјР»РµРЅРёСЏ С„Р°РµСЂС‚РёРјР° (Bravo/Charlie).
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public class TeamKillOverlay {

    private static final ResourceLocation ICON = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/teamkill_icon.png");

    // РРєРѕРЅРєРё С„Р°РµСЂС‚РёРјР° (Р±РµР»С‹Р№ СЃРёР»СѓСЌС‚ 16x16 РЅР° РїСЂРѕР·СЂР°С‡РЅРѕРј С„РѕРЅРµ, РєСЂР°СЃРёС‚СЃСЏ РІ С†РІРµС‚ РіСЂСѓРїРїС‹).
    // РРЅРґРµРєСЃ = С‚РёРї СѓРІРµРґРѕРјР»РµРЅРёСЏ: 0 РґРѕР±Р°РІРёР»Рё, 1 РІС‹ Р»РёРґРµСЂ, 2 Р»РёРґРµСЂ СЃРјРµРЅРёР»СЃСЏ, 3 РІР°С€ Р»РёРґРµСЂ.
    // РЎРµР№С‡Р°СЃ РІРµР·РґРµ РѕРґРёРЅ С€РµРІСЂРѕРЅ; С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃРґРµР»Р°С‚СЊ СЂР°Р·РЅС‹Рµ - РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РїРѕРјРµРЅСЏР№ РїСѓС‚Рё.
    private static final ResourceLocation FT_CHEVRON = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/fireteam_chevron.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation[] FT_ICONS = { FT_CHEVRON, FT_CHEVRON, FT_CHEVRON, FT_CHEVRON };

    private static final int COLOR_BRAVO = 0xFFAA33FF;
    private static final int COLOR_CHARLIE = 0xFF00E5CC;

    private static final int HEIGHT = 26;
    private static final int BASE_Y = 72;
    private static final int STACK_GAP = 4;
    private static final int MAX_VISIBLE = 4;
    private static final int STRIPE_COLOR = 0xFFE03B3B;

    private static final long SLIDE_MS = 400;
    private static final long HOLD_MS = 5000;
    private static final long TOTAL_MS = SLIDE_MS + HOLD_MS + SLIDE_MS;

    private static class Entry {
        final Component text;
        final ResourceLocation icon;
        final int stripe;
        final boolean tintIcon;
        final long start = System.currentTimeMillis();

        Entry(Component text, ResourceLocation icon, int stripe, boolean tintIcon) {
            this.text = text;
            this.icon = icon;
            this.stripe = stripe;
            this.tintIcon = tintIcon;
        }
    }

    private static final List<Entry> ENTRIES = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

    private static void add(Entry e) {
        ENTRIES.add(e);
        while (ENTRIES.size() > MAX_VISIBLE) {
            ENTRIES.remove(0);
        }
    }

    /** Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· PacketTeamKillNotification РЅР° РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Рµ. */
    public static void push(String otherName, boolean youAreKiller, boolean knocked) {
        String key = "aas.hud.teamkill." + (knocked ? "knock." : "") + (youAreKiller ? "killer" : "victim");
        add(new Entry(Component.translatable(key, otherName), ICON, STRIPE_COLOR, false));
    }

    /** Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· PacketFireteamNotification РЅР° РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Рµ. */
    public static void pushFireteam(int type, boolean bravo, String name) {
        String group = bravo ? "Bravo" : "Charlie";
        Component text;
        switch (type) {
            case 0: text = Component.translatable("aas.hud.fireteam.added", group); break;
            case 1: text = Component.translatable("aas.hud.fireteam.you_leader", group); break;
            case 2: text = Component.translatable("aas.hud.fireteam.leader_changed", group, name); break;
            case 3: text = Component.translatable("aas.hud.fireteam.your_leader", group, name); break;
            default: return;
        }
        ResourceLocation icon = FT_ICONS[Math.max(0, Math.min(type, FT_ICONS.length - 1))];
        add(new Entry(text, icon, bravo ? COLOR_BRAVO : COLOR_CHARLIE, true));
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRenderGui(RenderGuiEvent.Post event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || ENTRIES.isEmpty()) return;

        GuiGraphics g = event.getGuiGraphics();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        int slot = 0;

        for (Entry e : ENTRIES) {
            long elapsed = now - e.start;
            if (elapsed >= TOTAL_MS) {
                ENTRIES.remove(e);
                continue;
            }

            float progress;
            if (elapsed < SLIDE_MS) {
                progress = (float) elapsed / SLIDE_MS;
            } else if (elapsed < SLIDE_MS + HOLD_MS) {
                progress = 1.0f;
            } else {
                progress = 1.0f - (float) (elapsed - SLIDE_MS - HOLD_MS) / SLIDE_MS;
            }

            int textWidth = mc.font.width(e.text);
            int width = textWidth + 46;
            int x = (int) (-width + (progress * (width + 10)));
            int y = BASE_Y + slot * (HEIGHT + STACK_GAP);

            RenderSystem.enableBlend();
            g.fill(x, y, x + width, y + HEIGHT, 0xAA000000);
            g.fill(x, y, x + 3, y + HEIGHT, e.stripe);

            if (e.tintIcon) {
                float r = ((e.stripe >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255f;
                float gr = ((e.stripe >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255f;
                float b = (e.stripe & 0xFF) / 255f;
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(r, gr, b, 1.0f);
            } else {
                RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            }
            g.blit(e.icon, x + 8, y + 5, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16, 16);
            RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);

            g.drawString(mc.font, e.text, x + 32, y + 9, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
            RenderSystem.disableBlend();

            slot++;
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLoggingOut(ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.LoggingOut event) {
        ENTRIES.clear();
    }

    private TeamKillOverlay() {
    }
}

// PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\client\VoiceIcons.java
package com.example.aas.client;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Client side: remembers the voice level per speaker and picks the icon texture for it.
 * level: 0 = quiet, 1 = medium, 2 = normal (same numbering as VoiceLevelMeter).
 * The shown level changes only after the new level has been stable for a short time (no flicker).
 *
 * Optional textures (if a file is missing, the base voice_icon.png is used):
 *   textures/gui/voice_icon_quiet.png
 *   textures/gui/voice_icon_medium.png
 */
public final class VoiceIcons {

    /** how long a HIGHER level must persist before the icon switches up (ms) */
    private static final long HOLD_UP_MS = 120;
    /** how long a LOWER level must persist before the icon switches down (ms) */
    private static final long HOLD_DOWN_MS = 450;
    /** pause in speech after which the icon is reset instantly on the next word (ms) */
    private static final long RESET_AFTER_MS = 1000;

    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_NORMAL = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/voice_icon.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_MEDIUM = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/voice_icon_medium.png");
    private static final ResourceLocation ICON_QUIET  = new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/voice_icon_quiet.png");

    private static final class State {
        int shown;          // level currently displayed
        int pending;        // level we are considering switching to
        long pendingSince;  // when pending was first seen
        long lastUpdate;    // last packet time
    }

    private static final Map<String, State> STATES = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<ResourceLocation, Boolean> EXISTS = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private VoiceIcons() {}

    /** Called from PacketVoiceChannelActivity when a player is speaking. */
    public static void put(String playerName, int level) {
        if (playerName == null) return;
        level = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, level));
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();

        State s = STATES.get(playerName);
        if (s == null || now - s.lastUpdate > RESET_AFTER_MS) {
            s = new State();
            s.shown = level;
            s.pending = level;
            s.pendingSince = now;
            STATES.put(playerName, s);
        } else if (level != s.pending) {
            s.pending = level;
            s.pendingSince = now;
        }
        s.lastUpdate = now;
    }

    /** Texture for the player's current voice level. Never returns null. */
    public static ResourceLocation forPlayer(String playerName) {
        int level = 2;
        State s = playerName == null ? null : STATES.get(playerName);
        if (s != null) {
            if (s.pending != s.shown) {
                long hold = s.pending > s.shown ? HOLD_UP_MS : HOLD_DOWN_MS;
                if (System.currentTimeMillis() - s.pendingSince >= hold) {
                    s.shown = s.pending;
                }
            }
            level = s.shown;
        }
        ResourceLocation tex = switch (level) {
            case 0 -> ICON_QUIET;
            case 1 -> ICON_MEDIUM;
            default -> ICON_NORMAL;
        };
        return exists(tex) ? tex : ICON_NORMAL;
    }

    private static boolean exists(ResourceLocation rl) {
        if (rl == ICON_NORMAL) return true;
        return EXISTS.computeIfAbsent(rl,
                r -> Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(r).isPresent());
    }

    public static void remove(String playerName) {
        if (playerName != null) STATES.remove(playerName);
    }

    public static void clear() {
        STATES.clear();
    }
}
