 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class VoiceKeyHandler {
    private static int current = 0;
    private static int ticksSinceSend = 0;
    private static final int HEARTBEAT_TICKS = 10;   // 0.5 СЃРµРє

    /** РљР°РєРѕР№ РєР°РЅР°Р» СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ Р°РєС‚РёРІРµРЅ Сѓ СЌС‚РѕРіРѕ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р° (0 = РЅРёРєР°РєРѕР№). РњРѕР¶РЅРѕ РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚СЊ РґР»СЏ HUD. */
    public static int getCurrentChannel() {
        return current;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientTick(TickEvent.ClientTickEvent event) {
        if (event.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();

        int want = 0;
        boolean online = mc.player != null && mc.level != null && mc.getConnection() != null;
        if (online && !inputBlocked(mc)) {
            if (isDown(mc, ModKeyBindings.VOICE_COMMAND_KEY)) want = 3;
            else if (isDown(mc, ModKeyBindings.VOICE_SQUAD_KEY)) want = 2;
            else if (isDown(mc, ModKeyBindings.VOICE_LOCAL_KEY)) want = 1;
        }

        if (!online) {          // РІС‹С€Р»Рё РёР· РјРёСЂР° вЂ” РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ СЃР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµРј Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ
            current = 0;
            ticksSinceSend = 0;
            return;
        }

        ticksSinceSend++;
        if (want != current || (want != 0 && ticksSinceSend >= HEARTBEAT_TICKS)) {
            if (want != current) RadioClickSounds.onChannelChange(current, want);
            current = want;
            ticksSinceSend = 0;
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketVoiceChannel(want));
        }
    }

    private static boolean inputBlocked(Minecraft mc) {
        Screen s = mc.screen;
        if (s == null) return false;
        if (s instanceof ChatScreen || s instanceof KeyBindsScreen || s instanceof PauseScreen) return true;
        return s.getFocused() instanceof EditBox box && box.isFocused();
    }

    private static boolean isDown(Minecraft mc, KeyMapping km) {
        InputConstants.Key key = km.getKey();
        int code = key.getValue();
        if (code == InputConstants.UNKNOWN.getValue()) return false;
        long window = mc.getWindow().getWindow();
        switch (key.getType()) {
            case MOUSE:
                return GLFW.glfwGetMouseButton(window, code) == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS;
            case KEYSYM:
                return InputConstants.isKeyDown(window, code);
            default:
                return km.isDown();
        }
    }
}

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.IntegerArgumentType;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;

import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class ClientCommands {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRegisterClientCommands(RegisterClientCommandsEvent event) {
        event.getDispatcher().register(net.minecraft.commands.Commands.literal("compass")
                .then(net.minecraft.commands.Commands.literal("scale")
                        .then(net.minecraft.commands.Commands.argument("value", IntegerArgumentType.integer(1, 3))
                                .executes(context -> {
                                    int val = IntegerArgumentType.getInteger(context, "value");

                                    // РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏРµРј Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёРµ РІ РєРѕРЅС„РёРі
                                    AASConfig.COMPASS_SCALE.set(val);
                                    AASConfig.CLIENT_SPEC.save(); // Р—Р°РїРёСЃС‹РІР°РµРј С„Р°Р№Р» РЅР° РґРёСЃРє

                                    String sizeText = (val == 1) ? "Small" : (val == 3) ? "Large" : "Normal";

                                    // РРЎРџР РђР’Р›Р•РќРћ: РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј sendSuccess РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ sendFeedback
                                    context.getSource().sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Compass scale saved: " + sizeText)
                                            .withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), false);

                                    return 1;
                                })
                        )
                )
        );
    }
}

                                .suggests((ctx, builder) -> SharedSuggestionProvider.suggest(List.of("blue", "red", "none"), builder))
                                .then(Commands.argument("pos", BlockPosArgument.blockPos())
                                        // Р ВР вЂ”Р СљР вЂўР СњР вЂўР СњР С› Р СћР Р€Р Сћ: getSpawnablePos
                                        .executes(ctx -> setTeamSpawn(ctx.getSource(), StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "team"), BlockPosArgument.getSpawnablePos(ctx, "pos")))
                                )
                        )
                )
                .then(Commands.literal("map")
                        .then(Commands.literal("setimage")
                                .then(Commands.argument("imagename", StringArgumentType.word())
                                        // Р СџР С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР С”Р В°Р В·Р С”Р С‘ Р С•РЎвЂљ map1 Р Т‘Р С• map12
                                        .suggests((ctx, builder) -> SharedSuggestionProvider.suggest(
                                                List.of("map1", "map2", "map3", "map4", "map5", "map6", "map7", "map8", "map9", "map10", "map11", "map12"), builder))
                                        .executes(ctx -> {
                                            String imgName = StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "imagename");
                                            ServerLevel level = ctx.getSource().getLevel();
                                            AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

                                            data.currentMapImage = imgName;
                                            data.setDirty();
                                            PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);

                                            ctx.getSource().sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Map image set to: " + imgName + ".png"), true);
                                            return 1;
                                        })
                                )
                        )
                        .then(Commands.literal("setcenter")
                                // Р вЂќР С•Р В±Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р В°РЎР‚Р С–РЎС“Р СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ X Р С‘ Z
                                .then(Commands.argument("x", IntegerArgumentType.integer())
                                        .then(Commands.argument("z", IntegerArgumentType.integer())
                                                .executes(ctx -> {
                                                    // Р СџР С•Р В»РЎС“РЎвЂЎР В°Р ВµР С Р В·Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р С‘Р В· Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘РЎвЂ№
                                                    int x = IntegerArgumentType.getInteger(ctx, "x");
                                                    int z = IntegerArgumentType.getInteger(ctx, "z");

                                                    ServerLevel level = ctx.getSource().getLevel();
                                                    AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

                                                    data.mapCenterX = x;
                                                    data.mapCenterZ = z;
                                                    data.setDirty();

                                                    // Р РЋР С‘Р Р…РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р Т‘Р В°Р Р…Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р Вµ РЎРѓР С• Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР СР С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°Р СР С‘
                                                    PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);

                                                    ctx.getSource().sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Map center manually set to X: " + x + ", Z: " + z), true);
                                                    return 1;
                                                })
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                        .then(Commands.literal("setsize")
                                .then(Commands.argument("blocks", IntegerArgumentType.integer(128))
                                        .executes(ctx -> {
                                            int size = IntegerArgumentType.getInteger(ctx, "blocks");
                                            AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(ctx.getSource().getLevel());
                                            data.mapSizeBlocks = size;
                                            data.setDirty();
                                            PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(ctx.getSource().getLevel(), data);
                                            ctx.getSource().sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Map world size set to " + size + " blocks."), true);
                                            return 1;
                                        })))
                )

                // --- Р В¤Р В Р С’Р С™Р В¦Р ВР В ---
                .then(Commands.literal("fraction")
                        .then(Commands.argument("team", StringArgumentType.word())
                                .suggests((ctx, builder) -> SharedSuggestionProvider.suggest(List.of("blue", "red"), builder))
                                .then(Commands.argument("faction", StringArgumentType.word())
                                        .suggests((ctx, builder) -> SharedSuggestionProvider.suggest(List.of(
                                                "ukraine", "russia", "usa", "nato", "bluefor", "redfor", "insurgency", "pmc", "germany", "militia", "clear"
                                        ), builder))
                                        .executes(ctx -> setFaction(
                                                ctx.getSource(),
                                                StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "team"),
                                                StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "faction")
                                        ))
                                )
                        )
                )
                .then(Commands.literal("votestart")
                        .then(Commands.argument("active", BoolArgumentType.bool())
                                .executes(ctx -> {
                                    ServerLevel level = ctx.getSource().getLevel();
                                    AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
                                    boolean active = BoolArgumentType.getBool(ctx, "active");

                                    data.voteActive = active;

                                    if (active) {
                                        // Р ВР Р…Р С‘РЎвЂ Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С‘Р В·Р В°РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎРЏ Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎвЂљР Вµ Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ
                                        data.voteTimer = AASConfig.VOTE_AUTO_START_TIME.get() * 60;
                                        data.votes.clear();

                                        // Р РЋР В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С РЎвЂћР В»Р В°Р С–Р С‘, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ РЎРѓР С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р С• Р С–Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р Р†Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘ Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘ Р СР С•Р С–Р В»Р С‘ РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р С•РЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓР Р…Р С•Р Р†Р В°
                                        data.blueReady = false;
                                        data.redReady = false;
                                    }

                                    data.setDirty();
                                    PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);

                                    String status = active ? "started" : "stopped";
                                    ctx.getSource().sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Voting process " + status), true);

                                    return 1;
                                })))
        );
    }

    // === Р вЂ™Р РЋР СџР С›Р СљР С›Р вЂњР С’Р СћР вЂўР вЂєР В¬Р СњР В«Р в„ў Р СљР вЂўР СћР С›Р вЂќ: Р СџР С›Р вЂќР РЋР С™Р С’Р вЂ”Р С™Р В Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р вЂќР вЂєР Р‡ Р СћР вЂўР С™Р Р€Р В©Р вЂўР вЂњР С› Р СљР ВР В Р С’ ===
    private static CompletableFuture<Suggestions> suggestLocalPoints(CommandContext<CommandSourceStack> ctx, SuggestionsBuilder builder) {
        // Р вЂР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР С РЎС“РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎРЉ, Р Р† Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С•Р С Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”/Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”
        ServerLevel level = ctx.getSource().getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        List<String> pointNames = new ArrayList<>();
        for (AASWorldData.CapturePoint p : data.capturePoints) {
            pointNames.add(p.name);
        }
        return SharedSuggestionProvider.suggest(pointNames, builder);
    }

    // === Р вЂєР С›Р вЂњР ВР С™Р С’ Р С™Р С›Р СљР С’Р СњР вЂќ ===

    private static int resetVictoryScreen(CommandSourceStack source) {
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor.ALL.noArg(),
                new com.example.aas.network.PacketResetVictoryScreen());
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.translatable("aas.command.resetvictoryscreen").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }

    private static int prepareStart(CommandSourceStack source) {
        switch (com.example.aas.deck.DeckManager.start(source.getLevel())) {
            case OK -> {
                source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.translatable("aas.command.prepare.started").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
                return 1;
            }
            case GAME_RUNNING -> source.sendFailure(Component.translatable("aas.command.prepare.game_running"));
            case ALREADY_PREPARING -> source.sendFailure(Component.translatable("aas.command.prepare.already"));
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static int prepareCancel(CommandSourceStack source) {
        if (com.example.aas.deck.DeckManager.cancel(source.getLevel()) == com.example.aas.deck.DeckManager.CancelResult.OK) {
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.translatable("aas.command.prepare.cancelled").withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW), true);
            return 1;
        }
        source.sendFailure(Component.translatable("aas.command.prepare.nothing"));
        return 0;
    }

    private static int setGameStart(CommandSourceStack source, boolean active) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        if (active) {
            data.playedBlueSiren = false;
            data.playedRedSiren = false;
            GameLogicEvents.startGameCountdown(level);
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Countdown started in this world!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
            for (ServerPlayer p : level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
                // TP, SP, Р С”Р С‘Р В»Р В»РЎвЂ№, РЎРѓР СР ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘ Р С‘ РЎРѓРЎвЂЎРЎвЂРЎвЂљРЎвЂЎР С‘Р С”Р С‘ РЎС“Р Р…Р С‘РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В¶Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С•Р в„– РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘ (Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р С‘Р в„– Р С‘ Р С—Р С• Р С”Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР С–Р С•РЎР‚Р С‘РЎРЏР С)
                com.example.aas.events.StatsHandler.resetStats(p);
            }
            com.example.aas.events.OfflineStats.resetAll();
        } else {
            data.isGameStarted = false;
            com.example.aas.uav.UavManager.onMatchEnd(level, data);
            com.example.aas.deck.DeckManager.onMatchEnd(level, data);
            com.example.aas.art.ArtManager.onMatchEnd(level, data);
            GameLogicEvents.cancelCountdown(level);
            data.setDirty();
            syncDataToAll(level, data);
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Game Stopped in this world!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
        }
        return 1;
    }

    private static int setRespawnTime(CommandSourceStack source, int seconds) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        data.respawnTimer = seconds;
        data.setDirty();
        syncDataToAll(level, data);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Respawn timer set to " + seconds + "s for current world").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }

    private static int setFaction(CommandSourceStack source, String team, String faction) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String cleanFaction = faction.toLowerCase();
        String valueToSave = cleanFaction.equals("clear") ? "none" : cleanFaction;
        if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("blue")) data.blueFaction = valueToSave;
        else if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("red")) data.redFaction = valueToSave;
        data.setDirty(); syncDataToAll(level, data); return 1;
    }

    private static int setTickets(CommandSourceStack source, String team, int amount) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("blue")) {
            data.blueTickets = amount;
            if (amount > 50) data.playedBlueSiren = false; // Р РЋР В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С РЎвЂћР В»Р В°Р С–, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ РЎРѓР С‘РЎР‚Р ВµР Р…Р В° Р СР С•Р С–Р В»Р В° Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р С—Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓР Р…Р С•Р Р†Р В°
        } else if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("red")) {
            data.redTickets = amount;
            if (amount > 50) data.playedRedSiren = false; // Р РЋР В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С РЎвЂћР В»Р В°Р С–
        }
        data.setDirty(); syncDataToAll(level, data);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal(team.toUpperCase() + " tickets set to " + amount).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD), true); return 1;
    }

    private static int setDeathTickets(CommandSourceStack source, int amount) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        data.deathTicketCost = amount; data.setDirty(); syncDataToAll(level, data);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Death cost set to " + amount).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD), true); return 1;
    }

    private static int joinTeam(CommandSourceStack source, String teamName, ServerPlayer player) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        PacketSquadAction.leaveCurrentSquad(player, data);
        data.setDirty();
        syncDataToAll(level, data);
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor.ALL.noArg(), new com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncSquads(data.squads));
        Scoreboard scoreboard = source.getServer().getScoreboard();
        String internalTeamName = teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("blue") ? "Blue" : "Red";
        ChatFormatting color = teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("blue") ? ChatFormatting.BLUE : ChatFormatting.RED;
        PlayerTeam team = scoreboard.getPlayerTeam(internalTeamName);
        if (team == null) team = scoreboard.addPlayerTeam(internalTeamName);
        team.setColor(color);
        scoreboard.addPlayerToTeam(player.getScoreboardName(), team);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Player joined " + internalTeamName).withStyle(color), true);
        return 1;
    }

    private static int addPoint(CommandSourceStack source, String shape, BlockPos pos1, BlockPos pos2, String name, int bp, int rp, int time, int penalty, int captureDeduct, int lockMinutes, int gainNeut, int gainCap) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        AABB area;
        if (shape.equalsIgnoreCase("cylinder")) {
            double radius = Math.sqrt(pos1.distSqr(new BlockPos(pos2.getX(), pos1.getY(), pos2.getZ())));
            double minY = Math.min(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY());
            double maxY = Math.max(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()) + 1;
            area = new AABB(pos1.getX() - radius, minY, pos1.getZ() - radius, pos1.getX() + radius, maxY, pos1.getZ() + radius);
        } else {
            double minX = Math.min(pos1.getX(), pos2.getX());
            double minY = Math.min(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY());
            double minZ = Math.min(pos1.getZ(), pos2.getZ());
            double maxX = Math.max(pos1.getX(), pos2.getX()) + 1;
            double maxY = Math.max(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()) + 1;
            double maxZ = Math.max(pos1.getZ(), pos2.getZ()) + 1;
            area = new AABB(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ);
        }

        String upperShape = shape.toUpperCase();

        // Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў: Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР С”Р В° РЎРѓ РЎвЂљР В°Р С”Р С‘Р С Р С‘Р СР ВµР Р…Р ВµР С РЎС“Р В¶Р Вµ Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С‘ РЎвЂ¦Р В°РЎР‚Р В°Р С”РЎвЂљР ВµРЎР‚Р С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘Р С”Р С‘ РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‹РЎвЂљ РІР‚вЂќ
        // Р Р…Р Вµ РЎРѓР С•Р В·Р Т‘Р В°РЎвЂР С Р Р…Р С•Р Р†РЎС“РЎР‹ РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР С”РЎС“, Р В° Р Т‘Р С•Р В±Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎРЊРЎвЂљРЎС“ Р В·Р С•Р Р…РЎС“ Р С”Р В°Р С” Р ВµРЎвЂ°РЎвЂ Р С•Р Т‘Р Р…РЎС“ Р В·Р С•Р Р…РЎС“ РЎРѓРЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†РЎС“РЎР‹РЎвЂ°Р ВµР в„– РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР С”Р С‘.
        // Р СћР В°Р С” Р СР С•Р В¶Р Р…Р С• Р Т‘Р ВµР В»Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓР С”Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• РЎС“Р С–Р С•Р Т‘Р Р…Р С• РЎР‚Р В°Р В· Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘.
        for (AASWorldData.CapturePoint existing : data.capturePoints) {
            if (existing.name.equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
                if (existing.sameCharacteristics(bp, rp, time, penalty, captureDeduct, upperShape, lockMinutes, gainNeut, gainCap)) {
                    existing.addLinkedArea(area);
                    data.setDirty();
                    int totalZones = existing.getAllAreas().size();
                    source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Zone added to point '" + name + "'! It now has " + totalZones + " linked zone(s).").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
                    PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);
                    return 1;
                } else {
                    source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' already exists with different settings. Use identical settings to link a new zone to it, or choose another name."));
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }

        data.capturePoints.add(new AASWorldData.CapturePoint(name, area, bp, rp, time, penalty, captureDeduct, upperShape, lockMinutes, gainNeut, gainCap));
        data.setDirty();
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' (" + shape + ") added! Lock: " + lockMinutes + " min."), true);
        PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);
        return 1;
    }

    // === Р Р€Р вЂќР С’Р вЂєР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р СћР С›Р В§Р С™Р В (Р ВРЎвЂ°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р Р† РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР С Р СР С‘РЎР‚Р Вµ) ===
    private static int removePoint(CommandSourceStack source, String name) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        boolean removed = data.capturePoints.removeIf(p -> p.name.equals(name));

        if (removed) {
            data.setDirty();
            syncDataToAll(level, data);
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' removed from " + level.dimension().location()).withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
            return 1;
        }

        source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' not found in THIS world!"));
        return 0;
    }

    // === Р РЋР вЂР В Р С›Р РЋ Р С™Р С›Р СњР С™Р В Р вЂўР СћР СњР С›Р в„ў Р СћР С›Р В§Р С™Р В (Р ВРЎвЂ°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р Р† РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР С Р СР С‘РЎР‚Р Вµ) ===
    private static int clearSpecificPoint(CommandSourceStack source, String name) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        for (AASWorldData.CapturePoint point : data.capturePoints) {
            if (point.name.equals(name)) {
                // Р РЋР В±РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓ Р С—Р В°РЎР‚Р В°Р СР ВµРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†
                point.owner = "NEUTRAL";
                point.progress = 0.0f;
                point.capturingTeam = "NONE";

                data.setDirty();
                syncDataToAll(level, data);

                source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' reset to NEUTRAL in this world!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW), true);
                return 1;
            }
        }

        source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' not found in THIS world!"));
        return 0;
    }

    // === Р СџР В Р ВР СњР Р€Р вЂќР ВР СћР вЂўР вЂєР В¬Р СњР В«Р в„ў Р вЂ”Р С’Р ТђР вЂ™Р С’Р Сћ Р С™Р С›Р СњР С™Р В Р вЂўР СћР СњР С›Р в„ў Р СћР С›Р В§Р С™Р В ===
    private static int forceCapturePoint(CommandSourceStack source, String teamInput, String name) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String targetTeam = teamInput.toUpperCase();

        if (!targetTeam.equals("BLUE") && !targetTeam.equals("RED")) {
            source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Invalid team! Please use 'blue' or 'red'."));
            return 0;
        }

        for (AASWorldData.CapturePoint point : data.capturePoints) {
            if (point.name.equals(name)) {
                point.owner = targetTeam;
                point.progress = 1.0f; // 100% Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р С–РЎР‚Р ВµРЎРѓРЎРѓР В°
                point.capturingTeam = "NONE";

                data.setDirty();
                syncDataToAll(level, data); // Р С›Р В±Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎС“ Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµРЎвЂ¦ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р†

                ChatFormatting color = targetTeam.equals("BLUE") ? ChatFormatting.BLUE : ChatFormatting.RED;

                // Р РЋР С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р В°Р Т‘Р СР С‘Р Р…РЎС“
                source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' forcefully captured by " + targetTeam + "!").withStyle(color), true);

                // Р Р€Р Р†Р ВµР Т‘Р С•Р СР В»Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р Р† Р С–Р В»Р С•Р В±Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎвЂЎР В°РЎвЂљ Р С• Р В·Р В°РЎвЂ¦Р Р†Р В°РЎвЂљР Вµ
                level.getServer().getPlayerList().broadcastSystemMessage(
                        Component.literal("[ADMIN] Point " + name + " forcefully captured by " + targetTeam).withStyle(color), false
                );

                return 1;
            }
        }

        source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' not found in THIS world!"));
        return 0;
    }

    private static int setTeamSpawn(CommandSourceStack source, String teamName, BlockPos pos) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String currentDim = level.dimension().location().toString();
        if (teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("blue")) data.blueSpawns.put(currentDim, pos);
        else if (teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("red")) data.redSpawns.put(currentDim, pos);
        else if (teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("none")) data.neutralSpawns.put(currentDim, pos);
        data.setDirty(); syncDataToAll(level, data);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Spawn set for this dimension.").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true); return 1;
    }
    private static int issueWarning(CommandSourceStack source, ServerPlayer target, String message) {
        // 1. Р СњР В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р В° РЎвЂљР В°Р в„–Р СР С‘Р Р…Р С–Р С•Р Р†: 10 РЎвЂљР С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р† (0.5РЎРѓ) Р С—Р С•РЎРЏР Р†Р В»Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ, 140 РЎвЂљР С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р† (7РЎРѓ) Р Р…Р В° РЎРЊР С”РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р Вµ, 20 РЎвЂљР С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р† (1РЎРѓ) Р В·Р В°РЎвЂљРЎС“РЎвЂ¦Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р Вµ
        target.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetTitlesAnimationPacket(10, 140, 20));

        // 2. Р РЋР Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР В°Р В»Р В° Р С•РЎвЂљР С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р В·Р В°Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•Р Р†Р С•Р С” (Р РЋР В°Р С РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎРѓРЎвЂљ РЎРѓР С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ - Р В¶Р ВµР В»РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№Р С РЎвЂ Р Р†Р ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р С)
        target.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetSubtitleTextPacket(
                Component.literal(message).withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW)
        ));

        // 3. Р С›РЎвЂљР С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С–Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р В·Р В°Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•Р Р†Р С•Р С” (Р С™РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„–, Р В¶Р С‘РЎР‚Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„–)
        target.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetTitleTextPacket(
                Component.literal("!WARNING!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.DARK_RED, ChatFormatting.BOLD)
        ));

        // 4. Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С Р Р…Р ВµР С—РЎР‚Р С‘РЎРЏРЎвЂљР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р В·Р Р†РЎС“Р С” РЎС“Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‚Р В° Р Р…Р В°Р С”Р С•Р Р†Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С‘ (РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР Р…Р С• Р С•Р В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р В» Р Р†Р Р…Р С‘Р СР В°Р Р…Р С‘Р Вµ)
        target.playNotifySound(net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.ANVIL_LAND, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.MASTER, 1.0f, 0.8f);

        // 5. Р вЂќРЎС“Р В±Р В»Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С РЎРѓР С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р Р† РЎвЂЎР В°РЎвЂљ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р С•Р Р…Р С• Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р В»Р С•РЎРѓРЎРЉ Р Р† Р С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С‘Р С‘ (Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎРѓРЎвЂљ Р Т‘Р В»Р С‘Р Р…Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С‘ Р С•Р Р… Р Р…Р Вµ РЎС“РЎРѓР С—Р ВµР В» Р Т‘Р С•РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ)
        target.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("[ADMIN WARN] " + message).withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED, ChatFormatting.BOLD));

        // 6. Р СџР С•Р Т‘РЎвЂљР Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р В¶Р Т‘Р В°Р ВµР С Р В°Р Т‘Р СР С‘Р Р…РЎС“, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С• Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘РЎС“Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР В¶Р Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р С•РЎвЂљР С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В»Р ВµР Р…Р С•
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Successfully warned " + target.getScoreboardName() + "!")
                .withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);

        return 1;
    }
    private static void syncDataToAll(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);
    }
    private static int addMainZone(CommandSourceStack source, String team, String shape, BlockPos pos1, BlockPos pos2) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        AABB area;
        if (shape.equalsIgnoreCase("cylinder")) {
            double radius = Math.sqrt(pos1.distSqr(new BlockPos(pos2.getX(), pos1.getY(), pos2.getZ())));
            double minY = Math.min(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY());
            double maxY = Math.max(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()) + 1;
            area = new AABB(pos1.getX() - radius, minY, pos1.getZ() - radius, pos1.getX() + radius, maxY, pos1.getZ() + radius);
        } else {
            area = new AABB(Math.min(pos1.getX(), pos2.getX()), Math.min(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()), Math.min(pos1.getZ(), pos2.getZ()),
                    Math.max(pos1.getX(), pos2.getX()) + 1, Math.max(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()) + 1, Math.max(pos1.getZ(), pos2.getZ()) + 1);
        }

        // Р Р€Р Т‘Р В°Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎС“РЎР‹ Р В·Р С•Р Р…РЎС“ РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С•Р в„– Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘РЎвЂ№ (Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р В±РЎвЂ№Р В»Р В°)
        data.mainZones.removeIf(z -> z.team.equalsIgnoreCase(team));

        data.mainZones.add(new AASWorldData.MainProtectionZone(team.toUpperCase(), shape.toUpperCase(), area));
        data.setDirty();

        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal(team.toUpperCase() + " Main Protection Zone successfully added!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }

    private static int removeMainZone(CommandSourceStack source, String team) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        // Р СџРЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµР СРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎС“Р Т‘Р В°Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р В·Р С•Р Р…РЎС“ Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘РЎвЂ№
        boolean removed = data.mainZones.removeIf(z -> z.team.equalsIgnoreCase(team));

        if (removed) {
            data.setDirty(); // Р РЋР С•РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…РЎРЏР ВµР С Р СР С‘РЎР‚
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal(team.toUpperCase() + " Main Protection Zone removed!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        } else {
            source.sendFailure(Component.literal("No protection zone found for team: " + team.toUpperCase()));
        }
        return 1;
    }
    // === Р СљР вЂўР СћР С›Р вЂќ Р вЂќР вЂєР Р‡ Р С›Р В§Р ВР РЋР СћР С™Р В Р С›Р СћР В Р Р‡Р вЂќР С›Р вЂ™ (Clear Squads) ===
    private static int clearSquads(CommandSourceStack source, String teamName) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String targetTeam = teamName.toUpperCase();

        // 1. Р РЋР В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С РЎвЂљР ВµР С–Р С‘ РЎС“ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р†
        for (ServerPlayer player : source.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            if (player.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_SquadID")) {
                boolean belongsToTeam = data.squads.stream()
                        .anyMatch(s -> s.id == player.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_SquadID") && s.team.equalsIgnoreCase(targetTeam));

                if (belongsToTeam) {
                    player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_SquadID");
                    player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_IsSquadLeader");
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Р Р€Р Т‘Р В°Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘РЎвЂ№
        data.squads.removeIf(squad -> squad.team.equalsIgnoreCase(targetTeam));

        // === 3. Р РЋР вЂР В Р С’Р РЋР В«Р вЂ™Р С’Р вЂўР Сљ CMD (Р вЂќР С•Р В±Р В°Р Р†РЎРЉ РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С‘ РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С‘) ===
        if (targetTeam.equals("BLUE")) {
            data.blueCMDId = -1;
        } else if (targetTeam.equals("RED")) {
            data.redCMDId = -1;
        }
        // ============================================

        data.setDirty();
        PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);
        // Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў: Р С•Р В±Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С•Р С” Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р С•Р Р† РЎС“ Р вЂ™Р РЋР вЂўР Тђ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р†
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor.ALL.noArg(),
                new com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncSquads(data.squads));

        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Cleared squads and CMD for " + targetTeam).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }
    private static int openEditPointGui(CommandSourceStack source, String name) {
        ServerPlayer player = source.getPlayer();
        if (player == null) return 0;

        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        for (AASWorldData.CapturePoint p : data.capturePoints) {
            if (p.name.equals(name)) {

                // Р вЂ™Р С•РЎРѓРЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р В»Р С‘Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С Р С•РЎР‚Р С‘Р С–Р С‘Р Р…Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р Вµ Р С”Р С•Р С•РЎР‚Р Т‘Р С‘Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ pos1 Р С‘ pos2 Р С‘Р В· Р С–Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р Р†Р С•Р С–Р С• РЎвЂ¦Р С‘РЎвЂљР В±Р С•Р С”РЎРѓР В° AABB
                int p1x, p1y, p1z, p2x, p2y, p2z;
                if (p.shapeType.equals("CYLINDER")) {
                    p1x = (int) ((p.area.minX + p.area.maxX) / 2);
                    p1y = (int) p.area.minY;
                    p1z = (int) ((p.area.minZ + p.area.maxZ) / 2);
                    p2x = (int) p.area.maxX;
                    p2y = (int) p.area.maxY - 1;
                    p2z = p1z;
                } else {
                    p1x = (int) p.area.minX;
                    p1y = (int) p.area.minY;
                    p1z = (int) p.area.minZ;
                    p2x = (int) p.area.maxX - 1;
                    p2y = (int) p.area.maxY - 1;
                    p2z = (int) p.area.maxZ - 1;
                }

                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(
                        net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> player),
                        new com.example.aas.network.PacketOpenPointEditor(
                                p.name, p.shapeType,
                                p1x, p1y, p1z, p2x, p2y, p2z,
                                p.bluePriority, p.redPriority,
                                p.captureTimeMinutes, p.ticketPenalty,
                                p.captureDeduction, p.lockDurationMinutes,
                                p.ticketGainNeutralize, p.ticketGainCapture
                        )
                );
                return 1;
            }
        }
        source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Point '" + name + "' not found!"));
        return 0;
    }
    private static int setMaxHubs(CommandSourceStack source, String team, int amount) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("blue")) {
            data.maxBlueHubs = amount;
        } else if (team.equalsIgnoreCase("red")) {
            data.maxRedHubs = amount;
        } else {
            source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Invalid team! Please use 'blue' or 'red'."));
            return 0;
        }

        data.setDirty();
        // Р вЂ™Р С’Р вЂ“Р СњР С›: Р РЋР С‘Р Р…РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓ Р С”Р В»Р С‘Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР С•Р С Р Р…Р Вµ Р С•Р В±РЎРЏР В·Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•, РЎвЂљР В°Р С” Р С”Р В°Р С” РЎС“РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р В° Р ТђР В°Р В±Р В° Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р Вµ
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Max FOBs for " + team.toUpperCase() + " set to " + amount).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }
    private static int setPvPState(CommandSourceStack source, boolean state) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        data.pvpEnabled = state;
        data.setDirty(); // Р РЋР С•РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С‘Р В·Р СР ВµР Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Р† Р СР С‘РЎР‚

        String status = state ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED";
        ChatFormatting color = state ? ChatFormatting.GREEN : ChatFormatting.YELLOW;
        Component msg = Component.literal("[AAS] PvP between players is now " + status + " in this world.")
                .withStyle(color);

        // Р С›РЎвЂљР С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎРѓР С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р В°Р С (РЎС“РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎРЉ Р С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р† 2+)
        for (ServerPlayer player : source.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            if (player.hasPermissions(2)) {
                player.sendSystemMessage(msg);
            }
        }

        // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘РЎС“ Р Р†Р Р†Р ВµР В»Р В° Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎРѓР С•Р В»РЎРЉ РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р В°, Р Р…РЎС“Р В¶Р Р…Р С• Р С•РЎвЂљР С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С•РЎвЂљР Р†Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С‘ Р ВµР в„–
        if (!(source.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer)) {
            source.sendSuccess(() -> msg, true);
        }

        return 1;
    }
    // === Р РЋР СљР вЂўР СњР С’ Р ВР вЂњР В Р С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂњР С› Р В Р вЂўР вЂ“Р ВР СљР С’ ===
    private static int setGameMode(CommandSourceStack source, String mode) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        String newMode = mode.toUpperCase();

        if (!newMode.equals("AAS") && !newMode.equals("INVASION")) {
            source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Invalid game mode! Use 'aas' or 'invasion'."));
            return 0;
        }

        data.gameMode = newMode;
        data.setDirty();
        syncDataToAll(level, data); // Р РЋР С‘Р Р…РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р С‘Р В·Р СР ВµР Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ РЎРѓ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°Р СР С‘

        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Game Mode successfully set to: " + newMode).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }
    private static int setInvasionDefender(CommandSourceStack source, String teamInput) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = teamInput.toUpperCase();

        if (!team.equals("BLUE") && !team.equals("RED")) {
            source.sendFailure(Component.literal("Use 'blue' or 'red'!"));
            return 0;
        }

        data.invasionDefender = team;
        data.setDirty();

        // Р РЋР С‘Р Р…РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С РЎРѓР С• Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР СР С‘
        PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);

        String attacker = team.equals("BLUE") ? "RED" : "BLUE";
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Invasion Setup: ")
                .append(Component.literal(team).withStyle(team.equals("BLUE") ? ChatFormatting.BLUE : ChatFormatting.RED))
                .append(" is DEFENDING, ")
                .append(Component.literal(attacker).withStyle(attacker.equals("BLUE") ? ChatFormatting.BLUE : ChatFormatting.RED))
                .append(" is ATTACKING."), true);

        return 1;
    }
    private static int showStats(CommandSourceStack source, ServerPlayer target) {
        int tp = target.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_TeamPoints");
        int sp = target.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_SquadPoints");
        int total = tp + sp;

        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("=== STATS: " + target.getScoreboardName() + " ===").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD), false);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Team Points (TP): ").withStyle(ChatFormatting.AQUA).append(Component.literal(String.valueOf(tp)).withStyle(ChatFormatting.WHITE)), false);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Squad Points (SP): ").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN).append(Component.literal(String.valueOf(sp)).withStyle(ChatFormatting.WHITE)), false);
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Total Score: ").withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW).append(Component.literal(String.valueOf(total)).withStyle(ChatFormatting.WHITE)), false);

        return 1;
    }
    private static int showTopStats(CommandSourceStack source, String scope) {
        // Р СџР С•Р В»РЎС“РЎвЂЎР В°Р ВµР С Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµРЎвЂ¦ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р† Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р Вµ
        List<ServerPlayer> players = source.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers();

        // Р вЂ™РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р СР С•Р С–Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С”Р В»Р В°РЎРѓРЎРѓ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ РЎРѓР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р С‘
        class PlayerScore {
            final String name;
            final int totalPoints;
            final String team;

            PlayerScore(ServerPlayer p) {
                this.name = p.getScoreboardName();
                int tp = p.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_TeamPoints");
                int sp = p.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_SquadPoints");
                this.totalPoints = tp + sp;
                this.team = (p.getTeam() != null) ? p.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
            }
        }

        // Р РЋР С•Р В±Р С‘РЎР‚Р В°Р ВµР С РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С•Р С” Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘РЎРЏРЎвЂ°Р С‘РЎвЂ¦ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р†
        List<PlayerScore> scores = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ServerPlayer p : players) {
            PlayerScore ps = new PlayerScore(p);

            // Р В¤Р С‘Р В»РЎРЉРЎвЂљРЎР‚ 1: Р С›РЎвЂЎР С”Р С•Р Р† Р В±Р С•Р В»РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р Вµ 0
            if (ps.totalPoints <= 0) continue;

            // Р В¤Р С‘Р В»РЎРЉРЎвЂљРЎР‚ 2: Р СџР С• Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р Вµ (Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р Р…Р Вµ ALL)
            if (!scope.equals("ALL")) {
                if (!ps.team.contains(scope)) continue; // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С Р Р†РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р В¶Р Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С‘ (BLUE/RED)
            }

            scores.add(ps);
        }

        // Р РЋР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р В° Р С•РЎвЂљ Р В±Р С•Р В»РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р ВµР С–Р С• Р С” Р СР ВµР Р…РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р ВµР СРЎС“
        scores.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b.totalPoints, a.totalPoints));

        // Р вЂ™РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р С•Р Т‘ Р В·Р В°Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р В°
        String header = scope.equals("ALL") ? "--- GLOBAL TOP PLAYERS ---" : "--- TOP PLAYERS: " + scope + " ---";
        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal(header).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD, ChatFormatting.BOLD), false);

        if (scores.isEmpty()) {
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("No players with points found in this category.").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GRAY), false);
            return 1;
        }

        // Р вЂ™РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р С•Р Т‘ РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С”Р В°
        for (int i = 0; i < scores.size(); i++) {
            PlayerScore ps = scores.get(i);
            int rank = i + 1;

            ChatFormatting teamColor = ps.team.contains("BLUE") ? ChatFormatting.BLUE :
                    (ps.team.contains("RED") ? ChatFormatting.RED : ChatFormatting.GRAY);

            // Р В¤Р С•РЎР‚Р СР В°РЎвЂљ: "1. NickName - 150 pts"
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal(rank + ". ")
                    .withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW)
                    .append(Component.literal(ps.name).withStyle(teamColor))
                    .append(Component.literal(" - " + ps.totalPoints + " pts").withStyle(ChatFormatting.WHITE)), false);
        }

        return 1;
    }
    private static int addCenterLobbyZone(CommandSourceStack source, BlockPos pos) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        data.lobbyCenter = pos;
        data.setDirty();

        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Lobby teleport point set to " + pos.getX() + ", " + pos.getY() + ", " + pos.getZ())
                .withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }

    private static int addLobbyZone(CommandSourceStack source, String shape, BlockPos pos1, BlockPos pos2) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        AABB area;
        if (shape.equalsIgnoreCase("cylinder")) {
            double radius = Math.sqrt(pos1.distSqr(new BlockPos(pos2.getX(), pos1.getY(), pos2.getZ())));
            double minY = Math.min(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY());
            double maxY = Math.max(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()) + 1;
            area = new AABB(pos1.getX() - radius, minY, pos1.getZ() - radius, pos1.getX() + radius, maxY, pos1.getZ() + radius);
        } else {
            area = new AABB(Math.min(pos1.getX(), pos2.getX()), Math.min(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()), Math.min(pos1.getZ(), pos2.getZ()),
                    Math.max(pos1.getX(), pos2.getX()) + 1, Math.max(pos1.getY(), pos2.getY()) + 1, Math.max(pos1.getZ(), pos2.getZ()) + 1);
        }

        data.lobbyZones.add(new AASWorldData.LobbyZone(shape.toUpperCase(), area));
        data.setDirty();

        source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Lobby zone added! (" + data.lobbyZones.size() + " total)")
                .withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        return 1;
    }

    private static int removeLobbyZone(CommandSourceStack source) {
        ServerLevel level = source.getLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);

        boolean removed = !data.lobbyZones.isEmpty();
        data.lobbyZones.clear();

        if (removed) {
            data.setDirty();
            source.sendSuccess(() -> Component.literal("Lobby zone(s) removed!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
        } else {
            source.sendFailure(Component.literal("No lobby zone found."));
        }
        return 1;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.config;

import com.example.aas.entity.SupplyCrateEntity;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncServerConfig;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.event.config.ModConfigEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import net.minecraftforge.server.ServerLifecycleHooks;

/** Pushes server config to clients on reload + server-side build range validation. */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
public class AASConfigSync {

    /** Fires when config file changes on disk (or is saved from the config screen). */
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onReload(ModConfigEvent.Reloading event) {
        if (event.getConfig().getSpec() != AASConfig.SPEC) return;
        MinecraftServer server = ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer();
        if (server == null) return; // pure client: nothing to broadcast
        // the watcher fires on another thread -> hop to the server thread
        server.execute(() ->
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.ALL.noArg(), PacketSyncServerConfig.fromConfig()));
    }

    /**
     * Server-side check: is `pos` within hubBuildRadius of an own/neutral constructed HUB
     * or within crateBuildRadius of an own/neutral Supply Crate? Creative bypasses.
     * Call from the build handler (PacketBuildRequest) BEFORE spending materials / placing.
     */
    public static boolean isInBuildRange(ServerPlayer player, BlockPos pos) {
        if (player.isCreative()) return true;

        String team = player.getTeam() != null ? player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
        String dim = player.level().dimension().location().toString();

        double hubR = AASConfig.HUB_BUILD_RADIUS.get();
        double hubRSq = hubR * hubR;
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(player.serverLevel());
        for (AASWorldData.HubInfo hub : data.hubs) {
            if (!hub.constructed) continue;
            if (hub.dimension != null && !hub.dimension.equals(dim)) continue;
            if (!hub.team.equalsIgnoreCase(team) && !hub.team.equalsIgnoreCase("NEUTRAL")) continue;
            if (hub.pos.distSqr(pos) <= hubRSq) return true;
        }

        double crateR = AASConfig.CRATE_BUILD_RADIUS.get();
        for (SupplyCrateEntity crate : player.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
                SupplyCrateEntity.class, new AABB(pos).inflate(crateR))) {
            String owner = crate.getTeamOwner();
            if (!owner.equalsIgnoreCase(team) && !owner.equals("NEUTRAL")) continue;
            if (crate.distanceToSqr(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5) <= crateR * crateR)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.deck;

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import com.example.aas.events.GameLogicEvents;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketDeckInfo;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.example.aas.world.VehicleSpawnerRegistry;
import com.example.aas.block.VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.GameType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.ForgeRegistries;
import net.minecraftforge.server.ServerLifecycleHooks;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import com.example.aas.util.VehicleCatalog;

/**
 * Server side of "preparation + deck choice":
 *   /aas prepare start -> TEAM_SELECT (10 s) -> DECK_VOTE (30 s) -> VERSUS (5 s) -> the usual "vote to start" -> countdown + match.
 * All state lives in AASWorldData (saved), the clients only display what PacketSyncGameData tells them.
 */
public final class DeckManager {
    private DeckManager() {}

    public static final int TEAM_SELECT_TICKS = 10 * 20;
    public static final int DECK_VOTE_TICKS = 30 * 20;
    public static final int VERSUS_TICKS = 5 * 20;

    public enum StartResult { OK, GAME_RUNNING, ALREADY_PREPARING }
    public enum CancelResult { OK, NOTHING }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    /** Creative players and spectators are observers: no team screen, no vote, no VS screen for them. */
    public static boolean isParticipant(ServerPlayer p) {
        return !p.isSpectator() && !p.isCreative();
    }

    /** "BLUE", "RED" or null. */
    public static String teamOf(ServerPlayer p) {
        if (p.getTeam() == null) return null;
        String n = p.getTeam().getName();
        if (n.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue")) return "BLUE";
        if (n.equalsIgnoreCase("Red")) return "RED";
        return null;
    }

    private static void sync(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(level, data);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ /aas prepare start | cancel

    public static StartResult start(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        if (data.isGameStarted || data.countdownActive) return StartResult.GAME_RUNNING;
        if (data.prepPhase != DeckPhase.NONE) return StartResult.ALREADY_PREPARING;

        data.blueDeck = null;
        data.redDeck = null;
        data.blueDeckVotes.clear();
        data.redDeckVotes.clear();
        // the classic "press to be ready" pre-match vote must not run during the preparation
        data.voteActive = false;
        data.blueReady = false;
        data.redReady = false;

        // 0. creative players become survival players (spectators stay as they are)
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (p.isSpectator()) continue;
            if (p.gameMode.getGameModeForPlayer() == GameType.CREATIVE) p.setGameMode(GameType.SURVIVAL);
        }

        // 1. everybody who has a team goes to the main base of that team (teamless players stay where they are, in the lobby)
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (p.isSpectator() || !p.isAlive()) continue;
            String team = teamOf(p);
            if (team != null) TeamBalance.teleportToMain(p, data, team);
        }

        // 2. the lobby zone stops pulling players back (lobbyZones / lobbyCenter stay untouched)
        data.lobbyDisabled = true;

        // 3. full health and food
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (p.isSpectator() || !p.isAlive()) continue;
            p.setHealth(p.getMaxHealth());
            p.getFoodData().setFoodLevel(20);
            p.getFoodData().setSaturation(20.0F);
        }

        // 4. team selection for those without a team, then (5.) the deck vote
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            p.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.prepare_started").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GOLD));
        }
        if (unassignedPlayers(level).isEmpty()) {
            beginDeckVote(level, data);
        } else {
            data.prepPhase = DeckPhase.TEAM_SELECT;
            data.prepTimer = TEAM_SELECT_TICKS;
            data.setDirty();
            sync(level, data);
        }
        return StartResult.OK;
    }

    public static CancelResult cancel(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        boolean wasPreparing = data.prepPhase != DeckPhase.NONE;
        // the countdown that the preparation started (decks chosen, match not running yet)
        boolean prepCountdown = !data.isGameStarted && data.countdownActive && (data.blueDeck != null || data.redDeck != null);
        // the "vote to start" that follows the deck vote (decks are chosen, match not started yet)
        boolean prepStartVote = !data.isGameStarted && data.voteActive && (data.blueDeck != null || data.redDeck != null);
        if (!wasPreparing && !prepCountdown && !prepStartVote) return CancelResult.NOTHING;

        if (prepStartVote) {
            data.voteActive = false;
            data.votes.clear();
            data.blueReady = false;
            data.redReady = false;
        }

        if (prepCountdown) GameLogicEvents.cancelCountdown(level);
        resetPreparation(data);
        data.lobbyDisabled = false;
        data.setDirty();
        sync(level, data);
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            p.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.prepare_cancelled").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
        }
        return CancelResult.OK;
    }

    private static void resetPreparation(AASWorldData data) {
        data.prepPhase = DeckPhase.NONE;
        data.prepTimer = 0;
        data.blueDeck = null;
        data.redDeck = null;
        data.blueDeckVotes.clear();
        data.redDeckVotes.clear();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ per-tick state machine

    public static void tick(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data, int globalTick) {
        DeckPhase phase = data.prepPhase;
        if (phase == DeckPhase.NONE) return;

        // somebody started the match by hand (/aas gamestart true) - the preparation is over
        if (data.isGameStarted) {
            data.prepPhase = DeckPhase.NONE;
            data.prepTimer = 0;
            data.setDirty();
            sync(level, data);
            return;
        }

        data.prepTimer--;
        boolean everySecond = data.prepTimer > 0 && data.prepTimer % 20 == 0;

        switch (phase) {
            case TEAM_SELECT -> {
                List<ServerPlayer> unassigned = unassignedPlayers(level);
                if (unassigned.isEmpty() || data.prepTimer <= 0) {
                    autoAssign(level, data, unassigned);
                    beginDeckVote(level, data);
                } else if (everySecond) {
                    data.setDirty();
                    sync(level, data);
                }
            }
            case DECK_VOTE -> {
                if (everySecond) {
                    // players who joined during the vote are put into a team, so they can vote too
                    autoAssign(level, data, unassignedPlayers(level));
                }
                if (data.prepTimer <= 0) {
                    finishVote(level, data);
                } else if (everySecond) {
                    data.setDirty();
                    sync(level, data);
                }
            }
            case VERSUS -> {
                if (data.prepTimer <= 0) finishPreparation(level, data);
                else if (everySecond) {
                    data.setDirty();
                    sync(level, data);
                }
            }
            default -> { }
        }
    }

    private static List<ServerPlayer> unassignedPlayers(ServerLevel level) {
        List<ServerPlayer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (isParticipant(p) && teamOf(p) == null) out.add(p);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Smaller team first, a coin flip on equality. Uses the same TeamBalance as PacketTeamSelect. */
    private static void autoAssign(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data, List<ServerPlayer> players) {
        if (players.isEmpty()) return;
        List<ServerPlayer> shuffled = new ArrayList<>(players);
        Collections.shuffle(shuffled);
        MinecraftServer server = level.getServer();
        for (ServerPlayer p : shuffled) {
            String team = TeamBalance.pickTeam(server, p);
            TeamBalance.assign(p, team, data, true);
            boolean blue = team.equals("BLUE");
            p.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.joined_team", TeamBalance.displayName(data, blue))
                    .withStyle(blue ? ChatFormatting.BLUE : ChatFormatting.RED));
        }
    }

    private static void beginDeckVote(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        data.prepPhase = DeckPhase.DECK_VOTE;
        data.prepTimer = DECK_VOTE_TICKS;
        data.blueDeckVotes.clear();
        data.redDeckVotes.clear();
        data.setDirty();
        // nothing to vote about when both teams have one deck only
        if (data.enabledDecks("BLUE").size() <= 1 && data.enabledDecks("RED").size() <= 1) {
            finishVote(level, data);
            return;
        }
        sync(level, data);
    }

    private static void finishVote(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        data.blueDeck = pickWinner(level, data, "BLUE");
        data.redDeck = pickWinner(level, data, "RED");
        data.prepPhase = DeckPhase.VERSUS;
        data.prepTimer = VERSUS_TICKS;
        data.setDirty();
        sync(level, data);

        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            String team = teamOf(p);
            if (team == null) continue;
            boolean blue = team.equals("BLUE");
            DeckType d = blue ? data.blueDeck : data.redDeck;
            if (d == null) continue;
            p.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.prepare_deck_result",
                            Component.translatable(DeckRegistry.nameKey(blue ? data.blueFaction : data.redFaction, blue, d)))
                    .withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW));
        }
    }

    /** Most votes wins; a tie or no votes at all = random among the leaders (all enabled decks when nobody voted). */
    private static DeckType pickWinner(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data, String team) {
        List<DeckType> enabled = data.enabledDecks(team);
        int[] votes = countVotes(data, team);
        int max = 0;
        for (DeckType d : enabled) max = Math.max(max, votes[d.ordinal()]);
        List<DeckType> leaders = new ArrayList<>();
        for (DeckType d : enabled) if (votes[d.ordinal()] == max) leaders.add(d);
        if (leaders.isEmpty()) return DeckType.COMBINED;
        return leaders.get(level.getRandom().nextInt(leaders.size()));
    }

    /** The VS screen is over: the usual "vote to start" (F9 / F10) begins; the countdown starts when both teams are ready. */
    private static void finishPreparation(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        data.prepPhase = DeckPhase.NONE;
        data.prepTimer = 0;
        data.playedBlueSiren = false;
        data.playedRedSiren = false;
        data.setDirty();

        for (ServerPlayer p : level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            com.example.aas.events.StatsHandler.resetStats(p);
        }
        com.example.aas.events.OfflineStats.resetAll();

        // same as "/aas votestart true": GameLogicEvents starts the countdown when both teams are ready or the timer ends
        data.voteActive = true;
        data.voteTimer = AASConfig.VOTE_AUTO_START_TIME.get() * 60;
        data.votes.clear();
        data.blueReady = false;
        data.redReady = false;
        data.setDirty();
        sync(level, data);
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            p.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.prepare_vote_start").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ votes

    /** A player clicked a deck card. Can be changed until the timer is over. */
    public static void handleVote(ServerPlayer player, int deckOrdinal) {
        ServerLevel level = player.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        if (data.prepPhase != DeckPhase.DECK_VOTE) return;
        String team = teamOf(player);
        DeckType deck = DeckType.byOrdinal(deckOrdinal);
        if (team == null || deck == null || !isParticipant(player)) return;
        if (!data.paramsFor(team, deck).enabled) return;

        Map<UUID, DeckType> votes = team.equals("BLUE") ? data.blueDeckVotes : data.redDeckVotes;
        votes.put(player.getUUID(), deck);
        data.setDirty();
        sync(level, data);
    }

    /**
     * Vote counters of one team. Only players who are online, still in that team and still participants are counted
     * (logged out players do not break the count and do not keep their vote).
     */
    public static int[] countVotes(AASWorldData data, String team) {
        int[] out = new int[DeckType.COUNT];
        MinecraftServer server = ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer();
        if (server == null) return out;
        boolean blue = team.equalsIgnoreCase("BLUE");
        Map<UUID, DeckType> votes = blue ? data.blueDeckVotes : data.redDeckVotes;
        for (Map.Entry<UUID, DeckType> e : votes.entrySet()) {
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(e.getKey());
            if (p == null || !isParticipant(p)) continue;
            String t = teamOf(p);
            if (t == null || !t.equals(blue ? "BLUE" : "RED")) continue;
            if (!data.paramsFor(t, e.getValue()).enabled) continue;
            out[e.getValue().ordinal()]++;
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ match start / end hooks

    /**
     * Called from GameLogicEvents exactly when isGameStarted becomes true (both /aas gamestart true and the automatic
     * start after the preparation). Applies the hub limit and the starting tickets of the chosen decks.
     * No chosen deck (match started without preparation) = nothing is touched.
     */
    public static void onMatchStart(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        DeckType b = data.blueDeck;
        DeckType r = data.redDeck;
        if (b == null && r == null) return;

        if (!data.hubsOverridden) {
            data.prevMaxBlueHubs = data.maxBlueHubs;
            data.prevMaxRedHubs = data.maxRedHubs;
            data.hubsOverridden = true;
        }
        if (b != null) {
            DeckParams p = data.paramsFor("BLUE", b);
            data.maxBlueHubs = p.hubLimit;
            data.blueTickets = p.tickets;
        }
        if (r != null) {
            DeckParams p = data.paramsFor("RED", r);
            data.maxRedHubs = p.hubLimit;
            data.redTickets = p.tickets;
        }
        data.playedBlueSiren = false;
        data.playedRedSiren = false;
        data.setDirty();
        // the caller sends the sync packet right after this (sendSyncPacket in the countdown block)
    }

    /**
     * Called when the match stops (victory, "/aas gamestart false"): restores the hub limits, forgets the chosen decks,
     * re-enables the lobby zone. The spawner redstone blocks are removed by the spawner block entities themselves.
     */
    public static void onMatchEnd(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data) {
        if (data.hubsOverridden) {
            data.maxBlueHubs = data.prevMaxBlueHubs;
            data.maxRedHubs = data.prevMaxRedHubs;
            data.hubsOverridden = false;
        }
        resetPreparation(data);
        data.lobbyDisabled = false;
        data.setDirty();
        sync(level, data);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ data for the "?" window

    /** Everything the "?" window shows for one deck of one team. Computed on the server, the client never reads AASWorldData. */
    public static PacketDeckInfo buildInfo(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData data, String team, DeckType deck) {
        DeckParams p = data.paramsFor(team, deck);

        // vehicle id -> {count, penalty, marker type}
        Map<String, int[]> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, String> markers = new HashMap<>();
        VehicleSpawnerRegistry registry = VehicleSpawnerRegistry.get(level);
        for (Map.Entry<BlockPos, VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot> en : registry.copy().entrySet()) {
            VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot s = en.getValue();
            if (level.isLoaded(en.getKey())) {
                BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(en.getKey());
                if (be instanceof VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity spawner) s = VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot.of(spawner);
            }
            if (!s.team().equalsIgnoreCase(team)) continue;
            String id = s.vehicleId(deck);
            if (id.isEmpty()) continue;
            int[] c = counts.computeIfAbsent(id, k -> new int[2]);
            c[0]++;
            c[1] = Math.max(c[1], s.penalty(deck));
            String mt = s.markerType(deck);
            markers.putIfAbsent(id, mt == null ? "" : mt);
        }
        List<PacketDeckInfo.VehicleLine> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, int[]> e : counts.entrySet()) {
            ResourceLocation rl = ResourceLocation.tryParse(e.getKey());
            String key = e.getKey();
            if (rl != null && ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.containsKey(rl)) {
                EntityType<?> type = ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.getValue(rl);
                if (type != null) key = type.getDescriptionId();
            }
            lines.add(new PacketDeckInfo.VehicleLine(key, e.getValue()[0], markers.get(e.getKey()), e.getValue()[1]));
        }
        // same order as the vehicle list: by category, then by name key
        lines.sort((x, y) -> {
            int c = Integer.compare(VehicleCatalog.resolve(null, x.markerType()).ordinal(),
                    VehicleCatalog.resolve(null, y.markerType()).ordinal());
            return c != 0 ? c : x.nameKey().compareTo(y.nameKey());
        });

        AASWorldData.KitInfo aa = data.kitsFor(team, deck).get("Anti_air");
        AASWorldData.KitInfo hat = data.kitsFor(team, deck).get("HAT");
        return new PacketDeckInfo(deck.ordinal(), p.enabled, p.hubLimit, p.crateBonus, p.tickets,
                aa == null ? -1 : aa.maxPerTeam, hat == null ? -1 : hat.maxPerTeam,
                AASConfig.SUPPLY_CRATE_MATERIALS.get() + p.crateBonus, lines);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ admin: which deck is being edited

    /** The deck the admin currently edits in the kit / deck menus (kept on the server, so every kit packet knows it). */
    public static DeckType editDeckOf(ServerPlayer p) {
        DeckType d = DeckType.fromId(p.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_EditDeck"));
        return d == null ? DeckType.COMBINED : d;
    }

    public static void setEditDeck(ServerPlayer p, DeckType d) {
        p.getPersistentData().putString("AAS_EditDeck", d.id);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.deck;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

/** Per-team, per-deck settings edited in the admin menu. */
public final class DeckParams {
    public static final int DEFAULT_HUB_LIMIT = 4;
    public static final int LOGISTICS_HUB_LIMIT = 6;
    public static final int LOGISTICS_CRATE_BONUS = 50;
    public static final int DEFAULT_TICKETS = 800;
    public static final int MAX_CRATE_BONUS = 1000;

    /** A disabled deck is not shown in the vote and cannot win. */
    public boolean enabled = true;
    /** Max hubs of the team when this deck wins (copied to maxBlueHubs / maxRedHubs at match start). */
    public int hubLimit = DEFAULT_HUB_LIMIT;
    /** Added to AASConfig.SUPPLY_CRATE_MATERIALS for every crate the team drops. 0..1000. */
    public int crateBonus = 0;
    /** Starting tickets of the team. >= 0. */
    public int tickets = DEFAULT_TICKETS;

    public static DeckParams defaultsFor(DeckType deck) {
        DeckParams p = new DeckParams();
        if (deck == DeckType.LOGISTICS) {
            p.hubLimit = LOGISTICS_HUB_LIMIT;
            p.crateBonus = LOGISTICS_CRATE_BONUS;
        }
        return p;
    }

    public DeckParams copy() {
        DeckParams p = new DeckParams();
        p.enabled = enabled;
        p.hubLimit = hubLimit;
        p.crateBonus = crateBonus;
        p.tickets = tickets;
        return p;
    }

    /** Brings every value into its legal range. */
    public void clamp() {
        if (hubLimit < 0) hubLimit = 0;
        if (crateBonus < 0) crateBonus = 0;
        if (crateBonus > MAX_CRATE_BONUS) crateBonus = MAX_CRATE_BONUS;
        if (tickets < 0) tickets = 0;
    }

    public CompoundTag save() {
        CompoundTag t = new CompoundTag();
        t.putBoolean("Enabled", enabled);
        t.putInt("HubLimit", hubLimit);
        t.putInt("CrateBonus", crateBonus);
        t.putInt("Tickets", tickets);
        return t;
    }

    public static DeckParams load(CompoundTag t, DeckType deck) {
        DeckParams p = defaultsFor(deck);
        if (t.contains("Enabled")) p.enabled = t.getBoolean("Enabled");
        if (t.contains("HubLimit")) p.hubLimit = t.getInt("HubLimit");
        if (t.contains("CrateBonus")) p.crateBonus = t.getInt("CrateBonus");
        if (t.contains("Tickets")) p.tickets = t.getInt("Tickets");
        p.clamp();
        return p;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.deck;

/** Phases of the "preparation" that precedes a match (see DeckManager). */
public enum DeckPhase {
    NONE,
    TEAM_SELECT,
    DECK_VOTE,
    VERSUS;

    public static DeckPhase byOrdinal(int i) {
        return i >= 0 && i < values().length ? values()[i] : NONE;
    }

    public static DeckPhase fromName(String s) {
        for (DeckPhase p : values()) if (p.name().equalsIgnoreCase(s)) return p;
        return NONE;
    }
}

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.HashMap;

/**
 * Data table: for every faction and every one of the 7 decks the display name (lang key
 * aas.deck.<faction>.<deckId>, translated in en_us / ru_ru / uk_ua) and the emblem texture path.
 *
 * Names that are invented (no real unit fits the class) are flagged here and in the lang files with the key
 * aas.deck.<faction>.<deckId>._fictional, so they are easy to find and replace.
 * Adding a faction = add it to FACTIONS, add 7 reg(...) lines and 7 lang keys. No logic depends on the names.
 */
public final class DeckRegistry {
    private DeckRegistry() {}

    /** Every faction that has all 7 decks. */
    public static final List<String> FACTIONS = List.of(
            "ukraine", "russia", "usa", "nato", "bluefor", "redfor", "insurgency", "pmc", "germany", "militia");

    public record Entry(String nameKey, boolean fictional) {}

    private static final Map<String, Map<DeckType, Entry>> TABLE = new HashMap<>();

    private static void reg(String faction, DeckType deck, boolean fictional) {
        TABLE.computeIfAbsent(faction, k -> new HashMap<>())
                .put(deck, new Entry("aas.deck." + faction + "." + deck.id, fictional));
    }

    static {

    /**
     * Maps a faction id coming from the world data ("none", unknown ids, null) to a faction that has a table:
     * BLUE falls back to "bluefor", RED to "redfor".
     */
    public static String resolveFaction(String faction, boolean blueTeam) {
        if (faction != null) {
            String f = faction.toLowerCase();
            if (TABLE.containsKey(f)) return f;
        }
        return blueTeam ? "bluefor" : "redfor";
    }

    public static Entry entry(String faction, boolean blueTeam, DeckType deck) {
        return TABLE.get(resolveFaction(faction, blueTeam)).get(deck);
    }

    /** Lang key of the unit name, e.g. aas.deck.russia.armor */
    public static String nameKey(String faction, boolean blueTeam, DeckType deck) {
        return entry(faction, blueTeam, deck).nameKey();
    }

    /** assets/aas/textures/gui/decks/emblem/<faction>/<deckId>.png (may not exist - the client draws a circle then). */
    public static ResourceLocation emblemTexture(String faction, boolean blueTeam, DeckType deck) {
        return new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/decks/emblem/" + resolveFaction(faction, blueTeam) + "/" + deck.id + ".png");
    }

    /** Also accepted: assets/aas/textures/gui/decks/<faction>/<deckId>.png (without the "emblem" folder). */
    public static ResourceLocation emblemTextureAlt(String faction, boolean blueTeam, DeckType deck) {
        return new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/decks/" + resolveFaction(faction, blueTeam) + "/" + deck.id + ".png");
    }

    /** assets/aas/textures/gui/decks/class/<deckId>.png */
    public static ResourceLocation classIcon(DeckType deck) {
        return new ResourceLocation("aas", "textures/gui/decks/class/" + deck.id + ".png");
    }
