    /**
     * Р вЂњР В»Р С•Р В±Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р В°РЎРЏ Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р В° Shift + Р СџР С™Р Сљ Р С—Р С• РЎРѓРЎС“РЎвЂ°Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘ (РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В°, Р С–Р В»РЎС“РЎв‚¬Р С‘Р С Р Т‘Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎС“Р С— Р С” Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎР‹ РЎРѓР С”Р Р†Р С•Р В·РЎРЉ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р В±Р В°Р В·РЎС“)
     */
    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onGlobalEntityInteract(PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteract event) {
        // Р С›Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р В°РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• Р С–Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р Р…РЎС“РЎР‹ РЎР‚РЎС“Р С”РЎС“, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р Р…Р Вµ РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р В°РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р В»Р С• Р Т‘Р Р†Р В°Р В¶Р Т‘РЎвЂ№ (Р С–Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р В°РЎРЏ РЎР‚РЎС“Р С”Р В° + Р С•РЎвЂћРЎвЂћРЎвЂ¦Р ВµР Р…Р Т‘)
        if (event.getHand() != net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND) return;

        Player player = event.getEntity();
        if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) return;

        if (player.isShiftKeyDown()) {
            Entity target = event.getTarget();

            // Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў: Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р† Р Р…Р Вµ РЎРѓРЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµР С "РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р в„–" - Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р С—РЎС“РЎРѓР С”Р В°Р ВµР С Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉРЎР‹,
            // РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ РЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р С•РЎвЂљР В°Р В»Р С‘ Revive (Р СџР С™Р Сљ Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р С) Р С‘ Carry/Drag (Shift+Р СџР С™Р Сљ) Р С‘Р В· DownedHandler
            if (target instanceof Player) {
                return;
            }

            ResourceLocation entityKey = ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.getKey(target.getType());

            // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С• Р Р† РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С”Р Вµ Р С‘РЎРѓР С”Р В»РЎР‹РЎвЂЎР ВµР Р…Р С‘Р в„– (Р СР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘РЎР‚Р В°/Р Т‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…) - РЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎР‚Р ВµРЎв‚¬Р В°Р ВµР С Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р Вµ Р Р†Р В·Р В°Р С‘Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘Р Вµ
            if (entityKey != null && ALLOWED_INVENTORY_ENTITIES.contains(entityKey.toString())) {
                return;
            }

            // === Р вЂќР С›Р СџР С›Р вЂєР СњР ВР СћР вЂўР вЂєР В¬Р СњР С›Р вЂў Р СџР С›Р СџР С›Р вЂєР СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р С™Р ВР СћР С’ (РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• Р Р…Р В° РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р Вµ) ===
            if (!event.getLevel().isClientSide) {
                if (target.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_VehicleTeam")) {
                    String vType = target.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_VehicleType");
                    String vTeam = target.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_VehicleTeam");
                    String pTeam = player.getTeam() != null ? player.getTeam().getName() : "";

                    // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С: Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р В° РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С‘ РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С• Р Р…Р Вµ Static ZU
                    if (!vType.equalsIgnoreCase("Static ZU") && vTeam.equalsIgnoreCase(pTeam)) {
                        ServerPlayer sPlayer = (ServerPlayer) player;

                        int currentMats = target.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_VehicleMats");

                        // 1. Р С›Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С”Р В°Р С”Р С•Р в„– Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В° (Р Р…РЎС“Р В¶Р Р…Р С• РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р Вµ, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р В·Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•Р С‘Р СР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С—Р С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ)
                        String pendingKit = sPlayer.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_PendingKit");
                        String currentKit = sPlayer.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");
                        boolean hasPending = !pendingKit.isEmpty();
                        String targetKitName = hasPending ? pendingKit : currentKit;

                        if (targetKitName == null || targetKitName.isEmpty() || targetKitName.equals("Unassigned")) {
                            sPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.no_kit").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                            event.setCanceled(true);
                            event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                            return;
                        }

                        // 2. Р РЋРЎвЂљР С•Р С‘Р СР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ: Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ "Drone Operator" Р С—Р С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р в„– droneOperatorCrateResupplyCost, РЎС“ Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦ - Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ№РЎвЂЎР Р…Р В°РЎРЏ hubResupplyCost
                        int cost;
                        if ("Drone Operator".equalsIgnoreCase(targetKitName)) {
                            cost = AASConfig.DRONE_OPERATOR_VEHICLE_RESUPPLY_COST.get();
                        } else if ("Sapper".equalsIgnoreCase(targetKitName)) {
                            cost = AASConfig.SAPPER_VEHICLE_RESUPPLY_COST.get();
                        } else if ("Rifleman".equalsIgnoreCase(targetKitName)) {
                            cost = AASConfig.RIFLEMAN_CRATE_RESUPPLY_COST.get();
                        } else {
                            cost = AASConfig.HUB_RESUPPLY_COST.get();
                        }

                        // 3. Р ТђР Р†Р В°РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В»Р С‘ Р СР В°РЎвЂљР ВµРЎР‚Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С•Р Р† Р Р† РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р Вµ?
                        if (currentMats < cost) {
                            sPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.not_enough_vehicle_mats", currentMats).withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                            event.setCanceled(true);
                            event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                            return;
                        }

                        // 4. Р вЂ™РЎвЂ№Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎРѓР СР ВµР Р…РЎС“ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР В° Р С‘Р В»Р С‘ Р С—Р С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ
                        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(sPlayer.serverLevel());

                        if (hasPending) {
                            // Р ВР С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В» Р Р…Р С•Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљ -> Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Т‘Р В°Р ВµР С Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉРЎР‹ РЎРѓР Р…Р В°РЎР‚РЎРЏР В¶Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ
                            com.example.aas.network.ResupplyHandler.tryApplyPendingKit(sPlayer, data);

                            if (!sPlayer.isCreative()) {
                                target.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_VehicleMats", currentMats - cost);
                            }
                            sPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.new_kit_mats", (currentMats - cost)).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
                            sPlayer.level().playSound(null, sPlayer.blockPosition(), SoundEvents.ITEM_PICKUP, SoundSource.PLAYERS, 1f, 1f);
                        } else {
                            // Р Р€ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В° Р Р…Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С•Р В¶Р С‘Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‹РЎвЂ°Р ВµР С–Р С• Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР В° Р Р† Р С•Р В¶Р С‘Р Т‘Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р С‘ -> Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С• Р С—Р С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р С‘Р в„–
                            boolean isAltVariant = sPlayer.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_CurrentKitAlt");
                            AASWorldData.KitInfo kit = data.getKitVariant(pTeam, currentKit, isAltVariant);
                            if (kit != null) {
                                if (com.example.aas.network.ResupplyHandler.resupplyPlayer(sPlayer, kit, false)) {
                                    if (!sPlayer.isCreative()) {
                                        target.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_VehicleMats", currentMats - cost);
                                    }
                                    sPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_resupplied_mats", (currentMats - cost)).withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
                                    sPlayer.level().playSound(null, sPlayer.blockPosition(), SoundEvents.ITEM_PICKUP, SoundSource.PLAYERS, 1f, 1f);
                                } else {
                                    sPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_full_mats", currentMats).withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW), true);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        event.setCanceled(true);
                        event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В° РЎвЂЎРЎС“Р В¶Р В°РЎРЏ, Р В»Р С‘Р В±Р С• Р Р†Р В·Р В°Р С‘Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘Р Вµ Р С—РЎС“РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•Р Вµ - Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С• Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎРЉ Р Р†Р В·Р В°Р С‘Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘РЎРЏ
            if (AASConfig.PREVENT_VEHICLE_INVENTORY_ACCESS.get()) {
                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                if (event.getLevel().isClientSide) {
                    player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.inventory_disabled").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Р вЂР В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘, Р Р†Р В·Р В°Р С‘Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘Р Вµ РЎРѓ Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р СР С‘ Р В·Р В°Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµРЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С• Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂћР С‘Р С–Р С•Р С restrictInteractionsToDoorsAndGates.
// AbstractChestBlock Р С—Р С•Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎС“ Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ№РЎвЂЎР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎРѓРЎС“Р Р…Р Т‘РЎС“Р С”, РЎРѓРЎС“Р Р…Р Т‘РЎС“Р С”-Р В»Р С•Р Р†РЎС“РЎв‚¬Р С”РЎС“ Р В РЎРЊР Р…Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚-РЎРѓРЎС“Р Р…Р Т‘РЎС“Р С”
// (EnderChestBlock РЎвЂљР С•Р В¶Р Вµ Р С•РЎвЂљ Р Р…Р ВµР С–Р С• Р Р…Р В°РЎРѓР В»Р ВµР Т‘РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ), Р С•РЎвЂљР Т‘Р ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С• Р ВµР С–Р С• Р Т‘Р С•Р В±Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р…РЎС“Р В¶Р Р…Р С•.
// AbstractFurnaceBlock Р С—Р С•Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С—Р ВµРЎвЂЎРЎРЉ, Р Т‘Р С•Р СР ВµР Р…Р Р…РЎС“РЎР‹ Р С—Р ВµРЎвЂЎРЎРЉ Р С‘ Р С”Р С•Р С—РЎвЂљР С‘Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎР‹.
// DispenserBlock Р С—Р С•Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С‘ Р Т‘Р С‘РЎРѓР С—Р ВµР Р…РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚, Р С‘ Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉ (DropperBlock Р ВµР С–Р С• Р Р…Р В°РЎРѓР В»Р ВµР Т‘РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљ).
// AnvilBlock Р С—Р С•Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ РЎвЂ Р ВµР В»РЎС“РЎР‹/РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р ВµРЎРѓР Р…РЎС“РЎвЂљРЎС“РЎР‹/Р С—Р С•Р Р†РЎР‚Р ВµР В¶Р Т‘РЎвЂР Р…Р Р…РЎС“РЎР‹ Р Р…Р В°Р С”Р С•Р Р†Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎР‹ (РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С• Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р Р… Р С”Р В»Р В°РЎРѓРЎРѓ Р Р…Р В° Р Р†РЎРѓР Вµ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Т‘Р С‘Р С‘).
    private static final Set<Class<?>> RESTRICTED_INTERACTION_BLOCK_CLASSES = Set.of(
            AbstractChestBlock.class,
            BarrelBlock.class,
            AbstractFurnaceBlock.class,
            TrapDoorBlock.class,
            AnvilBlock.class,
            ShulkerBoxBlock.class,
            HopperBlock.class,
            DispenserBlock.class,
            BrewingStandBlock.class,
            EnchantmentTableBlock.class,
            GrindstoneBlock.class,
            SmithingTableBlock.class,
            LecternBlock.class,
            BeaconBlock.class,
            BedBlock.class
    );

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onRestrictedInteraction(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
        if (!AASConfig.RESTRICT_INTERACTIONS_TO_DOORS_GATES.get()) return;

        Player player = event.getEntity();

        // Р СћР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• survival/adventure РІР‚вЂќ Р С”РЎР‚Р ВµР В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р† Р С‘ РЎРѓР С—Р ВµР С”РЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚ Р Р…Р Вµ РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С–Р В°Р ВµР С
        if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) return;

        Block block = event.getLevel().getBlockState(event.getPos()).getBlock();

        // Р вЂ”Р В°Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµРЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµР С Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂ°Р В°/Р В»РЎС“РЎвЂљ-Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘ Р С‘Р В· РЎвЂЎРЎвЂРЎР‚Р Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С”Р В° Р Р†РЎвЂ№РЎв‚¬Р Вµ.
        // Р вЂ™РЎРѓРЎвЂ Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р Вµ (Р Т‘Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С‘, Р С”Р В°Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂљР С”Р С‘, Р С”Р Р…Р С•Р С—Р С”Р С‘, РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂЎР В°Р С–Р С‘, Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р С” Р С‘ РЎвЂљ.Р Т‘.) РЎвЂљР ВµР С—Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЉ РЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎР‚Р ВµРЎв‚¬Р ВµР Р…Р С•.
        boolean isRestricted = RESTRICTED_INTERACTION_BLOCK_CLASSES.stream()
                .anyMatch(clazz -> clazz.isInstance(block));

        if (!isRestricted) return;

        event.setCanceled(true);
        event.setUseBlock(net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event.Result.DENY);
        event.setUseItem(net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event.Result.DENY);
    }
    /**
     * Р вЂР В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р В° Р С”Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎв‚¬Р С‘ E (Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎРЉ), Р С”Р С•Р С–Р Т‘Р В° Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” РЎРѓР С‘Р Т‘Р С‘РЎвЂљ Р Р†Р Р…РЎС“РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С‘ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘
     */
    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onContainerOpen(PlayerContainerEvent.Open event) {
        Player player = event.getEntity();
        if (AASConfig.PREVENT_VEHICLE_INVENTORY_ACCESS.get() && !player.isCreative() && player.getVehicle() != null) {

            Entity vehicle = player.getVehicle();
            ResourceLocation vehicleKey = ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.getKey(vehicle.getType());

            // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р Р† РЎР‚Р В°Р В·РЎР‚Р ВµРЎв‚¬Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С•Р в„– РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р Вµ - Р Р…Р С‘РЎвЂЎР ВµР С–Р С• Р Р…Р Вµ Р Т‘Р ВµР В»Р В°Р ВµР С
            if (vehicleKey != null && ALLOWED_INVENTORY_ENTITIES.contains(vehicleKey.toString())) {
                return;
            }

            // Р ВР Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР Вµ Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘Р Р…РЎС“Р Т‘Р С‘РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С• Р В·Р В°Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎРЉ
            event.setCanceled(true);
            if (player instanceof ServerPlayer serverPlayer) {
                serverPlayer.server.execute(serverPlayer::closeContainer);
            } else {
                player.closeContainer();
            }
        }
    }


    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLeftClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.LeftClickBlock event) {
        if (AASConfig.PREVENT_BLOCK_BREAKING.get()) {
            Player player = event.getEntity();
            if (player.isCreative()) return;

            Level level = event.getLevel();
            boolean isStarted = false;

            // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В° Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р Вµ
            if (level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
                isStarted = AASWorldData.get(serverLevel).isGameStarted;
            }
            // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В° Р Р…Р В° Р С”Р В»Р С‘Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР Вµ (Р С‘РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµР С Р В±Р ВµР В·Р С•Р С—Р В°РЎРѓР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С•Р С”, РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ РЎРѓР ВµРЎР‚Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚ Р Р…Р Вµ Р С”РЎР‚Р В°РЎв‚¬Р Р…РЎС“Р В»РЎРѓРЎРЏ)
            else if (level.isClientSide) {
                isStarted = com.example.aas.client.ClientData.isGameStarted;
            }

            if (!isStarted) {
                // Р вЂќР С› Р РЋР СћР С’Р В Р СћР С’ Р ВР вЂњР В Р В« Р СњР вЂўР вЂєР В¬Р вЂ”Р Р‡ Р вЂєР С›Р СљР С’Р СћР В¬ Р СњР ВР В§Р вЂўР вЂњР С› Р С™Р В Р С›Р СљР вЂў Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР вЂєР вЂєР В«
                event.setCanceled(true);
            } else {
                // Р СџР С›Р РЋР вЂєР вЂў Р РЋР СћР С’Р В Р СћР С’ Р ВР вЂњР В Р В« Р СџР В Р С›Р вЂ™Р вЂўР В Р Р‡Р вЂўР Сљ Р вЂР вЂўР вЂєР В«Р в„ў Р РЋР СџР ВР РЋР С›Р С™ Р вЂР вЂєР С›Р С™Р С›Р вЂ™
                BlockState state = level.getBlockState(event.getPos());
                if (!isBlockWhitelisted(state)) {
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onBlockPlace(BlockEvent.EntityPlaceEvent event) {
        if (event.getPlacedBlock().is(ModBlocks.GAME_START_TRIGGER.get()) || event.getPlacedBlock().is(ModBlocks.INVASION_PREP_TRIGGER.get())) {
            if (event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level) {
                AASWorldData.get(level).triggerBlocks.add(event.getPos());
                AASWorldData.get(level).setDirty();
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onBlockBreak(BlockEvent.BreakEvent event) {
        // 1. Р вЂєР С•Р С–Р С‘Р С”Р В° РЎС“Р Т‘Р В°Р В»Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С‘Р С–Р С–Р ВµРЎР‚Р С•Р Р† (Р С•Р В±РЎРЏР В·Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…Р В°РЎРЏ)
        if (event.getState().is(ModBlocks.GAME_START_TRIGGER.get()) || event.getState().is(ModBlocks.INVASION_PREP_TRIGGER.get())) {
            if (event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level) {
                AASWorldData.get(level).triggerBlocks.remove(event.getPos());
                AASWorldData.get(level).setDirty();
            }
        }

        // 2. Р вЂєР С•Р С–Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р В·Р В°РЎвЂ°Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ Р С•РЎвЂљ Р В»Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р† (Р С—Р С• Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂћР С‘Р С–РЎС“)
        if (AASConfig.PREVENT_BLOCK_BREAKING.get()) {
            Player player = event.getPlayer();
            if (!player.isCreative()) {
                if (event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
                    boolean isStarted = AASWorldData.get(serverLevel).isGameStarted;

                    if (!isStarted) {
                        // Р вЂќР С› Р РЋР СћР С’Р В Р СћР С’ Р ВР вЂњР В Р В« Р СњР вЂўР вЂєР В¬Р вЂ”Р Р‡ Р вЂєР С›Р СљР С’Р СћР В¬ Р СњР ВР В§Р вЂўР вЂњР С›
                        event.setCanceled(true);
                    } else {
                        // Р СџР С›Р РЋР вЂєР вЂў Р РЋР СћР С’Р В Р СћР С’ Р СџР В Р С›Р вЂ™Р вЂўР В Р Р‡Р вЂўР Сљ Р вЂР вЂўР вЂєР В«Р в„ў Р РЋР СџР ВР РЋР С›Р С™
                        if (!isBlockWhitelisted(event.getState())) {
                            event.setCanceled(true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Р вЂ™РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р СР С•Р С–Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р Т‘ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С•Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР В»Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р†, Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Вµ Р СР С•Р В¶Р Р…Р С• Р В»Р С•Р СР В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р Р† Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р Вµ
    private static boolean isBlockWhitelisted(BlockState state) {
        // 1. РСЃРєР»СЋС‡Р°РµРј: С†РІРµС‚С‹, СЃС‚РµР±Р»Рё РєСѓР»СЊС‚СѓСЂ
        if (state.is(BlockTags.REPLACEABLE) || state.is(BlockTags.FLOWERS) || state.is(BlockTags.CROPS) || state.is(BlockTags.LEAVES)) {
            return true;
        }

        // Р”РѕРї. РёСЃРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРµ: Р»РёСЃС‚РІР° (РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РєР»Р°СЃСЃ) Рё РѕРїР°РІС€Р°СЏ Р»РёСЃС‚РІР° РёР· РґСЂСѓРіРѕРіРѕ РјРѕРґР° (РїРѕ ID, Р±РµР· РїСЂСЏРјРѕР№ Р·Р°РІРёСЃРёРјРѕСЃС‚Рё)
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock) {
            return true;
        }
        net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation blockId = ForgeRegistries.BLOCKS.getKey(state.getBlock());
        if (blockId != null && blockId.toString().equals("squadmcscreen:squad_leaf_litter")) {
            return true;
        }

        // 2. Р ВРЎРѓР С”Р В»РЎР‹РЎвЂЎР В°Р ВµР С: Р Р…Р ВµР Т‘Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р ВµР Р…Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р Вµ Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘ (Р В§Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂљР ВµР В¶Р С‘)
        // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘, РЎвЂљРЎС“ Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦ Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ РЎРѓР Р†Р С•Р в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С• РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С‘РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р В°
        if (state.hasProperty(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED) && !state.getValue(WallBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) {
            return true; // Р СњР ВµР Т‘Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р В°РЎРЏ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР ВµР Р…Р В°
        }
        if (state.hasProperty(BarbedWireBlock.CONSTRUCTED) && !state.getValue(BarbedWireBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) {
            return true; // Р СњР ВµР Т‘Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р В°РЎРЏ Р С”Р С•Р В»РЎР‹РЎвЂЎР С”Р В°
        }
        if (state.hasProperty(HubBlock.CONSTRUCTED) && !state.getValue(HubBlock.CONSTRUCTED)) {
            return true; // Р СњР ВµР Т‘Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р ВµР Р…Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р ТђР С’Р вЂ (Р СћР В°Р В±)
        }

        // Р вЂР В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘ РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С‘РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р В° РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘ (Р С•Р Р…Р С‘ Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР С–Р Т‘Р В° Р С–Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р Р†РЎвЂ№, Р С—Р С•Р С”Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р В·Р В°Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎв‚¬Р ВµР Р… Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘Р В·РЎвЂ№Р Р†)
        if (state.is(ModBlocks.M2_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.AGS_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.MORTAR_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.TOW_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCK.get())) {
            return true;
        }

        // 3. Р ВР С–РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Вµ РЎвЂ Р ВµР В»Р ВµР Р†РЎвЂ№Р Вµ Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘ (Р СћР С•РЎвЂЎР С”Р С‘ Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р С‘)
        boolean isDefense = state.is(ModBlocks.WALL_BLOCK.get()) || state.is(ModBlocks.BARBED_WIRE_BLOCK.get());
        boolean allowDefenses = AASConfig.ALLOW_BREAKING_DEFENSES.get();

        return state.is(ModBlocks.HUB_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.BLUE_RALLY_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.RED_RALLY_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.AMMO_BAG_BLOCK.get()) ||
                state.is(ModBlocks.VEHICLE_STATION_BLOCK.get()) ||
                (isDefense && allowDefenses) ||
                state.is(Tags.Blocks.GLASS) ||
                state.is(Tags.Blocks.GLASS_PANES) ||
                state.is(BlockTags.IMPERMEABLE) ||
                state.is(net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.STONE_BUTTON);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
        if (event.getHand() != net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND) return;

        Player player = event.getEntity();
        Level level = event.getLevel();
        ItemStack heldItem = event.getItemStack();
        BlockPos clickedPos = event.getPos();
        Direction face = event.getFace();

        BlockState clickedState = level.getBlockState(clickedPos);

        // === Р С™Р вЂєР ВР С™Р СњР Р€Р вЂє MAIN SUPPLY BLOCK (Р вЂ™Р В·РЎРЏРЎвЂљР С‘Р Вµ/Р С—Р С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР В° Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘ Р СџР С™Р Сљ) ===
        if (clickedState.is(ModBlocks.MAIN_SUPPLY_BLOCK.get())) {
            if (!level.isClientSide) {
                ServerPlayer sPlayer = (ServerPlayer) player;
                AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(sPlayer.serverLevel());

                if (!data.isGameStarted && !sPlayer.isCreative()) {
                    sPlayer.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Game hasn't started yet!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    return;
                }

                long lastMainUse = sPlayer.getPersistentData().getLong("AAS_LastMainResupply");
                long currentTime = sPlayer.level().getGameTime();

                if (!sPlayer.isCreative() && currentTime < lastMainUse + 1200) {
                    long secondsLeft = (lastMainUse + 1200 - currentTime) / 20;
                    sPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Main Supply Cooldown: " + secondsLeft + "s")
                            .withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    return;
                }

                if (sPlayer.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_PendingKit")) {
                    com.example.aas.network.ResupplyHandler.tryApplyPendingKit(sPlayer, data);
                    sPlayer.getPersistentData().putLong("AAS_LastMainResupply", currentTime);
                } else {
                    String kitName = sPlayer.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");
                    if (!kitName.isEmpty() && sPlayer.getTeam() != null) {
                        String t = sPlayer.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase();
                        boolean isAltVariant2 = sPlayer.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_CurrentKitAlt");
                        AASWorldData.KitInfo kit = data.getKitVariant(t, kitName, isAltVariant2);
                        if (kit != null) {
                            if (com.example.aas.network.ResupplyHandler.resupplyPlayer(sPlayer, kit, false)) {
                                sPlayer.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Kit Resupplied!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN));
                                sPlayer.level().playSound(null, sPlayer.blockPosition(), SoundEvents.ITEM_PICKUP, SoundSource.PLAYERS, 1f, 1f);
                                sPlayer.getPersistentData().putLong("AAS_LastMainResupply", currentTime);
                            } else {
                                sPlayer.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_full").withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            event.setCanceled(true);
            event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
            return;
        }

        if (face == null) return;
        BlockPos placePos = clickedPos.relative(face);

        if (MortarShellStackBlock.isMortarItem(heldItem)) {
            if (clickedState.getBlock() == ModBlocks.MORTAR_SHELL_STACK_BLOCK.get()) return;
            if (level.getBlockState(placePos).canBeReplaced() && !level.isOutsideBuildHeight(placePos)) {
                BlockState newState = ModBlocks.MORTAR_SHELL_STACK_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(MortarShellStackBlock.FACING, player.getDirection().getOpposite());
                if (newState.canSurvive(level, placePos)) {
                    if (!level.isClientSide) {
                        level.setBlock(placePos, newState, 3);
                        level.playSound(null, placePos, SoundEvents.METAL_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                        if (!player.isCreative()) heldItem.shrink(1);
                    }
                    player.swing(event.getHand());
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (TOWMissileStackBlock.isTOWItem(heldItem)) {
            if (clickedState.getBlock() == ModBlocks.TOW_MISSILE_STACK_BLOCK.get()) return;
            if (level.getBlockState(placePos).canBeReplaced() && !level.isOutsideBuildHeight(placePos)) {
                BlockState newState = ModBlocks.TOW_MISSILE_STACK_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(TOWMissileStackBlock.FACING, player.getDirection().getOpposite());
                if (newState.canSurvive(level, placePos)) {
                    if (!level.isClientSide) {
                        level.setBlock(placePos, newState, 3);
                        level.playSound(null, placePos, SoundEvents.METAL_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                        if (!player.isCreative()) heldItem.shrink(1);
                    }
                    player.swing(event.getHand());
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (heldItem.getItem() == ModItems.AGS_AMMO.get()) {
            if (clickedState.getBlock() == ModBlocks.AGS_AMMO_STACK_BLOCK.get()) return;
            if (level.getBlockState(placePos).canBeReplaced() && !level.isOutsideBuildHeight(placePos)) {
                BlockState newState = ModBlocks.AGS_AMMO_STACK_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(AGSAmmoStackBlock.FACING, player.getDirection().getOpposite());
                if (newState.canSurvive(level, placePos)) {
                    if (!level.isClientSide) {
                        level.setBlock(placePos, newState, 3);
                        BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(placePos);
                        if (be instanceof AmmoStackBlockEntity ammoBe) {
                            int ammo = AGSAmmoItem.getAmmo(heldItem);
                            ammoBe.addAmmoBox(ammo);
                        }
                        level.playSound(null, placePos, SoundEvents.METAL_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                        if (!player.isCreative()) heldItem.shrink(1);
                    }
                    player.swing(event.getHand());
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (heldItem.getItem() == ModItems.M2_AMMO.get()) {
            if (clickedState.getBlock() == ModBlocks.M2_AMMO_STACK_BLOCK.get()) return;
            if (level.getBlockState(placePos).canBeReplaced() && !level.isOutsideBuildHeight(placePos)) {
                BlockState newState = ModBlocks.M2_AMMO_STACK_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()
                        .setValue(M2AmmoStackBlock.FACING, player.getDirection().getOpposite());
                if (newState.canSurvive(level, placePos)) {
                    if (!level.isClientSide) {
                        level.setBlock(placePos, newState, 3);
                        BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(placePos);
                        if (be instanceof AmmoStackBlockEntity ammoBe) {
                            int ammo = M2AmmoItem.getAmmo(heldItem);
                            ammoBe.addAmmoBox(ammo);
                        }
                        level.playSound(null, placePos, SoundEvents.METAL_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                        if (!player.isCreative()) heldItem.shrink(1);
                    }
                    player.swing(event.getHand());
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onGlobalVehicleInteract(PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteract event) {
        Player player = event.getEntity();

        // 1. Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С”Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂћР С‘Р С–
        if (!AASConfig.PREVENT_ENEMY_VEHICLE_ENTRY.get()) return;

        // 2. Р ВР С–Р Р…Р С•РЎР‚Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р С”РЎР‚Р ВµР В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р† Р С‘ РЎРѓР С—Р ВµР С”РЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р В°
        if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) return;

        Entity target = event.getTarget();

        // 3. Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С, Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р В»Р С‘ РЎС“ РЎРѓРЎС“РЎвЂ°Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘ Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р В° (РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В° РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљ РЎвЂљР ВµР С– РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР В· Spawner Р С‘Р В»Р С‘ Р Р†РЎР‚РЎС“РЎвЂЎР Р…РЎС“РЎР‹)
        if (target.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_VehicleTeam")) {
            String vTeam = target.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_VehicleTeam");

            // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р…Р ВµР в„–РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р В°РЎРЏ
            if (!vTeam.isEmpty() && !vTeam.equalsIgnoreCase("NEUTRAL")) {
                String pTeam = (player.getTeam() != null) ? player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";

                // 4. Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р В° РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘ Р Р…Р Вµ РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ РЎРѓ Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р С•Р в„– Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В° - Р В±Р В»Р С•Р С”Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р Р†Р В·Р В°Р С‘Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘Р Вµ
                if (!vTeam.equalsIgnoreCase(pTeam)) {
                    // Р С›РЎвЂљР СР ВµР Р…РЎРЏР ВµР С Р Р†Р В·Р В°Р С‘Р СР С•Р Т‘Р ВµР в„–РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†Р С‘Р Вµ (Р С—Р С•РЎРѓР В°Р Т‘Р С”РЎС“)
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.FAIL);

                    // Р вЂ™РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р С РЎРѓР С•Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р Вµ Р С”Р В»Р С‘Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°
                    if (event.getLevel().isClientSide) {
                        player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Access Denied: Enemy Vehicle!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // === Р‘Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІРєР° СЂР°С†РёРё walkietalkie:netherite_walkietalkie РІ survival/adventure ===
    private static boolean isBlockedWalkieTalkie(ItemStack stack, Player player) {
        if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) return false;
        if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty()) return false;
        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(stack.getItem());
        return id != null
                && id.getNamespace().equals("walkietalkie")
                && id.getPath().equals("netherite_walkietalkie");
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onWalkieTalkieRightClickItem(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickItem event) {
        if (isBlockedWalkieTalkie(event.getItemStack(), event.getEntity())) {
            event.setCanceled(true);
            event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.FAIL);
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onWalkieTalkieRightClickBlockGuard(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
        if (isBlockedWalkieTalkie(event.getItemStack(), event.getEntity())) {
            event.setUseItem(net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event.Result.DENY);
            event.setCanceled(true);
            event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.FAIL);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.aas.events;

/**
 * Р Р°РЅРіРё РєРёС‚РѕРІ.
 * <p>
 * - Р’СЂРµРјСЏ РёРіСЂС‹ РЅР° РєРёС‚Рµ (AAS_CurrentKit, РќР• AAS_PendingKit) РєРѕРїРёС‚СЃСЏ РІ СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґР°С…; 600 СЃРµРє (10 РјРёРЅ) = 1 РѕС‡РєРѕ.
 * - Р”Р°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РїСЂРёРІСЏР·Р°РЅС‹ Рє РќРРљРЈ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° Рё С…СЂР°РЅСЏС‚СЃСЏ РІ aas_kit_ranks.json РІ РєРѕСЂРЅРµ РёРіСЂС‹/СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР°
 * (СЂСЏРґРѕРј СЃ РїР°РїРєР°РјРё mods, config Рё С‚.Рґ.).
 * - РҐСЂР°РЅРёС‚СЃСЏ РЅРµ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РѕС‡РєРё, РЅРѕ Рё РѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РѕРє СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґ РґРѕ СЃР»РµРґСѓСЋС‰РµРіРѕ РѕС‡РєР°, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РІСЂРµРјСЏ РЅРµ СЃРіРѕСЂР°Р»Рѕ.
 * - РќР°РєРѕРїР»РµРЅРёРµ РёРґС‘С‚ РІСЃРµРіРґР°; РєРѕРЅС„РёРі showKitRanks СѓРїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїРѕРєР°Р·РѕРј РЅР° РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Рµ.
 * <p>
 * Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚ С„Р°Р№Р»Р°:
 * {
 * "Nick": {
 * "Medic": { "level": 3, "points": 7, "seconds": 120 }
 * }
 * }

@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas")
public final class KitRankManager {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = LogUtils.getLogger();

    public static final int MAX_LEVEL = 20;
    /**
     * 10 РјРёРЅСѓС‚ РёРіСЂС‹ = 1 РѕС‡РєРѕ.
     */
    public static final int SECONDS_PER_POINT = 10 * 60;

    private static final String FILE_NAME = "aas_kit_ranks.json";
    private static final int AUTOSAVE_TICKS = 20 * 60; // СЂР°Р· РІ РјРёРЅСѓС‚Сѓ, РµСЃР»Рё РµСЃС‚СЊ РёР·РјРµРЅРµРЅРёСЏ

    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().disableHtmlEscaping().create();

    public static final class Entry {
        public int level = 1;
        public int points = 0;
        public int seconds = 0;
    }

    // РЅРёРє (Р±РµР· СѓС‡С‘С‚Р° СЂРµРіРёСЃС‚СЂР°) -> РЅР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ РєРёС‚Р° -> РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ
    private static final Map<String, Map<String, Entry>> DATA = new TreeMap<>(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER);
    // РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёР№ РёР·РІРµСЃС‚РЅС‹Р№ РєРёС‚ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° (РґР»СЏ СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅРµРЅРёСЏ РїСЂРё СЃРјРµРЅРµ РєРёС‚Р°)
    private static final Map<UUID, String> LAST_KIT = new HashMap<>();

    private static boolean dirty = false;
    private static long tickCounter = 0;

    // С‡С‚Рѕ РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёР№ СЂР°Р· РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІРёР»Рё РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р°Рј
    private static Boolean lastSentShow = null;
    private static Map<String, KitRankProgress> lastSentRanks = null;   // Р±С‹Р»Рѕ Map<String, Integer>

    // ================== РџР РђР’РР›Рђ РЈР РћР’РќР•Р™ ==================

    /**
     * РЎРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РѕС‡РєРѕРІ РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃ СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ {@code level} РїРµСЂРµР№С‚Рё РЅР° {@code level + 1}.
     */
    public static int costToNext(int level) {
        if (level <= 4) return 3;
        if (level <= 10) return 6;
        if (level <= 12) return 8;
        if (level <= 16) return 10;
        return 12; // 17-20
    }

    /**
     * РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ (1..20) РїРѕ СЃСѓРјРјР°СЂРЅРѕРјСѓ РєРѕР»РёС‡РµСЃС‚РІСѓ РѕС‡РєРѕРІ. Р’СЃРµ СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚СѓСЋС‚ СЃ 1 СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ.
     */
    public static int levelForPoints(int points) {
        int level = 1;
        int rem = Math.max(0, points);
        while (level < MAX_LEVEL) {
            int cost = costToNext(level);
            if (rem < cost) break;
            rem -= cost;
            level++;
        }
        return level;
    }

    // ================== РџРЈР‘Р›РР§РќР«Р™ API ==================

    /**
     * РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РЅР° РєРёС‚Рµ. Р•СЃР»Рё Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё РµС‰С‘ РЅРµС‚ вЂ” 1.
     */
    public static int getLevel(String nick, String kit) {
        Entry e = getEntry(nick, kit);
        return e == null ? 1 : e.level;
    }

    /**
     * РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ + РѕС‡РєРё РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ + СЃС‚РѕРёРјРѕСЃС‚СЊ СЃР»РµРґСѓСЋС‰РµРіРѕ СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ (0 = РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј).
     */
    public static KitRankProgress progressFor(String nick, String kit) {
        Entry e = getEntry(nick, kit);
        int rem = e == null ? 0 : Math.max(0, e.points);
        int level = 1;
        while (level < MAX_LEVEL) {
            int cost = costToNext(level);
            if (rem < cost) break;
            rem -= cost;
            level++;
        }
        int cost = level >= MAX_LEVEL ? 0 : costToNext(level);
        return new KitRankProgress(level, rem, cost);
    }

    public static Entry getEntry(String nick, String kit) {
        Map<String, Entry> kits = DATA.get(nick);
        return kits == null ? null : kits.get(kit);
    }

    /**
     * Р—Р°РґРµР» РЅР° Р±СѓРґСѓС‰РµРµ: РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»РёС‚СЊ РѕС‡РєРё РєРёС‚Сѓ РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјСѓСЋ (РЅРµ РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРµРј).
     */
    public static void addPoints(String nick, String kit, int points) {
        if (points <= 0 || !isRankedKit(kit)) return;
        Entry e = entry(nick, kit);
        e.points += points;
        e.level = levelForPoints(e.points);
        dirty = true;
    }

    private static boolean isRankedKit(String kit) {
        return kit != null && !kit.isEmpty() && !kit.equalsIgnoreCase("Unassigned");
    }

    private static Entry entry(String nick, String kit) {
        return DATA.computeIfAbsent(nick, k -> new TreeMap<>()).computeIfAbsent(kit, k -> new Entry());
    }

    // ================== Р–РР—РќР•РќРќР«Р™ Р¦РРљР› ==================

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onServerStarting(ServerStartingEvent event) {
        load();
        LAST_KIT.clear();
        lastSentShow = null;
        lastSentRanks = null;
        tickCounter = 0;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onServerStopping(ServerStoppingEvent event) {
        save();
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogin(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)) return;
        MinecraftServer server = player.getServer();
        if (server == null) return;
        boolean show = AASConfig.SHOW_KIT_RANKS.get();
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> player),
                new PacketSyncKitRanks(show, show ? buildRanks(server) : new HashMap<>()));
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogout(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)) return;
        LAST_KIT.remove(player.getUUID());
        if (dirty) save();
    }

    // ================== РўРРљ ==================

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onServerTick(TickEvent.ServerTickEvent event) {
        if (event.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END) return;

        tickCounter++;
        if (tickCounter % 20 != 0) return; // СЂР°Р· РІ СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґСѓ

        MinecraftServer server = ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer();
        if (server == null) return;

        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(server.overworld());
        boolean flushNeeded = false;

        for (ServerPlayer p : server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            // РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РІС‹РґР°РЅРЅС‹Р№ РєРёС‚. AAS_PendingKit (Р±СЂРѕРЅСЊ) РЅРµ СѓС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ.
            String kit = p.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");

            String prev = LAST_KIT.put(p.getUUID(), kit);
            if (prev != null && !prev.equals(kit)) flushNeeded = true;

            if (!isRankedKit(kit)) continue;
            if (!data.isGameStarted) continue;
            if (!p.isAlive() || p.isSpectator()) continue;

            addSecond(p.getGameProfile().getName(), kit);
        }

        syncToClientsIfChanged(server);

        if (flushNeeded || (tickCounter % AUTOSAVE_TICKS == 0)) {
            if (dirty) save();
        }
    }

    private static void addSecond(String nick, String kit) {
        Entry e = entry(nick, kit);
        e.seconds++;
        if (e.seconds >= SECONDS_PER_POINT) {
            e.seconds -= SECONDS_PER_POINT;
            e.points++;
            e.level = levelForPoints(e.points);
        }
        dirty = true;
    }

    // ================== РЎРРќРҐР РћРќРР—РђР¦РРЇ РЎ РљР›РР•РќРўРђРњР ==================

    /**
     * РЅРёРє -> СѓСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ РЅР° С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµРј РєРёС‚Рµ, С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ РѕРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ СЃ РЅР°Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅС‹Рј РєРёС‚РѕРј.
     */
    private static Map<String, KitRankProgress> buildRanks(MinecraftServer server) {
        Map<String, KitRankProgress> ranks = new HashMap<>();
        for (ServerPlayer p : server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            String kit = p.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");
            if (!isRankedKit(kit)) continue;
            String nick = p.getGameProfile().getName();
            ranks.put(nick, progressFor(nick, kit));
        }
        return ranks;
    }

    private static void syncToClientsIfChanged(MinecraftServer server) {
        boolean show = AASConfig.SHOW_KIT_RANKS.get();
        Map<String, KitRankProgress> ranks = show ? buildRanks(server) : new HashMap<>();

        if (lastSentShow != null && lastSentShow == show && ranks.equals(lastSentRanks)) return;

        lastSentShow = show;
        lastSentRanks = ranks;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.ALL.noArg(), new PacketSyncKitRanks(show, ranks));
    }

    // ================== Р¤РђР™Р› ==================

    private static Path file() {
        return FMLPaths.GAMEDIR.get().resolve(FILE_NAME);
    }

    private static void load() {
        DATA.clear();
        dirty = false;

        Path file = file();
        if (!Files.exists(file)) return;

        try (Reader r = Files.newBufferedReader(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            Type type = new TypeToken<Map<String, Map<String, Entry>>>() {
            }.getType();
            Map<String, Map<String, Entry>> loaded = GSON.fromJson(r, type);
            if (loaded == null) return;

            for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, Entry>> nickEntry : loaded.entrySet()) {
                if (nickEntry.getValue() == null) continue;
                Map<String, Entry> kits = new TreeMap<>();
                for (Map.Entry<String, Entry> kitEntry : nickEntry.getValue().entrySet()) {
                    Entry e = kitEntry.getValue();
                    if (e == null) continue;
                    if (e.points < 0) e.points = 0;
                    if (e.seconds < 0) e.seconds = 0;
                    // РµСЃР»Рё РІ С„Р°Р№Р»Рµ СЂСѓРєР°РјРё РІС‹СЃС‚Р°РІРёР»Рё РјРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґ вЂ” РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґРёРј РІ РѕС‡РєРё
                    if (e.seconds >= SECONDS_PER_POINT) {
                        e.points += e.seconds / SECONDS_PER_POINT;
                        e.seconds = e.seconds % SECONDS_PER_POINT;
                    }
                    e.level = levelForPoints(e.points); // РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє РёСЃС‚РёРЅС‹ вЂ” РѕС‡РєРё
                    kits.put(kitEntry.getKey(), e);
                }
                DATA.put(nickEntry.getKey(), kits);
            }
            LOGGER.info("[AAS] Kit ranks loaded: {} players", DATA.size());
        } catch (JsonParseException | IOException ex) {
            // РќРµ Р·Р°С‚РёСЂР°РµРј Р±РёС‚С‹Р№ С„Р°Р№Р» РјРѕР»С‡Р°: РѕС‚РєР»Р°РґС‹РІР°РµРј РІ СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅСѓ Рё СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚СѓРµРј СЃ РїСѓСЃС‚РѕРіРѕ.
            LOGGER.error("[AAS] Failed to read " + FILE_NAME + ", moving it aside", ex);
            try {
                Path bad = file.resolveSibling(FILE_NAME + ".broken-" + System.currentTimeMillis());
                Files.move(file, bad, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
            DATA.clear();
        }
    }

    public static void save() {
        Path file = file();
        Path tmp = file.resolveSibling(FILE_NAME + ".tmp");
        try {
            try (Writer w = Files.newBufferedWriter(tmp, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                GSON.toJson(DATA, w);
            }
            try {
                Files.move(tmp, file, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
            } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ex) {
                Files.move(tmp, file, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            }
            dirty = false;
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            LOGGER.error("[AAS] Failed to save " + FILE_NAME, ex);
        }
    }

    private KitRankManager() {
    }
}

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onServerChat(ServerChatEvent event) {

        // Р•СЃР»Рё СЌС‚Рѕ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР° (РЅР°С‡РёРЅР°РµС‚СЃСЏ СЃ /), РЅРµ С‚СЂРѕРіР°РµРј

import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;

/**
 * "Р—Р°РјРѕСЂРѕР¶РµРЅРЅР°СЏ" СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєР° РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рµ РІС‹С€Р»Рё СЃ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР°.

 * - Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє РІРµСЂРЅСѓР»СЃСЏ - СЃРЅРёРјРѕРє СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ, РґР°Р»СЊС€Рµ РёРґСѓС‚ РµРіРѕ Р¶РёРІС‹Рµ РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ.
 * - Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє РЅРµ Р±С‹Р» РѕРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ РІ РјРѕРјРµРЅС‚ СЃР±СЂРѕСЃР°, РѕР±РЅСѓР»РёС‚СЊ РµРіРѕ СЃС‡С‘С‚ РјРѕР¶РЅРѕ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РєРѕРіРґР° РѕРЅ Р·Р°Р№РґС‘С‚
 *   (РµРіРѕ РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ Р»РµР¶Р°С‚ РІ playerdata), РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ РёРјСЏ Р·Р°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РІ PENDING_RESET.
 *
 * РҐСЂР°РЅРёС‚СЃСЏ РІ РїР°РјСЏС‚Рё: РїСЂРё РїРµСЂРµР·Р°РїСѓСЃРєРµ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР° СЃРЅРёРјРєРё С‚РµСЂСЏСЋС‚СЃСЏ.
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas")
public final class OfflineStats {

    public static final class Snap {
        public String name;
        public String team;   // "BLUE" / "RED"
        public String dim;    // id РёР·РјРµСЂРµРЅРёСЏ, РІ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕРј РёРіСЂРѕРє РІС‹С€РµР»
        public int kills, deaths, tp, sp, revives, vehTotal, logi;
        public int[] vehByCat = new int[0];
    }

    // РЅРёРє (РЅРёР¶РЅРёР№ СЂРµРіРёСЃС‚СЂ) -> СЃРЅРёРјРѕРє
    private static final Map<String, Snap> SNAPS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    // РЅРёРєРё, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рј РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕ РѕР±РЅСѓР»РёС‚СЊ СЃС‡С‘С‚ РїСЂРё СЃР»РµРґСѓСЋС‰РµРј РІС…РѕРґРµ
    private static final Set<String> PENDING_RESET = new HashSet<>();

    private OfflineStats() {}

    private static String key(String name) {
        return name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    // ================== РЎРћР‘Р«РўРРЇ ==================

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogout(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p)) return;
        if (p.getTeam() == null) return;
        String team = p.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase();
        if (!team.equals("BLUE") && !team.equals("RED")) return;

        var tag = p.getPersistentData();
        Snap s = new Snap();
        s.name = p.getScoreboardName();
        s.team = team;
        s.dim = p.serverLevel().dimension().location().toString();
        s.kills = tag.getInt(StatsHandler.KEY_KILLS);
        s.deaths = tag.getInt(StatsHandler.KEY_DEATHS);
        s.tp = tag.getInt(StatsHandler.KEY_TP);
        s.sp = tag.getInt(StatsHandler.KEY_SP);
        s.revives = StatsHandler.getRevives(p);
        s.vehTotal = StatsHandler.getVehKillsTotal(p);
        s.logi = StatsHandler.getLogisticsPoints(p);
        s.vehByCat = StatsHandler.getVehKillsByCategory(p);
        SNAPS.put(key(s.name), s);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogin(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p)) return;
        String k = key(p.getScoreboardName());
        SNAPS.remove(k); // РёРіСЂРѕРє СЃРЅРѕРІР° РѕРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ - РґР°Р»СЊС€Рµ РµРіРѕ Р¶РёРІС‹Рµ РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ
        if (PENDING_RESET.remove(k)) {
            StatsHandler.resetStats(p); // СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєСѓ СЃР±СЂРѕСЃРёР»Рё, РїРѕРєР° РѕРЅ Р±С‹Р» РѕС„Р»Р°Р№РЅ
        }
    }

    // ================== API ==================

    /** РЎР±СЂРѕСЃ СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєРё (СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚ РјР°С‚С‡Р°): СЃРЅРёРјРєРё РїСЂРѕРїР°РґР°СЋС‚, РѕС„Р»Р°Р№РЅ-РёРіСЂРѕРєР°Рј СЃС‡С‘С‚ РѕР±РЅСѓР»РёС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё РІС…РѕРґРµ. */
    public static void resetAll() {
        PENDING_RESET.addAll(SNAPS.keySet());
        SNAPS.clear();
    }

    /** РЎРЅРёРјРєРё РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹С… СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ РЅРµС‚ РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ, РґР»СЏ СѓРєР°Р·Р°РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ РёР·РјРµСЂРµРЅРёСЏ. */
    public static List<Snap> offline(MinecraftServer server, String dim) {
        List<Snap> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Snap s : SNAPS.values()) {
            if (!s.dim.equals(dim)) continue;
            if (server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(s.name) != null) continue; // РѕРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ, РІ РґСЂСѓРіРѕРј РёР·РјРµСЂРµРЅРёРё)
            out.add(s);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** РЎС‚СЂРѕРєРё РґР»СЏ С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С‹ РЅР° Caps Lock. ping = -1 -> РєР»РёРµРЅС‚ СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚ СЃРµСЂС‹Р№ Р·РЅР°С‡РѕРє. */
    public static List<PlayerStatInfo> buildInfos(MinecraftServer server, String dim, AASWorldData data) {
        List<PlayerStatInfo> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Snap s : offline(server, dim)) {
            int squadId = -1;
            boolean isLeader = false;
            for (AASWorldData.Squad sq : data.squads) {
                if (sq.members.contains(s.name)) {
                    squadId = sq.id;
                    isLeader = sq.leader.equals(s.name);
                    break;
                }
            }
            boolean isCMD = (s.team.equals("BLUE") && squadId == data.blueCMDId && data.blueCMDId != -1)
                    || (s.team.equals("RED") && squadId == data.redCMDId && data.redCMDId != -1);

            out.add(new PlayerStatInfo(s.name, s.team, squadId, isLeader, isCMD,
                    s.kills, s.deaths, s.tp, s.sp, s.revives, s.vehTotal, s.vehByCat, -1));
        }
        return out;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.events;

import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * "РђРєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‚СЂРёРіРіРµСЂ": РїРѕРєР° РёРіСЂРѕРє Р¶РёРІ, РЅРµ РІ СЃРїРµРєС‚Р°С‚РѕСЂРµ Рё РЅР°С…РѕРґРёС‚СЃСЏ РІ Р·РѕРЅРµ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕР№ С‚РѕС‡РєРё,
 * РєРѕС‚РѕСЂР°СЏ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РѕСЃРїР°СЂРёРІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР»Рё СѓРґРµСЂР¶РёРІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ, РѕРЅ РїРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµС‚ POINT_PRESENCE_TP РєР°Р¶РґС‹Рµ 30 СЃРµРє РїСЂРёСЃСѓС‚СЃС‚РІРёСЏ.
 * РђРЅС‚Рё-Р°С„Рє: РёРіСЂРѕРє РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ РґРІРёРіР°С‚СЊСЃСЏ, РєСЂСѓС‚РёС‚СЊ РєР°РјРµСЂСѓ РёР»Рё С‡С‚Рѕ-С‚Рѕ РґРµР»Р°С‚СЊ С…РѕС‚СЏ Р±С‹ СЂР°Р· РІ 15 СЃРµРє.
 */
public final class PointPresenceTracker {

    private PointPresenceTracker() {}

    private static final class State {
        long presenceTicks = 0;
        long lastSeenTick = 0;
        long lastActiveTick = 0;
        double x, y, z;
        float yaw, pitch;
        boolean hasSample = false;
    }

    private static final Map<UUID, State> STATES = new HashMap<>();

    public static void tick(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData.CapturePoint point, List<ServerPlayer> playersInBox,
                            String dominantTeam, boolean isContested, boolean isBeingActivelyCaptured, boolean isTimeLocked,
                            boolean blueCanCapture, boolean redCanCapture) {
        if (isTimeLocked || playersInBox.isEmpty()) return;
        long now = level.getGameTime();

        for (ServerPlayer p : playersInBox) {
            if (!p.isAlive() || p.isSpectator()) continue;
            if (p.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned")) continue;
            if (!point.isInside(p.position())) continue;
            if (p.getTeam() == null) continue;

            String teamKey;
            if (p.getTeam().getName().equalsIgnoreCase("Blue")) teamKey = "BLUE";
            else if (p.getTeam().getName().equalsIgnoreCase("Red")) teamKey = "RED";
            else continue;

            State st = STATES.get(p.getUUID());
            if (st == null) {
                st = new State();
                st.lastActiveTick = now;
                STATES.put(p.getUUID(), st);
            }
            if (now - st.lastSeenTick > 40L) st.presenceTicks = 0; // РІС‹С€РµР» РёР· Р·РѕРЅС‹ - СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРє РЅР°С‡РёРЅР°РµС‚СЃСЏ Р·Р°РЅРѕРІРѕ
            st.lastSeenTick = now;

            updateActivity(st, p, now);
            boolean afk = now - st.lastActiveTick > ScoreValues.POINT_AFK_TIMEOUT_TICKS;

            // РўРѕС‡РєР° "Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅР°" РґР»СЏ РёРіСЂРѕРєР°, РµСЃР»Рё: РёРґС‘С‚ СЃРїРѕСЂ, РѕРЅ Р°С‚Р°РєСѓРµС‚/РЅРµР№С‚СЂР°Р»РёР·СѓРµС‚ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ,
            // РёР»Рё РѕРЅ Р·Р°С‰РёС‰Р°РµС‚ СЃРІРѕСЋ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ, РЅР° РєРѕС‚РѕСЂСѓСЋ РІСЂР°Рі СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РјРѕР¶РµС‚ РЅР°РїР°СЃС‚СЊ (С„СЂРѕРЅС‚РѕРІР°СЏ С‚РѕС‡РєР°)
            boolean enemyCanCapture = teamKey.equals("BLUE") ? redCanCapture : blueCanCapture;
            boolean active = isContested
                    || (teamKey.equals(dominantTeam) && isBeingActivelyCaptured)
                    || (point.owner.equals(teamKey) && enemyCanCapture);

            if (!active || afk) continue;

            st.presenceTicks++;
            if (st.presenceTicks >= ScoreValues.POINT_PRESENCE_INTERVAL_TICKS) {
                st.presenceTicks = 0;
                StatsHandler.addScore(p, ScoreType.POINT_PRESENCE);
            }
        }

        if (STATES.size() > 256) {
            STATES.values().removeIf(s -> now < s.lastSeenTick || now - s.lastSeenTick > 1200L);
        }
    }

    private static void updateActivity(State st, ServerPlayer p, long now) {
        double x = p.getX(), y = p.getY(), z = p.getZ();
        float yaw = p.getYRot(), pitch = p.getXRot();
        if (!st.hasSample) {
            st.hasSample = true;
            st.lastActiveTick = now;
        } else {
            double dx = x - st.x, dy = y - st.y, dz = z - st.z;
            boolean moved = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > 0.0004;
            boolean looked = Math.abs(yaw - st.yaw) + Math.abs(pitch - st.pitch) > 0.5f;
            if (moved || looked || p.swinging || p.isUsingItem()) st.lastActiveTick = now;
        }
        st.x = x; st.y = y; st.z = z;
        st.yaw = yaw; st.pitch = pitch;
    }
}

    REVIVE            (ScoreValues.REVIVE_TP, 0, "aas.score.revive"),

    VEHICLE_DESTROYED (0, 0, "aas.score.vehicle_destroyed"),

    HUB_PLACED        (ScoreValues.HUB_PLACED_TP, 0, "aas.score.hub_placed"),
    HUB_SPAWN         (ScoreValues.HUB_SPAWN_TP, 0, "aas.score.hub_spawn"),
    HUB_DESTROYED     (ScoreValues.HUB_DESTROYED_TP, 0, "aas.score.hub_destroyed"),
    HUB_RESUPPLY      (ScoreValues.HUB_RESUPPLY_TP, 0, "aas.score.hub_resupply"),

    RALLY_PLACED      (0, ScoreValues.RALLY_PLACED_SP, "aas.score.rally_placed"),
    RALLY_SPAWN       (0, ScoreValues.RALLY_SPAWN_SP, "aas.score.rally_spawn"),
    RALLY_DESTROYED   (ScoreValues.RALLY_DESTROYED_TP, 0, "aas.score.rally_destroyed"),

    POINT_CAPTURED    (ScoreValues.POINT_CAPTURED_TP, ScoreValues.POINT_CAPTURED_SP, "aas.score.point_captured"),
    POINT_PRESENCE    (ScoreValues.POINT_PRESENCE_TP, 0, "aas.score.point_presence"),

    BUILD_LIGHT       (ScoreValues.BUILD_LIGHT_TP, 0, "aas.score.build_light"),
    BUILD_BUNKER      (ScoreValues.BUILD_BUNKER_TP, 0, "aas.score.build_bunker"),
    BUILD_WEAPON      (ScoreValues.BUILD_WEAPON_TP, 0, "aas.score.build_weapon"),
    BUILD_STATION     (ScoreValues.BUILD_STATION_TP, 0, "aas.score.build_station"),

    TRANSPORT         (0, 0, "aas.score.transport");

    public final int teamPoints;
    public final int squadPoints;
    public final String langKey;

    ScoreType(int teamPoints, int squadPoints, String langKey) {

    }

package com.example.aas.events;

import com.example.aas.util.VehicleCatalog;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class StatsHandler {

    // РљР»СЋС‡Рё РІ player.getPersistentData()
    public static final String KEY_TP = "AAS_Stats_TeamPoints";
    public static final String KEY_SP = "AAS_Stats_SquadPoints";
    public static final String KEY_KILLS = "AAS_Stats_Kills";
    public static final String KEY_DEATHS = "AAS_Stats_Deaths";
    public static final String KEY_VEH_TOTAL = "AAS_Stats_VehKills_TOTAL";
    public static final String KEY_REVIVES = "AAS_Stats_Revives";
    /** РћС‡РєРё С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р·Р° РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєСѓ (HUB_PLACED) Рё РїРѕРїРѕР»РЅРµРЅРёРµ (HUB_RESUPPLY) С…Р°Р±РѕРІ вЂ” РґР»СЏ В«Р›СѓС‡С€РµРіРѕ Р»РѕРіРёСЃС‚Р°В». */
    public static final String KEY_LOGISTICS = "AAS_Stats_LogisticsPoints";
    private static final String KEY_VEH_PREFIX = "AAS_Stats_VehKills_";

    // РљСѓР»РґР°СѓРЅС‹ Р°РЅС‚Рё-С„Р°СЂРјР°: РєР»СЋС‡ -> С‚РёРє РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРµРіРѕ РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРёСЏ
    private static final Map<String, Long> COOLDOWNS = new HashMap<>();

    public static String vehKey(VehicleCatalog.Category category) {
        return KEY_VEH_PREFIX + category.name();
    }

    public static void addStats(ServerPlayer player, int teamPoints, int squadPoints, String reason) {
        if (player == null) return;

        int currentTP = player.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_TeamPoints");
        int currentSP = player.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_SquadPoints");

        if (teamPoints > 0) player.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_Stats_TeamPoints", currentTP + teamPoints);
        if (squadPoints > 0) player.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_Stats_SquadPoints", currentSP + squadPoints);

        // РЈР’Р•Р”РћРњР›Р•РќРР• РЈР”РђР›Р•РќРћ (С‚РµРїРµСЂСЊ РѕС‡РєРё РґР°СЋС‚СЃСЏ РјРѕР»С‡Р°)
        /*
        player.displayClientMessage(
                Component.literal(tpStr + spStr + "(" + reason + ")").withStyle(ChatFormatting.AQUA),
                true
        );
        */
    }

    // ================= РќРћР’РћР•: РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРёРµ РїРѕ С‚РёРїСѓ (Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёСЏ РёР· ScoreValues) =================

    /** РќР°С‡РёСЃР»СЏРµС‚ РѕС‡РєРё РїРѕ С‚РёРїСѓ ScoreType, Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёСЏ Р±РµСЂСѓС‚СЃСЏ РёР· ScoreValues. */
    public static void addScore(ServerPlayer player, ScoreType type) {
        if (player == null || type == null) return;
        applyScore(player, type.teamPoints, type.squadPoints, type);
    }

    /** РќР°С‡РёСЃР»СЏРµС‚ РѕС‡РєРё РїРѕ С‚РёРїСѓ, РЅРѕ СЃ РїСЂРѕС†РµРЅС‚РѕРј РѕС‚ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІС‹С… Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёР№ (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ, 50% РІРєР»Р°РґС‡РёРєР°Рј СЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєРё). */
    public static void addScoreScaled(ServerPlayer player, ScoreType type, int percent) {
        if (player == null || type == null) return;
        int tp = type.teamPoints * percent / 100;
        int sp = type.squadPoints * percent / 100;
        applyScore(player, tp, sp, type);
    }

    /** РќР°С‡РёСЃР»СЏРµС‚ РїСЂРѕРёР·РІРѕР»СЊРЅС‹Рµ РѕС‡РєРё, РЅРѕ СЃ РїСЂРёС‡РёРЅРѕР№/Р»РѕРєР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёРµР№ РёР· ScoreType (С‚РµС…РЅРёРєР°, РїРµСЂРµРІРѕР·РєР°). */
    public static void addScoreCustom(ServerPlayer player, ScoreType type, int teamPoints, int squadPoints) {
        if (player == null || type == null) return;
        applyScore(player, teamPoints, squadPoints, type);
    }

    public static void addScoreByName(MinecraftServer server, String playerName, ScoreType type) {
        if (server == null || playerName == null || playerName.isEmpty()) return;
        ServerPlayer player = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(playerName);
        if (player != null) addScore(player, type);
    }

    private static void applyScore(ServerPlayer player, int teamPoints, int squadPoints, ScoreType type) {
        if (teamPoints <= 0 && squadPoints <= 0) return;
        CompoundTag data = player.getPersistentData();
        if (teamPoints > 0) data.putInt(KEY_TP, data.getInt(KEY_TP) + teamPoints);
        if (squadPoints > 0) data.putInt(KEY_SP, data.getInt(KEY_SP) + squadPoints);
        // РћС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРє РѕС‡РєРѕРІ Р»РѕРіРёСЃС‚Р°: С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєР° Рё РїРѕРїРѕР»РЅРµРЅРёРµ С…Р°Р±РѕРІ
        if (teamPoints > 0 && (type == ScoreType.HUB_PLACED || type == ScoreType.HUB_RESUPPLY)) {
            data.putInt(KEY_LOGISTICS, data.getInt(KEY_LOGISTICS) + teamPoints);
        }
        // РЈРІРµРґРѕРјР»РµРЅРёСЏ Рѕ РЅР°С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРёРё РѕС‚РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅС‹ - РѕС‡РєРё РґР°СЋС‚СЃСЏ РјРѕР»С‡Р°
    }

    // ================= РђРќРўР-Р¤РђР Рњ =================

    /**
     * true - РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёРµ СЂР°Р·СЂРµС€РµРЅРѕ (Рё РєСѓР»РґР°СѓРЅ Р·Р°РїСѓС‰РµРЅ), false - РµС‰С‘ РЅР° РєСѓР»РґР°СѓРЅРµ.
     * key РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ РІРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚СЊ С‚РёРї РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏ Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃС‚РЅРёРєРѕРІ, РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ "revive:<reviver>:<target>".
     */
    public static boolean tryCooldown(String key, long nowTick, long cooldownTicks) {
        Long last = COOLDOWNS.get(key);
        if (last != null && nowTick >= last && nowTick - last < cooldownTicks) return false;
        COOLDOWNS.put(key, nowTick);
        if (COOLDOWNS.size() > 512) {
            COOLDOWNS.values().removeIf(t -> nowTick < t || nowTick - t > ScoreValues.MAX_COOLDOWN_TICKS);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // ================= K/D Рё С‚РµС…РЅРёРєР° =================

    public static void addKill(ServerPlayer killer) {
        if (killer == null) return;
        int current = killer.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_Kills");
        killer.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_Stats_Kills", current + 1);
    }

    public static void addDeath(ServerPlayer victim) {
        if (victim == null) return;
        int current = victim.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_Stats_Deaths");
        victim.getPersistentData().putInt("AAS_Stats_Deaths", current + 1);
    }

    /** +1 Рє СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРєСѓ РїРѕРґРЅСЏС‚С‹С… РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ. */
    public static void addRevive(ServerPlayer reviver) {
        if (reviver == null) return;
        CompoundTag data = reviver.getPersistentData();
        data.putInt(KEY_REVIVES, data.getInt(KEY_REVIVES) + 1);
    }

    public static int getLogisticsPoints(ServerPlayer player) {
        return player.getPersistentData().getInt(KEY_LOGISTICS);
    }

    public static int getRevives(ServerPlayer player) {
        return player.getPersistentData().getInt(KEY_REVIVES);
    }

    /** +1 Рє СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРєР°Рј СѓРЅРёС‡С‚РѕР¶РµРЅРЅРѕР№ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё СѓР±РёР№С†С‹: РїРѕ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂРёРё Рё РѕР±С‰РёР№. */
    public static void addVehicleKill(ServerPlayer killer, VehicleCatalog.Category category) {
        if (killer == null) return;
        if (category == null) category = VehicleCatalog.Category.OTHER;
        CompoundTag data = killer.getPersistentData();
        String key = vehKey(category);
        data.putInt(key, data.getInt(key) + 1);
        data.putInt(KEY_VEH_TOTAL, data.getInt(KEY_VEH_TOTAL) + 1);
    }

    /** РЎС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРєРё РїРѕ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂРёСЏРј РІ РїРѕСЂСЏРґРєРµ VehicleCatalog.Category.values(). */
    public static int[] getVehKillsByCategory(ServerPlayer player) {
        VehicleCatalog.Category[] all = VehicleCatalog.Category.values();
        int[] result = new int[all.length];
        CompoundTag data = player.getPersistentData();
        for (int i = 0; i < all.length; i++) result[i] = data.getInt(vehKey(all[i]));
        return result;
    }

    public static int getVehKillsTotal(ServerPlayer player) {
        return player.getPersistentData().getInt(KEY_VEH_TOTAL);
    }

    /** РџРѕР»РЅС‹Р№ СЃР±СЂРѕСЃ СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєРё РёРіСЂРѕРєР° (СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚ РјР°С‚С‡Р°). */
    public static void resetStats(ServerPlayer player) {
        CompoundTag data = player.getPersistentData();
        data.putInt(KEY_TP, 0);
        data.putInt(KEY_SP, 0);
        data.putInt(KEY_KILLS, 0);
        data.putInt(KEY_DEATHS, 0);
        data.putInt(KEY_VEH_TOTAL, 0);
        data.putInt(KEY_REVIVES, 0);
        data.putInt(KEY_LOGISTICS, 0);
        for (VehicleCatalog.Category c : VehicleCatalog.Category.values()) data.putInt(vehKey(c), 0);
    }

    /** РљРѕРїРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєРё РїСЂРё РєР»РѕРЅРµ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° (С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‚Рµ РєР»СЋС‡Рё, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рµ РµСЃС‚СЊ Сѓ СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕРіРѕ РёРіСЂРѕРєР°). */
    public static void copyStats(CompoundTag oldData, CompoundTag newData) {
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_TP);
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_SP);
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_KILLS);
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_DEATHS);
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_VEH_TOTAL);
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_REVIVES);
        copyInt(oldData, newData, KEY_LOGISTICS);
        for (VehicleCatalog.Category c : VehicleCatalog.Category.values()) copyInt(oldData, newData, vehKey(c));
    }

    private static void copyInt(CompoundTag from, CompoundTag to, String key) {
        if (from.contains(key)) to.putInt(key, from.getInt(key));
    }

    public static void addStatsByName(MinecraftServer server, String playerName, int teamPoints, int squadPoints, String reason) {
        if (playerName == null || playerName.isEmpty()) return;
        ServerPlayer player = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(playerName);
        if (player != null) {
            addStats(player, teamPoints, squadPoints, reason);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.aas.events;

import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketTeamKillNotification;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource;
import net.minecraft.world.scores.Team;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

/** РЎРµСЂРІРµСЂРЅР°СЏ Р»РѕРіРёРєР°: РѕРїСЂРµРґРµР»СЏРµС‚ С‚РёРјРєРёР»Р»/С‚РёРјРЅРѕРє Рё СЂР°СЃСЃС‹Р»Р°РµС‚ СѓРІРµРґРѕРјР»РµРЅРёСЏ СѓР±РёР№С†Рµ Рё Р¶РµСЂС‚РІРµ. */
public final class TeamKillNotifier {

    /** РќР°СЃС‚РѕСЏС‰Р°СЏ СЃРјРµСЂС‚СЊ РёРіСЂРѕРєР°. */
    public static void onPlayerDeath(ServerPlayer victim, DamageSource source, boolean wasGivingUp) {
        // РРіСЂРѕРє СЃР°Рј РЅР°Р¶Р°Р» "Give Up" РІ РЅРѕРєР°СѓС‚Рµ вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ РЅРµ СѓР±РёР№СЃС‚РІРѕ.
        if (wasGivingUp) return;

        ServerPlayer found = null;
        if (source != null && source.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer direct) {
            found = direct;
        } else if (victim.getLastHurtByMob() instanceof ServerPlayer lastAttacker) {
            found = lastAttacker;
        }

        notifyIfAllied(victim, found, false);
    }

    /** РРіСЂРѕРєР° СѓР»РѕР¶РёР»Рё РІ РЅРѕРє (РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· DownedHandler.onPlayerHurt). */
    public static void onPlayerKnocked(ServerPlayer victim, @Nullable ServerPlayer attacker) {
        notifyIfAllied(victim, attacker, true);
    }

    private static void notifyIfAllied(ServerPlayer victim, @Nullable ServerPlayer killer, boolean knocked) {
        if (killer == null || killer == victim) return;

        Team killerTeam = killer.getTeam();
        Team victimTeam = victim.getTeam();
        if (killerTeam == null || victimTeam == null || !killerTeam.isAlliedTo(victimTeam)) return;

        String killerName = killer.getGameProfile().getName();
        String victimName = victim.getGameProfile().getName();

        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> killer),
                new PacketTeamKillNotification(victimName, true, knocked));
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> victim),
                new PacketTeamKillNotification(killerName, false, knocked));
    }

    private TeamKillNotifier() {
    }
}

package com.example.aas.events;

import com.example.aas.util.VehicleCatalog;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import net.minecraft.world.level.Explosion;

import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.ProjectileImpactEvent;

/**
 * РћС‚СЃР»РµР¶РёРІР°РЅРёРµ СѓСЂРѕРЅР° РїРѕ РІСЂР°Р¶РµСЃРєРѕР№ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРµ: РєС‚Рѕ Рё РєРѕРіРґР° Р±РёР».
 * getLastHurtByMob РґР»СЏ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё РЅРµРЅР°РґС‘Р¶РµРЅ, РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ С…РёС‚С‹ СЃРѕР±РёСЂР°СЋС‚СЃСЏ РёР· РЅРµСЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРёС… РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєРѕРІ:
 *  - LivingHurtEvent (РµСЃР»Рё С‚РµС…РЅРёРєР° - LivingEntity),
 *  - ProjectileImpactEvent (СЃРЅР°СЂСЏРґС‹/РїСѓР»Рё РїРѕ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРµ, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂР°СЏ РЅРµ LivingEntity),
 *  - ExplosionEvent.Detonate (РІР·СЂС‹РІС‹).
 * РўР°СЂР°РЅ: РµСЃР»Рё РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє СѓСЂРѕРЅР° - РґСЂСѓРіР°СЏ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєР°, Р·Р°СЃС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РµС‘ РІРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЊ.
 * РџРѕРјРµС‡РµРЅРЅРѕР№ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ Р»СЋР±Р°СЏ СЃСѓС‰РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ СЃ AAS_VehicleTeam РІ persistent data.
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas", bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public final class VehicleDamageTracker {

    private VehicleDamageTracker() {}

    // uuid С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё -> (uuid РёРіСЂРѕРєР° -> С‚РёРє РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРµРіРѕ РїРѕРїР°РґР°РЅРёСЏ)
    private static final Map<UUID, Map<UUID, Long>> HITS = new HashMap<>();

    // ================= РЎР‘РћР  РҐРРўРћР’ =================

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLivingHurt(LivingHurtEvent event) {
        LivingEntity target = event.getEntity();
        if (target.level().isClientSide) return;
        if (!isMarkedVehicle(target)) return;
        ServerPlayer attacker = resolveAttacker(event.getSource());
        recordHit(target, attacker);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onProjectileImpact(ProjectileImpactEvent event) {
        Projectile projectile = event.getProjectile();
        if (projectile.level().isClientSide) return;
        if (!(event.getRayTraceResult() instanceof EntityHitResult hit)) return;
        Entity target = hit.getEntity();
        if (!isMarkedVehicle(target)) return;
        Entity owner = projectile.getOwner();
        ServerPlayer attacker = asPlayer(owner);
        if (attacker == null) attacker = driverOf(owner);
        recordHit(target, attacker);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onExplosion(ExplosionEvent.Detonate event) {
        if (event.getLevel().isClientSide) return;
        Explosion explosion = event.getExplosion();
        Entity source = explosion.getIndirectSourceEntity();
        ServerPlayer attacker = asPlayer(source);
        if (attacker == null) attacker = driverOf(source);
        if (attacker == null) return;
        for (Entity affected : event.getAffectedEntities()) {
            if (isMarkedVehicle(affected)) recordHit(affected, attacker);
        }
    }

    private static boolean isMarkedVehicle(Entity entity) {
        return entity != null && entity.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_VehicleTeam");
    }

    /** РЈР±РёР№С†Р°: РёРіСЂРѕРє-СЃС‚СЂРµР»РѕРє; РµСЃР»Рё РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє - С‚РµС…РЅРёРєР° (С‚Р°СЂР°РЅ), С‚Рѕ РµС‘ РІРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЊ. */
    private static ServerPlayer resolveAttacker(DamageSource source) {
        if (source == null) return null;
        Entity direct = source.getDirectEntity();
        Entity indirect = source.getEntity();
        ServerPlayer p = asPlayer(indirect);
        if (p != null) return p;
        p = asPlayer(direct);
        if (p != null) return p;
        p = driverOf(indirect);
        if (p != null) return p;
        return driverOf(direct);
    }

    private static ServerPlayer asPlayer(Entity e) {
        return (e instanceof ServerPlayer sp) ? sp : null;
    }

    private static ServerPlayer driverOf(Entity e) {
        if (e == null) return null;
        Entity driver = e.getControllingPassenger();
        return (driver instanceof ServerPlayer sp) ? sp : null;
    }

    private static void recordHit(Entity vehicle, ServerPlayer attacker) {
        if (attacker == null || vehicle == null) return;
        if (!isEnemyOfVehicle(vehicle.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_VehicleTeam"), attacker)) return;

        long now = vehicle.level().getGameTime();
        Map<UUID, Long> perPlayer = HITS.get(vehicle.getUUID());
        if (perPlayer == null) {
            perPlayer = new HashMap<>();
            HITS.put(vehicle.getUUID(), perPlayer);
        }
        perPlayer.put(attacker.getUUID(), now);

        if (HITS.size() > 256) {
            HITS.values().removeIf(m -> {
                m.values().removeIf(t -> now < t || now - t > ScoreValues.VEHICLE_ASSIST_WINDOW_TICKS);
                return m.isEmpty();
            });
        }
    }

    private static boolean isEnemyOfVehicle(String vehicleTeam, ServerPlayer player) {
        if (vehicleTeam == null || vehicleTeam.isEmpty() || vehicleTeam.equalsIgnoreCase("NEUTRAL")) return false;
        if (player.getTeam() == null) return false;
        String pTeam = player.getTeam().getName();
        boolean playerIsBlueRed = pTeam.equalsIgnoreCase("BLUE") || pTeam.equalsIgnoreCase("RED");
        return playerIsBlueRed && !vehicleTeam.equalsIgnoreCase(pTeam);
    }

    // ================= РќРђР§РРЎР›Р•РќРР• РџР Р РЈРќРР§РўРћР–Р•РќРР =================

    /**
     * Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РёР· GameLogicEvents.processEntityLoss РїСЂРё РїРѕС‚РµСЂРµ РІСЂР°Р¶РµСЃРєРѕР№ С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё.
     * РЈР±РёР№С†Р° РїРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµС‚ clamp(penalty * 15, 30, 300) TP Рё +1 Рє СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРєР°Рј С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё,
     * Р°СЃСЃРёСЃС‚С‹ (Р±РёР»Рё Р·Р° РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёРµ 30 СЃРµРє, РЅРѕ РЅРµ РґРѕР±РёР»Рё) - 40% РѕС‚ РѕС‡РєРѕРІ СѓР±РёР№С†С‹.
     */
    public static void awardForDestroyedVehicle(Entity vehicle, ServerLevel level, String vTeam, int penalty) {
        long now = level.getGameTime();
        Map<UUID, Long> hits = HITS.remove(vehicle.getUUID());

        ServerPlayer killer = null;
        long killerTick = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        List<ServerPlayer> assists = new ArrayList<>();

        if (hits != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<UUID, Long> e : hits.entrySet()) {
                long t = e.getValue();
                if (now < t || now - t > ScoreValues.VEHICLE_ASSIST_WINDOW_TICKS) continue;
                ServerPlayer p = level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(e.getKey());
                if (p == null || !isEnemyOfVehicle(vTeam, p)) continue;
                if (t > killerTick) {
                    if (killer != null) assists.add(killer);
                    killer = p;
                    killerTick = t;
                } else {
                    assists.add(p);
                }
            }
        }

        // Р—Р°РїР°СЃРЅРѕР№ РІР°СЂРёР°РЅС‚: РµСЃР»Рё С…РёС‚РѕРІ РЅРµ СЃРѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ (РЅРµСЃС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅС‹Р№ РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє СѓСЂРѕРЅР°)
        if (killer == null && vehicle instanceof LivingEntity living) {
            if (living.getLastHurtByMob() instanceof ServerPlayer lastAttacker && isEnemyOfVehicle(vTeam, lastAttacker)) {
                killer = lastAttacker;
            }
        }
        if (killer == null) return;

        int killerTp = Math.max(ScoreValues.VEHICLE_TP_MIN,
                Math.min(ScoreValues.VEHICLE_TP_MAX, penalty * ScoreValues.VEHICLE_TP_PER_TICKET));
        StatsHandler.addScoreCustom(killer, ScoreType.VEHICLE_DESTROYED, killerTp, 0);

        String vehicleId = null;
        ResourceLocation key = ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES.getKey(vehicle.getType());
        if (key != null) vehicleId = key.toString();
        String markerType = vehicle.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_VehicleType");
        VehicleCatalog.Category category = VehicleCatalog.resolve(vehicleId, markerType);
        StatsHandler.addVehicleKill(killer, category);

        int assistTp = killerTp * ScoreValues.VEHICLE_ASSIST_PERCENT / 100;
        for (ServerPlayer assist : assists) {
            if (assist == killer) continue;
            StatsHandler.addScoreCustom(assist, ScoreType.VEHICLE_ASSIST, assistTp, 0);
        }
    }
}
