package com.example.aas.network;

import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.example.aas.events.GameLogicEvents;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.ModList;

import java.util.Map;

public class ResupplyHandler {

    /**
     * Р вЂ™Р В«Р вЂќР С’Р В§Р С’ Р С™Р ВР СћР С’: Р С•РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎРЉ Р С‘ Р В·Р В°Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљ Р ВµР С–Р С•.
     * Р РЋР В»Р С•РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ 41-48 Р С—РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‹РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎРѓР Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР В°Р В»Р В° Р С—Р С•Р С—Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р Р† Curios.
     */
    public static void applyKitToPlayer(ServerPlayer player, AASWorldData.KitInfo kit) { applyKitToPlayer(player, kit, false); }

    public static void applyKitToPlayer(ServerPlayer player, AASWorldData.KitInfo kit, boolean isAlt) {
        Inventory pInv = player.getInventory();
        pInv.clearContent();
        clearCurios(player);

        Map<Integer, CompoundTag> savedTags = GameLogicEvents.PERSISTENT_NBT_STORAGE.remove(player.getUUID());

        for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++) {
            ItemStack kitStack = kit.inventory.get(i);
            if (kitStack.isEmpty()) continue;

            ItemStack itemToGive = kitStack.copy();

            if (i < kit.saveNbtFlags.length && kit.saveNbtFlags[i] && savedTags != null && savedTags.containsKey(i)) {
                itemToGive.setTag(savedTags.get(i));
            }

            if (i < 41) {
                pInv.setItem(i, itemToGive);
            } else {
                boolean equipped = false;
                if (ModList.get().isLoaded("curios")) {
                    equipped = tryEquipInCurios(player, itemToGive);
                }

                if (!equipped) {
                    if (!pInv.add(itemToGive)) {
                        player.drop(itemToGive, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        player.getPersistentData().putString("AAS_CurrentKit", kit.name);
        player.getPersistentData().putBoolean("AAS_CurrentKitAlt", isAlt);
        com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(
                net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> player),
                new com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncMyKit(kit.name));
    }

    /** Р С›РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С”Р В° Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµРЎвЂ¦ РЎРѓР В»Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р Р† Curios */
    public static void clearCurios(ServerPlayer player) {
        if (ModList.get().isLoaded("curios")) {
            try {
                top.theillusivec4.curios.api.CuriosApi.getCuriosInventory(player).ifPresent(handler -> {
                    for (var entry : handler.getCurios().values()) {
                        var stacks = entry.getStacks();
                        for (int i = 0; i < stacks.getSlots(); i++) {
                            stacks.setStackInSlot(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                        }
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /** Р С’Р Р†РЎвЂљР С•Р СР В°РЎвЂљР С‘РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎРѓР С”Р В°РЎРЏ РЎРЊР С”Р С‘Р С—Р С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р С”Р В° Р Р† Curios (1.20.1). */
    private static boolean tryEquipInCurios(ServerPlayer player, ItemStack stack) {
        try {
            return top.theillusivec4.curios.api.CuriosApi.getCuriosInventory(player).map(handler -> {
                for (var entry : handler.getCurios().entrySet()) {
                    var stacksHandler = entry.getValue().getStacks();

                    for (int i = 0; i < stacksHandler.getSlots(); i++) {
                        if (stacksHandler.getStackInSlot(i).isEmpty() && stacksHandler.isItemValid(i, stack)) {
                            stacksHandler.setStackInSlot(i, stack.copy());
                            stack.setCount(0);
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }).orElse(false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Р СџР С›Р СџР С›Р вЂєР СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р С™Р ВР СћР С’. Р вЂ™РЎРѓРЎРЏ Р В»Р С•Р С–Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Р…Р ВµРЎРѓР ВµР Р…Р В° Р Р† KitResupplier
     * (РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р Р† Р В±Р ВµР В· Р С‘Р В·Р СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂЎР С‘Р Р†Р С•Р С–Р С• NBT, РЎРѓРЎС“Р СР СР В°РЎР‚Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎРѓРЎвЂЎРЎвЂРЎвЂљ, Р В»Р С‘Р СР С‘РЎвЂљ Р С—Р С• РЎРѓР В»Р С•РЎвЂљР В°Р С Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР В°).
     */
    public static boolean resupplyPlayer(ServerPlayer player, AASWorldData.KitInfo kit, boolean isAmmoBagSource) {
        return KitResupplier.resupply(player, kit, isAmmoBagSource);
    }

    public static void tryApplyPendingKit(ServerPlayer player, AASWorldData data) {
        // --- 1. Р С›Р СџР В Р вЂўР вЂќР вЂўР вЂєР Р‡Р вЂўР Сљ Р В¦Р вЂўР вЂєР вЂўР вЂ™Р С›Р в„ў Р С™Р ВР Сћ ---
        String pending = player.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_PendingKit");
        String current = player.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");
        boolean pendingAlt = player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_PendingKitAlt");
        boolean currentAlt = player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_CurrentKitAlt");

        // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С•РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘РЎРЉ (Pending) РІР‚вЂќ Р В±Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂР С Р ВµРЎвЂ, Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С—РЎС“РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В° РІР‚вЂќ Р В±Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂР С РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р С‘Р в„– Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљ
        String targetKitName = !pending.isEmpty() ? pending : current;
        boolean targetIsAlt = !pending.isEmpty() ? pendingAlt : currentAlt;

        // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР В° Р Р…Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С‘Р В»Р С‘ РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С• "Unassigned", Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С• Р С•РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµР С Р С•РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘РЎРЉ Р С‘ Р Р†РЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р С
        if (targetKitName.isEmpty() || targetKitName.equals("Unassigned")) {
            player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_PendingKit");
            return;
        }

        // --- Р СџР В Р С›Р вЂ™Р вЂўР В Р С™Р С’: Р РЋР СћР С’Р В Р Сћ Р ВР вЂњР В Р В« ---
        // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎР‚Р В°РЎС“Р Р…Р Т‘ Р ВµРЎвЂ°РЎвЂ Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР В°РЎвЂљ, Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Т‘Р В°РЎвЂР С Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р СР ВµРЎвЂљРЎвЂ№, Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С• Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Pending.
        if (!data.isGameStarted && !player.isCreative()) {
            player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_reserved", targetKitName).withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW), true);
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. Р СџР В Р С›Р вЂ™Р вЂўР В Р С™Р С’ Р СџР С›Р вЂќР вЂњР С›Р СћР С›Р вЂ™Р С™Р В Р вЂ™ INVASION ---
        if (data.gameMode.equalsIgnoreCase("INVASION") && data.invasionPrepTicks > 0) {
            String pTeam = player.getTeam() != null ? player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
            if (!pTeam.equals(data.invasionDefender) && !player.isCreative()) {
                player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.invasion_prep").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                return;
            }
        }

        String teamName = player.getTeam() != null ? player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "";
        if (teamName.isEmpty()) return;

        AASWorldData.KitInfo kit = data.getKitVariant(teamName, targetKitName, targetIsAlt);
        if (kit == null) return;

        // --- 3. Р СџР В Р С›Р вЂ™Р вЂўР В Р С™Р С’ Р вЂєР ВР СљР ВР СћР С›Р вЂ™ (Р С™Р В Р С›Р СљР вЂў Р РЋР С’Р СљР С›Р вЂњР С› Р ВР вЂњР В Р С›Р С™Р С’) ---
        int teamCount = 0;
        int squadCount = 0;
        String pName = player.getScoreboardName();
        AASWorldData.Squad mySquad = null;

        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : data.squads) {
            if (s.members.contains(pName)) {
                mySquad = s; break;
            }
        }

        for (ServerPlayer p : player.server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            if (p == player) continue; // Р СњР Вµ РЎРѓРЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµР С РЎРѓР В°Р СР С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР ВµР В±РЎРЏ
            if (p.getTeam() != null && p.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase().equals(teamName)) {
                String otherCurrent = p.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_CurrentKit");
                String otherPending = p.getPersistentData().getString("AAS_PendingKit");
                // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р Т‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р С–Р С•Р в„– Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” РЎС“Р В¶Р Вµ Р С‘РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С‘Р В»Р С‘ Р В·Р В°Р В±РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р В°Р В» РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂљ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљ
                if (otherCurrent.equals(targetKitName) || otherPending.equals(targetKitName)) {
                    teamCount++;
                    if (mySquad != null && mySquad.members.contains(p.getScoreboardName())) {
                        squadCount++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        boolean allowed = true;
        if (kit.maxPerTeam > 0 && teamCount >= kit.maxPerTeam) allowed = false;
        if (kit.maxPerSquad > 0 && squadCount >= kit.maxPerSquad) allowed = false;
        if (kit.minSquadPlayers > 0 && (mySquad == null || mySquad.members.size() < kit.minSquadPlayers)) allowed = false;
        if (kit.isLeaderOnly && (mySquad == null || !mySquad.leader.equals(pName))) allowed = false;

        // --- 4. Р СџР В Р ВР СљР вЂўР СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р С™Р ВР СћР С’ ---
        if (allowed) {
            // applyKitToPlayer РЎРѓР В°Р С Р С•РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С‘РЎвЂљ Р С‘Р Р…Р Р†Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚РЎРЉ Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘ Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Т‘Р В°РЎвЂЎР ВµР в„–
            applyKitToPlayer(player, kit, targetIsAlt);
        } else {
            // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р В·Р В° Р Р†РЎР‚Р ВµР СРЎРЏ РЎРѓР СР ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘ Р В»Р С‘Р СР С‘РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ Р Р…Р В° Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљ Р В·Р В°Р В±Р С‘Р В»Р С‘РЎРѓРЎРЉ Р Т‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р С–Р С‘Р СР С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°Р СР С‘
            player.sendSystemMessage(Component.translatable("aas.msg.kit_blocked", targetKitName).withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
            AASWorldData.KitInfo unassigned = data.activeKits(teamName).get("Unassigned");
            if (unassigned != null) applyKitToPlayer(player, unassigned, false);
        }

        // Р С›РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµР С Pending (Р В±РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…РЎРЉ), РЎвЂљР В°Р С” Р С”Р В°Р С” Р СРЎвЂ№ Р ВµРЎвЂ Р С•Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р С•РЎвЂљР В°Р В»Р С‘
        player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_PendingKit");
        player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_PendingKitAlt");
        // Р РЋР С‘Р Р…РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р…Р С”Р С‘ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР С•Р Р† Р Р…Р В° Р С”Р В°РЎР‚РЎвЂљР Вµ
        PacketHandler.sendToAllClients(player.serverLevel(), data);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.network;

import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * РЎРЅРёРјРѕРє РёС‚РѕРіРѕРІ РјР°С‚С‡Р° РґР»СЏ СЌРєСЂР°РЅР° РїРѕР±РµРґС‹. РЎРѕР±РёСЂР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ РІ РјРѕРјРµРЅС‚ РїРѕР±РµРґС‹
 * Рё С†РµР»РёРєРѕРј РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р°Рј (РєР»РёРµРЅС‚ С…СЂР°РЅРёС‚ РµРіРѕ РІ ClientData.lastVictory).
 */
public class VictoryData {

    /** РћРґРЅР° РёР· С‚СЂС‘С… РЅРёР¶РЅРёС… РїР°РЅРµР»РµР№ (Р»СѓС‡С€РёР№ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ / РјРµРґРёРє / Р»РѕРіРёСЃС‚). */
    public static class Panel {
        public boolean present = false;     // false -> В«РќРµС‚ Р»СѓС‡С€РµРіРѕ ...В»
        public String name = "";            // РЅР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° РёР»Рё РЅРёРє РёРіСЂРѕРєР°
        public String sub = "";             // РЅРёРє Р»РёРґРµСЂР° (С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°)
        public String team = "";            // "BLUE" / "RED" вЂ” РїРѕ РЅРµРјСѓ РІС‹Р±РёСЂР°РµС‚СЃСЏ С„Р»Р°Рі
        public int squadNumber = 0;         // СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РЅРѕРјРµСЂ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° РІ РµРіРѕ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРµ (0 = РЅРµС‚ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°)
        public boolean cmd = false;         // РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂР° (Р·РµР»С‘РЅС‹Р№ РєСЂСѓР¶РѕРє CMD)
        public int value = 0;               // РїРѕРґСЉС‘РјС‹ / РѕС‡РєРё Р»РѕРіРёСЃС‚Р° / РѕС‡РєРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°
        public List<String> squadMembers = new ArrayList<>(); // СѓС‡Р°СЃС‚РЅРёРєРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° РЅР° РјРѕРјРµРЅС‚ РїРѕР±РµРґС‹

        public void encode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
            buf.writeBoolean(present);
            buf.writeUtf(name);
            buf.writeUtf(sub);
            buf.writeUtf(team);
            buf.writeVarInt(squadNumber);
            buf.writeBoolean(cmd);
            buf.writeInt(value);
            buf.writeVarInt(squadMembers.size());
            for (String m : squadMembers) buf.writeUtf(m);
        }

        public static Panel decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
            Panel p = new Panel();
            p.present = buf.readBoolean();
            p.name = buf.readUtf();
            p.sub = buf.readUtf();
            p.team = buf.readUtf();
            p.squadNumber = buf.readVarInt();
            p.cmd = buf.readBoolean();
            p.value = buf.readInt();
            int n = buf.readVarInt();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) p.squadMembers.add(buf.readUtf());
            return p;
        }
    }

    public boolean blueWon;
    public int blueTickets, redTickets;
    public String blueFaction = "none", redFaction = "none";
    public String blueName = "", redName = "";
    public Panel bestSquad = new Panel();
    public Panel bestMedic = new Panel();
    public Panel bestLogist = new Panel();

    public int winnerTickets() { return blueWon ? blueTickets : redTickets; }
    public int loserTickets() { return blueWon ? redTickets : blueTickets; }
    public String factionOf(String team) { return "RED".equalsIgnoreCase(team) ? redFaction : blueFaction; }

    public void encode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        buf.writeBoolean(blueWon);
        buf.writeInt(blueTickets);
        buf.writeInt(redTickets);
        buf.writeUtf(blueFaction);
        buf.writeUtf(redFaction);
        buf.writeUtf(blueName);
        buf.writeUtf(redName);
        bestSquad.encode(buf);
        bestMedic.encode(buf);
        bestLogist.encode(buf);
    }

    public static VictoryData decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        VictoryData d = new VictoryData();
        d.blueWon = buf.readBoolean();
        d.blueTickets = buf.readInt();
        d.redTickets = buf.readInt();
        d.blueFaction = buf.readUtf();
        d.redFaction = buf.readUtf();
        d.blueName = buf.readUtf();
        d.redName = buf.readUtf();
        d.bestSquad = Panel.decode(buf);
        d.bestMedic = Panel.decode(buf);
        d.bestLogist = Panel.decode(buf);
        return d;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleOptions;
import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;

/** Far-visible explosion, far-audible sound and a lingering smoke column for a destroyed UAV. */
public final class UavEffects {
    private UavEffects() {}

    private static final double RANGE = 1200.0;
    private static final int SMOKE_TICKS = 160; // 8 s

    private static final class Smoke {
        final ServerLevel level; final double x, y, z; int left = SMOKE_TICKS;
        Smoke(ServerLevel l, double x, double y, double z) { this.level = l; this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; }
    }

    private static final List<Smoke> SMOKES = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void explode(ServerLevel level, Vec3 pos) {
        // volume > 1 widens the audible range (16 * volume blocks)
        level.playSound(null, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, SoundEvents.GENERIC_EXPLODE, SoundSource.AMBIENT, 64.0f, 0.6f);
        level.playSound(null, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, SoundEvents.GENERIC_EXPLODE, SoundSource.AMBIENT, 48.0f, 0.9f);

        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            double ox = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 12, oy = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 6, oz = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 12;
            toAll(level, ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, pos.x + ox, pos.y + oy, pos.z + oz, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        toAll(level, ParticleTypes.FLASH, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 3, 2, 2, 2, 0);
        toAll(level, ParticleTypes.FLAME, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 80, 5, 3, 5, 0.18);
        toAll(level, ParticleTypes.LAVA, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 30, 4, 2, 4, 0);
        toAll(level, ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 100, 6, 4, 6, 0.1);
        toAll(level, ParticleTypes.CLOUD, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 50, 5, 3, 5, 0.2);

        SMOKES.add(new Smoke(level, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z));
    }

    /** Called every level tick. */
    public static void tick(ServerLevel level) {
        if (SMOKES.isEmpty()) return;
        for (Iterator<Smoke> it = SMOKES.iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
            Smoke s = it.next();
            if (s.level != level) continue;
            if (--s.left <= 0) { it.remove(); continue; }
            if (s.left % 2 != 0) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                double ox = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.5, oz = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.5;
                // count == 0: the "spread" is the velocity direction, times speed -> rising column
                toAll(level, ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_SIGNAL_SMOKE, s.x + ox, s.y + level.random.nextDouble() * 4, s.z + oz, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0.12);
            }
            toAll(level, ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, s.x, s.y, s.z, 6, 1.5, 1.0, 1.5, 0.02);
        }
    }

    public static void clear() { SMOKES.clear(); }

    private static <T extends ParticleOptions> void toAll(ServerLevel level, T particle, double x, double y, double z,
                                                          int count, double dx, double dy, double dz, double speed) {
        double rangeSq = RANGE * RANGE;
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (!near(p.getX(), p.getZ(), x, z, rangeSq)) {
                Vec3 v = UavViewManager.viewPos(p); // a viewer's camera sits at the UAV, not at the body
                if (v == null || !near(v.x, v.z, x, z, rangeSq)) continue;
            }
            level.sendParticles(p, particle, true, x, y, z, count, dx, dy, dz, speed);
        }
    }

    private static boolean near(double ax, double az, double bx, double bz, double rangeSq) {
        double dx = ax - bx, dz = az - bz;
        return dx * dx + dz * dz <= rangeSq;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

/** Why a player stopped looking through the UAV. The id travels in PacketUavViewState. */
public enum UavExitReason {
    USER("user"),
    DESTROYED("destroyed"),
    EXPIRED("expired"),
    DOWNED("downed"),
    DEAD("dead"),
    NOT_CMD("not_cmd"),
    MATCH_END("match_end"),
    LOST("lost");

    public final String key;

    UavExitReason(String key) { this.key = key; }

    public String langKey() { return "aas.uav.exit." + key; }

    /** USER is a voluntary exit: no notification. */
    public boolean notifies() { return this != USER; }

    public static UavExitReason byId(int id) {
        UavExitReason[] v = values();
        return id >= 0 && id < v.length ? v[id] : LOST;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/** Flight path maths shared by server (entity) and client (camera anchor, map icon). */
public final class UavFlight {
    private UavFlight() {}

    /** Angular speed in rad/tick for a given linear speed (blocks/tick) and orbit radius. */
    public static double omega(double speed, double radius) {
        return speed / Math.max(1.0, radius);
    }

    public static Vec3 position(double cx, double cz, double r, double y, double theta0, double omega, double ticks) {
        double t = theta0 + omega * ticks;
        return new Vec3(cx + r * Math.cos(t), y, cz + r * Math.sin(t));
    }

    /** Minecraft yaw (degrees) of the tangent direction of travel. */
    public static float yaw(double theta0, double omega, double ticks) {
        double t = theta0 + omega * ticks;
        double dx = -Math.sin(t);
        double dz = Math.cos(t);
        return (float) (Mth.atan2(-dx, dz) * (180.0 / Math.PI));
    }

    /**
     * Average terrain height over the centre + 24 points on the circle, LOADED chunks only.
     * Fallback when nothing is loaded: sea level.
     */
    public static double averageTerrain(ServerLevel level, double cx, double cz, double r) {
        double sum = 0;
        int n = 0;
        int samples = 24;
        for (int i = -1; i < samples; i++) {
            double x = cx;
            double z = cz;
            if (i >= 0) {
                double a = i * (Math.PI * 2.0) / samples;
                x += r * Math.cos(a);
                z += r * Math.sin(a);
            }
            int bx = Mth.floor(x);
            int bz = Mth.floor(z);
            LevelChunk chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(bx >> 4, bz >> 4);
            if (chunk != null) {
                sum += chunk.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES, bx, bz);
                n++;
            }
        }
        return n > 0 ? sum / n : level.getSeaLevel();
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import com.example.aas.entity.ModEntities;
import com.example.aas.entity.ReconUavEntity;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncUav;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.mojang.logging.LogUtils;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.TicketType;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.ChunkPos;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

import java.util.Comparator;

/** Server-side UAV logic: launch, cooldown, lifetime, destruction, team sync. */
public final class UavManager {
    private UavManager() {}

    public static final TicketType<ChunkPos> UAV_TICKET =
            TicketType.create("aas_uav", Comparator.comparingLong(ChunkPos::toLong), 40);

    public enum EndKind { DESTROYED, EXPIRED, LOST, MATCH_END }
    private static final Logger LOGGER = LogUtils.getLogger();
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ launch
    public static boolean tryLaunch(ServerPlayer p, double cx, double cz, int radius) {
        ServerLevel level = p.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);

        if (!UavRules.isTeam(team) || !UavRules.isCommander(p, d)) return fail(p, "not_commander");
        if (!d.isGameStarted) return fail(p, "not_started");
        if (!p.isAlive()) return fail(p, "dead");
        if (UavRules.isDowned(p)) return fail(p, "downed");
        if (UavRules.get(d, team) != null) return fail(p, "already_active");

        long now = level.getGameTime();
        long cdEnd = UavRules.cooldownEnd(d, team);
        if (now < cdEnd) {
            p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.uav.msg.cooldown", (cdEnd - now + 19) / 20), true);
            return false;
        }

        int min = AASConfig.UAV_MIN_RADIUS.get();
        int max = Math.max(min, AASConfig.UAV_MAX_RADIUS.get());
        if (!Double.isFinite(cx) || !Double.isFinite(cz) || radius < min || radius > max) return fail(p, "bad_radius");
        if (!level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(cx, cz)) return fail(p, "bad_position");
        if (d.mapSizeBlocks > 0) {
            double half = d.mapSizeBlocks / 2.0;
            if (Math.abs(cx - d.mapCenterX) > half || Math.abs(cz - d.mapCenterZ) > half) return fail(p, "bad_position");
        }

        double altY = UavFlight.averageTerrain(level, cx, cz, radius) + AASConfig.UAV_ALTITUDE.get();
        double theta0 = level.random.nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0;
        float speed = AASConfig.UAV_SPEED.get().floatValue();
        long endTick = now + AASConfig.UAV_DURATION_SECONDS.get() * 20L;
        UavState u = new UavState(team, p.getUUID(), cx, cz, radius, altY, theta0, speed, now, endTick);

        Vec3 start = UavFlight.position(cx, cz, radius, altY, theta0, u.omega(), 0);
        ChunkPos cp = new ChunkPos(Mth.floor(start.x) >> 4, Mth.floor(start.z) >> 4);
        level.getChunk(cp.x, cp.z); // make sure the chunk exists before the entity is added
        level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(UAV_TICKET, cp, 2, cp);

        ReconUavEntity e = new ReconUavEntity(ModEntities.RECON_UAV.get(), level);
        e.configure(u, AASConfig.UAV_HEALTH.get());
        e.moveTo(start.x, start.y, start.z, UavFlight.yaw(theta0, u.omega(), 0), 0f);
        if (!level.addFreshEntity(e)) return fail(p, "bad_position");

        u.entityUuid = e.getUUID();
        UavRules.set(d, team, u);
        d.setDirty();
        syncTeam(level, d, team);
        p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.uav.msg.launched"), true);
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean fail(ServerPlayer p, String key) {
        p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.uav.msg." + key), true);
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ tick
    public static void tickLevel(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        tickTeam(level, d, "BLUE");
        tickTeam(level, d, "RED");
        if (level.getGameTime() % 100 == 0) { // safety resync (team changes, late joins)
            syncTeam(level, d, "BLUE");
            syncTeam(level, d, "RED");
        }
    }

    private static ChunkPos flightChunk(UavState u, long now, int ahead) {
        Vec3 p = UavFlight.position(u.cx, u.cz, u.radius, u.altY, u.theta0, u.omega(), now - u.startTick + ahead);
        return new ChunkPos(Mth.floor(p.x) >> 4, Mth.floor(p.z) >> 4);
    }

    /** Tickets under the UAV and ahead of it along the orbit, so chunks are generated before it arrives. */
    private static void keepFlightPathLoaded(ServerLevel level, UavState u, long now) {
        ChunkPos cur = flightChunk(u, now, 0);
        level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(UAV_TICKET, cur, 3, cur);
        for (int ahead : new int[]{40, 80}) {
            ChunkPos cp = flightChunk(u, now, ahead);
            level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(UAV_TICKET, cp, 2, cp);
        }
    }

    private static void tickTeam(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d, String team) {
        UavState u = UavRules.get(d, team);
        if (u == null) return;
        long now = level.getGameTime();
        Entity e = level.getEntity(u.entityUuid);

        if (now >= u.endTick) {
            finish(level, d, team, EndKind.EXPIRED, e instanceof ReconUavEntity r ? r : null);
            return;
        }
        if (now % 5 == 0) keepFlightPathLoaded(level, u, now);

        if (e instanceof ReconUavEntity uav && !uav.isRemoved()) {
            u.missingSince = -1;
            return;
        }
        if (now <= u.startTick + 5) return;

        // The UAV sits in a chunk that is not loaded yet: pull it in and wait instead of giving up at once.
        if (u.missingSince < 0) {
            u.missingSince = now;
            LOGGER.info("[AAS] UAV entity not found, loading its chunk (team={})", team);
        }
        ChunkPos cp = flightChunk(u, now, 0);
        level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(UAV_TICKET, cp, 3, cp);
        if (now % 5 == 0) level.getChunk(cp.x, cp.z);
        if (now - u.missingSince > 200) finish(level, d, team, EndKind.LOST, null); // 10 s
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ end of life
    /** Called by the entity when its health reached 0. */
    public static void onUavDestroyed(ReconUavEntity e, DamageSource src) {
        if (!(e.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = e.getUavTeam();
        UavState u = UavRules.get(d, team);
        if (u == null || !e.getUUID().equals(u.entityUuid)) return;
        UavEffects.explode(level, e.position());
        finish(level, d, team, EndKind.DESTROYED, e);
    }

    private static void finish(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d, String team, EndKind kind, ReconUavEntity uav) {
        UavState u = UavRules.get(d, team);
        if (u == null) return;
        UavRules.set(d, team, null);
        if (uav != null && !uav.isRemoved()) uav.discard();
        if (kind != EndKind.MATCH_END) {
            UavRules.setCooldownEnd(d, team, level.getGameTime() + AASConfig.UAV_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.get() * 20L);
        }
        d.setDirty();
        UavExitReason reason = switch (kind) {
            case DESTROYED -> UavExitReason.DESTROYED;
            case EXPIRED -> UavExitReason.EXPIRED;
            case MATCH_END -> UavExitReason.MATCH_END;
            default -> UavExitReason.LOST;
        };
        UavViewManager.exitTeam(level, team, reason);
        syncTeam(level, d, team);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ match hooks
    public static void onMatchStart(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d) {
        for (String team : new String[]{"BLUE", "RED"}) {
            if (UavRules.get(d, team) != null) finish(level, d, team, EndKind.MATCH_END, null);
            UavRules.setCooldownEnd(d, team, level.getGameTime() + AASConfig.UAV_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.get() * 20L);
        }
        d.setDirty();
        syncTeam(level, d, "BLUE");
        syncTeam(level, d, "RED");
    }

    public static void onMatchEnd(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d) {
        for (String team : new String[]{"BLUE", "RED"}) {
            UavState u = UavRules.get(d, team);
            if (u != null) {
                Entity e = level.getEntity(u.entityUuid);
                finish(level, d, team, EndKind.MATCH_END, e instanceof ReconUavEntity r ? r : null);
            }
            UavRules.setCooldownEnd(d, team, 0);
        }
        d.setDirty();
        syncTeam(level, d, "BLUE");
        syncTeam(level, d, "RED");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sync (own team only!)
    public static void syncTeam(ServerLevel level, AASWorldData d, String team) {
        PacketSyncUav pkt = PacketSyncUav.of(UavRules.get(d, team), UavRules.cooldownEnd(d, team));
        for (ServerPlayer p : level.players()) {
            if (UavRules.teamOf(p).equals(team)) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), pkt);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void syncPlayer(ServerPlayer p) {
        ServerLevel level = p.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);
        PacketSyncUav pkt = UavRules.isTeam(team)
                ? PacketSyncUav.of(UavRules.get(d, team), UavRules.cooldownEnd(d, team))
                : PacketSyncUav.of(null, 0);
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), pkt);
    }

    /** Test command: UAV cooldown of both teams back to zero. */
    public static void resetCooldowns(ServerLevel level) {
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        UavRules.setCooldownEnd(d, "BLUE", 0);
        UavRules.setCooldownEnd(d, "RED", 0);
        d.setDirty();
        syncTeam(level, d, "BLUE");
        syncTeam(level, d, "RED");
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;

/** Server-side permission checks, mirroring the artillery strike rules. */
public final class UavRules {
    private UavRules() {}

    public static String teamOf(ServerPlayer p) {
        return p.getTeam() != null ? p.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "";
    }

    public static boolean isTeam(String team) {
        return team.equals("BLUE") || team.equals("RED");
    }

    /** Leader of the squad that is the team's CMD squad (same check as PacketConfirmArtStrike). */
    public static boolean isCommander(ServerPlayer p, AASWorldData data) {
        String team = teamOf(p);
        if (!isTeam(team)) return false;
        int squadId = p.getPersistentData().getInt("AAS_SquadID");
        boolean isSL = p.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsSquadLeader");
        int cmdId = team.equals("BLUE") ? data.blueCMDId : data.redCMDId;
        return isSL && cmdId != -1 && squadId == cmdId;
    }

    public static boolean isDowned(ServerPlayer p) {
        return p.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned");
    }

    public static UavState get(AASWorldData d, String team) {
        return team.equals("BLUE") ? d.blueUav : d.redUav;
    }

    public static void set(AASWorldData d, String team, UavState s) {
        if (team.equals("BLUE")) d.blueUav = s; else d.redUav = s;
    }

    public static long cooldownEnd(AASWorldData d, String team) {
        return team.equals("BLUE") ? d.blueUavCooldownEnd : d.redUavCooldownEnd;
    }

    public static void setCooldownEnd(AASWorldData d, String team, long t) {
        if (team.equals("BLUE")) d.blueUavCooldownEnd = t; else d.redUavCooldownEnd = t;
    }

    public static float zoomFov(int index) {
        float[] def = {45f, 25f, 10f};
        try {
            java.util.List<? extends Number> l = AASConfig.UAV_ZOOM_FOV.get();
            if (l != null && index < l.size() && l.get(index) != null) return l.get(index).floatValue();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return def[index];
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraftforge.event.TickEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.item.ItemTossEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.living.LivingDeathEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.living.LivingEntityUseItemEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.AttackEntityEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.event.server.ServerStoppingEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas")
public class UavServerEvents {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLevelTick(TickEvent.LevelTickEvent e) {
        if (e.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END || !(e.level instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        UavManager.tickLevel(level);
        UavViewManager.tickLevel(level);
        UavEffects.tick(level);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogin(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) UavManager.syncPlayer(p);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRespawn(PlayerEvent.PlayerRespawnEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) UavManager.syncPlayer(p);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onDimension(PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) {
            UavViewManager.exit(p, UavExitReason.LOST);
            UavManager.syncPlayer(p);
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogout(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent e) {
        UavViewManager.forget(e.getEntity().getUUID());
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onDeath(LivingDeathEvent e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer p) UavViewManager.exit(p, UavExitReason.DEAD);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onServerStopping(ServerStoppingEvent e) {
        UavViewManager.clearAll();
        UavEffects.clear();
    }

    // ---------------- server-side input lock for the body while looking through the UAV ----------------
    private static boolean locked(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player p) {
        return p instanceof ServerPlayer sp && UavViewManager.isViewing(sp);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent public static void onRightClickItem(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickItem e) { if (locked(e.getEntity())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock e) { if (locked(e.getEntity())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onLeftClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.LeftClickBlock e) { if (locked(e.getEntity())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onEntityInteract(PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteract e) { if (locked(e.getEntity())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onEntityInteractSpecific(PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteractSpecific e) { if (locked(e.getEntity())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onAttack(AttackEntityEvent e) { if (locked(e.getEntity())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onToss(ItemTossEvent e) { if (locked(e.getPlayer())) e.setCanceled(true); }
    @SubscribeEvent public static void onUseStart(LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Start e) {
        if (e.getEntity() instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player p && locked(p)) e.setCanceled(true);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import java.util.UUID;

/** Runtime state of one team's recon UAV (kept in AASWorldData, not saved to disk). */
public class UavState {
    public final String team;
    public final UUID owner;
    public final double cx, cz;
    public final int radius;
    public final double altY;
    public final double theta0;
    public final float speed;
    public final long startTick, endTick;
    public long missingSince = -1;
    public UUID entityUuid;

    public UavState(String team, UUID owner, double cx, double cz, int radius, double altY,
                    double theta0, float speed, long startTick, long endTick) {
        this.team = team;
        this.owner = owner;
        this.cx = cx;
        this.cz = cz;
        this.radius = radius;
        this.altY = altY;
        this.theta0 = theta0;
        this.speed = speed;
        this.startTick = startTick;
        this.endTick = endTick;
    }

    public double omega() { return UavFlight.omega(speed, radius); }
}

package com.example.aas.uav;

import com.example.aas.entity.ReconUavEntity;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketUavViewState;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.mojang.logging.LogUtils;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.SectionPos;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundLevelChunkWithLightPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetChunkCacheCenterPacket;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetCarriedItemPacket;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.TicketType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.ChunkPos;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Server side of "looking through the UAV". The player body is NOT moved or replaced: it stays where it is,
 * stays loaded (own chunk ticket) and stays vulnerable; only the chunk/entity tracking centre is redirected to the
 * UAV (see ChunkMapUavMixin / TrackedEntityUavMixin) and the body's input is locked.
 */
public final class UavViewManager {
    private UavViewManager() {}

    public static final TicketType<ChunkPos> BODY_TICKET =
            TicketType.create("aas_uav_body", Comparator.comparingLong(ChunkPos::toLong), 40);

    /** Keeps the chunks around the UAV loaded server side (the player's own ticket stays on the body). */
    public static final TicketType<ChunkPos> VIEW_TICKET =
            TicketType.create("aas_uav_view", Comparator.comparingLong(ChunkPos::toLong), 40);

    private static final Logger LOGGER = LogUtils.getLogger();

    /** Set by ChunkMapUavMixin the first time it redirects a viewer. */
    public static volatile boolean mixinActive = false;

    /** Sends chunks around a centre chunk straight to one client. */
    private static final class Sender {
        int cx = Integer.MIN_VALUE, cz = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        final Set<Long> sent = new HashSet<>();

        /** @return true when every loaded chunk inside the radius has been sent */
        boolean step(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer p, int ccx, int ccz, int r, int budget, int syncLoads) {
            if (ccx != cx || ccz != cz) {
                cx = ccx; cz = ccz;
                p.connection.send(new ClientboundSetChunkCacheCenterPacket(ccx, ccz));
                sent.removeIf(k -> Math.abs(ChunkPos.getX(k) - ccx) > r || Math.abs(ChunkPos.getZ(k) - ccz) > r);
            }
            boolean missing = false;
            for (int d = 0; d <= r; d++) {
                for (int dx = -d; dx <= d; dx++) {
                    for (int dz = -d; dz <= d; dz++) {
                        if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) != d) continue;
                        long key = ChunkPos.asLong(ccx + dx, ccz + dz);
                        if (sent.contains(key)) continue;
                        if (budget <= 0) return false;
                        LevelChunk c = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(ccx + dx, ccz + dz);
                        if (c == null && syncLoads > 0) { syncLoads--; c = level.getChunk(ccx + dx, ccz + dz); } // load/generate now
                        if (c == null) { missing = true; continue; }
                        p.connection.send(new ClientboundLevelChunkWithLightPacket(c, level.getLightEngine(), null, null));
                        sent.add(key);
                        budget--;
                    }
                }
            }
            return !missing;
        }
    }

    private static final class Restore {
        final Sender sender = new Sender();
        int ticks = 0;
    }

    private static final Map<UUID, Restore> RESTORE = new HashMap<>();

    private static int fallbackRadius(ServerLevel level) {
        return Math.max(2, Math.min(level.getServer().getPlayerList().getViewDistance(), 16));
    }

    private static final class Session {
        final Sender sender = new Sender();
        long enteredAt = -1;
        final String team;
        Vec3 viewPos;
        final Vec3 anchor;
        final int slot;
        Session(String team, Vec3 viewPos, Vec3 anchor, int slot) {
            this.team = team; this.viewPos = viewPos; this.anchor = anchor; this.slot = slot;
        }
    }
    private static final class Guard {
        final Vec3 anchor; final long until;
        Guard(Vec3 a, long u) { anchor = a; until = u; }
    }
    private static final Map<UUID, Guard> GUARD = new HashMap<>();

    private static void tickGuard(ServerLevel level, MinecraftServer server, long now) {
        if (GUARD.isEmpty()) return;
        for (UUID id : new ArrayList<>(GUARD.keySet())) {
            Guard g = GUARD.get(id);
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(id);
            if (g == null || p == null || !p.isAlive() || now > g.until) { GUARD.remove(id); continue; }
            if (p.serverLevel() != level) continue;
            if (p.getY() < g.anchor.y - 1.0) {
                LOGGER.warn("[AAS] body dropped to y={} after UAV exit, put back at y={}", p.getY(), g.anchor.y);
                p.connection.teleport(g.anchor.x, g.anchor.y, g.anchor.z, p.getYRot(), p.getXRot());
                p.fallDistance = 0f;
                p.setDeltaMovement(Vec3.ZERO);
            }
        }
    }
    private static final Map<UUID, Session> SESSIONS = new HashMap<>();

    public static boolean isViewing(ServerPlayer p) { return SESSIONS.containsKey(p.getUUID()); }

    /** Where the player's chunks/entities are tracked from, or null for the normal body position. Used by mixins. */
    public static Vec3 viewPos(ServerPlayer p) {
        if (SESSIONS.isEmpty()) return null;
        Session s = SESSIONS.get(p.getUUID());
        return s == null ? null : s.viewPos;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ enter / exit
    public static boolean tryEnter(ServerPlayer p) {
        ServerLevel level = p.serverLevel();
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);
        String team = UavRules.teamOf(p);
        if (SESSIONS.containsKey(p.getUUID())) return false;
        if (!UavRules.isTeam(team) || !UavRules.isCommander(p, d) || !p.isAlive()) return deny(p, "not_commander");
        if (UavRules.isDowned(p)) return deny(p, "downed");
        UavState u = UavRules.get(d, team);
        Entity e = u == null ? null : level.getEntity(u.entityUuid);
        if (!(e instanceof ReconUavEntity uav) || uav.isRemoved()) return deny(p, "no_uav");

        RESTORE.remove(p.getUUID());
        SESSIONS.put(p.getUUID(), new Session(team, uav.position(), p.position(), p.getInventory().selected));
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), new PacketUavViewState(true, 0));
        keepBodyLoaded(level, p);
        keepViewLoaded(level, uav.position());
        level.getChunkSource().move(p); // re-evaluate tracking around the UAV
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean deny(ServerPlayer p, String key) {
        p.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("aas.uav.msg." + key), true);
        return false;
    }

    public static void exit(ServerPlayer p, UavExitReason reason) {
        Session s = SESSIONS.remove(p.getUUID());
        if (s == null) return;
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), new PacketUavViewState(false, reason.ordinal()));
        if (p.isAlive() && !p.hasDisconnected()) {
            LOGGER.info("[AAS] UAV exit: reason={} bodyY={} anchorY={} onGround={} bodyChunkLoaded={}",
                    reason, p.getY(), s.anchor.y, p.onGround(),
                    p.serverLevel().getChunkSource().getChunkNow(p.chunkPosition().x, p.chunkPosition().z) != null);
            GUARD.put(p.getUUID(), new Guard(s.anchor, p.serverLevel().getGameTime() + 20)); // 1 s
            if (p.position().distanceToSqr(s.anchor) > 0.01) {
                p.connection.teleport(s.anchor.x, s.anchor.y, s.anchor.z, p.getYRot(), p.getXRot());
            }
            p.fallDistance = 0f;
            p.setDeltaMovement(Vec3.ZERO);
            p.serverLevel().getChunkSource().move(p); // tracking back to the body
            RESTORE.put(p.getUUID(), new Restore()); // resend the body's surroundings
        }
    }

    public static void exitTeam(ServerLevel level, String team, UavExitReason reason) {
        MinecraftServer server = level.getServer();
        for (UUID id : new ArrayList<>(SESSIONS.keySet())) {
            Session s = SESSIONS.get(id);
            if (s == null || !s.team.equals(team)) continue;
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(id);
            if (p == null) { SESSIONS.remove(id); continue; }
            exit(p, reason);
        }
    }

    /** Player left the server: just forget (tracking is cleaned up by vanilla using the last section). */
    public static void forget(UUID id) { SESSIONS.remove(id); GUARD.remove(id); RESTORE.remove(id); }

    public static void clearAll() { SESSIONS.clear(); RESTORE.clear(); GUARD.clear(); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ per tick
    public static void tickLevel(ServerLevel level) {
        if (SESSIONS.isEmpty() && RESTORE.isEmpty() && GUARD.isEmpty()) return;
        MinecraftServer server = level.getServer();
        long now = level.getGameTime();
        tickGuard(level, server, now);   // was never called: nothing caught the body falling after exit
        tickRestore(level, server, now);
        if (SESSIONS.isEmpty()) return;
        AASWorldData d = AASWorldData.get(level);

        for (UUID id : new ArrayList<>(SESSIONS.keySet())) {
            Session s = SESSIONS.get(id);
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(id);
            if (s == null) continue;
            if (p == null) { SESSIONS.remove(id); continue; }
            if (p.serverLevel() != level) continue;

            if (!p.isAlive()) { exit(p, UavExitReason.DEAD); continue; }
            if (UavRules.isDowned(p)) { exit(p, UavExitReason.DOWNED); continue; }
            if (!UavRules.isCommander(p, d)) { exit(p, UavExitReason.NOT_CMD); continue; }

            UavState u = UavRules.get(d, s.team);
            Entity e = u == null ? null : level.getEntity(u.entityUuid);
            if (!(e instanceof ReconUavEntity) || e.isRemoved()) { exit(p, UavExitReason.LOST); continue; }
            s.viewPos = e.position();

            if (s.enteredAt < 0) s.enteredAt = now;
            int ccx = SectionPos.blockToSectionCoord(Mth.floor(s.viewPos.x));
            int ccz = SectionPos.blockToSectionCoord(Mth.floor(s.viewPos.z));
            if (now % 2 == 0) s.sender.step(level, p, ccx, ccz, fallbackRadius(level), 16, 1); // always, on top of the mixin
            long age = now - s.enteredAt;
            if (age == 60 || age == 200) logView(level, p, s, ccx, ccz);

            // --- server-side input lock: the body must not move or switch slots ---
            if (p.getInventory().selected != s.slot) {
                p.getInventory().selected = s.slot;
                p.connection.send(new ClientboundSetCarriedItemPacket(s.slot));
            }
            if (p.position().distanceToSqr(s.anchor) > 4.0) {
                p.connection.teleport(s.anchor.x, s.anchor.y, s.anchor.z, p.getYRot(), p.getXRot());
            }

            if (now % 20 == 0) keepBodyLoaded(level, p);
            if (now % 10 == 0) keepViewLoaded(level, s.viewPos);
            if (now % 5 == 0) level.getChunkSource().move(p); // follow the UAV with chunk/entity tracking
        }
    }

    /** Diagnostics: how many chunks around the UAV are loaded on the server / sent by the sender. */
    private static void logView(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer p, Session s, int ccx, int ccz) {
        int r = fallbackRadius(level), loaded = 0, total = 0;
        for (int dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) for (int dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
            total++;
            if (level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(ccx + dx, ccz + dz) != null) loaded++;
        }
        LOGGER.info("[AAS] UAV view: mixinActive={} uavChunk=({},{}) bodyChunk=({},{}) r={} loadedOnServer={}/{} sentByUs={} uavY={}",
                mixinActive, ccx, ccz, p.chunkPosition().x, p.chunkPosition().z, r, loaded, total, s.sender.sent.size(), (int) s.viewPos.y);
    }

    private static void tickRestore(ServerLevel level, MinecraftServer server, long now) {
        if (RESTORE.isEmpty() || now % 2 != 0) return;
        for (UUID id : new ArrayList<>(RESTORE.keySet())) {
            Restore r = RESTORE.get(id);
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(id);
            if (r == null || p == null || p.serverLevel() != level) continue;
            boolean done = r.sender.step(level, p, p.chunkPosition().x, p.chunkPosition().z, fallbackRadius(level), 24, 1);
            if (done || ++r.ticks > 200) RESTORE.remove(id);
        }
    }

    private static void keepViewLoaded(ServerLevel level, Vec3 pos) {
        ChunkPos cp = new ChunkPos(BlockPos.containing(pos));
        level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(VIEW_TICKET, cp, 3, cp); // small: only keeps the UAV's own surroundings alive
    }

    /** The body's own chunk must stay loaded + entity-ticking while the vanilla player ticket is moved to the UAV. */
    private static void keepBodyLoaded(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer p) {
        ChunkPos cp = p.chunkPosition();
        level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(BODY_TICKET, cp, 2, cp);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.util;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import com.mojang.authlib.GameProfile;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.loading.FMLPaths;

import java.io.FileReader;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Р§РёС‚Р°РµС‚ squad_players.json РёР· РєРѕСЂРЅСЏ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР° (СЂСЏРґРѕРј СЃ РїР°РїРєР°РјРё mods/config).
 * Р¤Р°Р№Р» РїРёС€РµС‚ СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅРЅРёР№ С‚СЂРµРєРµСЂ СЃС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєРё, СЌС‚РѕС‚ РєР»Р°СЃСЃ РµРіРѕ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚.
 */
public class SquadPlaytimeHelper {

    private static final String FILE_NAME = "squad_players.json";

    /** Р§Р°СЃС‹ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ, Р»РёР±Рѕ -1 РµСЃР»Рё РЅРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РѕРїСЂРµРґРµР»РёС‚СЊ. */
    public static long getPlaytimeHoursByName(MinecraftServer server, String playerName) {
        if (server == null || playerName == null || playerName.isEmpty()) return -1;
        UUID uuid = resolveUuid(server, playerName);
        if (uuid == null) return -1;
        return getPlaytimeHoursByUuid(uuid);
    }

    private static UUID resolveUuid(MinecraftServer server, String playerName) {
        // Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ РѕРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ - Р±РµСЂС‘Рј UUID РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјСѓСЋ
        ServerPlayer online = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(playerName);
        if (online != null) return online.getUUID();

        // РРЅР°С‡Рµ РїСЂРѕР±СѓРµРј РёР· РєСЌС€Р° РїСЂРѕС„РёР»РµР№ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР° (usercache.json)
        try {
            Optional<GameProfile> cached = server.getProfileCache() != null
                    ? server.getProfileCache().get(playerName)
                    : Optional.empty();
            return cached.map(GameProfile::getId).orElse(null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static long getPlaytimeHoursByUuid(UUID uuid) {
        Path path = FMLPaths.GAMEDIR.get().resolve(FILE_NAME);
        if (!Files.exists(path)) return -1;

        try (FileReader reader = new FileReader(path.toFile())) {
            JsonObject root = JsonParser.parseReader(reader).getAsJsonObject();
            JsonObject entry = root.getAsJsonObject(uuid.toString());
            if (entry == null || !entry.has("playtimeTicks")) return -1;

            long ticks = entry.get("playtimeTicks").getAsLong();
            return ticks / 20L / 3600L; // 20 С‚РёРєРѕРІ = 1 СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґР°
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.aas.util;

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.scores.Team;

/**
 * Utility for broadcasting HUB / Rally Point / Vehicle destruction messages,
 * optionally keeping them separate per team (see AASConfig.SEPARATE_TEAM_DESTRUCTION_MESSAGES).
 */
public class TeamMessageUtil {

    /**
     * Sends a destruction-related chat message either to all players (default behaviour),
     * or - if separateTeamDestructionMessages is enabled in the config - only to:
     *  - players on the "ownerTeam" (BLUE or RED, whichever team lost the HUB/Rally/Vehicle)
     *  - players who are NOT currently on the BLUE or RED team (no team, spectators, other scoreboard teams)
     * The opposing team (BLUE or RED, whichever one is NOT ownerTeam) will not receive the message.
     *
     * @param level     the server level to broadcast in
     * @param ownerTeam "BLUE" or "RED" - the team that owns/lost the destroyed object
     * @param message   the chat message to send
     */
    public static void broadcastDestructionMessage(ServerLevel level, String ownerTeam, Component message) {
        if (!AASConfig.SEPARATE_TEAM_DESTRUCTION_MESSAGES.get()) {
            level.getServer().getPlayerList().broadcastSystemMessage(message, false);
            return;
        }

        for (ServerPlayer player : level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            Team pt = player.getTeam();
            String teamName = (pt != null) ? pt.getName() : null;
            boolean isBlueOrRed = teamName != null
                    && (teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue") || teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("Red"));

            // Players without a team (or on some other scoreboard team) always see both teams' messages.
            // Players on BLUE/RED only see the message if it's about their own team's loss.
            if (!isBlueOrRed || teamName.equalsIgnoreCase(ownerTeam)) {
                player.sendSystemMessage(message);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.aas.util;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Vehicle catalog: maps a vehicle to a display category and an icon key.
 * Shared by server and client, so it must NOT import any client-only classes.
 *
 * How the category is resolved (first match wins):
 *   1) OVERRIDES_BY_VEHICLE_ID - exact vehicleIdString (e.g. "othermod:some_tank") -> category.
 *      This table is intentionally EMPTY: the entity ids of the external vehicle mod are not
 *      present in the mod sources, so they cannot be listed here. Fill it in if you want to
 *      force a category for a specific entity id.
 *   2) BY_MARKER_TYPE - the "type" string of the marker item placed in slot 0 of the spawner
 *      (VehicleMarkerItem#getType / SupplyTruckMarkerItem#getVehicleType). These strings are
 *      fully known from ModItems, so every vehicle already gets a sensible category.
 *   3) Category.OTHER.
 */
public final class VehicleCatalog {

    private VehicleCatalog() {}

    /**
     * Declaration order == list order in the panel (logistics/transport, APC/IFV, tanks, AA, helicopters).
     * langKey: EXISTING keys are reused where the mod already has one (aas.gui.map_marker.*),
     *          otherwise a new aas.gui.vehicles.category.* key is used.
     * iconKey: texture is textures/gui/vehicles/<iconKey>.png
     */
    public enum Category {
        LOGISTICS   ("logistics",   "aas.gui.vehicles.category.logistics"),
        TRANSPORT   ("transport",   "aas.gui.vehicles.category.transport"),
        APC         ("apc",         "aas.gui.map_marker.heavy_vehicle"),   // existing key (text is "APC" in all 3 langs)
        IFV         ("ifv",         "aas.gui.map_marker.light_vehicle"),   // existing key ("Combat Vehicle")
        TANK        ("tank",        "aas.gui.map_marker.tank"),            // existing key
        SPG         ("spg",         "aas.gui.map_marker.spg"),             // existing key
        AIR_DEFENSE ("air_defense", "aas.gui.map_marker.anti_air"),        // existing key
        HELICOPTER  ("helicopter",  "aas.gui.map_marker.aircraft"),        // existing key
        AIRCRAFT    ("aircraft",    "aas.gui.map_marker.cas_fighter"),     // existing key
        OTHER       ("other",       "aas.gui.vehicles.category.other");

        public final String iconKey;
        public final String langKey;

        Category(String iconKey, String langKey) {
            this.iconKey = iconKey;
            this.langKey = langKey;
        }

        /** Safe lookup by ordinal (used by the network packet). */
        public static Category byId(int id) {
            Category[] all = values();
            return (id >= 0 && id < all.length) ? all[id] : OTHER;
        }
    }

    /** vehicleIdString (entity type id) -> category. Optional manual overrides, empty by default. */
    private static final Map<String, Category> OVERRIDES_BY_VEHICLE_ID = new HashMap<>();

    /** Marker type (lower case) -> category. Values taken from ModItems. */
    private static final Map<String, Category> BY_MARKER_TYPE = new HashMap<>();

    static {
        // Example of a manual override:
        // OVERRIDES_BY_VEHICLE_ID.put("somemod:t90", Category.TANK);

        // Logistics
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("supply truck",      Category.LOGISTICS);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("light supply",      Category.LOGISTICS);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("heavy supply",      Category.LOGISTICS);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("supply helicopter", Category.LOGISTICS);
        // Transport
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("motorcycle",        Category.TRANSPORT);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("infantry vehicle",  Category.TRANSPORT);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("boat",              Category.TRANSPORT);
        // Armour
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("apc",               Category.APC);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("combat vehicle",    Category.IFV);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("atgm carrier",      Category.IFV);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("tank",              Category.TANK);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("spg",               Category.SPG);
        // Air defence
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("static zu",         Category.AIR_DEFENSE);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("mobile zu",         Category.AIR_DEFENSE);
        // Air
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("helicopter",        Category.HELICOPTER);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("cas helicopter",    Category.HELICOPTER);
        BY_MARKER_TYPE.put("cas fighter",       Category.AIRCRAFT);
    }

    /** Resolves the category of a vehicle. Both arguments may be null/empty. */
    public static Category resolve(String vehicleIdString, String markerType) {
        if (vehicleIdString != null) {
            Category c = OVERRIDES_BY_VEHICLE_ID.get(vehicleIdString);
            if (c != null) return c;
        }
        if (markerType != null) {
            Category c = BY_MARKER_TYPE.get(markerType.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            if (c != null) return c;
        }
        return Category.OTHER;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.util;

import com.example.aas.block.VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketSyncVehicleList;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import com.example.aas.world.VehicleSpawnerRegistry;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.scores.Team;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Server side: builds the per-type vehicle summary for one player.
 *
 * The per-level summary is cached for CACHE_TICKS (1 second), so even if many players poll
 * at once the spawner registry is walked at most once per second per level.
 */
public final class VehicleListService {

    private VehicleListService() {}

    private static final long CACHE_TICKS = 20L;

    /** Aggregated data for one vehicle type (vehicleIdString) of one team. */
    private static final class Agg {
        VehicleCatalog.Category category;
        int total;
        int alive;
        long nextRespawnTarget = -1;   // Р В°Р В±РЎРѓР С•Р В»РЎР‹РЎвЂљР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎвЂљР С‘Р С”, -1 = Р Р…Р ВµР С‘Р В·Р Р†Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р…Р С•/Р Р…Р ВµРЎвЂљ
        int penalty;
        String markerType = "";
    }

    private static final class Cached {
        long tick = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        Map<String, Map<String, Agg>> byTeam = new HashMap<>();
    }

    private static final Map<ResourceKey<Level>, Cached> CACHE = new HashMap<>();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- public API

    /** Builds the packet content for this player. Must be called on the server thread. */
    public static PacketSyncVehicleList buildFor(ServerPlayer player) {
        boolean privileged = player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator();
        String own = teamOf(player);

        // A player without a team (and not creative/spectator) gets an empty list -> "No data".
        if (own == null && !privileged) return PacketSyncVehicleList.empty();

        // "Allied" side: the player's own team. Creative/spectator players without a team are shown
        // BLUE as the allied side. Privileged players get full data (alive + timers) for BOTH sides.
        String ally = own != null ? own : "BLUE";
        String enemy = ally.equals("BLUE") ? "RED" : "BLUE";

        Map<String, Map<String, Agg>> summary = summaryFor(player.serverLevel());
        List<PacketSyncVehicleList.Entry> allyList = toEntries(summary.get(ally), true);
        // Enemy side: alive counts and respawn timers are NOT put on the wire (no intel leak),
        // unless the viewer is creative/spectator.
        List<PacketSyncVehicleList.Entry> enemyList = toEntries(summary.get(enemy), privileged);
        return new PacketSyncVehicleList(true, privileged, ally, allyList, enemyList);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- internals

    /** "BLUE" / "RED" or null. Team names are compared case-insensitively, like the rest of the mod. */
    private static String teamOf(ServerPlayer player) {
        Team t = player.getTeam();
        if (t == null) return null;
        String n = t.getName();
        if (n.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue")) return "BLUE";
        if (n.equalsIgnoreCase("Red")) return "RED";
        return null;
    }

    private static List<PacketSyncVehicleList.Entry> toEntries(Map<String, Agg> map, boolean full) {
        List<PacketSyncVehicleList.Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (map == null) return out;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Agg> e : map.entrySet()) {
            Agg a = e.getValue();
            out.add(new PacketSyncVehicleList.Entry(
                    e.getKey(), a.category.ordinal(), a.total,
                    full ? a.alive : -1,
                    full ? a.nextRespawnTarget : -1L,
                    a.penalty,
                    a.markerType));
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static Map<String, Map<String, Agg>> summaryFor(ServerLevel level) {
        Cached c = CACHE.computeIfAbsent(level.dimension(), k -> new Cached());
        long now = level.getGameTime();
        if (c.tick == Long.MIN_VALUE || now - c.tick >= CACHE_TICKS || now < c.tick) {
            c.byTeam = compute(level, now);
            c.tick = now;
        }
        return c.byTeam;
    }

    private static Map<String, Map<String, Agg>> compute(ServerLevel level, long now) {
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(level);
        VehicleSpawnerRegistry registry = VehicleSpawnerRegistry.get(level);

        // A spawner is "alive" if its vehicle record exists (global list, independent of chunk loading).
        Set<BlockPos> aliveSpawners = new HashSet<>();
        for (AASWorldData.VehicleRecord v : data.markedVehicles) {
            if (v.spawnerPos != null) aliveSpawners.add(v.spawnerPos);
        }

        Map<String, Map<String, Agg>> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("BLUE", new HashMap<>());
        result.put("RED", new HashMap<>());

        for (Map.Entry<BlockPos, VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot> en : registry.copy().entrySet()) {
            BlockPos pos = en.getKey();
            VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot s = en.getValue();

            // Loaded chunk: refresh the snapshot from the live block entity.
            if (level.isLoaded(pos)) {
                BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
                if (be instanceof VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity spawner) {
                    s = VehicleSpawnerRegistry.Snapshot.of(spawner);
                    registry.put(pos, s);
                } else {
                    registry.unregister(pos);   // block is gone
                    continue;
                }
            }

            Map<String, Agg> teamMap = result.get(s.team());
            final com.example.aas.deck.DeckType deckOfTeam = data.effectiveDeck(s.team());
            final String vid = s.vehicleId(deckOfTeam);   // vehicle of the deck this team plays with
            if (teamMap == null) continue;                    // NEUTRAL / no marker: not shown
            if (vid.isEmpty()) continue;            // spawner without a vehicle id

            final String markerType = s.markerType(deckOfTeam);   // class marker of that deck
            Agg a = teamMap.computeIfAbsent(vid, k -> {
                Agg n = new Agg();
                n.category = VehicleCatalog.resolve(k, markerType);
                n.markerType = markerType == null ? "" : markerType;   // <-- Р вЂќР С›Р вЂР С’Р вЂ™Р ВР СћР В¬
                return n;
            });
            a.total++;
            a.penalty = Math.max(a.penalty, s.penalty(deckOfTeam));

            if (aliveSpawners.contains(pos)) {
                a.alive++;
                continue;
            }

            // Waiting for (re)spawn. Global deadline first (set the instant the vehicle dies, works even
            // in unloaded chunks), then the spawner's own targetSpawnTick (initial spawn countdown).
            Long pending = data.pendingSpawnerRespawns.get(pos);
            long target = pending != null ? pending : s.targetSpawnTick();
            if (target > 0) {
                a.nextRespawnTarget = a.nextRespawnTarget < 0 ? target : Math.min(a.nextRespawnTarget, target);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}

/**

    public static final int NORMAL_MAX = 300;

    /** РљР»СЋС‡ Р»РѕРєР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёРё Р·Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРєР°. winnerTickets вЂ” С‚РёРєРµС‚С‹ РїРѕР±РµРґРёРІС€РµР№ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹. */

    // (РїРµСЂРµСЃС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїРѕ yaw РЅР° РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РїР°РєРµС‚, С‚.Рµ. Р·РІСѓРє В«РїСЂРёРєР»РµРµРЅВ» Рє РіРѕР»РѕРІРµ). Р“СЂРѕРјРєРѕСЃС‚СЊ РЅРµ РїР°РґР°РµС‚: СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ ~2 Р±Р»РѕРєР°.
