    // РҐРѕС‡РµС€СЊ С‚РёС€Рµ СЃР»РµРІР° вЂ” СѓРІРµР»РёС‡СЊ СѓРіРѕР» (РґРѕ 90), РіСЂРѕРјС‡Рµ СЃР»РµРІР° вЂ” СѓРјРµРЅСЊС€Рё.
    private static final double COMMAND_PAN_AZIMUTH_DEG = 39.0;
    private static final double COMMAND_PAN_DISTANCE = 2.0;    // Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ РѕС‚ РіРѕР»РѕРІС‹ СЃР»СѓС€Р°С‚РµР»СЏ
    private static final float COMMAND_PAN_RANGE = 32.0f;      // РґР°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ РїР°РєРµС‚Р° (РґРѕР»Р¶РЅР° Р±С‹С‚СЊ > COMMAND_PAN_DISTANCE)

    @Override
    public String getPluginId() {
        return "aas_voicechat";
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(VoicechatApi api) {}

    @Override
    public void registerEvents(EventRegistration registration) {
        registration.registerEvent(VoicechatServerStartedEvent.class, this::onServerStarted);
        registration.registerEvent(MicrophonePacketEvent.class, this::onMicPacket);
        registration.registerEvent(PlayerConnectedEvent.class, this::onPlayerConnectedVoice);
        // РРіСЂРѕРє РѕС‚РєР»СЋС‡РёР»СЃСЏ РѕС‚ voice chat вЂ” РѕСЃРІРѕР±РѕР¶РґР°РµРј РµРіРѕ Opus-РґРµРєРѕРґРµСЂ (Р·Р°РјРµСЂ РіСЂРѕРјРєРѕСЃС‚Рё).
        registration.registerEvent(PlayerDisconnectedEvent.class, e -> VoiceLevelMeter.remove(e.getPlayerUuid()));
        registerNameTagIconHider(registration);
        registerConnectionListener(registration);
    }

    // РЎРєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚ РЅР°Рґ РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕР№ Р’РЎР• РёРєРѕРЅРєРё voice chat (РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚/С€РµРїС‡РµС‚/РјСЊСЋС‚/РіСЂСѓРїРїР°),
    // РљР РћРњР• РёРєРѕРЅРєРё "РЅРµС‚ СЃРѕРµРґРёРЅРµРЅРёСЏ СЃ Simple Voice Chat" - РµС‘ РѕСЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏРµРј РІРёРґРёРјРѕР№.
    // NameTagIconRenderEvent РїРѕСЏРІРёР»СЃСЏ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РІ voicechat-api 2.6.0, РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ РІСЃС‘
    // РґРµР»Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ С‡РµСЂРµР· СЂРµС„Р»РµРєСЃРёСЋ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РєРѕРґ РєРѕРјРїРёР»РёСЂРѕРІР°Р»СЃСЏ РЅР° СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕР№ РІРµСЂСЃРёРё api-jar.
    private void registerNameTagIconHider(EventRegistration registration) {
        try {
            Class<?> eventClass = Class.forName("de.maxhenkel.voicechat.api.events.NameTagIconRenderEvent");

            java.util.function.Consumer<Object> consumer = event -> {
                try {
                    Object clientApi = event.getClass().getMethod("getVoicechat").invoke(event);
                    java.util.UUID entityId = (java.util.UUID) event.getClass().getMethod("getEntityId").invoke(event);

                    java.lang.reflect.Method isDisconnectedMethod =
                            clientApi.getClass().getMethod("isDisconnected", java.util.UUID.class);
                    boolean disconnected = (boolean) isDisconnectedMethod.invoke(clientApi, entityId);

                    if (!disconnected) {
                        // Р­С‚Рѕ РќР• РёРєРѕРЅРєР° "РЅРµС‚ РєРѕРЅРЅРµРєС‚Р°" (Р·РЅР°С‡РёС‚ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚/С€РµРїС‡РµС‚/РјСЊСЋС‚/РіСЂСѓРїРїР° Рё С‚.Рї.) - СЃРєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј
                        event.getClass().getMethod("cancel").invoke(event);
                    }
                    // РµСЃР»Рё disconnected == true - РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ РґРµР»Р°РµРј, РёРєРѕРЅРєР° РѕСЃС‚Р°С‘С‚СЃСЏ РІРёРґРёРјРѕР№
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                    // СЃС‚Р°СЂС‹Р№/РЅРµСЃРѕРІРјРµСЃС‚РёРјС‹Р№ API - РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РЅРµ С‚СЂРѕРіР°РµРј СЂРµРЅРґРµСЂ
                }
            };

            java.lang.reflect.Method registerEvent = EventRegistration.class.getMethod(
                    "registerEvent", Class.class, java.util.function.Consumer.class);
            registerEvent.invoke(registration, eventClass, consumer);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] NameTagIconRenderEvent unavailable, skipping icon hiding: " + t);
        }
    }

    // РћС‚СЃР»РµР¶РёРІР°РµС‚ РїРѕРґРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРµ/РѕС‚РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРµ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р° РѕС‚ РіРѕР»РѕСЃРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР° Simple Voice Chat.
    // ClientVoicechatConnectionEvent - С‡РµСЂРµР· СЂРµС„Р»РµРєСЃРёСЋ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ Р·Р°РІРёСЃРµС‚СЊ РѕС‚ РІРµСЂСЃРёРё api-jar.
    private void registerConnectionListener(EventRegistration registration) {
        try {
            Class<?> eventClass = Class.forName("de.maxhenkel.voicechat.api.events.ClientVoicechatConnectionEvent");

            java.util.function.Consumer<Object> consumer = event -> {
                try {
                    boolean connected = (boolean) event.getClass().getMethod("isConnected").invoke(event);
                    net.minecraftforge.fml.DistExecutor.unsafeRunWhenOn(
                            net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist.CLIENT,
                            () -> () -> com.example.aas.client.ClientData.voicechatConnected = connected
                    );
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            };

            java.lang.reflect.Method registerEvent = EventRegistration.class.getMethod(
                    "registerEvent", Class.class, java.util.function.Consumer.class);
            registerEvent.invoke(registration, eventClass, consumer);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] ClientVoicechatConnectionEvent unavailable: " + t);
        }
    }

    private void onServerStarted(VoicechatServerStartedEvent event) {
        serverApi = event.getVoicechat();
    }

    // ======================= Р“РћР›РћРЎРћР’Р«Р• РљРђРќРђР›Р« =======================
    // V (Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№) / B (РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ) / * (РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№) вЂ” РёРіСЂРѕРє Р·Р°Р¶РёРјР°РµС‚ РєР»Р°РІРёС€Сѓ, РєР»РёРµРЅС‚ СЃРѕРѕР±С‰Р°РµС‚
    // СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂСѓ РЅРѕРјРµСЂ РєР°РЅР°Р»Р° (PacketVoiceChannel -> VoiceChannelState). Р—РґРµСЃСЊ РјС‹ РџР•Р Р•РҐР’РђРўР«Р’РђР•Рњ
    // РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РіРѕР»РѕСЃРѕРІРѕР№ РїР°РєРµС‚ Simple Voice Chat, РѕС‚РјРµРЅСЏРµРј СЃС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅСѓСЋ РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚РєСѓ (РёРЅР°С‡Рµ SVC
    // СЃР°Рј СЂР°Р·РґР°Р» Р±С‹ Р·РІСѓРє РїРѕ СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёСЋ / РіСЂСѓРїРїР°Рј) Рё РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµРј Р·РІСѓРє С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‚РµРј, РєРѕРјСѓ РѕРЅ РїРѕР»РѕР¶РµРЅ:
    //   LOCAL   вЂ” РІСЃРµ РёРіСЂРѕРєРё РІ СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃРµ VOICE_LOCAL_RANGE (РІ С‚.С‡. РїСЂРѕС‚РёРІРЅРёРєРё), РїРѕР·РёС†РёРѕРЅРЅС‹Р№ Р·РІСѓРє;
    //   SQUAD   вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СѓС‡Р°СЃС‚РЅРёРєРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°, РЅР° Р»СЋР±РѕРј СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРё;
    //   COMMAND вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р»РёРґРµСЂС‹ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРѕРІ СЃРІРѕРµР№ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹, РЅР° Р»СЋР±РѕРј СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРё.
    // РќРё РѕРґРёРЅ РєР°РЅР°Р» РЅРµ Р·Р°Р¶Р°С‚ -> РїР°РєРµС‚ РѕС‚Р±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ (РЅРёРєС‚Рѕ РЅРµ СЃР»С‹С€РёС‚).
    // РњС‘СЂС‚РІС‹Р№ РёРіСЂРѕРє РќР• РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ РІ Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚ Рё РќР• СЃР»С‹С€РёС‚ Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚ (РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ / РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№ / СЂР°С†РёСЏ вЂ” Р±РµР· РёР·РјРµРЅРµРЅРёР№).
    // Р Р°С†РёСЏ (walkietalkie): РµСЃР»Рё Сѓ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РІ СЂСѓРєРµ РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅРЅР°СЏ СЂР°С†РёСЏ Рё РЅРё РѕРґРёРЅ РЅР°С€ РєР°РЅР°Р» РЅРµ Р·Р°Р¶Р°С‚,
    // СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёРµ РќР• РѕС‚РјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ вЂ” РјРѕРґ СЂР°С†РёРё СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚ РєР°Рє СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ.
    //
    // Р“СЂРѕРјРєРѕСЃС‚СЊ РіРѕР»РѕСЃР°: РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РїР°РєРµС‚ РґРµРєРѕРґРёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РІ VoiceLevelMeter, Р° СѓСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ (0 С‚РёС…Рѕ / 1 СЃСЂРµРґРЅРёР№ /
    // 2 РЅРѕСЂРјР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№) РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р°Рј РІРјРµСЃС‚Рµ СЃ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂРѕРј В«РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚В» вЂ” РѕС‚ РЅРµРіРѕ Р·Р°РІРёСЃРёС‚ РёРєРѕРЅРєР° РјРёРєСЂРѕС„РѕРЅР°.
    private void onMicPacket(MicrophonePacketEvent event) {
        try {
            if (serverApi == null || ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer() == null) return;
            if (event.getSenderConnection() == null) return;

            MinecraftServer server = ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer();
            UUID playerUuid = event.getSenderConnection().getPlayer().getUuid();
            ServerPlayer sender = server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(playerUuid);
            if (sender == null) return;

            int channel = VoiceChannelState.get(playerUuid);

            // --- Р РђР¦РРЇ: РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ СЂР°С†РёРё (РєР°Рє СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ) ---
            Integer talkerCanal = getActiveWalkieTalkieCanal(sender);
            if (talkerCanal != null) {
                notifyRadioActivity(server, sender, talkerCanal);
                if (channel == VoiceChannelState.NONE) return;   // РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РІ СЂР°С†РёСЋ вЂ” РЅРµ РІРјРµС€РёРІР°РµРјСЃСЏ
            }

            // Р”Р°Р»СЊС€Рµ РІСЃС‘ СЂРµС€Р°РµРј СЃР°РјРё: СЃС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅСѓСЋ СЂР°Р·РґР°С‡Сѓ Р·РІСѓРєР° SVC РѕС‚РєР»СЋС‡Р°РµРј.
            event.cancel();
            if (channel == VoiceChannelState.NONE) return;

            // РњС‘СЂС‚РІС‹Р№ РёРіСЂРѕРє РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РµС‚ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚СЊ РІ Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚ (РїРѕСЃР»Рµ event.cancel(), С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ SVC РЅРµ СЂР°Р·РґР°Р» Р·РІСѓРє СЃР°Рј)
            if (channel == VoiceChannelState.LOCAL && !sender.isAlive()) return;

            MicrophonePacket mic = event.getPacket();
            byte[] opus = mic.getOpusEncodedData();

            // Р—Р°РјРµСЂ РіСЂРѕРјРєРѕСЃС‚Рё РіРѕР»РѕСЃР° (РґР»СЏ РёРєРѕРЅРєРё РјРёРєСЂРѕС„РѕРЅР°)
            VoiceLevelMeter.update(serverApi, playerUuid, opus);

            AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(sender.serverLevel());
            String pName = sender.getScoreboardName();

            switch (channel) {
                case VoiceChannelState.LOCAL -> routeLocal(server, sender, mic, opus);
                case VoiceChannelState.SQUAD -> routeSquad(server, data, sender, pName, mic, opus);
                case VoiceChannelState.COMMAND -> routeCommand(server, data, sender, pName, mic, opus);
                default -> { }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // РЅРёРєРѕРіРґР° РЅРµ РґР°РµРј РѕС€РёР±РєРµ voicechat СѓСЂРѕРЅРёС‚СЊ tick СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР°
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] onMicPacket failed: " + e);
        }
    }

    // ---------- V: Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚ ----------
    private void routeLocal(MinecraftServer server, ServerPlayer sender, MicrophonePacket mic, byte[] opus) {
        float range = getLocalRange();
        double r2 = (double) range * range;

        LocationalSoundPacket packet = mic.locationalSoundPacketBuilder()
                .position(serverApi.createPosition(sender.getX(), sender.getEyeY(), sender.getZ()))
                .distance(range)
                .opusEncodedData(opus)
                .build();

        boolean report = shouldReportActivity(sender.getUUID());
        // level Р±РµСЂС‘Рј С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РєРѕРіРґР° СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІР»СЏРµРј РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ (takeLevel РЅР°С‡РёРЅР°РµС‚ РЅРѕРІРѕРµ РѕРєРЅРѕ Р·Р°РјРµСЂР°)
        PacketVoiceChannelActivity activity = report
                ? new PacketVoiceChannelActivity(sender.getScoreboardName(), VoiceChannelState.LOCAL,
                VoiceLevelMeter.takeLevel(sender.getUUID()))
                : null;

        for (ServerPlayer p : server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            if (p.level() != sender.level()) continue;
            if (p.distanceToSqr(sender) > r2) continue;

            // РњС‘СЂС‚РІС‹Р№ СЃР»СѓС€Р°С‚РµР»СЊ РЅРµ СЃР»С‹С€РёС‚ Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚ (РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ В«РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚В» РµРјСѓ РїРѕ-РїСЂРµР¶РЅРµРјСѓ С€Р»С‘Рј РЅРёР¶Рµ)
            if (p != sender && p.isAlive()) {
                VoicechatConnection conn = serverApi.getConnectionOf(p.getUUID());
                if (conn != null) serverApi.sendLocationalSoundPacketTo(conn, packet);
            }
            // РРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ РІ СЃРїРёСЃРєРµ СЃР»РµРІР°: С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃРѕСЋР·РЅРёРєР°Рј (Рё СЃР°РјРѕРјСѓ РіРѕРІРѕСЂСЏС‰РµРјСѓ). РџСЂРѕС‚РёРІРЅРёРє РЅРµ РІРёРґРёС‚.
            if (report && (p == sender || isAlly(sender, p))) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), activity);
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------- B: С‡Р°С‚ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° ----------
    private void routeSquad(MinecraftServer server, AASWorldData data, ServerPlayer sender, String pName,
                            MicrophonePacket mic, byte[] opus) {
        AASWorldData.Squad squad = findSquad(data, pName);
        if (squad == null) return;   // РЅРµ РІ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРµ вЂ” РЅРёРєС‚Рѕ РЅРµ СЃР»С‹С€РёС‚

        StaticSoundPacket packet = mic.staticSoundPacketBuilder().opusEncodedData(opus).build();
        boolean report = shouldReportActivity(sender.getUUID());
        PacketVoiceChannelActivity activity = report
                ? new PacketVoiceChannelActivity(pName, VoiceChannelState.SQUAD,
                VoiceLevelMeter.takeLevel(sender.getUUID()))
                : null;

        for (String member : new java.util.ArrayList<>(squad.members)) {
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(member);
            if (p == null) continue;
            if (p != sender) {
                VoicechatConnection conn = serverApi.getConnectionOf(p.getUUID());
                if (conn != null) {
                    if (com.example.aas.uav.UavViewManager.isViewing(p)) {
                        // РєР°РјРµСЂР° РІ Р‘РџР›Рђ РґР°Р»РµРєРѕ РѕС‚ С‚РµР»Р°: РїРѕР·РёС†РёРѕРЅРЅС‹Р№ Р·РІСѓРє РЅРµ РґРѕС€С‘Р» Р±С‹, С€Р»С‘Рј СЃС‚Р°С‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№ (РєР°Рє РІ С‡Р°С‚Рµ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°)
                        serverApi.sendStaticSoundPacketTo(conn, mic.staticSoundPacketBuilder().opusEncodedData(opus).build());
                    } else {
                        serverApi.sendLocationalSoundPacketTo(conn, buildCommandPannedPacket(mic, opus, p));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (report) PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), activity);
        }
    }

    // ---------- *: РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№ С‡Р°С‚ (С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р»РёРґРµСЂС‹ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРѕРІ) ----------
    private void routeCommand(MinecraftServer server, AASWorldData data, ServerPlayer sender, String pName,
                              MicrophonePacket mic, byte[] opus) {
        AASWorldData.Squad own = findSquad(data, pName);
        if (own == null || !pName.equals(own.leader)) return;   // РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚СЊ РјРѕР¶РµС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р»РёРґРµСЂ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°

        boolean report = shouldReportActivity(sender.getUUID());
        PacketVoiceChannelActivity activity = report
                ? new PacketVoiceChannelActivity(pName, VoiceChannelState.COMMAND,
                VoiceLevelMeter.takeLevel(sender.getUUID()))
                : null;

        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : new java.util.ArrayList<>(data.squads)) {
            if (s.leader == null || s.leader.isEmpty()) continue;
            ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(s.leader);
            if (p == null) continue;
            if (p != sender && !isAlly(sender, p)) continue;   // С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃРІРѕСЏ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР°

            if (p != sender) {
                VoicechatConnection conn = serverApi.getConnectionOf(p.getUUID());
                if (conn != null) {
                    if (com.example.aas.uav.UavViewManager.isViewing(p)) {
                        // РєР°РјРµСЂР° РІ Р‘РџР›Рђ РґР°Р»РµРєРѕ РѕС‚ С‚РµР»Р°: РїРѕР·РёС†РёРѕРЅРЅС‹Р№ Р·РІСѓРє РЅРµ РґРѕС€С‘Р» Р±С‹, С€Р»С‘Рј СЃС‚Р°С‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№ (РєР°Рє РІ С‡Р°С‚Рµ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°)
                        serverApi.sendStaticSoundPacketTo(conn, mic.staticSoundPacketBuilder().opusEncodedData(opus).build());
                    } else {
                        serverApi.sendLocationalSoundPacketTo(conn, buildCommandPannedPacket(mic, opus, p));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (report) PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), activity);
        }
    }

    // РџРѕР·РёС†РёРѕРЅРЅС‹Р№ РїР°РєРµС‚ РґР»СЏ СЃР»СѓС€Р°С‚РµР»СЏ: РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє Р·РІСѓРєР° СЂСЏРґРѕРј СЃ РµРіРѕ РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕР№, СЃРјРµС‰С‘РЅ РІРїСЂР°РІРѕ РѕС‚ РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёСЏ РІР·РіР»СЏРґР°.
    private LocationalSoundPacket buildCommandPannedPacket(MicrophonePacket mic, byte[] opus, ServerPlayer listener) {
        double yaw = Math.toRadians(listener.getYRot());
        double az = Math.toRadians(COMMAND_PAN_AZIMUTH_DEG);
        // Minecraft: yaw 0 = РІР·РіР»СЏРґ РЅР° +Z (СЋРі); РІРїРµСЂС‘Рґ = (-sin yaw, cos yaw); РІРїСЂР°РІРѕ = (-cos yaw, -sin yaw)
        double fx = -Math.sin(yaw), fz = Math.cos(yaw);
        double rx = -Math.cos(yaw), rz = -Math.sin(yaw);
        double x = listener.getX() + (fx * Math.cos(az) + rx * Math.sin(az)) * COMMAND_PAN_DISTANCE;
        double z = listener.getZ() + (fz * Math.cos(az) + rz * Math.sin(az)) * COMMAND_PAN_DISTANCE;
        double y = listener.getEyeY();
        return mic.locationalSoundPacketBuilder()
                .position(serverApi.createPosition(x, y, z))
                .distance(COMMAND_PAN_RANGE)
                .opusEncodedData(opus)
                .build();
    }

    // ---------- РІСЃРїРѕРјРѕРіР°С‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕРµ ----------
    private static AASWorldData.Squad findSquad(AASWorldData data, String playerName) {
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : data.squads) {
            if (s.members.contains(playerName)) return s;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // РЎРѕСЋР·РЅРёРє = С‚РѕС‚ Р¶Рµ СЃРєРѕСЂР±РѕСЂРґ-РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР° (BLUE/RED). РРіСЂРѕРєРё Р±РµР· РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹ РЅРёРєРѕРјСѓ РЅРµ СЃРѕСЋР·РЅРёРєРё.
    private static boolean isAlly(ServerPlayer a, ServerPlayer b) {
        if (a.getTeam() == null || b.getTeam() == null) return false;
        return a.getTeam().getName().equals(b.getTeam().getName());
    }

    private static float getLocalRange() {
        try {
            return (float) AASConfig.VOICE_LOCAL_RANGE.get();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return 30.0f;   // РєРѕРЅС„РёРі РµС‰С‘ РЅРµ Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР¶РµРЅ
        }
    }

    // РРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ В«РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚В» С€Р»С‘Рј РЅРµ С‡Р°С‰Рµ СЂР°Р·Р° РІ 150 РјСЃ РЅР° РёРіСЂРѕРєР° (Р·РІСѓРє РїСЂРё СЌС‚РѕРј РёРґС‘С‚ РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РїР°РєРµС‚).
    private static boolean shouldReportActivity(UUID playerUuid) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - lastVoiceActivity.getOrDefault(playerUuid, 0L) > 150) {
            lastVoiceActivity.put(playerUuid, now);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // РљСЂР°СЃРЅС‹Р№ РёРЅРґРёРєР°С‚РѕСЂ СЂР°С†РёРё: С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РёРіСЂРѕРєРё СЃ СЂР°С†РёРµР№ РЅР° С‚РѕРј Р¶Рµ РєР°РЅР°Р»Рµ (РєР°Рє СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ, С‚СЂРѕС‚С‚Р»РёРЅРі 150 РјСЃ).
    private void notifyRadioActivity(MinecraftServer server, ServerPlayer sender, int talkerCanal) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        UUID id = sender.getUUID();
        if (now - lastRadioActivity.getOrDefault(id, 0L) <= 150) return;
        lastRadioActivity.put(id, now);

        PacketRadioVoiceActivity radioPacket = new PacketRadioVoiceActivity(sender.getScoreboardName());
        for (ServerPlayer p : server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            if (p.getUUID().equals(id)) continue;
            if (playerHasWalkieTalkieOnCanal(p, talkerCanal)) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), radioPacket);
            }
        }
    }

    // Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РЅРѕРјРµСЂ РєР°РЅР°Р»Р° СЂР°С†РёРё, С‡РµСЂРµР· РєРѕС‚РѕСЂСѓСЋ СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ СЌС‚РѕС‚ РёРіСЂРѕРє,
    // РР›Р null, РµСЃР»Рё РѕРЅ РЅРµ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚ РїРѕ СЂР°С†РёРё (СЂР°С†РёРё РЅРµС‚ РІ СЂСѓРєРµ, РѕРЅР° РІС‹РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅР°,
    // РёР»Рё Сѓ РЅРµРіРѕ РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅ mute). РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ main hand Рё off hand вЂ” РјРѕРґ
    // walkietalkie СЂР°Р·СЂРµС€Р°РµС‚ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚СЊ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґРµСЂР¶Р° СЂР°С†РёСЋ РІ СЂСѓРєРµ.
    private Integer getActiveWalkieTalkieCanal(ServerPlayer player) {
        try {
            Integer canal = getActiveCanalFromStack(player.getMainHandItem());
            if (canal != null) return canal;
            return getActiveCanalFromStack(player.getOffhandItem());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private Integer getActiveCanalFromStack(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (!isWalkieTalkieStack(stack)) return null;

        CompoundTag tag = stack.getTag();
        if (tag == null) return null;

        boolean activated = tag.getBoolean(TAG_ACTIVATE);
        boolean muted = tag.getBoolean(TAG_MUTE);
        if (!activated || muted) return null;

        return tag.getInt(TAG_CANAL);
    }

    // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµС‚, РµСЃС‚СЊ Р»Рё Сѓ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РіРґРµ-Р»РёР±Рѕ РІ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂРµ (РІРєР»СЋС‡Р°СЏ СЂСѓРєРё, С…РѕС‚Р±Р°СЂ,
    // РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРѕР№ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЊ) РІРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅРЅР°СЏ СЂР°С†РёСЏ РЅР° СѓРєР°Р·Р°РЅРЅРѕРј РєР°РЅР°Р»Рµ. РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚СЃСЏ
    // РґР»СЏ СЃР»СѓС€Р°С‚РµР»СЏ: РµРјСѓ РґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РѕС‡РЅРѕ РРњР•РўР¬ РЅР°СЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРЅСѓСЋ СЂР°С†РёСЋ, РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚СЊ РІ РЅРµС‘ РЅРµ РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕ.
    private boolean playerHasWalkieTalkieOnCanal(ServerPlayer player, int canal) {
        try {
            for (ItemStack stack : player.getInventory().items) {
                if (matchesCanal(stack, canal)) return true;
            }
            if (matchesCanal(player.getOffhandItem(), canal)) return true;
            return false;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private boolean matchesCanal(ItemStack stack, int canal) {
        if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty() || !isWalkieTalkieStack(stack)) return false;
        CompoundTag tag = stack.getTag();
        if (tag == null) return false;
        // РЎР»СѓС€Р°С‚РµР»СЋ РЅРµ РѕР±СЏР·Р°С‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ Р±С‹С‚СЊ "activate=true" вЂ” РѕРЅ РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ Р±С‹С‚СЊ
        // РЅР°СЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅ РЅР° РЅСѓР¶РЅС‹Р№ РєР°РЅР°Р», С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СѓСЃР»С‹С€Р°С‚СЊ. Р•СЃР»Рё С…РѕС‡РµС€СЊ С‚СЂРµР±РѕРІР°С‚СЊ,
        // С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЂР°С†РёСЏ СЃР»СѓС€Р°С‚РµР»СЏ С‚РѕР¶Рµ Р±С‹Р»Р° РІРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅР°, РґРѕР±Р°РІСЊ: && tag.getBoolean(TAG_ACTIVATE)
        return tag.getInt(TAG_CANAL) == canal;
    }

    // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµС‚, СЏРІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ Р»Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ СЂР°С†РёРµР№ РјРѕРґР° walkietalkie (Р»СЋР±РѕР№ Р°РїРіСЂРµР№Рґ),
    // РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓСЏ namespace СЂРµРіРёСЃС‚СЂРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РёРјРµРЅРё, Р° РЅРµ РєРѕРЅРєСЂРµС‚РЅС‹Р№ РєР»Р°СЃСЃ/RegistryObject
    // РјРѕРґР° walkietalkie, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ С‚СЏРЅСѓС‚СЊ РµРіРѕ API РєР°Рє hard-dependency Рё РЅРµ СЃР»РѕРІРёС‚СЊ
    // NoClassDefFoundError/LinkageError, РµСЃР»Рё РјРѕРґ РІРґСЂСѓРі РѕС‚СЃСѓС‚СЃС‚РІСѓРµС‚ РёР»Рё СЃРјРµРЅРёС‚ РєР»Р°СЃСЃС‹.
    private boolean isWalkieTalkieStack(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty()) return false;
        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(stack.getItem());
        return id != null && id.getNamespace().equals(WALKIETALKIE_NAMESPACE);
    }

    // Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє РїРѕРґРєР»СЋС‡РёР»СЃСЏ Рє Voice Chat (Р·Р°С€РµР» РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ/РїРµСЂРµР·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РёР» РјРёРєСЂРѕС„РѕРЅ)
    private void onPlayerConnectedVoice(PlayerConnectedEvent event) {
        try {
            if (serverApi == null || ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer() == null) return;

            UUID playerUuid = event.getConnection().getPlayer().getUuid();
            ServerPlayer player = ServerLifecycleHooks.getCurrentServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(playerUuid);
            if (player == null) return;

            // Р Р°РЅСЊС€Рµ Р·РґРµСЃСЊ РёРіСЂРѕРє РґРѕР±Р°РІР»СЏР»СЃСЏ РІ РіСЂСѓРїРїСѓ SVC. РўРµРїРµСЂСЊ РіСЂСѓРїРїС‹ РЅРµ РЅСѓР¶РЅС‹; РЅР° РІСЃСЏРєРёР№ СЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№
            // РІС‹РІРѕРґРёРј РёР· Р»СЋР±РѕР№ СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕР№ РіСЂСѓРїРїС‹, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РѕРЅР° РЅРµ РїРѕРґРјРµС€РёРІР°Р»Р° Р·РІСѓРє.
            leaveGroup(player);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] onPlayerConnectedVoice failed: " + e);
        }
    }

    // ================== РњР•РўРћР”Р« РЈРџР РђР’Р›Р•РќРРЇ Р“Р РЈРџРџРђРњР ==================
    // Р’СЃРµ РІС‹Р·РѕРІС‹ Р·Р°РІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚С‹ РІ try/catch: РєР°РєР°СЏ-Р»РёР±Рѕ РѕС€РёР±РєР° voicechat РЅРµ РґРѕР»Р¶РЅР°
    // РЅРёРєРѕРіРґР° РїСЂРµСЂС‹РІР°С‚СЊ РІС‹РїРѕР»РЅРµРЅРёРµ PacketSquadAction.handle() РЅР° СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅРµ РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°СЋС‰РµРіРѕ.

    public static void createAndJoinGroup(ServerPlayer player, int squadId, String squadName) {
        // Р“СЂСѓРїРїС‹ Simple Voice Chat Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ РќР• РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓСЋС‚СЃСЏ: Р·РІСѓРє РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° СЂР°Р·РґР°С‘С‚СЃСЏ РІСЂСѓС‡РЅСѓСЋ (СЃРј. routeSquad),
        // РїРѕС‚РѕРјСѓ С‡С‚Рѕ OPEN-РіСЂСѓРїРїР° СЃР»С‹С€Р°Р»Р° РёРіСЂРѕРєР° РґР°Р¶Рµ РєРѕРіРґР° РѕРЅ РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёР» СЃ РєРµРј-С‚Рѕ РЅРµ РёР· РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°.
        if (true) return;
        if (serverApi == null) return;
        try {
            String password = UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0, 8); // РЎР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅС‹Р№ СЃРµРєСЂРµС‚РЅС‹Р№ РїР°СЂРѕР»СЊ
            UUID groupId = UUID.randomUUID(); // Р“РµРЅРµСЂРёСЂСѓРµРј ID РґР»СЏ РіСЂСѓРїРїС‹

            Group group = serverApi.groupBuilder()
                    .setId(groupId)
                    .setName("Squad: " + squadName)
                    .setPassword(password)
                    .setType(Group.Type.OPEN) // OPEN - РІСЃРµ РјРѕРіСѓС‚ СЃР»С‹С€Р°С‚СЊ РІР°СЃ РІ 3D (Spatial)
                    .setPersistent(false)     // РЎР°РјРѕСѓРґР°Р»РёС‚СЃСЏ, РєРѕРіРґР° РІС‹Р№РґРµС‚ РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёР№
                    .setHidden(true)          // РЎРєСЂС‹С‚Р°СЏ РѕС‚ РјРµРЅСЋ
                    .build();

            // Р’Р°Р¶РЅРѕ: С…СЂР°РЅРёРј СЃР°Рј РѕР±СЉРµРєС‚ Group, Р° РЅРµ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ groupId, РїРѕС‚РѕРјСѓ С‡С‚Рѕ
            // setPersistent(false) РіСЂСѓРїРїР° РЅРµ РіР°СЂР°РЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅРѕ "РЅР°С…РѕРґРёС‚СЃСЏ" С‡РµСЂРµР·
            // getGroup(groupId) РґРѕ РІС…РѕРґР° РІ РЅРµРµ РїРµСЂРІРѕРіРѕ РёРіСЂРѕРєР°.
            squadToGroupMap.put(squadId, group);

            VoicechatConnection conn = serverApi.getConnectionOf(player.getUUID());
            if (conn != null) {
                conn.setGroup(group);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] createAndJoinGroup failed for squad " + squadId + ": " + e);
        }
    }

    public static void joinGroup(ServerPlayer player, int squadId) {
        if (true) return;   // СЃРј. createAndJoinGroup
        if (serverApi == null) return;
        try {
            Group group = squadToGroupMap.get(squadId);
            if (group != null) {
                VoicechatConnection conn = serverApi.getConnectionOf(player.getUUID());
                if (conn != null) conn.setGroup(group);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] joinGroup failed for squad " + squadId + ": " + e);
        }
    }

    public static void leaveGroup(ServerPlayer player) {
        if (serverApi == null) return;
        try {
            VoicechatConnection conn = serverApi.getConnectionOf(player.getUUID());
            if (conn != null) {
                conn.setGroup(null);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] leaveGroup failed: " + e);
        }
    }
}

// PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\voicechat\VoiceActivityClock.java
package com.example.aas.voicechat;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Remembers when the last REAL microphone packet of each player arrived.
 * Has no Simple Voice Chat dependency, so it is safe to use from code that must work without the voicechat mod.
 */
public final class VoiceActivityClock {
    private static final Map<UUID, Long> LAST_MIC = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private VoiceActivityClock() {}

    public static void markMic(UUID id) {
        LAST_MIC.put(id, System.currentTimeMillis());
    }

    /** timestamp (ms) of the last mic packet, 0 if none */
    public static long lastMic(UUID id) {
        return LAST_MIC.getOrDefault(id, 0L);
    }

    public static void remove(UUID id) {
        LAST_MIC.remove(id);
    }
}

package com.example.aas.voicechat;

import net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * РљР°РєРѕР№ РіРѕР»РѕСЃРѕРІРѕР№ РєР°РЅР°Р» СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ Р·Р°Р¶Р°Р» РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РёРіСЂРѕРє (РµРіРѕ РїСЂРёСЃС‹Р»Р°РµС‚ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚, СЃРј. PacketVoiceChannel).
 *
 * Р’РђР–РќРћ: РІ СЌС‚РѕРј РєР»Р°СЃСЃРµ РќР•Рў СЃСЃС‹Р»РѕРє РЅР° Simple Voice Chat, РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ РµРіРѕ Р±РµР·РѕРїР°СЃРЅРѕ РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°С‚СЊ
 * РёР· СЃРµС‚РµРІС‹С… РїР°РєРµС‚РѕРІ РґР°Р¶Рµ РµСЃР»Рё РјРѕРґ voicechat РЅРµ СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅ.
 *
 * РЎРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ В«РїСЂРѕС‚СѓС…Р°РµС‚В»: РєР»РёРµРЅС‚ С€Р»С‘С‚ В«СЏ РІСЃС‘ РµС‰С‘ РґРµСЂР¶Сѓ РєР»Р°РІРёС€СѓВ» РєР°Р¶РґС‹Рµ ~0.5 СЃРµРє.
 * Р•СЃР»Рё СЃРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёСЏ РїРµСЂРµСЃС‚Р°Р»Рё РїСЂРёС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ (РєСЂР°С€ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р°, РїРѕС‚РµСЂСЏ РїР°РєРµС‚Р° РѕС‚РїСѓСЃРєР°РЅРёСЏ) вЂ” С‡РµСЂРµР·
 * STALE_MS РєР°РЅР°Р» СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РѕС‚РїСѓС‰РµРЅРЅС‹Рј, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РјРёРєСЂРѕС„РѕРЅ РЅРµ Р·Р°Р»РёРїР°Р».
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas")
public final class VoiceChannelState {
    public static final int NONE = 0;
    public static final int LOCAL = 1;     // V вЂ” Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‡Р°С‚
    public static final int SQUAD = 2;     // B вЂ” С‡Р°С‚ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР°
    public static final int COMMAND = 3;   // * вЂ” РєРѕРјР°РЅРґРёСЂСЃРєРёР№ С‡Р°С‚ (С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р»РёРґРµСЂС‹ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґРѕРІ)

    private static final long STALE_MS = 3000L;
    private static final Map<UUID, long[]> STATE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(); // {channel, timestampMs}

    private VoiceChannelState() {}

    public static void set(UUID id, int channel) {
        if (channel <= NONE || channel > COMMAND) {
            STATE.remove(id);
            return;
        }
        STATE.put(id, new long[]{channel, System.currentTimeMillis()});
    }

    public static int get(UUID id) {
        long[] s = STATE.get(id);
        if (s == null) return NONE;
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - s[1] > STALE_MS) {
            STATE.remove(id);
            return NONE;
        }
        return (int) s[0];
    }

    public static void clear(UUID id) {
        STATE.remove(id);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLogout(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity() != null) clear(event.getEntity().getUUID());
    }
}

            return ModList.get().isLoaded("voicechat");
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] Failed to check ModList: " + t);
            broken = true;
            return false;
        }

    public static void createAndJoinGroup(ServerPlayer player, int squadId, String squadName) {

            AASVoicechatPlugin.createAndJoinGroup(player, squadId, squadName);

            System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] createAndJoinGroup crashed, disabling voicechat integration: " + t);

    }

        } catch (Throwable t) {

// PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\voicechat\VoiceHeldKeyIndicator.java
package com.example.aas.voicechat;

import com.example.aas.config.AASConfig;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketVoiceChannelActivity;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraftforge.event.TickEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * If a player HOLDS a voice channel key (V / B / *) but no microphone packets arrive
 * (silent mic, Simple Voice Chat in voice-activation mode, ...), the speaking indicator would never show.
 * This class fills that gap: while the key is held and no real mic packet arrived recently,
 * it reports "speaking" with the quietest level (0) every 150 ms, to the same recipients as real speech.
 *
 * Real mic packets are handled by AASVoicechatPlugin (with the measured level);
 * this class only steps in when they are missing. It does not use the Simple Voice Chat API.
 */
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "aas")
public final class VoiceHeldKeyIndicator {

    private static final long REPORT_EVERY_MS = 150;
    /** if a real mic packet arrived within this time, the plugin already reports the activity */
    private static final long MIC_ACTIVE_MS = 300;

    private static final Map<UUID, Long> LAST_REPORT = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private VoiceHeldKeyIndicator() {}

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onServerTick(TickEvent.ServerTickEvent event) {
        if (event.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END) return;
        MinecraftServer server = event.getServer();
        if (server == null) return;

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (ServerPlayer sender : server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
            UUID id = sender.getUUID();
            int channel = VoiceChannelState.get(id);
            if (channel == VoiceChannelState.NONE) {
                LAST_REPORT.remove(id);
                continue;
            }
            if (now - VoiceActivityClock.lastMic(id) < MIC_ACTIVE_MS) continue;       // real speech: plugin reports it
            if (now - LAST_REPORT.getOrDefault(id, 0L) < REPORT_EVERY_MS) continue;   // throttle
            LAST_REPORT.put(id, now);

            try {
                report(server, sender, channel);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("[AAS Voicechat] held-key indicator failed: " + e);
            }
        }
    }

    // Same recipients as the real voice routing (see AASVoicechatPlugin.routeLocal / routeSquad / routeCommand).
    private static void report(MinecraftServer server, ServerPlayer sender, int channel) {
        String name = sender.getScoreboardName();
        PacketVoiceChannelActivity activity = new PacketVoiceChannelActivity(name, channel, VoiceLevelConstants.QUIET);

        switch (channel) {
            case VoiceChannelState.LOCAL -> {
                double range = getLocalRange();
                double r2 = range * range;
                for (ServerPlayer p : server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
                    if (p.level() != sender.level()) continue;
                    if (p.distanceToSqr(sender) > r2) continue;
                    if (p == sender || isAlly(sender, p)) send(p, activity);
                }
            }
            case VoiceChannelState.SQUAD -> {
                AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(sender.serverLevel());
                AASWorldData.Squad squad = findSquad(data, name);
                if (squad == null) return;
                for (String member : new java.util.ArrayList<>(squad.members)) {
                    ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(member);
                    if (p != null) send(p, activity);
                }
            }
            case VoiceChannelState.COMMAND -> {
                AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(sender.serverLevel());
                AASWorldData.Squad own = findSquad(data, name);
                if (own == null || !name.equals(own.leader)) return;   // only squad leaders can use the command channel
                for (AASWorldData.Squad s : new java.util.ArrayList<>(data.squads)) {
                    if (s.leader == null || s.leader.isEmpty()) continue;
                    ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(s.leader);
                    if (p == null) continue;
                    if (p != sender && !isAlly(sender, p)) continue;
                    send(p, activity);
                }
            }
            default -> { }
        }
    }

    private static void send(ServerPlayer p, PacketVoiceChannelActivity activity) {
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), activity);
    }

    private static AASWorldData.Squad findSquad(AASWorldData data, String playerName) {
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : data.squads) {
            if (s.members.contains(playerName)) return s;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isAlly(ServerPlayer a, ServerPlayer b) {
        if (a.getTeam() == null || b.getTeam() == null) return false;
        return a.getTeam().getName().equals(b.getTeam().getName());
    }

    private static double getLocalRange() {
        try {
            return (double) (float) AASConfig.VOICE_LOCAL_RANGE.get();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return 30.0;
        }
    }

    /** quietest stage; same numbering as VoiceLevelMeter / VoiceIcons (kept here to avoid touching the SVC-dependent class) */
    private static final class VoiceLevelConstants {
        static final int QUIET = 0;
    }
}

// PATH: src\main\java\com\example\aas\voicechat\VoiceLevelMeter.java
package com.example.aas.voicechat;

import de.maxhenkel.voicechat.api.VoicechatServerApi;
import de.maxhenkel.voicechat.api.opus.OpusDecoder;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Measures how loud each player is speaking (server side, from the microphone packets).
 *
 * Every mic packet (20 ms of Opus audio) is decoded to PCM, its RMS level is converted to dBFS,
 * smoothed (fast attack, slow release) and the peak since the last report is quantized to 3 stages:
 *
 *   QUIET  (0) - barely audible
 *   MEDIUM (1) - medium volume
 *   NORMAL (2) - normal / loud speech
 *
 * Usage (see AASVoicechatPlugin):
 *   VoiceLevelMeter.update(serverApi, playerUuid, opus);   // for every mic packet
 *   int level = VoiceLevelMeter.takeLevel(playerUuid);     // when an activity packet is sent
 *   VoiceLevelMeter.remove(playerUuid);                    // on disconnect
 */
public final class VoiceLevelMeter {

    public static final int QUIET = 0;
    public static final int MEDIUM = 1;
    public static final int NORMAL = 2;

    // ---- thresholds (dBFS, 0 = full scale). Tune these if your players' mics are louder/quieter. ----
    /** at or above this level the voice is "medium" (below it: quiet) */
    static final float MEDIUM_DB = -40f;
    /** at or above this level the voice is "normal" */
    static final float NORMAL_DB = -28f;
    /** how fast the displayed level falls after a loud moment, in dB per 20 ms packet (1.0 = 50 dB/s) */
    static final float DECAY_DB_PER_PACKET = 1.0f;

    static final float SILENCE_DB = -90f;

    private static final class State {
        OpusDecoder decoder;
        float smoothed = SILENCE_DB;   // current smoothed level
        float peak = SILENCE_DB;       // highest smoothed level since the last takeLevel()
    }

    private static final Map<UUID, State> STATES = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private VoiceLevelMeter() {}

    /** Call for every microphone packet of the player (in order). */
    public static void update(VoicechatServerApi api, UUID id, byte[] opus) {
        try {
            State st = STATES.computeIfAbsent(id, k -> {
                State s = new State();
                s.decoder = api.createDecoder();
                return s;
            });

            // an empty packet marks the end of a transmission
            if (opus == null || opus.length == 0) {
                st.decoder.resetState();
                st.smoothed = SILENCE_DB;
                st.peak = SILENCE_DB;
                return;
            }

            float db = dbfs(st.decoder.decode(opus));
            st.smoothed = db > st.smoothed ? db : Math.max(db, st.smoothed - DECAY_DB_PER_PACKET);
            if (st.smoothed > st.peak) st.peak = st.smoothed;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // decoding problem: don't break voice routing, just show the full icon
            State st = STATES.get(id);
            if (st != null) st.peak = Math.max(st.peak, NORMAL_DB);
        }
    }

    /** Level (0..2) of the loudest moment since the previous call; starts a new measuring window. */
    public static int takeLevel(UUID id) {
        State st = STATES.get(id);
        if (st == null) return NORMAL;
        int level = levelForDb(st.peak);
        st.peak = st.smoothed;
        return level;
    }

    public static void remove(UUID id) {
        State st = STATES.remove(id);
        if (st != null && st.decoder != null) {
            try { st.decoder.close(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    static int levelForDb(float db) {
        if (db >= NORMAL_DB) return NORMAL;
        if (db >= MEDIUM_DB) return MEDIUM;
        return QUIET;
    }

    /** RMS of 16-bit PCM in dBFS. */
    static float dbfs(short[] pcm) {
        if (pcm == null || pcm.length == 0) return SILENCE_DB;
        double sum = 0;
        for (short s : pcm) sum += (double) s * s;
        double rms = Math.sqrt(sum / pcm.length);
        if (rms < 1.0) return SILENCE_DB;
        return (float) (20.0 * Math.log10(rms / 32768.0));
    }
}

package com.example.aas.voicechat;

import com.example.aas.network.PacketHandler;
import com.example.aas.network.PacketRadioClick;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraftforge.network.PacketDistributor;

import java.util.ArrayList;

/**
 * Server side: when a player starts / stops talking in the squad or command channel, everybody who hears that channel
 * gets a "radio click" packet (the speaker plays his own click locally, so he is not included).
 * Recipients are the same as in the voice routing: squad = members of the speaker's squad,
 * command = leaders of the team's squads (only a squad leader may use the command channel).
 * No Simple Voice Chat classes here.
 */
public final class VoiceRadioClicks {
    private VoiceRadioClicks() {}

    /** Called with the channel before and after the change (VoiceChannelState constants). */
    public static void onChannelChange(ServerPlayer sender, int from, int to) {
        if (from == to) return;
        if (from == VoiceChannelState.SQUAD || from == VoiceChannelState.COMMAND) notifyListeners(sender, from, false);
        if (to == VoiceChannelState.SQUAD || to == VoiceChannelState.COMMAND) notifyListeners(sender, to, true);
    }

    private static void notifyListeners(ServerPlayer sender, int channel, boolean start) {
        MinecraftServer server = sender.getServer();
        if (server == null) return;
        String name = sender.getScoreboardName();
        AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(sender.serverLevel());
        PacketRadioClick pkt = new PacketRadioClick(channel, start);

        AASWorldData.Squad own = null;
        for (AASWorldData.Squad s : data.squads) {
            if (s.members.contains(name)) { own = s; break; }
        }
        if (own == null) return;

        if (channel == VoiceChannelState.SQUAD) {
            for (String member : new ArrayList<>(own.members)) {
                if (member.equals(name)) continue;
                send(server, member, sender, pkt);
            }
        } else if (channel == VoiceChannelState.COMMAND) {
            if (!name.equals(own.leader)) return;   // only squad leaders use the command channel
            for (AASWorldData.Squad s : new ArrayList<>(data.squads)) {
                if (s.leader == null || s.leader.isEmpty() || s.leader.equals(name)) continue;
                send(server, s.leader, sender, pkt);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void send(MinecraftServer server, String playerName, ServerPlayer sender, PacketRadioClick pkt) {
        ServerPlayer p = server.getPlayerList().getPlayerByName(playerName);
        if (p == null || p == sender) return;
        if (sender.getTeam() == null || p.getTeam() == null
                || !sender.getTeam().getName().equals(p.getTeam().getName())) return;   // allies only
        PacketHandler.INSTANCE.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> p), pkt);
    }
}

    public final Map<DeckType, Map<String, KitInfo>> redDeckKits = new EnumMap<>(DeckType.class);
    public final Map<DeckType, DeckParams> blueDeckParams = new EnumMap<>(DeckType.class);
    public final Map<DeckType, DeckParams> redDeckParams = new EnumMap<>(DeckType.class);
    /** The deck each team won the vote with (null = no preparation was run: behaves like COMBINED). */
    public DeckType blueDeck = null;
    public DeckType redDeck = null;
    public final Map<UUID, DeckType> blueDeckVotes = new HashMap<>();
    public final Map<UUID, DeckType> redDeckVotes = new HashMap<>();
    public DeckPhase prepPhase = DeckPhase.NONE;
    public int prepTimer = 0;
    /** While true the lobby zone does nothing (lobbyZones / lobbyCenter are kept). */
    public boolean lobbyDisabled = false;
    /** maxBlueHubs / maxRedHubs were replaced by the hubLimit of the chosen decks; the old values are kept here. */
    public boolean hubsOverridden = false;
    public int prevMaxBlueHubs = 8;
    public int prevMaxRedHubs = 8;

    public int mapCenterX = 0;
    public int mapCenterZ = 0;
    public int mapSizeBlocks = 2048;
    public String currentMapImage = "map1";

            "Officer", "Pilot Officer", "Mechanic Officer", "Scout", // Р СњР С•Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Вµ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№ Р В·Р Т‘Р ВµРЎРѓРЎРЉ
            "LAT", "HAT", "Sapper", "Sniper", "Marksman",

    public AASWorldData() {
        // Р ВР Р…Р С‘РЎвЂ Р С‘Р В°Р В»Р С‘Р В·Р В°РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎРЏ Р С—РЎС“РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦ Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂљР С•Р Р† Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘ РЎРѓР С•Р В·Р Т‘Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р С‘ Р СР С‘РЎР‚Р В°
        initDecks();

    public List<BlockPos> triggerBlocks = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    public CompoundTag save(CompoundTag tag) {
        tag.putInt("BlueTickets", blueTickets);
        tag.putInt("RedTickets", redTickets);
        tag.putInt("RespawnTimer", respawnTimer);
        tag.putInt("DeathTicketCost", deathTicketCost);
        tag.putString("BlueFaction", blueFaction);
        tag.putString("RedFaction", redFaction);
        tag.putBoolean("IsGameStarted", isGameStarted);
        tag.putString("GameMode", gameMode);
        tag.putString("InvasionDefender", invasionDefender);
        tag.putInt("InvasionPrepTicks", invasionPrepTicks);
        tag.putBoolean("PvpEnabled", pvpEnabled);
        tag.putInt("CountdownTicks", countdownTicks);
        tag.putBoolean("CountdownActive", countdownActive);
        tag.putBoolean("PlayedBlueSiren", playedBlueSiren);
        tag.putBoolean("PlayedRedSiren", playedRedSiren);
        tag.putInt("MapCenterX", mapCenterX);
        tag.putInt("MapCenterZ", mapCenterZ);
        tag.putInt("MapSizeBlocks", mapSizeBlocks);
        tag.putString("CurrentMapImage", currentMapImage);
        tag.putLong("BlueArtCD", blueArtStrikeCdEnd);
        tag.putLong("RedArtCD", redArtStrikeCdEnd);
        tag.putLong("BlueUavCD", blueUavCooldownEnd);
        tag.putLong("RedUavCD", redUavCooldownEnd);
        tag.putInt("MaxBlueHubs", maxBlueHubs);
        tag.putInt("MaxRedHubs", maxRedHubs);
        // --- Р РЋР С›Р ТђР В Р С’Р СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р РЋР СћР С’Р СћР Р€Р РЋР С’ Р С™Р С›Р СљР С’Р СњР вЂќР ВР В Р С›Р вЂ™ ---
        tag.putInt("BlueCMDId", blueCMDId);
        tag.putInt("RedCMDId", redCMDId);
        ListTag stationList = new ListTag();
        for (StationInfo s : vehicleStations) {
            stationList.add(s.save());
        }
        tag.put("VehicleStations", stationList);

        // --- Р РЋР С›Р ТђР В Р С’Р СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р РЋР С›Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ BLUE ---
        tag.putBoolean("BlueCmdActive", blueCmdVoteActive);
        tag.putString("BlueCmdCandName", blueCmdCandidateName);
        tag.putInt("BlueCmdCandId", blueCmdCandidateId);
        tag.putInt("BlueCmdTimer", blueCmdVoteTimer);
        CompoundTag blueVotesTag = new CompoundTag();
        blueCmdVotes.forEach((uuid, val) -> blueVotesTag.putBoolean(uuid.toString(), val));
        tag.put("BlueCmdVotesMap", blueVotesTag);

        // --- Р РЋР С›Р ТђР В Р С’Р СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р РЋР С›Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ RED ---
        tag.putBoolean("RedCmdActive", redCmdVoteActive);
        tag.putString("RedCmdCandName", redCmdCandidateName);
        tag.putInt("RedCmdCandId", redCmdCandidateId);
        tag.putInt("RedCmdTimer", redCmdVoteTimer);
        CompoundTag redVotesTag = new CompoundTag();
        redCmdVotes.forEach((uuid, val) -> redVotesTag.putBoolean(uuid.toString(), val));
        tag.put("RedCmdVotesMap", redVotesTag);
        ListTag vehicleList = new ListTag();
        for (VehicleRecord v : markedVehicles) {
            vehicleList.add(v.save());
        }
        CompoundTag pendingRespawnsTag = new CompoundTag();
        pendingSpawnerRespawns.forEach((p, t) -> pendingRespawnsTag.putLong(String.valueOf(p.asLong()), t));
        tag.put("PendingSpawnerRespawns", pendingRespawnsTag);
        ListTag triggerList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos p : triggerBlocks) triggerList.add(LongTag.valueOf(p.asLong()));
        tag.put("TriggerBlocks", triggerList);
        tag.put("MarkedVehicles", vehicleList);
        ListTag markerList = new ListTag();
        for (MapMarker m : activeMarkers) markerList.add(m.save());
        tag.put("TacticalMarkers", markerList);
        ListTag blueList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos pos : blueRallies) blueList.add(LongTag.valueOf(pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("BlueRallies", blueList);

        ListTag mainZoneList = new ListTag();
        for (MainProtectionZone zone : mainZones) mainZoneList.add(zone.save());
        tag.put("MainZones", mainZoneList);

        if (lobbyCenter != null) {
            CompoundTag centerTag = new CompoundTag();
            centerTag.putInt("X", lobbyCenter.getX());
            centerTag.putInt("Y", lobbyCenter.getY());
            centerTag.putInt("Z", lobbyCenter.getZ());
            tag.put("LobbyCenter", centerTag);
        }

        ListTag lobbyZoneList = new ListTag();
        for (LobbyZone zone : lobbyZones) lobbyZoneList.add(zone.save());
        tag.put("LobbyZones", lobbyZoneList);

        ListTag redList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos pos : redRallies) redList.add(LongTag.valueOf(pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("RedRallies", redList);

        ListTag hubList = new ListTag();
        for (HubInfo h : hubs) hubList.add(h.save());
        tag.put("HubsData", hubList);

        CompoundTag blueSpawnsTag = new CompoundTag();
        blueSpawns.forEach((dim, pos) -> blueSpawnsTag.putLong(dim, pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("BlueSpawnsMap", blueSpawnsTag);

        CompoundTag redSpawnsTag = new CompoundTag();
        redSpawns.forEach((dim, pos) -> redSpawnsTag.putLong(dim, pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("RedSpawnsMap", redSpawnsTag);

        CompoundTag neutralSpawnsTag = new CompoundTag();
        neutralSpawns.forEach((dim, pos) -> neutralSpawnsTag.putLong(dim, pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("NeutralSpawnsMap", neutralSpawnsTag);

        ListTag pointsList = new ListTag();
        for (CapturePoint point : capturePoints) pointsList.add(point.save());
        tag.put("CapturePoints", pointsList);

        ListTag squadList = new ListTag();
        for (Squad s : squads) squadList.add(s.save());
        tag.put("Squads", squadList);

        // === Р РЋР С›Р ТђР В Р С’Р СњР вЂўР СњР ВР вЂў Р С™Р ВР СћР С›Р вЂ™ ===
        saveDeckData(tag);
        ListTag reqList = new ListTag();
        for (com.example.aas.art.ArtRequest r : artRequests) reqList.add(r.save());
        tag.put("ArtRequests", reqList);

        ListTag cdList = new ListTag();
        for (Map.Entry<UUID, Long> e : artCooldownEnd.entrySet()) {
            CompoundTag c = new CompoundTag();
            c.putUUID("Id", e.getKey());
            c.putLong("End", e.getValue());
            cdList.add(c);
        }
        tag.put("ArtCooldowns", cdList);

        ListTag artList = new ListTag();
        for (com.example.aas.art.ArtStrike s : activeStrikes) artList.add(s.save());
        tag.put("ActiveStrikesList", artList);

        return tag;
    }

    public static AASWorldData load(CompoundTag tag) {
        AASWorldData data = new AASWorldData();
        data.blueTickets = tag.getInt("BlueTickets");
        data.redTickets = tag.getInt("RedTickets");
        data.respawnTimer = tag.getInt("RespawnTimer");
        data.deathTicketCost = tag.getInt("DeathTicketCost");
        data.blueFaction = tag.getString("BlueFaction");
        data.redFaction = tag.getString("RedFaction");
        data.isGameStarted = tag.getBoolean("IsGameStarted");
        data.gameMode = tag.contains("GameMode") ? tag.getString("GameMode") : "AAS";
        data.invasionDefender = tag.getString("InvasionDefender");
        data.invasionPrepTicks = tag.getInt("InvasionPrepTicks");
        data.pvpEnabled = tag.contains("PvpEnabled") ? tag.getBoolean("PvpEnabled") : true;
        data.countdownTicks = tag.getInt("CountdownTicks");
        data.countdownActive = tag.getBoolean("CountdownActive");
        data.playedBlueSiren = tag.getBoolean("PlayedBlueSiren");
        data.playedRedSiren = tag.getBoolean("PlayedRedSiren");
        data.mapCenterX = tag.getInt("MapCenterX");
        data.mapCenterZ = tag.getInt("MapCenterZ");
        data.mapSizeBlocks = tag.contains("MapSizeBlocks") ? tag.getInt("MapSizeBlocks") : 2048;
        data.currentMapImage = tag.contains("CurrentMapImage") ? tag.getString("CurrentMapImage") : "map1";
        data.blueArtStrikeCdEnd = tag.getLong("BlueArtCD");
        data.redArtStrikeCdEnd = tag.getLong("RedArtCD");
        data.blueUavCooldownEnd = tag.getLong("BlueUavCD");
        data.redUavCooldownEnd = tag.getLong("RedUavCD");
        data.maxBlueHubs = tag.contains("MaxBlueHubs") ? tag.getInt("MaxBlueHubs") : 8;
        data.maxRedHubs = tag.contains("MaxRedHubs") ? tag.getInt("MaxRedHubs") : 8;
        data.blueCMDId = tag.getInt("BlueCMDId");
        data.redCMDId = tag.getInt("RedCMDId");

        // --- Р вЂ”Р С’Р вЂњР В Р Р€Р вЂ”Р С™Р С’ Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р РЋР С›Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ BLUE ---
        data.blueCmdVoteActive = tag.getBoolean("BlueCmdActive");
        data.blueCmdCandidateName = tag.getString("BlueCmdCandName");
        data.blueCmdCandidateId = tag.getInt("BlueCmdCandId");
        data.blueCmdVoteTimer = tag.getInt("BlueCmdTimer");
        if (tag.contains("BlueCmdVotesMap")) {
            CompoundTag cv = tag.getCompound("BlueCmdVotesMap");
            for (String key : cv.getAllKeys()) data.blueCmdVotes.put(UUID.fromString(key), cv.getBoolean(key));
        }

        // --- Р вЂ”Р С’Р вЂњР В Р Р€Р вЂ”Р С™Р С’ Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р РЋР С›Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ RED ---
        data.redCmdVoteActive = tag.getBoolean("RedCmdActive");
        data.redCmdCandidateName = tag.getString("RedCmdCandName");
        data.redCmdCandidateId = tag.getInt("RedCmdCandId");
        data.redCmdVoteTimer = tag.getInt("RedCmdTimer");
        if (tag.contains("RedCmdVotesMap")) {
            CompoundTag cv = tag.getCompound("RedCmdVotesMap");
            for (String key : cv.getAllKeys()) data.redCmdVotes.put(UUID.fromString(key), cv.getBoolean(key));
        }
        if (tag.contains("TacticalMarkers")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("TacticalMarkers", 10);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.activeMarkers.add(MapMarker.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("TriggerBlocks")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("TriggerBlocks", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) data.triggerBlocks.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }
        if (tag.contains("MainZones")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("MainZones", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.mainZones.add(MainProtectionZone.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("LobbyCenter")) {
            CompoundTag centerTag = tag.getCompound("LobbyCenter");
            data.lobbyCenter = new BlockPos(centerTag.getInt("X"), centerTag.getInt("Y"), centerTag.getInt("Z"));
        }
        if (tag.contains("LobbyZones")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("LobbyZones", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.lobbyZones.add(LobbyZone.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("MarkedVehicles")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("MarkedVehicles", 10);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                data.markedVehicles.add(VehicleRecord.load(list.getCompound(i)));
            }
        }
        if (tag.contains("PendingSpawnerRespawns")) {
            CompoundTag pendingTag = tag.getCompound("PendingSpawnerRespawns");
            for (String key : pendingTag.getAllKeys()) {
                long posLong = Long.parseLong(key);
                data.pendingSpawnerRespawns.put(BlockPos.of(posLong), pendingTag.getLong(key));
            }
        }
        if (tag.contains("BlueRallies")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("BlueRallies", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) data.blueRallies.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }
        if (tag.contains("RedRallies")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("RedRallies", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) data.redRallies.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }

        if (tag.contains("HubsData")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("HubsData", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                data.hubs.add(HubInfo.load(list.getCompound(i)));
            }
        }

        if (tag.contains("BlueSpawnsMap")) {
            CompoundTag map = tag.getCompound("BlueSpawnsMap");
            for(String key : map.getAllKeys()) data.blueSpawns.put(key, BlockPos.of(map.getLong(key)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("RedSpawnsMap")) {
            CompoundTag map = tag.getCompound("RedSpawnsMap");
            for(String key : map.getAllKeys()) data.redSpawns.put(key, BlockPos.of(map.getLong(key)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("NeutralSpawnsMap")) {
            CompoundTag map = tag.getCompound("NeutralSpawnsMap");
            for(String key : map.getAllKeys()) data.neutralSpawns.put(key, BlockPos.of(map.getLong(key)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("CapturePoints")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("CapturePoints", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.capturePoints.add(CapturePoint.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("Squads")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("Squads", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.squads.add(Squad.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }

        if (tag.contains("VehicleStations")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("VehicleStations", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                // Р вЂќР С›Р вЂР С’Р вЂ™Р В¬ "data." Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘ vehicleStations
                data.vehicleStations.add(StationInfo.load(list.getCompound(i)));
            }
        }

        // === Р вЂ”Р С’Р вЂњР В Р Р€Р вЂ”Р С™Р С’ Р С™Р ВР СћР С›Р вЂ™ ===
        data.loadDeckData(tag);

        if (tag.contains("ArtRequests")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("ArtRequests", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.artRequests.add(com.example.aas.art.ArtRequest.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("ArtCooldowns")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("ArtCooldowns", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                CompoundTag c = list.getCompound(i);
                data.artCooldownEnd.put(c.getUUID("Id"), c.getLong("End"));
            }
        }
        if (tag.contains("ActiveStrikesList")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("ActiveStrikesList", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                com.example.aas.art.ArtStrike s = com.example.aas.art.ArtStrike.load(list.getCompound(i));
                if (s != null) data.activeStrikes.add(s);   // entries of the old strike system are skipped
            }
        }
        data.activeMarkers.removeIf(m -> "Artillery Request".equals(m.type));   // old map-marker request flow is gone
        if (tag.contains("VehicleStations")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("VehicleStations", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) data.vehicleStations.add(StationInfo.load(list.getCompound(i)));
        }
        return data;
    }

    // ====================================================================== DECKS

    private static boolean isBlueTeam(String team) {
        return "BLUE".equalsIgnoreCase(team);
    }

    private void initDecks() {
        for (DeckType deck : DeckType.VALUES) {
            blueDeckKits.put(deck, newKitMap());
            redDeckKits.put(deck, newKitMap());
            blueDeckParams.put(deck, DeckParams.defaultsFor(deck));
            redDeckParams.put(deck, DeckParams.defaultsFor(deck));
        }
    }

    /** Empty KitInfo for every name in KIT_NAMES. */
    private static Map<String, KitInfo> newKitMap() {
        Map<String, KitInfo> m = new HashMap<>();
        for (String name : KIT_NAMES) m.put(name, new KitInfo(name));
        return m;
    }

    /** The kits of one deck of one team ("BLUE" / "RED"). Never falls back to another deck. */
    public Map<String, KitInfo> kitsFor(String team, DeckType deck) {
        Map<DeckType, Map<String, KitInfo>> all = isBlueTeam(team) ? blueDeckKits : redDeckKits;
        return all.computeIfAbsent(deck, k -> newKitMap());
    }

    public DeckParams paramsFor(String team, DeckType deck) {
        Map<DeckType, DeckParams> all = isBlueTeam(team) ? blueDeckParams : redDeckParams;
        return all.computeIfAbsent(deck, DeckParams::defaultsFor);
    }

    /** The deck the team won with, null if none (also for NEUTRAL). */
    public DeckType chosenDeck(String team) {
        if ("BLUE".equalsIgnoreCase(team)) return blueDeck;
        if ("RED".equalsIgnoreCase(team)) return redDeck;
        return null;
    }

    /** Chosen deck, or COMBINED when there is none (old worlds, match started without preparation). */
    public DeckType effectiveDeck(String team) {
        DeckType d = chosenDeck(team);
        return d != null ? d : DeckType.COMBINED;
    }

    /** The kits players of this team use right now = kits of the effective deck. */
    public Map<String, KitInfo> activeKits(String team) {
        return kitsFor(team, effectiveDeck(team));
    }

    /** Enabled decks of the team (never empty: COMBINED is returned if the admin disabled everything). */
    public List<DeckType> enabledDecks(String team) {
        List<DeckType> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (DeckType deck : DeckType.VALUES) if (paramsFor(team, deck).enabled) out.add(deck);
        if (out.isEmpty()) out.add(DeckType.COMBINED);
        return out;
    }

    private static CompoundTag saveKits(Map<DeckType, Map<String, KitInfo>> all) {
        CompoundTag out = new CompoundTag();
        for (Map.Entry<DeckType, Map<String, KitInfo>> e : all.entrySet()) {
            CompoundTag kits = new CompoundTag();
            for (KitInfo k : e.getValue().values()) kits.put(k.name, k.save());
            out.put(e.getKey().id, kits);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static void loadKits(CompoundTag in, Map<DeckType, Map<String, KitInfo>> all) {
        for (DeckType deck : DeckType.VALUES) {
            Map<String, KitInfo> kits = newKitMap();
            if (in.contains(deck.id, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND)) {
                CompoundTag t = in.getCompound(deck.id);
                for (String key : t.getAllKeys()) kits.put(key, KitInfo.load(t.getCompound(key)));
            }
            all.put(deck, kits);
        }
    }

    private static CompoundTag saveParams(Map<DeckType, DeckParams> all) {
        CompoundTag out = new CompoundTag();
        for (Map.Entry<DeckType, DeckParams> e : all.entrySet()) out.put(e.getKey().id, e.getValue().save());
        return out;
    }

    private static void loadParams(CompoundTag in, Map<DeckType, DeckParams> all) {
        for (DeckType deck : DeckType.VALUES) {
            all.put(deck, in.contains(deck.id, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND) ? DeckParams.load(in.getCompound(deck.id), deck) : DeckParams.defaultsFor(deck));
        }
    }

    private static CompoundTag saveVotes(Map<UUID, DeckType> votes) {
        CompoundTag out = new CompoundTag();
        votes.forEach((uuid, deck) -> out.putString(uuid.toString(), deck.id));
        return out;
    }

    private static void loadVotes(CompoundTag in, Map<UUID, DeckType> votes) {
        votes.clear();
        for (String key : in.getAllKeys()) {
            DeckType deck = DeckType.fromId(in.getString(key));
            if (deck == null) continue;
            try { votes.put(UUID.fromString(key), deck); } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) { }
        }
    }

    private void saveDeckData(CompoundTag tag) {
        tag.putInt("DataVersion", DATA_VERSION);
        CompoundTag dd = new CompoundTag();
        dd.put("BlueKits", saveKits(blueDeckKits));
        dd.put("RedKits", saveKits(redDeckKits));
        dd.put("BlueParams", saveParams(blueDeckParams));
        dd.put("RedParams", saveParams(redDeckParams));
        if (blueDeck != null) dd.putString("BlueDeck", blueDeck.id);
        if (redDeck != null) dd.putString("RedDeck", redDeck.id);
        dd.putString("Phase", prepPhase.name());
        dd.putInt("PhaseTimer", prepTimer);
        dd.put("BlueVotes", saveVotes(blueDeckVotes));
        dd.put("RedVotes", saveVotes(redDeckVotes));
        dd.putBoolean("LobbyDisabled", lobbyDisabled);
        dd.putBoolean("HubsOverridden", hubsOverridden);
        dd.putInt("PrevBlueHubs", prevMaxBlueHubs);
        dd.putInt("PrevRedHubs", prevMaxRedHubs);
        tag.put("DeckData", dd);
    }

    /** New format, or migration of an old world (no DataVersion / DeckData tag). */
    private void loadDeckData(CompoundTag tag) {
        if (tag.contains("DataVersion") && tag.contains("DeckData", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND)) {
            CompoundTag dd = tag.getCompound("DeckData");
            loadKits(dd.getCompound("BlueKits"), blueDeckKits);
            loadKits(dd.getCompound("RedKits"), redDeckKits);
            loadParams(dd.getCompound("BlueParams"), blueDeckParams);
            loadParams(dd.getCompound("RedParams"), redDeckParams);
            blueDeck = DeckType.fromId(dd.getString("BlueDeck"));
            redDeck = DeckType.fromId(dd.getString("RedDeck"));
            prepPhase = DeckPhase.fromName(dd.getString("Phase"));
            prepTimer = dd.getInt("PhaseTimer");
            loadVotes(dd.getCompound("BlueVotes"), blueDeckVotes);
            loadVotes(dd.getCompound("RedVotes"), redDeckVotes);
            lobbyDisabled = dd.getBoolean("LobbyDisabled");
            hubsOverridden = dd.getBoolean("HubsOverridden");
            prevMaxBlueHubs = dd.contains("PrevBlueHubs") ? dd.getInt("PrevBlueHubs") : maxBlueHubs;
            prevMaxRedHubs = dd.contains("PrevRedHubs") ? dd.getInt("PrevRedHubs") : maxRedHubs;
            dataVersion = tag.getInt("DataVersion");
        } else {
            migrateLegacy(tag);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Old world: everything that existed before decks goes into the COMBINED deck of both teams
     * (kits, starting tickets = the saved ticket counts, hub limit = maxBlueHubs / maxRedHubs).
     * The other 6 decks stay empty with default settings. Saved in the new format at the next save, so it runs once.
     */
    private void migrateLegacy(CompoundTag tag) {
        Map<String, KitInfo> bk = kitsFor("BLUE", DeckType.COMBINED);
        Map<String, KitInfo> rk = kitsFor("RED", DeckType.COMBINED);
        if (tag.contains("BlueKits")) {
            CompoundTag t = tag.getCompound("BlueKits");
            for (String key : t.getAllKeys()) bk.put(key, KitInfo.load(t.getCompound(key)));
        }
        if (tag.contains("RedKits")) {
            CompoundTag t = tag.getCompound("RedKits");
            for (String key : t.getAllKeys()) rk.put(key, KitInfo.load(t.getCompound(key)));
        }
        DeckParams bp = paramsFor("BLUE", DeckType.COMBINED);
        bp.tickets = blueTickets;
        bp.hubLimit = maxBlueHubs;
        bp.clamp();
        DeckParams rp = paramsFor("RED", DeckType.COMBINED);
        rp.tickets = redTickets;
        rp.hubLimit = maxRedHubs;
        rp.clamp();
        dataVersion = DATA_VERSION;
        setDirty();
    }

    public static class StationInfo {
        public BlockPos pos;
        public String team;
        public String dimension;

        public StationInfo(BlockPos pos, String team, String dimension) {
            this.pos = pos;
            this.team = team;
            this.dimension = dimension;
        }

        public CompoundTag save() {
            CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
            tag.putLong("Pos", pos.asLong());
            tag.putString("Team", team);
            tag.putString("Dim", dimension);
            return tag;
        }

        public static StationInfo load(CompoundTag tag) {
            return new StationInfo(BlockPos.of(tag.getLong("Pos")), tag.getString("Team"), tag.getString("Dim"));
        }
    }

    public static AASWorldData get(ServerLevel level) {
        String dimId = level.dimension().location().toString().replace(":", "_");
        String dataName = "aas_data_" + dimId;

        return level.getDataStorage().computeIfAbsent(AASWorldData::load, AASWorldData::new, dataName);
    }

        public static HubInfo load(CompoundTag tag) {

            String d = tag.contains("Dimension") ? tag.getString("Dimension") : "minecraft:overworld";
            String b = tag.contains("Builder") ? tag.getString("Builder") : ""; // <--- Р В§Р ВР СћР С’Р вЂўР Сљ Р РЋР СћР В Р С›Р ВР СћР вЂўР вЂєР Р‡

            HubInfo h = new HubInfo(p, t, c, d, b);

            if (tag.contains("Materials")) h.materials = tag.getInt("Materials");
            return h;
